articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian
paras.zh: 卓越的非公路制动和摩擦性能均来自意大利

paras.en: SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.
paras.zh: SK Wellman 是一家专门生产非公路用制动和摩擦部件的公司，拥有活跃的基因。工厂仍位于 Orzinuovi (Bs) 的历史现实中，多年来，它经历了转型和变化，从而使其成为今天的样子：一家不断发展的公司，能够不断发展对意大利当地领土的忠诚度，并在全球范围内以创造力和灵活性创新其行业。如今，作为 CentroMotion 集团及其 Carlisle 制动与摩擦部门的一部分，SK Wellman 已成为该领域的领导者，受到土方、农业和建筑机械领域主要品牌的认可和选择。摩擦工程全球总监工程师 Alessandro Gamba 向我们介绍了持续增长的情况。

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.
paras.zh: “S.K. Wellman S.R.L. 拥有 340 名员工，到 2023 年营业额将达到 1.27 亿美元，”Gamba 开始说道。在过去的五年里，强大的推动力来自于市场，但最重要的是来自 SK 的特点，如创造力、创新性、灵活性，归根结底，这些都是这家公司最大财富的结果：“人”。正是他们使这家位于布雷西亚的公司成为一家真正的、顽强的公司，以至于不仅能够成功出口他们的产品，而且能够将他们的技能和设计技能出口到卡莱尔制动和摩擦部门的其他工厂。刚刚结束的 2023 年，仅销售收入就实现了积极的表现，与上一个出色的 2022 财年相比，略有下降 -5%；对于布雷西亚和非布雷西亚经济的许多现实来说，后者可能是不可重复的一年。事实上，2023 年无疑是变革的一年，帮助人们培养了更强的能力来管理不确定性，以更强的韧性接受和处理意外情况。

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.
paras.zh: 工程师解释说：“成功的基础是通过集团治理形成的矩阵组织：所有职能和技能的垂直驱动，能够在全球范围内定义和指导流程并产生最佳实践。而这还不是全部，”Gamba 补充道，“我们是人员流动率最低的公司之一，这使我们能够将长期与我们在一起的人的经验传授给我们特别关注的年轻人。除此之外，公司人口还来自 15 个不同的国家，他们的强有力的合作创造了真正宁静的工作氛围，”人力资源经理说道。成长的方向尤其是社会责任并非巧合。

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.
paras.zh: 他指出，“SK Wellman 和 Carlisle 的主要项目中，最突出的是 Enactus，这是一家国际非营利组织，通过其活动，让大学生参与创建可持续创业项目，帮助缩小大学和企业之间的差距；然后是 Treedom，该公司承诺在三年内种植 1,600 棵树，并让利益相关者参与到该项目中”。金属加工行业还有两颗稀有宝石吗？工作事故率接近于零，并且以人才发展为中心。迈向卓越并超越。

paras.en: Source: Il Corriere della Sera – edizione Lombardia
paras.zh: 资料来源：《晚邮报》——伦巴第版

paras.zh: 请参观位于印度大诺伊达/德里 NCR 印度博览中心 bauma CONEXPO INDIA 2024 15 号展厅 F01 号展位的 Carlisle Brake & Friction。印度 bauma CONEXPO 将于 2024 年 12 月 11 日至 14 日举行。

paras.zh: bauma CONEXPO INDIA 是工程机械、建材机械、采矿机械和工程车辆的国际贸易展览会，是行业的心跳和国际成功引擎、创新驱动力和市场。

articles.title: A Holiday Season of Giving

paras.en: This holiday season, Carlisle Brake & Friction’s Medina location is proud to support 15 children of our colleagues who could use a little extra cheer. Our employees have generously donated toys, clothing, and other essential items to bring joy to these young lives.
paras.zh: 这个假期，Carlisle Brake & Friction 的麦地那办事处很荣幸能够为我们同事的 15 名孩子提供支持，他们需要一点额外的欢乐。我们的员工慷慨捐赠玩具、衣服和其他必需品，为这些年轻的生命带来欢乐。

paras.en: By coming together as a team, we’re demonstrating our commitment to making a positive impact on our community. We’re grateful for the kindness and generosity of our employees, and we hope this initiative will bring warmth and happiness to the children who receive these gifts.
paras.zh: 通过作为一个团队聚集在一起，我们展示了我们对为社区产生积极影响的承诺。我们感谢员工的善意和慷慨，希望这一举措能为收到这些礼物的孩子们带来温暖和快乐。

paras.en: Want to join us in spreading holiday cheer? Consider donating to Toys for Tots. This incredible organization ensures that every child experiences the joy of Christmas. Visit their website to find a drop-off location near you.
paras.zh: 想和我们一起传播节日的欢乐吗？考虑向 Toys for Tots 捐款。这个令人难以置信的组织确保每个孩子都能体验到圣诞节的欢乐。访问他们的网站查找您附近的下车地点。

articles.title: Allstate planning round of layoffs in restructuring with AI push
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: P&C Specialist reports Allstate plans to lay off up to 10% of its employees under a company restructuring “aimed at streamlining operations in an AI-driven efficiency push.”
paras.zh: P&C Specialist 报告称，Allstate 计划在公司重组中裁员多达 10%，“旨在通过人工智能驱动的效率提升来简化运营”。

paras.en: Sources didn’t confirm the exact number; however, they said up to 10% of Allstate’s workforce could be affected, according to the article. The company’s 2025 annual report states that it employs 53,000.
paras.zh: 消息人士没有证实确切的数字；然而，据文章称，Allstate 多达 10% 的员工可能会受到影响。该公司 2025 年年度报告称，拥有 53,000 名员工。

paras.en: “Layoffs hit across the organization, including at unit National General and in customer service, underwriting, legal, inside sales, casualty, design, human resources, information technology, claims and support, said sources, who asked not to be named, discussing internal issues,” the article states. “The cuts are not tied to individual performance but stem from broader organizational realignment at Allstate, they said.”
paras.zh: 文章称，“整个组织都遭到了裁员，包括国家综合部门以及客户服务、承保、法律、内部销售、伤亡、设计、人力资源、信息技术、索赔和支持部门。”在讨论内部问题时，不愿透露姓名的消息人士称。他们表示：“裁员与个人绩效无关，而是源于好事达更广泛的组织调整。”

paras.en: Allstate hasn’t commented on the reported layoffs.
paras.zh: 好事达尚未对裁员消息发表评论。

paras.en: In its Nov. 5 Q3 earnings call, Allstate CEO Tom Wilson said the company will launch a personal agentic assistant (PAA) next year, which it has been working on for a year.
paras.zh: 在 11 月 5 日的第三季度财报电话会议上，Allstate 首席执行官汤姆·威尔逊 (Tom Wilson) 表示，该公司将于明年推出个人代理助理 (PAA)，该公司已经为此投入了一年的时间。

paras.en: “The advent of personal agentic assistants, or PAAs, gives us the opportunity to serve consumers who prefer to have a machine to handle their transactions, such as Muse, Spark, Dot, you go down the list,” he said. “The introduction of PAAs creates opportunity for Allstate, given our capabilities, and an upcoming launch of our own personal agentic assistant that is focused on protection.
paras.zh: “个人代理助理（PAA）的出现让我们有机会为那些喜欢用机器来处理交易的消费者提供服务，比如 Muse、Spark、Dot，等等，”他说。 “考虑到我们的能力，以及即将推出的专注于保护的个人代理助理，PAA 的推出为 Allstate 创造了机会。

paras.en: “To thrive in this world of highly sophisticated agents, you need sophisticated pricing, since they’re likely going to do more price comparisons. Secondly, some consumers may still have a brand preference or want a local agent, so we have a broad set of opportunities for them. When ALLIE [Allstate’s Large Language Intelligent Ecosystem] is fully deployed, and the PAAs have expanded their capabilities, this will give customers straight-through processing on servicing claims… Its value proposition includes more accurate pricing, given our insurance expertise, than the general-purpose PAAs will have.”
paras.zh: “要在这个高度复杂的代理世界中蓬勃发展，您需要复杂的定价，因为他们可能会进行更多的价格比较。其次，一些消费者可能仍然有品牌偏好或想要本地代理，因此我们为他们提供了广泛的机会。当 ALLIE [Allstate 的大语言智能生态系统] 全面部署，并且 PAA 扩展了其功能时，这将为客户提供直接的服务索赔处理……考虑到我们的保险专业知识，其价值主张包括比通用 PAA 更准确的定价。有。”

paras.en: Allstate began designing and building ALLIE several years ago, according to Wilson, who noted in the call that “like most companies, we are using AI to do an increasing amount of coding.”
paras.zh: Wilson 表示，Allstate 几年前就开始设计和构建 ALLIE，他在电话中指出，“像大多数公司一样，我们正在使用人工智能来进行越来越多的编码。”

paras.en: In Q3, Allstate used AI to write over 12 million lines of code — 3.6 times higher than in Q1, Wilson said. P&C Specialist reported that Allstate also uses AI to generate or review nearly 10 million outbound claim emails annually.
paras.zh: Wilson 表示，第三季度，Allstate 使用 AI 编写了超过 1200 万行代码，是第一季度的 3.6 倍。 P&C Specialist 报告称，Allstate 每年还使用人工智能生成或审查近 1000 万封出站索赔电子邮件。

paras.en: In Q2, Wilson explained that ALLIE uses agentic AI “to improve customer value, lower cost, and increase growth.”
paras.zh: 在第二季度，Wilson 解释说 ALLIE 使用代理人工智能“来提高客户价值、降低成本并促进增长”。

paras.en: P&C Specialist notes that Allstate’s P&C unit underwriting profit fell 30.1% in Q3 to $2.02 billion from Q3 2025.
paras.zh: P&C Specialist 指出，Allstate 的 P&C 部门承保利润在第三季度下降了 30.1%，至 2025 年第三季度的 20.2 亿美元。

paras.en: “The latest cuts follow several rounds of workforce reductions carried out under the carrier’s ‘Transformative Growth Plan,’ which was launched in 2019 to reshape distribution, introduce lower-cost products, and streamline claim processing,” P&C Specialist reports. “In one of the larger downsizings, the insurer cut 3,800 jobs in September 2020. The carrier is also overhauling its exclusive agency network of about 6,000 agents by three operating models based on agency size, staffing, and local presence.”
paras.zh: P&C Specialist 报告称：“最近的裁员是在该航空公司根据 2019 年推出的‘转型增长计划’进行了几轮裁员之后进行的，该计划旨在重塑分销、推出低成本产品并简化索赔处理。” “在规模较大的裁员中，这家保险公司于 2020 年 9 月裁员 3,800 人。该保险公司还根据代理规模、人员配置和当地业务，通过三种运营模式对其约 6,000 名代理人组成的独家代理网络进行彻底改革。”

paras.en: The article notes “a broader trend across the personal lines insurance industry” regarding layoffs.
paras.zh: 文章指出了关于裁员的“整个个人保险行业的更广泛趋势”。

paras.en: “USAA has conducted multiple rounds of layoffs in recent months, with the latest affecting at least 400 employees across its IT department,” the article states. “In October, GEICO cut about 100 employees, most of them in its Florida legal department. Farmers Insurance laid off at least 370 employees in June.”
paras.zh: 文章称：“USAA 近几个月来进行了多轮裁员，最新一次影响了其 IT 部门至少 400 名员工。” “10 月份，GEICO 裁减了大约 100 名员工，其中大部分是佛罗里达州法律部门的员工。Farmers Insurance 6 月份裁掉了至少 370 名员工。”

paras.en: P&C Specialist also reported in September that Allstate plans to shift “routine” customer service away from agents and into “a new service infrastructure” that includes phone, digital self-service tools, centralized service teams, and agentic AI.
paras.zh: P&C Specialist 在 9 月份还报道称，Allstate 计划将“常规”客户服务从代理商转移到“新的服务基础设施”，其中包括电话、数字自助服务工具、集中服务团队和代理人工智能。

paras.en: In May, State Farm changed its compensation and benefits package for 19,000 agents, with some saying it would substantially reduce their earnings.
paras.zh: 今年 5 月，State Farm 改变了 19,000 名代理商的薪酬和福利方案，一些人表示这将大幅减少他们的收入。

paras.en: Chart provided in Allstate Q3 earnings press release
paras.zh: 好事达第三季度收益新闻稿中提供的图表

articles.title: Hurry! School of the Year Nomination Deadline is Near!
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Don’t miss your chance to nominate your school or another deserving educational institution for Tomorrow’s Technician’s 2026/2027 School of the Year competition. WIX Filters is once again partnering with O’Reilly Auto Parts as title sponsors for the national contest that finds and names the best technician training school in the country.
paras.zh: 不要错过提名您的学校或其他值得参加“Tomorrow’s Technician”2026/2027 年度学校竞赛的教育机构的机会。 WIX Filters 再次与 O’Reilly Auto Parts 合作，作为全国竞赛的冠名赞助商，该竞赛旨在寻找并命名该国最好的技术人员培训学校。

paras.en: “There’s a massive difference between the number of automotive professionals retiring or leaving the industry and the number entering to take their place. Due to the rapidly expanding use of technology in today’s vehicles, this is one of the toughest careers to keep educated about. It requires a knowledge of science, math, communications and business skills – not the grease monkey persona that many people believe still exists,” explains Doug Kaufman, editorial director for Tomorrow’s Technician. “Today’s standards of excellence are defined by a combination of education and experience. The future of the automotive sector relies on the dedication of instructors and the commitment of industry partners to develop skilled professionals capable of navigating a rapidly changing landscape. The School of the Year program, sponsored by WIX, honors schools that exemplify the best in automotive education and are dedicated to shaping the future of the industry.”
paras.zh: “退休或离开该行业的汽车专业人士数量与进入该行业的人数之间存在巨大差异。由于当今汽车技术的使用迅速扩大，这是最难接受教育的职业之一。它需要科学、数学、通信和商业技能方面的知识，而不是许多人认为仍然存在的油猴形象，”《明天的技术人员》编辑总监道格·考夫曼解释道。 “当今的卓越标准是由教育和经验相结合来定义的。汽车行业的未来依赖于教师的奉献和行业合作伙伴的承诺，以培养能够驾驭快速变化的环境的熟练专业人员。年度最佳学校计划由 WIX 赞助，旨在表彰在汽车教育领域表现最佳并致力于塑造行业未来的学校。”

paras.en: “The automotive industry needs skilled technicians now more than ever. At WIX Filters, we are committed to supporting the next generation of professionals through programs like ‘School of the Year.’ By investing in these students today, we are helping to build a stronger workforce, support local communities, and ensure that the automotive aftermarket remains strong for years to come” said Carmina Lopez, WIX Filters Brand Manager.
paras.zh: “汽车行业现在比以往任何时候都更需要熟练的技术人员。在 WIX Filters，我们致力于通过‘年度学校’等计划支持下一代专业人士。通过今天投资这些学生，我们正在帮助建立更强大的劳动力队伍，支持当地社区，并确保汽车售后市场在未来几年保持强劲”，WIX Filters 品牌经理 Carmina Lopez 说道。

paras.en: The winning school will receive a visit from Tomorrow’s Technician staff and program sponsors, a $10,000 WIX Filters donation to the school’s program, WIX Filters gear and other prizes to be determined.
paras.zh: 获奖学校将接受“Tomorrow’s Technician”工作人员和项目赞助商的来访、为学校项目捐赠 10,000 美元的 WIX Filters、WIX Filters 装备和其他待确定的奖品。

paras.en: The Top 20 schools will also receive national recognition through Tomorrow’s Technician’s digital platforms. Each of the three schools selected as runners-up will receive special recognition as well.
paras.zh: 排名前 20 的学校还将通过“明天的技术人员”的数字平台获得全国认可。被选为亚军的三所学校也将获得特别认可。

paras.en: Click here to nominate your school today. The deadline for initial nominations is Friday, December 4, 2026.
paras.zh: 单击此处立即提名您的学校。初次提名的截止日期为 2026 年 12 月 4 日星期五。

articles.title: CREF Awards Deliver $475K to Collision Schools
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Collision Repair Education Foundation (CREF) announced that 71 collision schools will receive a combined $475,000 through its 2026 Benchmark Awards program. Recipients were announced at CREF’s Benchmark Awards Breakfast held Nov. 4 in Las Vegas during the 2026 SEMA Show.
paras.zh: 碰撞修复教育基金会 (CREF) 宣布，71 所碰撞学校将通过其 2026 年基准奖计划获得总计 475,000 美元的资金。获奖者名单于 11 月 4 日在拉斯维加斯 2026 年 SEMA 展期间举行的 CREF 基准奖早餐会上公布。

paras.en: Schools were selected through CREF’s 2026 Collision School Career Readiness Benchmark Awards program, which provides financial assistance to help collision education programs overcome budgetary limitations and prepare students for careers. Benchmark Awards can be used, in line with the award category, to enhance program capabilities, attract new students or fuel innovative approaches to collision education.
paras.zh: 学校是通过 CREF 的 2026 年碰撞学校职业准备基准奖励计划选出的，该计划提供财政援助，帮助碰撞教育项目克服预算限制，为学生的职业生涯做好准备。根据奖项类别，基准奖可用于增强项目能力、吸引新生或推动碰撞教育的创新方法。

paras.en: These funds will help instructors strengthen programs, invest in tools and equipment, and provide hands-on training and technical skills. Based on current enrollment figures, the investments are expected to benefit more than 3,580 students this year, with improvements continuing to support future classes.
paras.zh: 这些资金将帮助教师加强课程、投资工具和设备，并提供实践培训和技术技能。根据目前的入学人数，今年的投资预计将使超过 3,580 名学生受益，并继续改进以支持未来的课程。

paras.en: “Congratulations to the 2026 Benchmark Award recipients,” said Brenda Hogen, chair of CREF. “The Collision Repair Education Foundation is incredibly grateful to our industry partners whose generosity makes these awards possible year after year. Their continued investment demonstrates a shared commitment to strengthening collision education and ensuring that the next generation of repair professionals has the knowledge and skills needed to succeed in our industry. I also want to recognize the dedicated instructors who take the time to apply for these awards, demonstrating their determination to provide students with the best possible education despite the challenges they face.
paras.zh: CREF 主席布伦达·霍根 (Brenda Hogen) 表示：“祝贺 2026 年基准奖获得者。” “碰撞修复教育基金会非常感谢我们的行业合作伙伴的慷慨捐助，年复一年地获得了这些奖项。他们的持续投资表明了我们对加强碰撞教育并确保下一代维修专业人员拥有在我们行业取得成功所需的知识和技能的共同承诺。我还要感谢那些花时间申请这些奖项的敬业讲师，这表明他们决心为学生提供尽可能最好的教育，尽管他们面临挑战。

paras.en: “Collision repair programs are the foundation of our industry’s future workforce, and the instructors leading those programs play an essential role in preparing students for successful careers. By connecting industry support with schools in need, CREF helps educators strengthen their programs, expand opportunities for hands-on learning and better prepare students to enter the workforce. We’re proud to be part of that process and grateful to the many organizations that recognize the importance of investing in tomorrow’s collision professionals.”
paras.zh: “碰撞修复项目是我们行业未来劳动力的基础，领导这些项目的讲师在为学生成功职业生涯做好准备方面发挥着至关重要的作用。通过将行业支持与有需要的学校联系起来，CREF 帮助教育工作者加强他们的项目，扩大实践学习的机会，并更好地为学生进入劳动力市场做好准备。我们很自豪能够参与这一过程，并感谢许多组织认识到投资未来碰撞专业人员的重要性。”

paras.en: Added CREF Director of Operations and Impact Melissa Marscin, “For the schools receiving these awards, that industry support translates into opportunities to address some of the most persistent challenges facing collision repair education. Many instructors struggle just to maintain their existing equipment and resources, making it even more difficult to introduce new technologies, update training materials or expand their programs to keep pace with an evolving industry. The Benchmark Awards help bridge that financial gap by providing schools with resources they might otherwise be unable to afford, ultimately creating stronger learning environments for students preparing to enter the collision repair workforce.
paras.zh: CREF 运营和影响总监 Melissa Marscin 补充道：“对于获得这些奖项的学校来说，行业支持转化为解决碰撞修复教育面临的一些最持久挑战的机会。许多讲师只是为了维护现有的设备和资源而苦苦挣扎，这使得引进新技术、更新培训材料或扩展项目以跟上不断发展的行业的步伐变得更加困难。基准奖通过为学校提供他们可能无法负担的资源来帮助缩小财务差距，最终为准备进入碰撞修复队伍的学生创造更强大的学习环境。

paras.en: “Every dollar invested in collision education has the potential to make a lasting difference. The impact of these awards extends well beyond the students currently enrolled. The tools, equipment and program improvements made possible by this funding will continue benefiting future classes for years to come. We’re thankful to the industry supporters who make that possible and to the instructors who work tirelessly to ensure their students are prepared for the opportunities ahead.”
paras.zh: “投资于碰撞教育的每一美元都有可能产生持久的影响。这些奖项的影响远远超出了目前就读的学生。这笔资金所带来的工具、设备和项目的改进将在未来几年继续使未来的课程受益。我们感谢使这一切成为可能的行业支持者，也感谢为确保学生为未来的机会做好准备的教师们的不懈努力。”

paras.en: That collaboration is reflected in a new approach to funding the 2026 Benchmark Awards, which provides flexibility in directing resources to collision education programs while recognizing industry partners based on their support across funding levels.
paras.zh: 这种合作体现在为 2026 年基准奖提供资金的新方法中，该方法可以灵活地将资源用于碰撞教育项目，同时根据行业合作伙伴在各个资助级别的支持来表彰他们。

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Foundation Awards 24 Scholarships
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Advance Auto Parts Foundation today announced the recipients of its 2026 scholarship program, awarding 24 scholarships to students pursuing higher education. The annual program helps family members of Advance Auto Parts team members continue their education and work toward earning degrees.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts Foundation 今天宣布了 2026 年奖学金计划的获得者，向接受高等教育的学生颁发了 24 份奖学金。该年度计划帮助 Advance Auto Parts 团队成员的家庭成员继续接受教育并努力获得学位。

paras.en: This year’s recipients stood out for their academic achievement, leadership, community involvement, personal accomplishments and future goals. Each student will receive a one-time scholarship of $3,500 to support their education.
paras.zh: 今年的获奖者在学术成就、领导力、社区参与、个人成就和未来目标方面脱颖而出。每位学生将获得 3,500 美元的一次性奖学金，以支持他们的学业。

paras.en: “Supporting our team members also means supporting their families, and we’re proud to recognize these students and their achievements,” said Anthony Sarlanis, president of the Advance Auto Parts Foundation and senior vice president, professional at Advance Auto Parts. “Their hard work and dedication have earned this recognition, and we’re proud to help them take the next step in their education. We congratulate each recipient and look forward to seeing all they accomplish in the years ahead.”
paras.zh: “支持我们的团队成员也意味着支持他们的家庭，我们很自豪能够认可这些学生和他们的成就，”Advance Auto Parts 基金会主席兼 Advance Auto Parts 专业高级副总裁 Anthony Sarlanis 说道。 “他们的辛勤工作和奉献精神赢得了这一认可，我们很自豪能够帮助他们在教育上迈出下一步。我们祝贺每位获奖者，并期待看到他们在未来几年取得的成就。”

paras.en: For more than two decades, the Advance Auto Parts Foundation has helped team members’ families pursue higher education, awarding $2.3 million in scholarships since 2003.
paras.zh: 二十多年来，Advance Auto Parts 基金会一直帮助团队成员的家庭接受高等教育，自 2003 年以来提供了 230 万美元的奖学金。

paras.en: The scholarship program honors the legacy of O. Temple Sloan Jr., founder of General Parts International and Carquest, which Advance Auto Parts acquired in 2014. The program reflects the company’s longstanding commitment to supporting team members and their families through scholarships for students pursuing college or vocational training.

articles.title: AutoZone’s Phil Daniele on ‘Putting Customers First’
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Phil Daniele, president and CEO of customer satisfaction at AutoZone.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 AutoZone 客户满意度总裁兼首席执行官 Phil Daniele。

paras.en: Daniele said the company’s commercial business has evolved significantly as it continues investing in the professional repair market. With commercial sales approaching $6 billion and programs in approximately 95% of its stores, AutoZone is strengthening its product quality, availability and delivery capabilities to better serve repair shops. Daniele emphasized the importance of OE-quality or better products, including its Duralast portfolio, alongside expanded assortments through its hub and mega hub strategy. Investments in technology, inventory optimization and a dedicated professional sales force are helping AutoZone get the right parts to shops faster while building stronger customer relationships.
paras.zh: Daniele 表示，随着公司继续投资专业维修市场，其商业业务已取得显着发展。 AutoZone 的商业销售额接近 60 亿美元，并在其约 95% 的商店中实施了该计划，因此正在加强其产品质量、可用性和交付能力，以更好地为维修店提供服务。 Daniele 强调了原厂品质或更好产品的重要性，包括其 Duralast 产品组合，以及通过其中心和大型中心战略扩大的品种。对技术、库存优化和专业销售队伍的投资正在帮助 AutoZone 更快地将合适的零件送到商店，同时建立更牢固的客户关系。

paras.en: AutoZone’s recent milestone of 8,000 stores globally reflects decades of expansion and continued growth opportunities, Daniele explained. The company also celebrated its 1,000th store in Mexico, expanded distribution capabilities there and broke ground on another facility. Looking ahead, AutoZone plans to continue opening stores across the United States, Mexico and Brazil. Daniele said that expansion creates opportunities not only to serve more customers but also to develop future leaders within the organization. AutoZone’s promote-from-within culture has helped employees build long-term careers, with many executives beginning their careers in stores.
paras.zh: Daniele 解释说，AutoZone 最近在全球拥有 8,000 家门店的里程碑反映了数十年的扩张和持续增长机会。该公司还庆祝其在墨西哥开设第 1,000 家商店，扩大了当地的分销能力，并在另一家工厂破土动工。展望未来，AutoZone 计划继续在美国、墨西哥和巴西开设门店。 Daniele 表示，扩张不仅创造了服务更多客户的机会，而且还为组织内培养未来的领导者创造了机会。 AutoZone 的内部晋升文化帮助员工建立了长期的职业生涯，许多高管都是在商店开始他们的职业生涯的。

paras.en: Delivering strong customer service remains central to AutoZone’s culture and operating philosophy. Daniele said empowering approximately 130,000 AutoZoners to consistently exceed customer expectations requires strong systems, processes and accountability. That means delivering quality parts quickly, ensuring accurate transactions and understanding each customer’s specific needs. Daniele emphasized that every interaction, from sales representatives to delivery drivers, contributes to the customer experience. By combining operational execution with a customer-first mindset, AutoZone aims to strengthen relationships and deliver the level of service that keeps customers coming back.
paras.zh: 提供强大的客户服务仍然是 AutoZone 文化和运营理念的核心。 Daniele 表示，要让大约 130,000 名 AutoZoners 持续超越客户期望，需要强大的系统、流程和问责制。这意味着快速交付优质零件，确保准确的交易并了解每个客户的具体需求。 Daniele 强调，从销售代表到送货司机的每一次互动都有助于提升客户体验。通过将运营执行与客户至上的理念相结合，AutoZone 旨在加强关系并提供高水平的服务，让客户成为回头客。

paras.zh: 要了解 Daniele 的更多见解，请务必观看上面的视频。

articles.title: Federated Auto Parts Holiday Diecast Giveaway Announced
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Federated Auto Parts announced the start of its annual diecast giveaway. Five winners of a limited-edition Federated collectible will be announced each Friday on the Federated Facebook pages beginning Nov. 13, with the final winners announced on Dec. 11.
paras.zh: 联邦汽车零部件公司宣布开始年度压铸赠品活动。从 11 月 13 日开始，Federated 限量版收藏品的五名获奖者将于每周五在 Federated Facebook 页面上公布，最终获奖者将于 12 月 11 日公布。

paras.en: “The holiday season is the perfect time to give back to our Facebook followers, and our annual diecast giveaway is one way we can show our appreciation,” said John Marcum, director of marketing at Federated Auto Parts. “These limited-edition Federated collectibles are sure to be a hit with the winners, whether they add them to their collections, give them as stocking stuffers or keep them as a special holiday treat.”
paras.zh: Federated Auto Parts 营销总监约翰·马库姆 (John Marcum) 表示：“节日季是回馈 Facebook 粉丝的最佳时机，每年的压铸赠品是我们表达谢意的一种方式。” “这些限量版联邦收藏品肯定会受到获奖者的欢迎，无论他们将它们添加到他们的收藏中，将它们作为圣诞礼物还是将它们作为特殊的节日礼物。”

paras.en: To enter for a chance to win, visit Federated Auto Parts and Federated Car Care on Facebook by Dec. 3 and click on the mobile link in the first post to complete the entry form. Participants can earn extra entries by sharing the contest with Facebook friends.
paras.zh: 要获得获奖机会，请于 12 月 3 日之前访问 Facebook 上的 Federated Auto Parts 和 Federated Car Care，然后单击第一篇文章中的移动链接来填写报名表。参与者可以通过与 Facebook 好友分享比赛来赚取额外的参赛资格。

articles.title: Porsche TPMS: The First Carmaker To The Game
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Porsche was the first manufacturer to use a tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) on a vehicle in 1986 for the 959 supercar. The 959 was another first because it was equipped with world’s first self-supporting run-flat tires made by Bridgestone. This TPMS setup was again used on the 928 for model years 1990 to 1994.
paras.zh: 保时捷于 1986 年在 959 超级跑车上成为第一家在车辆上使用轮胎压力监测系统 (TPMS) 的制造商。 959 是另一个第一，因为它配备了世界上第一款由普利司通制造的自支撑防爆轮胎。该 TPMS 设置再次在 1990 至 1994 年的 928 车型上使用。

paras.en: The 959 did not have a spare tire as standard equipment. Instead, the dealership would dispatch a technician with a spare if a customer had a flat or loss of inflation. The run-flat tires could be driven for a limited distance at 50mph. The wheels used a system that locked a compatible tire into a channel that locked the bead to the wheel. This was called the Denloc system and prevented the tire from coming off the rim and suddenly deflating in the event of a puncture. The rims also used an innovative hollow-spoke system.
paras.zh: 959 没有标配备胎。相反，如果客户出现故障或通货膨胀损失，经销商会派遣一名技术人员携带备件。缺气保用轮胎可以以 50 英里/小时的速度行驶有限的距离。车轮使用了一个系统，将兼容的轮胎锁定到一个通道中，将胎圈锁定到车轮上。这被称为 Denloc 系统，可防止轮胎在发生刺穿时脱离轮辋并突然泄气。轮圈还采用了创新的空心辐条系统。

paras.en: The early system used tire pressure sensors mounted in special holes in the valley of the wheel. This early tire pressure monitoring system was known as RDK, or Reifen Druck Kontrolle, which roughly translates to Tire Pressure Control.
paras.zh: 早期的系统使用安装在车轮凹槽中的特殊孔内的轮胎压力传感器。这种早期的轮胎气压监测系统被称为 RDK，即 Reifen Druck Kontrolle，大致翻译为“轮胎气压控制”。

paras.en: The sensors looked like a stack of poker chips. A diaphragm inside the sensors connected to switches that were set to a reference pressure. The receiver was mounted on the knuckle and was an inductive coil that would pass current through the sensors wirelessly. Depending on the position of the diaphragm and which switches were open or closed, the amount of current flowing through the receiver’s coils, would change the voltage.
paras.zh: 传感器看起来就像一堆扑克筹码。传感器内部的隔膜连接到设置为参考压力的开关。接收器安装在指关节上，是一个感应线圈，可以无线方式通过传感器传递电流。根据隔膜的位置以及打开或关闭的开关，流经接收器线圈的电流量会改变电压。

paras.en: In 2004, Porsche started to use a conventional TPMS system for the Cayenne and select Boxster and 911 models. These systems were a lot like those found on BMW, Mercedes-Benz and Audi vehicles.
paras.zh: 2004 年，保时捷开始在 Cayenne 以及部分 Boxster 和 911 车型上使用传统的 TPMS 系统。这些系统与宝马、梅赛德斯-奔驰和奥迪汽车上的系统非常相似。

paras.en: Porsche TPMS systems use four antennas mounted in the wheel wells and a designated module for the tire pressure. The sensors use a 433mHz frequency. On most models, the menu will have the option for two sets of tires and sensor IDs for summer and winter tires.
paras.zh: 保时捷 TPMS 系统使用安装在轮舱中的四个天线和一个指定的轮胎压力模块。传感器使用 433mHz 频率。在大多数车型上，菜单将提供两组轮胎以及夏季和冬季轮胎的传感器 ID 的选项。

paras.en: The system has a telltale malfunction indicator light and a low-pressure light. When the system detects a malfunction, the telltale light will flash for approximately one minute, and then will remain continuously illuminated. This sequence will continue upon subsequent vehicle startups, as long as the malfunction exists.
paras.zh: 该系统有一个指示故障的指示灯和一个低压灯。当系统检测到故障时，警示灯将闪烁大约一分钟，然后持续亮起。只要故障存在，后续车辆启动时就会继续执行此序列。

paras.en: If a sensor is not transmitting, the warning light in the speedometer flashes for one minute, and then remains continuously illuminated. Codes and data from the TPMS control module can be accessed with a scan tool. If there is a problem, it is typically communication errors with the four receivers in the wheel wells.
paras.zh: 如果传感器未进行传输，车速表中的警告灯会闪烁一分钟，然后持续亮起。可以使用扫描工具访问 TPMS 控制模块的代码和数据。如果出现问题，通常是轮舱中四个接收器的通信错误。

paras.en: It is also important to remember that the TPMS module starts hunting for sensor signals the second the ignition is turned on. Leaving the ignition in the “on” position when a wheel is removed may cause the information display to say, “Wheel change? Input new TPM settings.” Also, if the second set of wheels is in the vicinity of the vehicle, the same warning could be set.
paras.zh: 同样重要的是要记住，TPMS 模块在点火开关打开的那一刻就开始寻找传感器信号。拆下车轮后，将点火装置保持在“打开”位置可能会导致信息显示屏显示“更换车轮？输入新的 TPM 设置”。此外，如果第二组车轮位于车辆附近，则可以设置相同的警告。

paras.en: Before starting any relearn process, set the tire to the pressure specified in the doorjamb for the cold temperature. The relearn process starts with turning the ignition on, accessing the vehicle’s computer and entering into the tire pressure control menu. On most models, you will need to select the winter or summer set of tires. The system will then start to learn the sensor IDs and positions.
paras.zh: 在开始任何重新学习过程之前，将轮胎设置为门框上指定的低温压力。重新学习过程从打开点火开关、访问车辆计算机并进入轮胎压力控制菜单开始。在大多数车型上，您需要选择冬季或夏季轮胎。然后系统将开始学习传感器 ID 和位置。

paras.en: The onboard computer displays the message “TPM is learning.” The process may take 2 to 10 minutes, and the vehicle speed needs to be above 15-16 mph. During this time, the current tire pressures are not available on the display. The tire pressure warning light will remain lit until all wheels have been learned.
paras.zh: 车载计算机显示消息“TPM 正在学习”。该过程可能需要 2 到 10 分钟，车速需要高于 15-16 英里/小时。在此期间，显示屏上不会显示当前轮胎压力。轮胎压力警告灯将一直亮起，直到所有车轮都被学习为止。

paras.en: Position and pressure information will be displayed as soon as the TPMS system has assigned the wheels identified as belonging to the vehicle and to the correct wheel positions.
paras.zh: 一旦 TPMS 系统将识别为属于车辆的车轮分配到正确的车轮位置，就会显示位置和压力​​信息。

articles.title: Sonic Tools USA Relaunches Next S15 13-Drawer Toolbox
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Sonic Tools USA has relaunched its Next S15 toolbox, a 13-drawer storage unit with a load capacity of more than one ton. The toolbox can scale from a mobile service cart to a full-capacity tool center for technicians, shops and fleets.
paras.zh: Sonic Tools USA 重新推出了 Next S15 工具箱，这是一款具有 13 个抽屉的存储单元，负载能力超过一吨。该工具箱可以从移动服务车扩展到面向技术人员、商店和车队的全功能工具中心。

paras.en: The Next S15 measures 46.5 inches high, 65 inches wide and 26 inches deep. It includes molded bumpers, integrated side pockets, two spray can holders and a paper roll holder.
paras.zh: Next S15 尺寸为 46.5 英寸高、65 英寸宽、26 英寸深。它包括模制保险杠、集成侧袋、两个喷雾罐支架和一个纸卷支架。

paras.en: According to the company, the toolbox uses ball-bearing drawer slides with soft-close technology and provides full-extension access on all 13 drawers. An advanced drawer-blocking system provides anti-tilt protection. A stainless steel worktop with integrated side pockets comes standard for shop use and tire maintenance operations.
paras.zh: 据该公司称，该工具箱采用滚珠轴承抽屉滑轨和软关闭技术，并为所有 13 个抽屉提供完全伸展的通道。先进的抽屉阻挡系统提供防倾斜保护。带有集成侧袋的不锈钢工作台是商店使用和轮胎维护操作的标准配置。

paras.en: Applications range from compact quick-service carts to large-format storage for high-volume service and tire repair facilities, the company said.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，应用范围从紧凑型快速服务推车到用于大容量服务和轮胎修理设施的大型存储。

paras.en: The relaunch includes a redesigned foam insert system. Two medium foam inserts can combine to form one large insert to accommodate growing tool sets. Existing foam inserts transfer directly into the S15, allowing users to maintain their current layouts without rebuilding configurations, the company said.
paras.zh: 重新推出包括重新设计的泡沫插入系统。两个中等泡沫嵌件可以组合成一个大嵌件，以容纳不断增长的工具套件。该公司表示，现有的泡沫插入物可直接转移到 S15 中，允许用户保持当前的布局，而无需重建配置。

paras.en: - How AutoZone’s hub and mega hub strategy and professional sales force support its growing commercial business. (11:07)
paras.zh: - AutoZone 的枢纽和大型枢纽战略以及专业销售队伍如何支持其不断增长的商业业务。 (11:07)

paras.en: - What AutoZone’s 8,000-store milestone represents for future expansion and employee career opportunities. (15:21)
paras.zh: - AutoZone 的 8,000 家门店里程碑对未来的扩张和员工职业机会意味着什么。 （15:21）

paras.en: - How AutoZone empowers 130,000 AutoZoners to consistently deliver WOW customer service. (21:34)
paras.zh: - AutoZone 如何帮助 130,000 名 AutoZoner 持续提供令人惊叹的客户服务。 (21:34)

articles.title: Federated Auto Parts Launches Holiday Diecast Giveaway
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Federated Auto Parts announced the start of its annual diecast giveaway. Five winners of a limited-edition Federated collectible will be announced each Friday on the Federated Facebook pages beginning Nov. 13, with the final winners announced on Dec. 11.
paras.zh: 联邦汽车零部件公司宣布开始年度压铸赠品活动。从 11 月 13 日开始，Federated 限量版收藏品的五名获奖者将于每周五在 Federated Facebook 页面上公布，最终获奖者将于 12 月 11 日公布。

paras.en: “The holiday season is the perfect time to give back to our Facebook followers, and our annual diecast giveaway is one way we can show our appreciation,” said John Marcum, director of marketing at Federated Auto Parts. “These limited-edition Federated collectibles are sure to be a hit with the winners, whether they add them to their collections, give them as stocking stuffers or keep them as a special holiday treat.”
paras.zh: Federated Auto Parts 营销总监约翰·马库姆 (John Marcum) 表示：“节日季是回馈 Facebook 粉丝的最佳时机，每年的压铸赠品是我们表达谢意的一种方式。” “这些限量版联邦收藏品肯定会受到获奖者的欢迎，无论他们将它们添加到他们的收藏中，将它们作为圣诞礼物还是将它们作为特殊的节日礼物。”

paras.en: To enter for a chance to win, visit Federated Auto Parts and Federated Car Care on Facebook by Dec. 3 and click on the mobile link in the first post to complete the entry form. Participants can earn extra entries by sharing the contest with Facebook friends.
paras.zh: 要获得获奖机会，请于 12 月 3 日之前访问 Facebook 上的 Federated Auto Parts 和 Federated Car Care，然后单击第一篇文章中的移动链接来填写报名表。参与者可以通过与 Facebook 好友分享比赛来赚取额外的参赛资格。

articles.title: TWG Names Kevin Valenzuela Data Specialist
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Wheel Group (TWG), a designer, developer and distributor of aftermarket wheels, tires, accessories and off-road brands, recently announced the hiring of Kevin Valenzuela. He joins the company as its new product data specialist. The company said Valenzuela brings extensive experience in automotive aftermarket catalog management, product data and technical support.
paras.zh: The Wheel Group (TWG) 是一家售后市场车轮、轮胎、配件和越野品牌的设计、开发商和分销商，最近宣布聘用 Kevin Valenzuela。他加入公司担任新产品数据专家。该公司表示，巴伦苏埃拉在汽车售后市场目录管理、产品数据和技术支持方面拥有丰富的经验。

paras.en: The Wheel Group Adds Aftermarket Data Experience
paras.zh: The Wheel Group 增加售后数据体验

paras.en: Most recently, Valenzuela served as a data analyst at Advanced Innovative Technology Corp. (TrakMotive). There, he supported product strategy, competitive analysis, pricing, market research and catalog accuracy. His work included application validation, digital asset management and ensuring product information aligned with industry standards.
paras.zh: 最近，Valenzuela 在 Advanced Innovative Technology Corp. (TrakMotive) 担任数据分析师。在那里，他负责支持产品策略、竞争分析、定价、市场研究和目录准确性。他的工作包括应用程序验证、数字资产管理以及确保产品信息符合行业标准。

paras.en: Prior to that, Valenzuela spent nearly three years as a data support specialist focused on catalog management. He oversaw product and application data across multiple product lines. He worked extensively with ACES and PIES standards, product fitment validation, new product introductions and catalog development. His work supported major retailers and distribution platforms.
paras.zh: 在此之前，Valenzuela 担任了近三年的数据支持专家，专注于目录管理。他负责监督多个产品线的产品和应用数据。 He worked extensively with ACES and PIES standards, product fitment validation, new product introductions and catalog development. His work supported major retailers and distribution platforms.

paras.en: Valenzuela also brings a technical foundation from his earlier career with NCR Corp., where he held several technical and implementation support roles. Combined with his hands-on automotive experience, this background gives him an understanding of the automotive industry’s technical and practical sides, TWG said.
paras.zh: Valenzuela 还从他早期在 NCR Corp. 的职业生涯中获得了技术基础，他在该公司担任过多个技术和实施支持职务。 TWG 表示，结合他在汽车领域的实践经验，这种背景使他能够了解汽车行业的技术和实践方面。

paras.en: Valenzuela to Support Product Data and Catalog Management
paras.zh: Valenzuela 支持产品数据和目录管理

paras.en: In his new role at The Wheel Group, Valenzuela will help strengthen product data accuracy, catalog management and application information. His work will span the company’s growing portfolio of brands. His experience will support TWG’s efforts to improve product information, enhance digital resources and provide reliable, comprehensive product data. These efforts will serve customers and distribution partners.
paras.zh: Valenzuela 在 The Wheel Group 担任新职务后，将帮助加强产品数据准确性、目录管理和应用信息。他的工作将涵盖公司不断增长的品牌组合。他的经验将支持 TWG 改进产品信息、增强数字资源并提供可靠、全面的产品数据的努力。这些努力将为客户和分销合作伙伴服务。

paras.en: “Accurate product information is essential to our business and to the experience we deliver to our customers,” said Joe Podlovits, vice president of Marketing and National Accounts at The Wheel Group. “Kevin brings valuable aftermarket experience and a strong understanding of catalog management and industry standards. We’re excited to have him on board and look forward to the contributions he’ll make as we continue to grow our brands and capabilities.”
paras.zh: “准确的产品信息对于我们的业务以及我们为客户提供的体验至关重要，”The Wheel Group 营销和国民账户副总裁 Joe Podlovits 表示。 “凯文带来了宝贵的售后经验以及对目录管理和行业标准的深刻理解。我们很高兴他加入，并期待他在我们继续发展我们的品牌和能力的过程中做出贡献。”

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Opens First Store in King of Prussia
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Advance Auto Parts opened its first store in King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, expanding access to parts, tools and expertise for local drivers and automotive professionals. The company marked the opening of the store at 125 W. Dekalb Pike with a ribbon-cutting ceremony alongside local officials and representatives from Central Montco Technical High School who were on site to accept a donation for the school’s automotive technology program.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 在宾夕法尼亚州普鲁士国王开设了第一家商店，为当地驾驶员和汽车专业人士提供了更多零件、工具和专业知识。该公司为庆祝位于 125 W. Dekalb Pike 的商店开业举行了剪彩仪式，当地官员和中央 Montco 技术高中的代表在现场接受了学校汽车技术项目的捐款。

paras.en: The donation will help students gain hands-on experience, training and career opportunities through the school’s automotive technology programs. Skilled automotive technicians continue to be in high demand, with approximately 70,000 openings projected annually through 2034, according to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
paras.zh: 此次捐赠将帮助学生通过学校的汽车技术项目获得实践经验、培训和职业机会。根据美国劳工统计局的数据，熟练的汽车技术人员的需求量仍然很高，预计到 2034 年，每年大约有 70,000 个职位空缺。

paras.en: “We’re excited to bring Advance Auto Parts to King of Prussia and open our first store in the community,” said Eli Rosa, regional vice president, Advance Auto Parts. “In addition to serving local customers, this market hub will help strengthen support for professional technicians and nearby shops across the area. We’re proud to mark the occasion by supporting Central Montco Technical High School and the programs that help students prepare for automotive technician careers.”
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 区域副总裁 Eli Rosa 表示：“我们很高兴将 Advance Auto Parts 带到普鲁士国王，并在社区开设我们的第一家商店。” “除了服务当地客户外，这个市场中心还将有助于加强对整个地区的专业技术人员和附近商店的支持。我们很自豪能够通过支持中央蒙特科技术高中和帮助学生为汽车技术人员职业生涯做好准备的计划来纪念这一时刻。”

paras.en: “We appreciate Advance Auto Parts’ support of career and technical education,” said Craig Robinson, administrative director at Central Montco Technical High School. “This donation helps support the hands-on learning experiences that are at the core of our automotive technology program and gives students opportunities to build skills they’ll use long after graduation.”
paras.zh: “我们感谢 Advance Auto Parts 对职业和技术教育的支持，”中央 Montco 技术高中行政总监 Craig Robinson 说道。 “这笔捐款有助于支持作为我们汽车技术项目核心的实践学习体验，并为学生提供培养毕业后长期使用的技能的机会。”

paras.en: The new store also serves as a market hub – a centralized facility designed to improve parts availability and same-day fulfillment across a network of stores, enhancing hard parts coverage for professional customers, Advance Auto Parts said.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 表示，新店还充当市场中心，这是一个集中设施，旨在提高整个商店网络的零部件可用性和当日履行率，从而提高专业客户的硬件零部件覆盖率。

articles.title: NexaMotion Group Names Inaugural Vendors of the Year
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: NexaMotion Group (NMG) named UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) and Precision International the recipients of its first annual Vendor of the Year award. The program honors supplier partners whose commitment to NMG’s customers, team and strategy extends well beyond the purchase order.
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group (NMG) 将 UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) 和 Precision International 授予其首个年度供应商奖。该计划旨在表彰对 NMG 客户、团队和战略的承诺远远超出采购订单范围的供应商合作伙伴。

paras.en: For 50 years, from the founding of Transtar to the formation of NexaMotion Group, that kind of supplier partnership has been a cornerstone of how the company competes. Honorees were selected by NMG’s executive and supply chain leadership on availability, quality and responsiveness, and on a harder test: how far the supplier was willing to go in service of NMG’s strategy and its customers’ success.
paras.zh: 50 年来，从 Transtar 的成立到 NexaMotion 集团的成立，这种供应商合作伙伴关系一直是公司竞争的基石。获奖者是由 NMG 的高管和供应链领导层根据可用性、质量和响应能力以及更严格的测试选出的：供应商愿意在多大程度上为 NMG 的战略和客户的成功提供服务。

paras.en: “Anyone can fill an order. Our best partners help us build the business,” said Scott Weinstein, President of NexaMotion Group. “UAC and Precision International show up in the planning room, not just on the loading dock. They bring us coverage before our customers ask for it, they invest in our people and our shops, and when we make bold moves as a company they are right beside us. That is partnership, and it is what this award was created to honor.”
paras.zh: “任何人都可以填写订单。我们最好的合作伙伴帮助我们发展业务，”NexaMotion 集团总裁 Scott Weinstein 说道。 “UAC 和 Precision International 出现在规划室，而不仅仅是装货码头。他们在客户提出要求之前就为我们提供报道，他们对我们的员工和商店进行投资，当我们作为一家公司采取大胆行动时，他们就在我们身边。这就是合作伙伴关系，这也是这个奖项的设立的目的。”

paras.en: Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Mansfield, Texas, UAC designs and supplies automotive air conditioning components, from compressors and condensers to evaporators, driers, hose assemblies and electrical parts, backed by a factory audit process and an in-house validation team. NMG recently selected UAC as the lead air conditioning supplier for its general repair business, a decision shaped as much by UAC’s willingness to plan, train and invest alongside NMG’s teams as by the quality of its catalog. UAC is led by Francisco Coll, CEO, and Sophia Coll Crowley, CEO, with Luke Masters, Vice President of Business Development.
paras.zh: UAC 成立于 1988 年，总部位于德克萨斯州曼斯菲尔德，设计和供应汽车空调组件，从压缩机和冷凝器到蒸发器、干燥器、软管组件和电气零件，并有工厂审核流程和内部验证团队的支持。 NMG 最近选择 UAC 作为其一般维修业务的主要空调供应商，这一决定不仅取决于 UAC 与 NMG 团队一起计划、培训和投资的意愿，还取决于其产品目录的质量。 UAC 由首席执行官 Francisco Coll 和首席执行官 Sophia Coll Crowley 以及业务开发副总裁 Luke Masters 领导。

paras.en: Founded in 1975 by Dennis Marshall and based in Yaphank, New York, Precision International supplies more than 3,000 transmission kits and nearly 10,000 parts and components to rebuilders worldwide. The company is ISO 9001 certified and a five-time consecutive General Motors Supplier of the Year. Precision International is led by Tina Parente, President, with Frank Miller, Executive Vice President, and John Sollazzo, Vice President of Sales and Marketing.
paras.zh: Precision International 由丹尼斯·马歇尔 (Dennis Marshall) 于 1975 年创立，总部位于纽约州雅芬克 (Yaphank)，为全球重建商提供 3,000 多种变速箱套件和近 10,000 个零部件。该公司已通过 ISO 9001 认证，并连续五次荣获通用汽车年度供应商称号。 Precision International 由总裁 Tina Parente、执行副总裁 Frank Miller 以及销售和营销副总裁 John Sollazzo 领导。

paras.en: “Both companies share forecasts with us, solve problems before they reach a customer, and measure their success by whether our shops win the job,” said Tim Cox, EVP of Supply Chain, NexaMotion Group. “That is when a supplier relationship stops being a transaction and becomes a competitive advantage for everyone it touches.”
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group 供应链执行副总裁 Tim Cox 表示：“两家公司都与我们分享预测，在问题到达客户之前解决问题，并通过我们的商店是否赢得这份工作来衡量他们的成功。” “那时供应商关系不再是一种交易，而是成为它所接触的每个人的竞争优势。”

paras.en: NMG said it will present the Vendor of the Year award annually. UAC and Precision International products are available through NMG’s business brands and sales representatives.
paras.zh: NMG 表示将每年颁发年度供应商奖。 UAC 和 Precision International 产品可通过 NMG 的商业品牌和销售代表购买。

articles.title: Black holes can split apart 'like pants' if they spin too fast, study hints
articles.author: Ivan Farkas

paras.en: Black holes are known to collide and combine in monstrously violent merger events, but new research suggests these celestial stalwarts can also fragment into smaller bodies, like a cosmic pair of pants splitting down the middle.
paras.zh: 众所周知，黑洞会在可怕的暴力合并事件中碰撞和结合，但新的研究表明，这些天体中坚力量也可以分裂成更小的物体，就像一条宇宙裤子从中间裂开。

paras.en: In a paper published Oct. 22 in the journal Physical Review D, researchers used several mathematical modeling methods to propose a "pair-of-pants" topology for black holes. The hypothesis suggests that under extremely specific conditions, these dark behemoths could fragment into numerous less-massive black holes.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 22 日发表在《物理评论 D》杂志上的一篇论文中，研究人员使用多种数学建模方法提出了黑洞的“裤子”拓扑。该假设表明，在极其特定的条件下，这些黑暗庞然大物可能会分裂成许多质量较小的黑洞。

paras.en: "Understanding precisely what is forbidden, what is merely unlikely, and what becomes possible once the assumptions are relaxed is the central goal of this work," the researchers wrote in the paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在论文中写道：“准确理解什么是被禁止的，什么是不太可能发生的，以及一旦放松假设就会发生什么是可能的，这是这项工作的中心目标。”

paras.en: Black hole fragmentation could play into other cosmic mysteries. For example, it could help to explain black holes with masses that are too small to be formed through conventional astrophysical processes. These hypothesized black hole "morsels" would be so small that astronomers could see them evaporating before their eyes on observational timescales.
paras.zh: 黑洞碎片可能会解开其他宇宙之谜。例如，它可以帮助解释质量太小而无法通过传统天体物理过程形成的黑洞。这些假设的黑洞“碎片”非常小，天文学家可以在观测时间尺度上看到它们在眼前蒸发。

paras.en: In the new paper, the researchers explored whether black holes' event horizons — the boundaries beyond which nothing, not even light, can escape — could split under various cosmological conditions. These situations included classical four-dimensional general relativity (Einstein's description of our large-scale universe as we currently understand it) as well as cosmologically esoteric frameworks such as higher-dimensional space-time and modified gravity scenarios.
paras.zh: 在这篇新论文中，研究人员探讨了黑洞的事件视界（任何东西，甚至光都无法逃脱的边界）是否会在各种宇宙学条件下分裂。这些情况包括经典的四维广义相对论（爱因斯坦对我们目前所理解的大尺度宇宙的描述）以及宇宙学深奥的框架，例如高维时空和修改后的重力场景。

paras.en: But modeling black hole dynamics, especially the split of an event horizon, is messy work. So the researchers simplified it by comparing discrete slices of space-time, effectively condensing the fragmentation process into static snapshots from before and after the split.
paras.zh: 但对黑洞动力学（尤其是事件视界的分裂）进行建模是一项繁琐的工作。因此，研究人员通过比较离散的时空切片来简化它，有效地将碎片过程压缩为分裂前后的静态快照。

paras.en: In our classical cosmos, it seems mostly impossible for black holes to split, the researchers found, but they did identify a loophole that might allow it to happen.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，在我们的经典宇宙中，黑洞似乎几乎不可能分裂，但他们确实发现了一个可能允许这种情况发生的漏洞。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The first impediment is entropy, the possible arrangements of an isolated system's energy, which cannot spontaneously decrease but only stay the same or increase. This has been theorized by Stephen Hawking and recently demonstrated through detections of ripples in space-time called gravitational waves, suggesting that a black hole's surface area cannot decrease.
paras.zh: 第一个障碍是熵，即孤立系统能量的可能排列，它不能自发减少，而只能保持不变或增加。这是斯蒂芬·霍金提出的理论，最近通过检测时空波纹（称为引力波）证明了这一点，表明黑洞的表面积不会减少。

paras.en: For these reasons, splitting a static Schwarzschild black hole — the simplest type of black hole in our four-dimensional general relativity — would be strictly forbidden because it would violate the second law of thermodynamics.
paras.zh: 由于这些原因，分裂静态史瓦西黑洞（四维广义相对论中最简单的黑洞类型）将被严格禁止，因为它会违反热力学第二定律。

paras.en: The second impediment is kinematics, the motion of orbital dynamics, which precludes the possibility of a permanent split because the black hole fragments would recombine into a single body incredibly quickly.
paras.zh: 第二个障碍是运动学，即轨道动力学的运动，它排除了永久分裂的可能性，因为黑洞碎片会以令人难以置信的速度重新组合成一个整体。

paras.en: But there is a loophole: A rapidly rotating black hole could literally spin itself apart.
paras.zh: 但有一个漏洞：快速旋转的黑洞实际上可能会自行旋转分开。

paras.en: "This is why, in four-dimensional general relativity, an isolated black hole in empty space could only split if it spins very close to the maximum rate the theory allows, what we call a near-extremal black hole," study co-author Manuel Del Piano, a theoretical physicist at the University of Southern Denmark, told Live Science via email. "Loosely speaking, the equator of the horizon is then dragged around at nearly the speed of light."
paras.zh: “这就是为什么，在四维广义相对论中，真空中的孤立黑洞只有在旋转非常接近理论允许的最大速率时才会分裂，我们称之为近极值黑洞，”该研究的合著者、南丹麦大学的理论物理学家曼努埃尔·德尔·皮亚诺(Manuel Del Piano)通过电子邮件告诉《生活科学》。 “宽松地说，地平线的赤道随后以接近光速的速度被拖动。”

paras.en: Through this theoretical process, the two resultant black hole fragments could be gravitationally slingshotted away from each other before they could recombine. So under conventional space-time conditions, it seems "black holes do not wear pants."
paras.zh: 通过这个理论过程，两个由此产生的黑洞碎片在重新组合之前可以通过引力弹弓彼此远离。所以在常规时空条件下，似乎“黑洞不穿裤子”。

paras.en: Then, the researchers mathematically modeled black hole fragmentation in versions of space-time with more than four dimensions.
paras.zh: 然后，研究人员在四个以上维度的时空版本中对黑洞碎片进行了数学建模。

paras.en: In models of higher-dimension space-times, a black hole's rotational velocity is no longer limited because gravity weakens with increasing dimensionality. Therefore, any such ultrafast spinning black holes could theoretically fragment, the researchers explained in the paper.
paras.zh: 在高维时空模型中，黑洞的旋转速度不再受到限制，因为引力随着维度的增加而减弱。因此，研究人员在论文中解释说，任何这种超快旋转的黑洞理论上都可能破碎。

paras.en: In the "black string" model, a normally spherical black hole would become cylindrical or string-like, stretching across any extra dimensions. It could then pinch off to fragment into multiple smaller bodies, akin to "beads on a string."
paras.zh: 在“黑弦”模型中，通常为球形的黑洞将变成圆柱形或弦状，延伸到任何额外的维度。然后它可以被捏碎成多个较小的物体，类似于“绳子上的珠子”。

paras.en: Additionally, the researchers calculated that black hole fragmentation may be entropically favored in space-time models with modified gravity, which alter the gravitational interactions in extremely warped environments near the black hole.
paras.zh: 此外，研究人员计算出，在具有修正重力的时空模型中，黑洞破碎可能会受到熵的青睐，这会改变黑洞附近极度扭曲环境中的重力相互作用。

paras.en: "The fragments are tiny, though: in one of our benchmarks, a black hole of ten solar masses would favour fragments … a few times the mass of the Great Pyramid of Giza squeezed into a region smaller than a proton, and the heavier the parent, the smaller the fragments," Del Piano explained.
paras.zh: “不过，这些碎片很小：在我们的一项基准测试中，十个太阳质量的黑洞更容易产生碎片……吉萨大金字塔的质量几倍，挤进一个比质子还小的区域，母体越重，碎片就越小，”德尔皮亚诺解释道。

paras.en: Fragmentation also may be more likely if there is a "bumpy horizon" around black holes, akin to a dense blanket or shroud of exotic matter that acts as a singular-but-gigantic quantum entity. The superfluid qualities of this matter could create strange vortices that eventually cause a black hole to fragment into multiple smaller bodies.
paras.zh: 如果黑洞周围有一个“凹凸不平的地平线”，类似于一层致密的外来物质毯子或覆盖物，充当单一但巨大的量子实体，那么碎片化的可能性也更大。这种物质的超流体特性可能会产生奇怪的漩涡，最终导致黑洞分裂成多个较小的物体。

paras.en: Scientists might see a black hole decrease in size, an actual fragmentation, or simply an indirect gravitational signature, depending on the dimensions and whether it intersects the viewer's "brane," or slice of dimensionality.
paras.zh: 科学家可能会看到黑洞尺寸减小、实际分裂或只是间接引力特征，具体取决于尺寸以及它是否与观察者的“膜”或维度切片相交。

paras.en: Smaller relativistic waistlines may be more conducive to wearing pants
paras.zh: 较小的相对论腰围可能更有利于穿裤子

paras.en: The researchers expect that smaller objects — like the hypothesized, miniature primordial back holes that may have formed shortly after the Big Bang — are more likely to split, compared with much more massive astrophysical black holes such as those at the centers of galaxies.
paras.zh: 研究人员预计，与更大的天体物理黑洞（例如星系中心的黑洞）相比，较小的物体（例如可能在大爆炸后不久形成的假设的微型原始背洞）更有可能分裂。

paras.en: - Earth is in the firing line of a strange new type of cosmic object: a 'microblazar'
paras.zh: - 地球正处于一种奇怪的新型宇宙物体的前线：“微耀体”

paras.en: - 'Like watching a cosmic volcano erupt': Scientists see monster black hole 'reborn' after 100 million years
paras.zh: -“就像观看宇宙火山喷发”：科学家们看到巨型黑洞在一亿年后“重生”

paras.en: - Black hole star? Solar-system-size 'dot' from the early universe is our best evidence yet of a brand-new type of cosmic object
paras.zh: - 黑洞星？早期宇宙中太阳系大小的“点”是我们迄今为止发现的全新宇宙物体的最佳证据

paras.en: "Overall, we expect small black holes, such as primordial ones from the early universe, to be the most prone to splitting," Del Piano told Live Science.
paras.zh: 德尔皮亚诺告诉《生活科学》杂志：“总的来说，我们预计小型黑洞，比如来自早期宇宙的原始黑洞，最容易分裂。”

paras.en: Gamma-ray telescopes or gravitational wave observatories may one day offer evidence of a signal associated with the supposed split of a small black hole, but the specifics, including whether this actually occurs, are uncertain.
paras.zh: 伽马射线望远镜或引力波天文台有一天可能会提供与小黑洞分裂相关的信号的证据，但具体细节，包括这种情况是否真的发生，尚不确定。

paras.en: "One important caveat: our analysis shows when splitting is allowed by entropy and conservation laws, not that it actually happens," Del Piano noted. "As we put it in the paper, a shattered glass has more entropy than an intact one, yet glasses don't shatter on their own. Settling the question requires full dynamical simulations, which is the natural next step."
paras.zh: “一个重要的警告：我们的分析表明，当熵和守恒定律允许分裂时，而不是它实际上发生了，”德尔皮亚诺指出。 “正如我们在论文中所说，破碎的玻璃比完整的玻璃具有更多的熵，但玻璃不会自行破碎。解决这个问题需要完整的动态模拟，这是自然的下一步。”

paras.en: Cacciapaglia, G., Del Piano, M., Sannino, F., & Vellucci, V. (2026). When black holes admit pair-of-pants topologies. Physical Review. D/Physical Review. D., 114(8). https://doi.org/10.1103/cx69-t466
paras.zh: Cacciapaglia, G.、Del Piano, M.、Sannino, F. 和 Vellucci, V. (2026)。当黑洞承认裤子拓扑时。物理评论。 D/物理审查。 D.，114（8）。 https://doi.org/10.1103/cx69-t466

articles.title: 2,200-year-old Celtic silver coin hoard unearthed at construction site in Hungary
articles.author: Tom Metcalfe

paras.en: Archaeologists in Hungary have discovered a stash of more than 200 Celtic silver coins that are over 2,000 years old. It's one of the largest hoards found there in decades.
paras.zh: 匈牙利考古学家发现了 200 多枚凯尔特银币的藏品，这些银币已有 2000 多年的历史。这是几十年来在那里发现的最大的宝藏之一。

paras.en: Researchers unearthed the coins during excavations ahead of construction for an electrical substation in western Hungary between 2023 and 2025, according to a translated statement from the power company E.ON. The hoard dates to sometime between the late second century B.C. and the early first century B.C.
paras.zh: 根据电力公司 E.ON 的翻译声明，研究人员在 2023 年至 2025 年间匈牙利西部一座变电站施工前的挖掘过程中发现了这些硬币。这批宝藏的历史可以追溯到公元前二世纪末。和公元前一世纪初

paras.en: The coin cache weighs roughly 4.4 pounds (2 kilograms). In today's market, it's worth more than $2,000 as raw silver alone, but its rarity and historical value effectively make it priceless, the statement said.
paras.zh: 硬币缓存重约 4.4 磅（2 公斤）。声明称，在当今市场上，仅原银的价值就超过 2,000 美元，但其稀有性和历史价值实际上使其成为无价之宝。

paras.en: The site was once part of a farm, and plowing there had unearthed several individual coins in recent decades, the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称，该地点曾经是一个农场的一部分，近几十年来，在那里耕作时出土了几枚单独的硬币。

paras.en: During the latest excavations, archaeologists initially found a few coins and then searched the area with metal detectors, which led them to the coin hoard. The treasure had been packed inside a small ceramic vessel and sat about 16 inches (40 centimeters) below ground.
paras.zh: 在最近的挖掘过程中，考古学家最初发现了一些硬币，然后用金属探测器搜索了该地区，最终找到了硬币宝藏。该宝藏被装在一个小陶瓷容器内，位于地下约 16 英寸（40 厘米）处。

paras.en: "This is a rarity in Europe," Eszter Kreiter, an archaeologist at Hungary's National Archaeological Institute, said at a news conference, according to local news outlets. She added that the last similar find was made in Hungary in the late 1960s.
paras.zh: 据当地新闻媒体报道，匈牙利国家考古研究所的考古学家埃斯特·克赖特在新闻发布会上说：“这在欧洲是罕见的。”她补充说，最后一次类似的发现是在 20 世纪 60 年代末在匈牙利发现的。

paras.en: The hoard's silver coins are modeled on Greek tetradrachms — a very early type of large silver coin that was introduced in the late sixth century B.C.
paras.zh: 宝藏中的银币是以希腊四德拉克货币为蓝本的，这是一种非常早期的大型银币，于公元前六世纪末引入。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The newfound Celtic tetradrachm copies are a type known as "Velem," which are named after Velem-Szent Vid, a fortified Celtic hilltop settlement, or oppidum. Similar coins have been found at that site, which is located about 10 miles (15 kilometers) to the west.
paras.zh: 新发现的凯尔特四德拉克马复制品是一种被称为“Velem”的类型，以 Velem-Szent Vid 命名，Velem-Szent Vid 是一个强化的凯尔特山顶定居点，或称 Oppidum。在该地点以西约 10 英里（15 公里）处也发现了类似的硬币。

paras.en: Each coin has a stylized head on one side that probably depicts the Greek god Apollo, and portrays a helmeted rider and horse on the other side.
paras.zh: 每枚硬币的一侧都有一个风格化的头像，可能描绘的是希腊神阿波罗，另一侧描绘的是戴着头盔的骑手和马。

paras.en: The excavations have revealed evidence of more than 7,000 years of occupation at the site, officials wrote in the statement. The artifacts include a nearly 7,000-year-old polished stone chisel used for woodworking and a glass bead with a peacock's eye pattern that seems to have been part of jewelry from the sixth or seventh century B.C.
paras.zh: 官员在声明中写道，挖掘工作揭示了该遗址 7000 多年被人类居住的证据。这些文物包括一把有近 7000 年历史的用于木工的抛光石凿和一颗带有孔雀眼图案的玻璃珠，这似乎是公元前六世纪或七世纪珠宝的一部分。

paras.en: A Roman-era villa was built at the same site in later centuries, without disturbing the hoard of buried silver, Kreiter said at the news conference.
paras.zh: 克赖特在新闻发布会上说，后来的几个世纪里，在同一地点建造了一座罗马时代的别墅，没有动摇埋藏的银器。

paras.en: The villa has long since been demolished, but the excavations enabled the archaeological team to reconstruct its floor plan, including its underfloor heating system, she said. They also found a Roman-era brick with a dog's paw print.
paras.zh: 她说，这座别墅早已被拆除，但挖掘工作使考古队能够重建其平面图，包括地暖系统。他们还发现了一块罗马时代的砖块，上面有狗爪印。

paras.en: The artifacts from the site will become part of a museum exhibition.
paras.zh: 该遗址的文物将成为博物馆展览的一部分。

paras.en: According to Museum Wales, the Celts were loosely related Iron Age peoples descended from Proto-Indo-European speakers. Emerging in Central Europe, Celtic groups occupied much of Central and Western Europe from about the 10th to the first century B.C. The Celtic Gauls were finally defeated by the Romans, led by Julius Caesar at Alesia, now in eastern France, in 52 B.C. The Britons were also Celtic, though most people of Celtic descent would not have recognized that name.
paras.zh: 根据威尔士博物馆的说法，凯尔特人是铁器时代民族的松散亲属，是原始印欧语使用者的后裔。凯尔特人群体兴起于中欧，从公元前十世纪到公元前一世纪左右，占据了中欧和西欧的大部分地区。凯尔特高卢人最终于公元前 52 年在阿莱西亚（现法国东部）被尤利乌斯·凯撒领导的罗马人击败。英国人也是凯尔特人，尽管大多数凯尔特人后裔不会认出这个名字。

paras.en: Several modern ethnic groups, including the native Irish and the Bretons of coastal France, trace their descent to the Celts. Regions with strong Celtic origins are sometimes called the "Celtic fringe" of Western Europe.
paras.zh: 一些现代民族，包括爱尔兰本土人和法国沿海的布列塔尼人，其后裔都可以追溯到凯尔特人。具有浓厚凯尔特血统的地区有时被称为西欧的“凯尔特边缘”。

paras.en: Writing in the Journal of Roman Studies, the British coin expert Christopher Howgego, an honorary curator and professor emeritus of Greek and Roman numismatics at the University of Oxford, stated that Celtic tribes in the Carpathian Basin, now in Hungary and Romania, started minting their own silver coins after Celtic mercenaries had seen them when serving with Hellenistic armies in Greece and Macedonia.
paras.zh: 英国钱币专家、牛津大学希腊和罗马钱币学名誉馆长兼名誉教授克里斯托弗·豪格戈在《罗马研究杂志》上撰文指出，喀尔巴阡盆地（现位于匈牙利和罗马尼亚）的凯尔特部落在凯尔特雇佣兵在希腊和马其顿的希腊化军队服役时看到银币后，开始铸造自己的银币。

paras.en: Howgego has written that the Greek-inspired Celtic coins included adaptations of classical Greek portraits, as well as distinctive Celtic designs. These copycat tetradrachms held very high value for their makers, so they were rarely used for everyday purchases. Instead, they were often hoarded as wealth or buried as ritual offerings.
paras.zh: 豪格戈写道，受希腊启发的凯尔特硬币包括对古典希腊肖像的改编，以及独特的凯尔特设计。这些仿制的四德拉克货币对其制造商来说具有很高的价值，因此很少用于日常购买。相反，它们经常被当作财富囤积或作为仪式祭品埋葬。

paras.en: See how much you know about the celts with our Celtic quiz!
paras.zh: 通过我们的凯尔特人测验，看看您对凯尔特人了解多少！

paras.en: Tom Metcalfe is a freelance journalist and regular Live Science contributor who is based in London in the United Kingdom. Tom writes mainly about science, space, archaeology, the Earth and the oceans. He has also written for the BBC, NBC News, National Geographic, Scientific American, Air & Space, and many others.
paras.zh: 汤姆·梅特卡夫 (Tom Metcalfe) 是一名自由撰稿人，也是《Live Science》的定期撰稿人，常驻英国伦敦。汤姆主要撰写有关科学、太空、考古学、地球和海洋的文章。他还为 BBC、NBC 新闻、国家地理、科学美国人、航空航天等多家媒体撰稿。

articles.title: Beaver Moon 2026: When to see a full 'supermoon' rise this week, and another on Christmas Eve
articles.author: Jamie Carter

paras.en: November’s full moon, known as the "Beaver Moon," will rise in the east at dusk on Tuesday (Nov. 24), marking the first of three consecutive supermoons.
paras.zh: 11 月的满月，被称为“海狸月”，将于周二（11 月 24 日）黄昏从东方升起，这是连续三个超级月亮中的第一个。

paras.en: It will be the third and final full moon of fall in the Northern Hemisphere and the first in a series of unusually close full moons that includes December's spectacular Christmas supermoon — the closest full moon since 2018.
paras.zh: 这将是北半球秋季的第三次也是最后一次满月，也是一系列异常接近的满月中的第一次，其中包括 12 月壮观的圣诞超级月亮——自 2018 年以来最接近的满月。

paras.en: The Beaver Moon gets its name from the time of year when nocturnal beavers in North America traditionally build dams and prepare for winter under the full moon, according to TimeandDate. Other nicknames include the Frost Moon and Snow Moon, and the Anishinaabeg people in North America call it Baashkaakodin Giizis — the Freezing Moon — according to the Center for Native American Studies.
paras.zh: 据《TimeandDate》报道，“海狸月”得名于北美夜间活动的海狸传统上在满月下建造水坝并为过冬做准备的时间。根据美洲原住民研究中心的说法，其他昵称包括“霜月”和“雪月”，北美的阿尼什纳贝格人称其为“Baashkaakodin Giizis”——“冰冻月亮”。

paras.en: The moon will reach its full phase at 9:53 a.m. ET on Tuesday, when it will be below the horizon in North America. The best time to see the Beaver Moon is at moonrise that evening, as it rises in the east around the same time the sun sets in the west. That's when the moon will appear against a relatively bright twilight sky, making it easier to appreciate its size and color.
paras.zh: 月球将于美国东部时间周二上午 9 点 53 分达到满月，届时它将位于北美地平线以下。观赏海狸月的最佳时间是当晚的月出时，因为海狸月从东方升起的时间大约与太阳从西方落下的时间相同。那时月亮会出现在相对明亮的暮色天空中，从而更容易欣赏它的大小和颜色。

paras.en: The moon will appear full on Monday and Wednesday as well, but Tuesday offers the best opportunity to see it rise during twilight.
paras.zh: 周一和周三也会出现满月，但周二提供了在黄昏时看到月亮升起的最佳机会。

paras.en: The Beaver Moon will be the first of three consecutive supermoons, according to EarthSky. A supermoon occurs when a full moon coincides with the moon being relatively close to Earth in its elliptical orbit. The moon's distance from Earth changes throughout the month. On average, the moon is 238,900 miles (384,472 kilometers) from Earth. When a full moon occurs near perigee, or its closest point during its orbit, it appears slightly larger and brighter than usual. Here's what's coming up:
paras.zh: 据《地球天空》报道，海狸月将是连续三个超级月亮中的第一个。当满月与月球在椭圆轨道上距离地球相对较近时，就会出现超级月亮。月球与地球的距离在整个月都在变化。月球平均距地球 238,900 英里（384,472 公里）。当满月出现在近地点或其轨道上最近点附近时，它看起来比平时稍大、更亮。以下是即将发生的事情：

paras.en: - Full Beaver Supermoon on Nov. 24, 2026 (224,170 miles / 360,768 km)
- Full Cold Supermoon on Dec. 24, 2026 (221,667 miles / 356,740 km)
- Full Wolf Supermoon on Jan. 22, 2027 (222,229 miles / 357,644 km)

November's Beaver Supermoon is just the beginning: It's the smallest of the three upcoming supermoons. December's full Cold Moon will be the closest, biggest and brightest full moon of 2026, bringing the moon closer to Earth than at any time since Jan. 2, 2018, according to late astrophysicist Fred Espenak.
paras.zh: 十一月的海狸超级月亮只是一个开始：它是即将到来的三个超级月亮中最小的一个。已故天体物理学家 Fred Espenak 表示，12 月的冷月将是 2026 年最近、最大、最亮的满月，使月球比 2018 年 1 月 2 日以来的任何时候都更接近地球。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: How much do you know about the moon? Test your lunar smarts with our moon quiz!
paras.zh: 关于月球你了解多少？通过我们的月球测验测试您的月球智慧！

paras.en: Jamie Carter is a Cardiff, U.K.-based freelance science journalist and a regular contributor to Live Science. He is the author of A Stargazing Program For Beginners and co-author of The Eclipse Effect, and leads international stargazing and eclipse-chasing tours. His work appears regularly in Space.com, Forbes, New Scientist, BBC Sky at Night, Sky & Telescope, and other major science and astronomy publications. He is also the editor of WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com.
paras.zh: 杰米·卡特 (Jamie Carter) 是英国卡迪夫的一名自由科学记者，也是《Live Science》的定期撰稿人。他是《初学者观星计划》一书的作者，也是《日食效应》一书的合著者，并领导国际观星和日食追逐之旅。他的作品经常出现在 Space.com、福布斯、新科学家、BBC 夜间天空、天空与望远镜以及其他主要科学和天文学出版物上。他还是 WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com 的编辑。
