paras.zh: 喜欢钓鱼和户外活动吗？在 Instagram、TikTok 和 YouTube 上关注 OutKick OutDoors！

articles.title: Americans don’t have to choose between our AI future and ripping off copyright owners

paras.en: One of the biggest court battles over artificial intelligence (AI) is putting an age-old legal principle to the test — and raising important questions about the Trump administration's AI policy.
paras.zh: 关于人工智能 (AI) 的最大法庭斗争之一是对一项古老的法律原则进行检验，并对特朗普政府的人工智能政策提出重要问题。

paras.en: Several news organizations, including The New York Times, are suing OpenAI and Microsoft for using millions of newspaper articles to train AI systems. The newspapers argue that the tech firms violated basic copyright protections. The tech firms contend that training their models on those articles qualifies as "fair use," a longstanding principle that allows copyrighted material to be used in certain ways without permission from or compensation to the copyright owner.
paras.zh: 包括《纽约时报》在内的多家新闻机构正在起诉 OpenAI 和微软使用数百万篇报纸文章来训练人工智能系统。报纸认为科技公司违反了基本的版权保护。科技公司认为，根据这些文章训练他们的模型符合“合理使用”，这是一项长期存在的原则，允许在未经版权所有者许可或不向版权所有者提供补偿的情况下以某些方式使用受版权保护的材料。

paras.en: The Department of Justice (DOJ) has sided squarely with OpenAI's position — breaking with the administration's previously more balanced stance on the issue. The DOJ filed a statement of interest embracing an extreme vision of fair use that would grant AI companies virtually unfettered access to copyrighted material for commercial training, without obtaining permission from or compensating the creators whose works fuel these systems.
paras.zh: 美国司法部 (DOJ) 完全支持 OpenAI 的立场——打破了政府此前在该问题上较为平衡的立场。美国司法部提交了一份利益声明，拥护合理使用的极端愿景，该声明将允许人工智能公司几乎不受限制地获取受版权保护的材料以进行商业培训，而无需获得其作品为这些系统提供动力的创作者的许可或对其进行补偿。

paras.en: This expansive interpretation threatens to turn a narrow copyright exception into a blanket exemption for the world's most powerful and profitable industries.
paras.zh: 这种宽泛的解释有可能将狭隘的版权例外变成对世界上最强大、最赚钱的行业的全面豁免。

paras.en: The DOJ's reasoning is that requiring a copyright license for material used in AI training would impose high costs on AI developers. It claims those costs could make it harder for small companies to compete and hamper U.S. AI leadership and national security.
paras.zh: 美国司法部的理由是，要求人工智能培训中使用的材料获得版权许可会给人工智能开发人员带来高昂的成本。它声称这些成本可能会使小公司更难竞争并阻碍美国人工智能的领导地位和国家安全。

paras.en: Those concerns deserve consideration. But the DOJ's aggressive arguments in the brief depart from more measured guidance elsewhere in the administration. The White House's official AI framework acknowledges valid arguments on both sides of the copyright debate.
paras.zh: 这些担忧值得考虑。但司法部在简报中的激进论点与政府其他部门更为谨慎的指导背道而驰。白宫的官方人工智能框架承认版权争论双方的有效论点。

paras.en: Likewise, the Carolina Principles for Emerging Technologies, adopted by G20 ministers at the Commerce Department's recent Innovation Ministerial, recognize that the intersection of AI and copyright poses "complex legal and policy questions." The principles note the "essential role" of copyright protections in supporting creators and call for respecting IP as a pillar of G20 AI policy.
paras.zh: 同样，二十国集团部长们在商务部最近举行的创新部长级会议上通过的《卡罗莱纳新兴技术原则》承认人工智能和版权的交叉带来了“复杂的法律和政策问题”。这些原则指出了版权保护在支持创作者方面的“重要作用”，并呼吁将尊重知识产权作为 G20 人工智能政策的支柱。

paras.en: The DOJ statement also overlooks how its stance could favor larger AI companies over smaller firms and startups. Several AI startups have argued that paying for the material they use provides more reliable access to training material, reduces legal uncertainty and improves models. Other companies have emerged to aggregate copyrights and make licensing easier.
paras.zh: 美国司法部的声明还忽视了其立场可能有利于大型人工智能公司，而不是小型公司和初创公司。几家人工智能初创公司认为，为他们使用的材料付费可以更可靠地获取培训材料，减少法律不确定性并改进模型。其他公司已经出现，以聚合版权并使许可变得更容易。

paras.en: It's particularly problematic for large AI companies to complain about paying for access to copyrighted materials. They are among the best positioned to pay for those materials, and doing so would help develop the kind of licensing markets they claim are lacking.
paras.zh: 对于大型人工智能公司来说，抱怨付费访问受版权保护的材料尤其成问题。他们是支付这些材料费用的最佳人选，这样做将有助于开发他们声称缺乏的许可市场。

paras.en: And even if national security were a legitimate justification, the government could not simply disregard property rights. The Constitution and other laws require just compensation when private property is taken for public use, and intellectual property rights are still property rights. Letting AI firms appropriate creators' IP without permission or compensation would be akin to letting data center builders seize private land without paying fair value.
paras.zh: 即使国家安全是一个合法的理由，政府也不能简单地忽视财产权。宪法和其他法律要求私有财产被公共使用时必须得到公正的补偿，而知识产权仍然是财产权。让人工智能公司在未经许可或不予补偿的情况下侵占创作者的知识产权，就像让数据中心建设者在不支付公平价值的情况下夺取私人土地一样。

paras.en: If courts adopt the DOJ's position that fair use protects AI developers in virtually all circumstances, it would reduce incentives to create new works. Copyrights encourage creative work by assuring writers, artists and other creators that their work can't be easily stolen or copied. Licensing those rights allows creators to earn a living and underpins over $1 trillion in U.S. economic activity.
paras.zh: 如果法院采纳司法部的立场，即合理使用几乎在所有情况下都能保护人工智能开发者，这将减少创作新作品的动力。版权通过向作家、艺术家和其他创作者保证他们的作品不会被轻易窃取或复制来鼓励创造性工作。获得这些权利的许可可以让创作者谋生并支撑超过 1 万亿美元的美国经济活动。

paras.en: Weaker copyrights could result in fewer human-created books, articles, research papers, films and songs. Ironically, that could eventually leave AI systems with fewer and lower-quality materials to train on – a scenario that serves no one's interests.
paras.zh: 版权较弱可能会导致人类创作的书籍、文章、研究论文、电影和歌曲减少。具有讽刺意味的是，这最终可能会让人工智能系统使用更少、质量更低的材料进行训练——这种情况不符合任何人的利益。

paras.en: All of this is why the Trump administration would be wise to follow its own AI framework and let the court system evaluate AI copyright disputes case by case, rather than arguing for unfettered fair use exceptions.
paras.zh: 所有这些就是为什么特朗普政府明智地遵循自己的人工智能框架，让法院系统逐案评估人工智能版权纠纷，而不是主张不受约束的合理使用例外。

paras.en: The DOJ's reasoning is that requiring a copyright license for material used in AI training would impose high costs on AI developers. It claims those costs could make it harder for small companies to compete and hamper U.S. AI leadership and national security.
paras.zh: 美国司法部的理由是，要求人工智能培训中使用的材料获得版权许可会给人工智能开发人员带来高昂的成本。它声称这些成本可能会使小公司更难竞争并阻碍美国人工智能的领导地位和国家安全。

paras.en: Policymakers also have a role to play. One promising bill is the bipartisan CLEAR Act. Introduced in February by California Democrat Sen. Adam Schiff and Utah Republican Sen. John Curtis, the CLEAR Act would require AI developers to publicly disclose the copyrighted works used in each new generative-AI model's training dataset.
paras.zh: 政策制定者也可以发挥作用。一项有前途的法案是两党共同通过的 CLEAR 法案。加州民主党参议员亚当·希夫 (Adam Schiff) 和犹他州共和党参议员约翰·柯蒂斯 (John Curtis) 在 2 月提出的 CLEAR 法案将要求人工智能开发人员公开披露每个新的生成人工智能模型的训练数据集中使用的受版权保护的作品。

paras.en: The proposal would not settle whether any particular training practice qualifies as fair use. But it would give creators more information about whether their work helped train an AI system, enabling them to pursue appropriate compensation or other remedies when they believe their rights have been violated.
paras.zh: 该提案不会解决任何特定培训实践是否符合合理使用的问题。但这将为创作者提供更多关于他们的工作是否有助于训练人工智能系统的信息，使他们能够在认为自己的权利受到侵犯时寻求适当的赔偿或其他补救措施。

paras.en: That kind of targeted reform offers a useful model for copyright enforcement in the age of AI. Rather than treating licensing as an obstacle to innovation, policymakers should foster a market where AI developers can efficiently license copyrighted material while respecting creators' rights.
paras.zh: 这种有针对性的改革为人工智能时代的版权执法提供了有用的模式。政策制定者不应将许可视为创新的障碍，而应培育一个市场，让人工智能开发者能够有效地许可受版权保护的材料，同时尊重创作者的权利。

paras.en: AI innovation is vital to America's future. But America's creative industries still depend on strong copyright protections. Policymakers need to promote both.
paras.zh: 人工智能创新对美国的未来至关重要。但美国的创意产业仍然依赖于强有力的版权保护。政策制定者需要促进两者。

articles.title: Cop31 climate talks break down as key deal rejected
articles.author: Fiona Harvey and Graham Readfearn in Antalya

paras.en: The EU, the UK and allies in the developing world rejected what they called an unacceptable deal on the future of the climate, which failed even to mention fossil fuels, in a dramatic finish to the Cop31 UN talks in Turkey.
paras.zh: 欧盟、英国和发展中国家的盟友拒绝了他们所谓的关于气候未来的不可接受的协议，该协议甚至没有提及化石燃料，从而戏剧性地结束了在土耳其举行的第 31 届联合国气候变化大会的谈判。

paras.en: The proposed deal “failed to meet the moment”, said Ireland’s environment minister, Darragh O’Brien, speaking for the EU. “We will not endorse a decision that does not respond to the science and that actually risks deepening the chasm between global commitments and the action required. [It] does not even mention fossil fuels.”
paras.zh: 爱尔兰环境部长达拉·奥布莱恩 (Darragh O’Brien) 代表欧盟发言时表示，拟议的协议“未能及时满足”。 “我们不会认可一项不符合科学的决定，而且实际上有可能加深全球承诺与所需行动之间的鸿沟。[它]甚至没有提到化石燃料。”

paras.en: As the talks, scheduled to end on Friday, dragged on into Sunday afternoon in the longest climate summit ever, it was clear that the “Antalya pact”, drafted by the Turkish and Australian joint presidencies of the summit, would not achieve the consensus needed to pass.
paras.zh: 由于原定于周五结束的会谈一直拖到周日下午，这是有史以来最长的气候峰会，很明显，由峰会联合主席国土耳其和澳大利亚起草的“安塔利亚协议”将无法达成通过所需的共识。

paras.en: The Antalya pact invites countries to electrify their economies, calls for rich countries to provide finance to the poor to help them adapt to the impacts of the climate crisis, and calls on countries to minimise the “overshoot” of the 1.5C global heating threshold, of the Paris agreement.
paras.zh: 安塔利亚协议邀请各国实现经济电气化，呼吁富裕国家向贫困国家提供资金，帮助他们适应气候危机的影响，并呼吁各国尽量减少对《巴黎协定》1.5摄氏度全球供暖阈值的“超调”。

paras.en: But it failed to endorse the “transition away from fossil fuels” that more than 130 countries demanded, and included controversial provisions on “carbon capture and storage” (CCS) technology that some have said perpetuates fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 但它未能支持 130 多个国家要求的“摆脱化石燃料”，并且包括了有关“碳捕获和储存”(CCS) 技术的有争议的条款，一些人认为这种技术使化石燃料永久化。

paras.en: The presidencies avoided outright collapse of the “conference of the parties” by passing decisions on various related matters, including the “just transition” to help workers in high-carbon industries shift to a low-carbon economy.
paras.zh: 历届总统通过就各种相关事项作出决定，包括帮助高碳行业工人转向低碳经济的“公正过渡”，避免了“政党会议”的彻底崩溃。

paras.en: But Murat Kurum, Turkey’s Cop president, acknowledged there was no agreement on the draft “cover decision” text and so it had not been adopted.
paras.zh: 但土耳其警察主席穆拉特·库鲁姆(Murat Kurum)承认，各方未能就“封面决定”文本草案达成一致，因此并未获得通过。

paras.en: “We have done our utmost; ultimately, we have not imposed this text on anyone, nor have we issued an ultimatum such as a ‘take it or leave it’ demand,” he said. “It is clear that there are parties in this hall who oppose this text. We recognise that there is no consensus on this document. Therefore, these decisions have not been adopted.”
paras.zh: 他说：“我们已经尽了最大努力；最终，我们没有将这一文本强加给任何人，也没有发出诸如‘接受或保留’之类的最后通牒。” “很明显，这个大厅里有人反对这份案文。我们认识到这份文件没有达成共识。因此，这些决定尚未获得通过。”

paras.en: Many countries, including the EU, UK and developing countries including small island states and some of the poorest countries, said they could not support the Antalya pact deal, which was supposed to be main outcome of the Cop.
paras.zh: 许多国家，包括欧盟、英国以及包括小岛屿国家和一些最贫穷国家在内的发展中国家表示，他们无法支持安塔利亚协议，而该协议本应是缔约方会议的主要成果。

paras.en: In a dramatic intervention, O’Brien said on behalf of the EU that it could not accept the final text in its current form. “It fails to meet the moment … We will not endorse a cover decision or an Antalya pact that does not even mention fossil fuels, which is the key driver of climate change.” He said the EU would not accept a decision “that greenwashes fossil fuels”.
paras.zh: 奥布莱恩戏剧性地代表欧盟表示，它不能接受目前形式的最终文本。 “它未能满足这一时刻……我们不会支持甚至不提及化石燃料的封面决定或安塔利亚协议，而化石燃料是气候变化的关键驱动因素。”他表示，欧盟不会接受“漂绿化石燃料”的决定。

paras.en: His intervention was met by applause from the hall, and was later followed by similar objections from Panama, the Marshall Islands and Norway.
paras.zh: 他的发言赢得了大厅里的掌声，随后巴拿马、马绍尔群岛和挪威也提出了类似的反对意见。

paras.en: “This feels like a real line in the sand moment. Countries are standing up to fossil fuel interests and saying no,” said Bill Hare, the chief executive of the advisory group Climate Analytics.
paras.zh: “这感觉就像是在划定一条真正的界限。各国正在挺身而出，拒绝化石燃料利益集团。”咨询机构Climate Analytics的首席执行官Bill Hare表示。

paras.en: But Mohamed Adow, the director of the thinktank Power Shift Africa, who called it “the worst Cop ever”, said: “The EU has rejected this text, but it cannot wash its hands of the wreckage it helped create ... For countries facing failed harvests, destroyed homes and mounting debt, this amounts to abandonment by the wealthy nations most responsible for the crisis.
paras.zh: 但智库“非洲权力转移”主任穆罕默德·阿多称其为“有史以来最糟糕的警察”，他表示：“欧盟拒绝了这一文本，但它无法摆脱它所造成的残骸……对于面临收成歉收、房屋被毁和债务增加的国家来说，这相当于被对危机负有最大责任的富裕国家抛弃。

paras.en: “Europe’s hypocrisy is staggering. Its governments demand fossil fuel roadmaps from others while expanding fossil fuels themselves.”
paras.zh: “欧洲的虚伪程度令人震惊。其政府要求其他国家制定化石燃料路线图，同时自己却在扩大化石燃料的规模。”

paras.en: Saudi Arabia defended the decision to include CCS in the text. Other countries, including the Africa group, China and Pakistan, also did not object to the deal, despite some having reservations. Pakistan told the conference that just because a few items in the pact were objectionable to some, the rest should not be sacrificed: “Climate action is not a menu from which we can select only what suits us.”
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯对将 CCS 纳入文本的决定进行了辩护。其他国家，包括非洲集团、中国和巴基斯坦，也没有反对该协议，尽管有些国家持保留意见。巴基斯坦在会议上表示，不应因为协议中的某些项目遭到一些人反对而牺牲其余项目：“气候行动不是一个菜单，我们只能从中选择适合我们的项目。”

paras.en: Ghana also had criticisms of the process but did not reject the final text: “Africa has always chosen to build multilateralism rather than walk away from it.”
paras.zh: 加纳也对这一进程提出了批评，但没有拒绝最终文本：“非洲始终选择建立多边主义，而不是放弃多边主义。”

paras.en: Close to 200 countries have been meeting in Antalya for a fortnight under the joint presidencies of Turkey and Australia, with the overrunning talks marked by long periods of deadlock as countries failed to find common ground.
paras.zh: 在土耳其和澳大利亚担任联合主席期间，近 200 个国家在安塔利亚举行了两周的会议，由于各国未能找到共同点，谈判陷入长期僵局。

paras.en: The Cop co-president, Australia’s climate change minister, Chris Bowen, defended his leadership. “Australia left nothing on the field,” he said, but the red lines the presidencies had tried to negotiate were “unbridgeable”.
paras.zh: 警察联席主席、澳大利亚气候变化部长克里斯·鲍文（Chris Bowen）捍卫了他的领导能力。 “澳大利亚在战场上没有留下任何东西，”他说，但历任总统试图谈判的红线是“无法逾越的”。

paras.en: Asked about the consensus-based system that broke down at the talks, Simon Stiell, the executive secretary of the UN framework convention on climate change, said: “It certainly fell short today,” while emphasising that a significant number of agenda items were passed, with “real progress and concrete results”.
paras.zh: 当被问及会谈中基于共识的体系破裂时，联合国气候变化框架公约执行秘书西蒙·斯蒂尔表示：“今天肯定没有达到目标”，同时强调通过了大量议程项目，取得了“真正的进展和具体成果”。

paras.en: But for many participants, these talks exposed a failure of collective will, particularly of the rich world, to confront the urgency of the climate crisis.
paras.zh: 但对于许多参与者来说，这些会谈暴露了集体意愿的失败，尤其是富裕国家在应对气候危机的紧迫性方面的失败。

paras.en: While extreme weather around the world has worsened this year, claiming tens of thousands of lives in heatwaves, in disasters such as the glacier collapse in Nepal, and in droughts and floods worsened by the supercharged El Niño, the slow speed of the climate negotiations appalled even veteran participants.
paras.zh: 尽管今年世界各地的极端天气有所恶化，热浪、尼泊尔冰川崩塌等灾难以及厄尔尼诺现象加剧的干旱和洪水夺走了数万人的生命，但气候谈判的缓慢速度甚至让资深参与者感到震惊。

paras.en: “There isn’t the sense of urgency to address these issues. That to me is very frustrating,” said Mary Robinson, a former president of Ireland and former UN climate envoy, as the talks neared their scheduled close. “We have co-presidents who haven’t really been stepping up and giving that leadership.”
paras.zh: “没有解决这些问题的紧迫感。这对我来说非常令人沮丧，”爱尔兰前总统、前联合国气候特使玛丽·罗宾逊在谈判接近预定结束时说道。 “我们的联席总裁并没有真正站出来发挥领导作用。”

paras.en: The UN secretary general, António Guterres, said: “I am deeply disappointed that Cop31 has ended without consensus on an overarching outcome. I share the very profound frustration of all those who expected governments to rise to the moment the climate crisis demands. But this setback does not change the facts. There may be no consensus in the negotiating room. There is no ambiguity in the science.”
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯表示：“我对第三十一届缔约方大会在没有就总体结果达成共识的情况下结束深感失望。我和所有那些希望各国政府在应对气候危机时采取行动的人一样感到非常沮丧。但这种挫折并不能改变事实。谈判室内可能没有达成共识。科学上没有任何含糊之处。”

articles.title: Russian ship hit in Benghazi by suspected Ukrainian drone attack, say Libyan officials
articles.author: Dan Sabbagh in Kharkiv, Angelique Chrisafis and agencies

paras.en: A suspected Ukrainian drone attack caused an explosion on a Russian warship docked at the naval base in the Libyan port city of Benghazi, Libyan officials have said.
paras.zh: 利比亚官员表示，疑似乌克兰无人机袭击导致停靠在利比亚港口城市班加西海军基地的一艘俄罗斯军舰发生爆炸。

paras.en: The strike severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy warship, and ignited a fire at the naval base, they said. Several Ukrainian sea drones were launched at the ship from a base run by Ukrainian forces in western Libya, according to an initial investigation into the attack. At least four drones were intercepted and destroyed, while two hit the warship, the officials told the Associated Press.
paras.zh: 他们说，这次袭击严重损坏了俄罗斯海军的“水星号”军舰，并引发了海军基地的火灾。根据对此次袭击的初步调查，几架乌克兰海上无人机从乌克兰军队在利比亚西部运营的基地向这艘船发射。官员们告诉美联社，至少四架无人机被拦截并摧毁，两架无人机击中了军舰。

paras.en: The officials were affiliated with the self-styled Libyan National Army, which controls eastern and southern Libya.
paras.zh: 这些官员隶属于自封的利比亚国民军，该军控制着利比亚东部和南部。

paras.en: There was no immediate reaction from Russian authorities, and no immediate claim of responsibility for the strike, but it comes as Ukrainian forces have stepped up their long-range barrages against Russia far beyond the frontlines.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯当局没有立即做出反应，也没有立即声称对这次袭击负责，但与此同时，乌克兰军队已经在远离前线的地方加强了对俄罗斯的远程攻击。

paras.en: Authorities in divided Libya’s east said in a statement that the vessel had stopped at Benghazi port to refuel and resupply on its way back to Russia, under maritime cooperation agreements between the two countries.
paras.zh: 分裂的利比亚东部当局在一份声明中表示，根据两国之间的海上合作协议，该船已在班加西港停靠，在返回俄罗斯的途中加油和补给。

paras.en: Two medical sources told Reuters no deaths had been reported, but there were injuries. The number and nationalities of those injured are not yet known.
paras.zh: 两名医疗消息人士告诉路透社，没有死亡报告，但有人受伤。目前尚不清楚受伤者的人数和国籍。

paras.en: In a separate attack, another sea drone hit a commercial vessel off the port of Benghazi on Sunday evening, Libyan military sources told Reuters.
paras.zh: 利比亚军方消息人士告诉路透社，在另一次袭击中，周日晚上，另一架海上无人机击中了班加西港附近的一艘商船。

paras.en: The eastern-based Libyan authority said port and naval base facilities, including warehouses, were safe and that normal operations would resume once the fire was brought under control and the site secured.
paras.zh: 利比亚东部当局表示，包括仓库在内的港口和海军基地设施是安全的，一旦火势得到控制并确保现场安全，就会恢复正常运营。

paras.en: It condemned the suspected attack as a violation of Libya’s sovereignty and a threat to maritime safety, saying it would take legal and diplomatic measures against anyone found responsible. “The Libyan government will not allow Libyan ports, territory or territorial waters to be turned into an arena for settling scores or exporting international conflicts,” it said.
paras.zh: 它谴责这起疑似袭击事件侵犯了利比亚的主权并对海上安全构成威胁，并表示将对任何责任人采取法律和外交措施。声明称：“利比亚政府不会允许利比亚港口、领土或领海成为算账或输出国际冲突的场所。”

paras.en: The specialist website Naval News also identified the ship attacked as the Merkury, a Russian corvette – the smallest class of warship, smaller than a frigate – and said it was almost certainly destroyed.
paras.zh: 专业网站《海军新闻》还确认，这艘遭到袭击的船只是俄罗斯护卫舰“水星号”——最小级别的军舰，比护卫舰还要小——并表示它几乎肯定已被摧毁。

paras.en: HI Sutton, a naval analyst, said the attack was probably conducted by sea drones, after a photograph of one emerged apparently taken off the Libyan coast. The drone, he said, “is also likely the type used in the subsequent attack”.
paras.zh: 海军分析家萨顿 (HI Sutton) 表示，这次袭击可能是由海上无人机实施的，因为一张照片显然是在利比亚海岸拍摄的。他说，这架无人机“也可能是随后袭击中使用的类型”。

paras.en: If it is confirmed that Ukraine has been able to blow up or seriously damage a Russian warship in Benghazi, it would represent one of its most successful naval strikes during the almost five-year war.
paras.zh: 如果确认乌克兰能够在班加西炸毁或严重损坏一艘俄罗斯军舰，这将是近五年战争中乌克兰最成功的海上打击之一。

paras.en: But it also represents a risky extension of the fighting far beyond eastern Europe, in an incident that could affect civilians in another continent and the working of the port.
paras.zh: 但这也代表着战斗有可能延伸到东欧以外的地区，这一事件可能会影响另一个大陆的平民和港口的运作。

paras.en: A small unit of Ukrainian special forces operatives has been based at Misrata, western Libya, and is believed to have coordinated drone attacks on Russian tankers and transport ships in the past year.
paras.zh: 乌克兰特种部队的一小支部队驻扎在利比亚西部的米苏拉塔，据信在过去一年里协调无人机袭击了俄罗斯油轮和运输船。

paras.en: Initial reports and footage suggest the Merkury was struck from above, potentially by a drone, launched no more than a few kilometres away from the target in port.
paras.zh: 初步报告和镜头显示，“水星号”是从上方被击中的，可能是由一架无人机击中的，该无人机在距港口目标不超过几公里的地方发射。

paras.en: Russia is close to the Benghazi authorities that control eastern Libya. It uses the port, which has a growing importance since it lost bases in Syria, to supply Russian mercenary forces in Africa and as a base in the Mediterranean.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯与控制利比亚东部的班加西当局关系密切。该港口自失去叙利亚基地以来变得越来越重要，它利用这个港口为非洲的俄罗斯雇佣军提供补给，并作为地中海的基地。

paras.en: Separately, a fire onboard a Russian cargo ship that was struck by drones in the Baltic Sea continued to smoulder on Sunday, Finland’s border guard said, with emergency services from Finland, Russia and Estonia working together to put out the blaze.
paras.zh: 另外，芬兰边防卫队表示，周日，一艘在波罗的海被无人机击中的俄罗斯货轮上的大火继续闷烧，芬兰、俄罗斯和爱沙尼亚的紧急服务部门共同努力扑灭大火。

paras.en: The Finnish military said the strike on the Sparta II on Saturday was probably carried out by Ukraine and that the vessel later drifted into Finnish waters, where it remained at anchor. The 16 crew members were evacuated on to a nearby Russian ship. One crew member was slightly injured.
paras.zh: 芬兰军方表示，周六对斯巴达二号的袭击可能是乌克兰所为，该船后来漂入芬兰水域，目前仍停泊在那里。 16名船员被疏散到附近的一艘俄罗斯船上。一名船员受轻伤。

paras.en: On Sunday, visible flames had been put out, with operations focusing on cooling down the containers and stabilising the vessel, Finnish authorities said.
paras.zh: 芬兰当局表示，周日，可见的火焰已被扑灭，行动重点是冷却集装箱和稳定船只。

paras.en: The ship, bound for the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad, had been damaged in international waters west of Russia’s Gogland Island, Finland’s defence forces said, corroborating an account by Russian officials.
paras.zh: 芬兰国防部称，这艘开往俄罗斯飞地加里宁格勒的船只在俄罗斯戈格兰岛以西的国际水域受损，证实了俄罗斯官员的说法。

paras.en: Kyiv has sent waves of military drones towards the Leningrad region on Russia’s north-west coast this year, including some that strayed into the airspace of nearby Baltic countries, leading to fears that the war was spilling on to Nato territory.
paras.zh: 基辅今年向俄罗斯西北海岸的列宁格勒地区派遣了大批军用无人机，其中一些无人机误入附近波罗的海国家的领空，引发人们对战争蔓延到北约领土的担忧。

paras.en: The risk of further attacks in the Gulf of Finland, a narrow arm of the Baltic Sea, could not be ruled out, Ivo Värk, the Estonian navy commander, told the public broadcaster ERR on Sunday.
paras.zh: 爱沙尼亚海军指挥官伊沃·瓦尔克周日对公共广播公司 ERR 表示，不能排除波罗的海狭窄海域芬兰湾遭受进一步袭击的风险。

paras.en: Finland’s military said last week it had detected a strike on a Russian warship in the same area during Ukrainian drone attacks.
paras.zh: 芬兰军方上周表示，在乌克兰无人机袭击期间，在同一地区发现一艘俄罗斯军舰遭到袭击。

paras.en: Reuters and the Associated Press contributed to this report
paras.zh: 路透社和美联社对此报道作出了贡献

articles.title: Datacentre bosses met Australian state premiers and ministers almost 120 times in three years, analysis finds
articles.author: Henry Belot and Josh Taylor Technology reporter

paras.en: Bosses at 10 datacentre companies secured almost 120 meetings with premiers and ministers in five states over a three-year period, with experts declaring this is “just the tip of the iceberg”.
paras.zh: 三年内，10 家数据中心公司的老板与 5 个州的州长和部长举行了近 120 次会议，专家称这“只是冰山一角”。

paras.en: Analysis by Transparency International Australia argues these meetings, when combined with political donations, demonstrate “unfettered access” to decision-makers that creates an “uneven playing field”.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚透明国际组织的分析认为，这些会议与政治捐款相结合，表明决策者可以“不受限制地接触”决策者，从而造成“不公平的竞争环境”。

paras.en: The report found donations from major datacentre companies and their contracted lobbying firms nearly tripled over the past three years from $685,000 to $1.8m, coinciding with increased investment across Australia.
paras.zh: 该报告发现，在过去三年中，主要数据中心公司及其签约游说公司的捐款几乎增加了两倍，从 685,000 澳元增至 180 万澳元，与澳大利亚各地投资的增加相一致。

paras.en: The analysis found the Queensland leader, David Crisafulli, was “by far the most frequently accessed state premier”, with public diaries showing he has met datacentre executives 13 times in the past three years.
paras.zh: 分析发现，昆士兰州领导人 David Crisafulli 是“迄今为止访问次数最多的州州长”，公开日记显示他在过去三年中与数据中心高管会面了 13 次。

paras.en: This included three meetings in as many weeks in August and September with Australia’s largest datacentre operator, NextDC – roughly one month before the company’s expansion in Melbourne was halted after its power provider delayed construction of new power poles due to community backlash.
paras.zh: 其中包括在 8 月和 9 月的几周内与澳大利亚最大的数据中心运营商 NextDC 举行了三次会议，大约在一个月前，该公司在墨尔本的扩张因社区强烈反对，其电力供应商推迟了新电线杆的建设而停止。

paras.en: “Those meetings took place shortly before the Queensland premier announced a dedicated framework to fast-track datacentre approvals by taking them out of the hands of local councils,” the Transparency International report said.
paras.zh: 透明国际的报告称：“这些会议是在昆士兰州州长宣布一个专门框架之前不久举行的，该框架旨在通过将数据中心的审批从地方议会手中夺走，从而加快数据中心的审批速度。”

paras.en: Crisafulli has embraced datacentre investment and flew to the United States in September to secure a $31.9bn deal with the AI giant Anthropic for what could become Australia’s largest datacentre. His office was contacted for comment.
paras.zh: Crisafulli 已经接受了数据中心投资，并于 9 月飞往美国，与人工智能巨头 Anthropic 达成了价值 319 亿美元的交易，该项目可能成为澳大利亚最大的数据中心。记者联系了他的办公室征求意见。

paras.en: During this three-year period, 119 meetings with ministers or premiers were held in New South Wales, Victoria, Tasmania, Queensland and the ACT. These are the only jurisdictions to publicly release ministerial diaries. The meetings were mostly held in 2026.
paras.zh: 在这三年期间，新南威尔士州、维多利亚州、塔斯马尼亚州、昆士兰州和首都地区与部长或总理举行了 119 次会议。这些是唯一公开发布部长日记的司法管辖区。这些会议大多于 2026 年举行。

paras.en: “These numbers are just the tip of the iceberg,” said Clancy Moore, the chief executive of Transparency International Australia.
paras.zh: “这些数字只是冰山一角，”澳大利亚透明国际首席执行官克兰西·摩尔说。

paras.en: “What we don’t know is how many meetings companies like NextDC, OpenAI and Anthropic and their third-party lobbyists are having with the prime minister and ministers in our federal parliament.
paras.zh: “我们不知道 NextDC、OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等公司及其第三方游说者与我们联邦议会的总理和部长进行了多少次会议。

paras.en: “Australia’s lobbying laws also don’t cover in-house lobbyists or government relations staff so there’s very little oversight of their activities too.”
paras.zh: “澳大利亚的游说法也不涵盖内部游说者或政府关系人员，因此对他们的活动也几乎没有监督。”

paras.en: The report also found Australian company Firmus Technologies secured 10 meetings with Tasmanian ministers and the premier this year alone. During this period, the company’s expansion in the state has faced sustained backlash from local communities who feel they were not properly consulted.
paras.zh: 报告还发现，仅今年一年，澳大利亚公司 Firmus Technologies 就与塔斯马尼亚部长和总理举行了 10 次会议。在此期间，该公司在该州的扩张遭到了当地社区的持续强烈反对，他们认为没有充分征求他们的意见。

paras.en: The three companies that secured the most meetings with ministers were Amazon Web Services, Macquarie Technology Group and NextDC.
paras.zh: 与部长会面次数最多的三家公司是 Amazon Web Services、Macquarie Technology Group 和 NextDC。

paras.en: Last month, Guardian Australia reported on political donations from Amazon and Macquarie to both major parties, closely aligning with the announcement of multimillion-dollar government contracts or planning developments. Both companies say these donations were not aimed at influencing policy and that their timing was coincidental.
paras.zh: 上个月，澳大利亚卫报报道了亚马逊和麦格理向两大政党提供的政治捐款，这与宣布的数百万美元的政府合同或规划开发密切相关。两家公司均表示，这些捐赠并不是为了影响政策，而且捐赠的时机纯属巧合。

paras.en: A shareholder at NextDC’s annual general meeting on Friday said the company had “a lot of lobbying going on in Canberra” but called on the company to better lobby the public on the benefits of datacentres.
paras.zh: NextDC 周五举行的年度股东大会上的一位股东表示，该公司“在堪培拉进行了大量游说活动”，但呼吁该公司更好地游说公众了解数据中心的好处。

paras.en: The company’s chair, Stephen Flynn, said he was “not sure we are great at lobbying as an industry or as a company” but the world had now changed.
paras.zh: 该公司董事长斯蒂芬·弗林表示，他“不确定我们作为一个行业或一家公司是否擅长游说”，但世界现在已经改变了。

paras.en: “We thought we were just going along and [being] invisible, in the way if you think about all telecommunications systems … [it] is kind of invisible. We just take it for granted. But we can’t do that. We can’t do that as we go forward.”
paras.zh: “我们以为我们只是继续前进，并且[成为]隐形的，就像你考虑所有电信系统一样……[它]是隐形的。我们只是认为这是理所当然的。但我们不能这样做。我们在前进的过程中不能这样做。”

paras.en: The report has also cited examples of four senior public servants at federal government departments quitting to assume leadership positions at OpenAI, AirTrunk and CDC. Three of these appointments were made this year.
paras.zh: 报告还列举了联邦政府部门四名高级公务员辞职前往 OpenAI、AirTrunk 和 CDC 担任领导职务的例子。其中三项任命是今年做出的。

paras.en: In September, the president of the Australian Professional Government Relations Association, Sally Mackenzie, said the scale of engagement between industry and ministers was a sign of the system working as intended.
paras.zh: 9月，澳大利亚专业政府关系协会主席莎莉·麦肯齐表示，行业和部长之间的接触规模是该体系按预期运作的标志。

paras.en: “What we’re seeing with AI and datacentres is that dynamic playing out at real pace, because the stakes for industry, government and Australians more broadly are so high,” Mackenzie said.
paras.zh: 麦肯齐说：“我们在人工智能和数据中心看到的是，这种动态正在以实际的速度展开，因为对行业、政府和更广泛的澳大利亚人来说，风险是如此之高。”

paras.en: “Lobbying is an important part of the democratic process. It ensures that all stakeholders have the ability to communicate with government.”
paras.zh: “游说是民主进程的重要组成部分。它确保所有利益相关者都有能力与政府沟通。”

articles.title: US Army to detonate tonnes of unstable explosives in Iowa despite court order

paras.en: The US Army plans to move ahead with detonating five tonnes of degraded explosives in Iowa despite a ruling to halt it indefinitely, a new court filing shows.
paras.zh: 一份新的法庭文件显示，美国陆军计划继续在爱荷华州引爆 5 吨已降解的爆炸物，尽管已裁定无限期停止该行动。

paras.en: "To protect its personnel and the surrounding communities, the Army needs to take swift action," the justice department notified the court on Saturday. "Protection of human health and the environment demand action now, not delay."
paras.zh: “为了保护其人员和周围社区，陆军需要迅速采取行动，”司法部周六通知法院。 “保护人类健康和环境需要立即采取行动，而不是拖延。”

paras.en: The court had ordered a pause after environmental groups sued to stop the detonation, arguing the army failed to consider safer alternatives.
paras.zh: 在环保组织提起诉讼要求停止爆炸后，法院下令暂停爆炸，理由是军队未能考虑更安全的替代方案。

paras.en: The detonation was originally scheduled for Friday at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown. The army now plans to act by 24 November under an emergency exemption.
paras.zh: 爆炸原定于周五在米德尔敦的爱荷华州陆军弹药厂进行。陆军现在计划在 11 月 24 日之前根据紧急豁免采取行动。

paras.en: In the new filing, the Department of the Army argued that a controlled detonation was necessary to protect the public from an unplanned explosion, a risk it said would become more likely as temperatures were set to fall in the coming days.
paras.zh: 在新提交的文件中，陆军部辩称，有必要进行受控爆炸，以保护公众免受意外爆炸的影响，并表示，随着未来几天气温下降，这种风险将变得更大。

paras.en: "There is an immediate risk that the lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant will explode as temperatures are expected to drop below 30 degrees Fahrenheit (-1C) in the next several days," the filing states.
paras.zh: 文件称：“由于预计未来几天气温将降至 30 华氏度 (-1C) 以下，爱荷华州陆军弹药厂的叠氮化铅将面临爆炸的直接风险。”

paras.en: It argued that the army had removed the doors to the bunker where the barrels were stored in preparation for the detonation and that made the explosives more "vulnerable to temperature changes".
paras.zh: 它认为，军队已经拆除了存放桶的掩体的门，以准备爆炸，这使得炸药更“容易受到温度变化的影响”。

paras.en: The government has not released details for the rescheduled detonation.
paras.zh: 政府尚未公布重新安排的爆炸的细节。

paras.en: Earlier, the army had warned residents to leave their homes for six hours on the original scheduled day of the explosion, for the duration of the explosion and until the dust settled. An advisory warned "all humans" to avoid being outside in the affected areas while the demolition detonation was set to take place.
paras.zh: 早些时候，军方警告居民在原定爆炸当天离开家六小时，直至爆炸持续时间直至尘埃落定。一份警告警告“所有人”在拆除爆炸即将发生时避免前往受影响地区。

paras.en: Lead azide is a highly volatile compound used as a detonator. Earlier this year, the IAAAP found that the material had degraded over time to the point where it was now too risky to move the material, according to Iowa Public Radio.
paras.zh: 叠氮化铅是一种用作雷管的高挥发性化合物。据爱荷华州公共广播电台报道，今年早些时候，IAAP 发现这些材料随着时间的推移已经降解，现在移动这些材料的风险太大。

paras.en: On Friday, the military said it was working with the Department of Health and Human Services and the EPA to ensure the explosion was done in the safest manner possible.
paras.zh: 周五，军方表示正在与卫生与公众服务部和美国环保局合作，确保爆炸以尽可能安全的方式进行。

paras.en: Military and environmental officials determined that detonating it in place was the safest way to eliminate the explosive safety hazard.
paras.zh: 军方和环境官员确定，就地引爆是消除爆炸安全隐患的最安全方法。

paras.en: The EPA, which granted an emergency permit to detonate 68 drums of the material, said it did so because the explosion risk "presented an imminent and substantial threat to human health and the environment".
paras.zh: 美国环保局授予了引爆 68 桶这种材料的紧急许可证，并表示这样做是因为爆炸风险“对人类健康和环境构成迫在眉睫的重大威胁”。

paras.en: One of the Environmental groups suing to pause the detonation, the Iowa Environmental Council, argued that many Iowans living within the risk-zone were unaware that the explosion was scheduled to happen.
paras.zh: 爱荷华州环境委员会是起诉暂停爆炸的环保组织之一，该委员会辩称，许多生活在危险区域内的爱荷华州人并不知道爆炸预定会发生。

paras.en: "There is no safe level of lead exposure, and Iowans were given just days to prepare for the November 20 detonation," the organisation said in a press statement.
paras.zh: 该组织在一份新闻声明中表示，“铅暴露没有安全水平，爱荷华州只有几天时间为 11 月 20 日的爆炸做好准备”。

paras.en: The Iowa Environmental Council and Sierra Club, which filed the lawsuit on Thursday that prompted the court-ordered pause, filed a new motion on Sunday in response to the army's filing.
paras.zh: 爱荷华州环境委员会和塞拉俱乐部于周四提起诉讼，促使法院下令暂停，并于周日提出了一项新动议，以回应军队的诉讼。

paras.en: The group asks the court to pause proceedings so that it may submit additional information before the scheduled detonation.
paras.zh: 该组织要求法院暂停诉讼程序，以便在预定的爆炸之前提交更多信息。

paras.en: The motion includes declarations from environmental experts and local officials who support pausing the detonation, citing a lack of public notice and questioning the Army's claim that delay would cause significant risks.
paras.zh: 该动议包括环境专家和地方官员的声明，他们支持暂停爆炸，理由是缺乏公众通知，并质疑陆军关于推迟爆炸会造成重大风险的说法。

articles.title: What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?

paras.en: What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?
paras.zh: COP31 气候谈判未达成协议后下一步将何去何从？

paras.en: The COP31 climate summit in Turkey has officially come to an end after countries failed to come to a consensus on a new deal.
paras.zh: 由于各国未能就新协议达成共识，在土耳其举行的 COP31 气候峰会正式结束。

paras.en: The European Union and some other countries rejected a fourth draft agreement over its failure to mention a need to phase out fossil fuels, the largest driver of global climate change.
paras.zh: 欧盟和其他一些国家拒绝了第四份协议草案，因为它没有提到需要逐步淘汰化石燃料，而化石燃料是全球气候变化的最大推动因素。

paras.en: An EU representative accuses some oil states of hijacking talks, as Russia defends opposing the inclusion of such a commitment and levels direct criticism at the EU in its speech.
paras.zh: 一名欧盟代表指责一些石油国家劫持谈判，而俄罗斯则辩称反对纳入此类承诺，并在讲话中直接批评欧盟。

paras.en: The talks have been the longest-running in the summit's history, with negotiations breaking down two days after they had been due to end.
paras.zh: 这次会谈是峰会历史上持续时间最长的一次，谈判在原定结束两天后就破裂了。

paras.en: BBC climate and science reporter Esme Stallard reports from Antalya, in Turkey.
paras.zh: BBC 气候与科学记者埃斯梅·斯塔拉德 (Esme Stallard) 在土耳其安塔利亚进行报道。

articles.title: Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say

paras.en: An explosion on a Russian ship docked at Benghazi naval base port was caused by a suspected drone attack, Libya's eastern government has said.
paras.zh: 利比亚东部政府表示，一艘停靠在班加西海军基地港口的俄罗斯船只发生爆炸，疑似由无人机袭击引起。

paras.en: The explosion happened at dawn on Sunday, while the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia, Libyan state media reported, citing the eastern government.
paras.zh: 利比亚官方媒体援引东部政府的消息称，爆炸发生在周日黎明，当时该船在返回俄罗斯的途中停下来补充燃料和补给。

paras.en: It added that the site was secured, and there were no casualties. Moscow has yet to comment.
paras.zh: 声明补充说，现场安全，没有人员伤亡。莫斯科尚未发表评论。

paras.en: Satellite imagery from Planet Labs PBC, reviewed by BBC Verify, shows a boat on fire at 0547 GMT at the Benghazi port, with a separate image captured several hours later appearing to show the same vessel partially submerged.
paras.zh: BBC verify 审查了 Planet Labs PBC 的卫星图像，显示格林威治标准时间 0547 号班加西港的一艘船着火，几小时后拍摄的另一张图像似乎显示该船部分被淹没。

paras.en: Videos posted on social media and geolocated by BBC Verify show the ship engulfed in flames and smoke, while it is still dark.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上发布并由 BBC verify 进行地理定位的视频显示，这艘船在天色还很黑的时候就被火焰和烟雾吞没了。

paras.en: The eastern-based Government of National Stability (GNS) said the Russian ship was using the Benghazi port within the framework of an existing maritime agreement.
paras.zh: 东部国家稳定政府（GNS）表示，这艘俄罗斯船只是在现有海事协议框架内使用班加西港。

paras.en: Sunday's incident is under investigation, and authorities are coordinating with their Russian counterparts to determine the source of the suspected attack and who is responsible for it, GNS added.
paras.zh: GNS 补充说，周日的事件正在调查中，当局正在与俄罗斯同行协调，以确定可疑袭击的来源以及责任人。

paras.en: GNS condemned the attack on a ship inside a Libyan port, and called it a violation of maritime safety and an attack on their sovereignty. It said Libya was not party to the Russia-Ukraine war, or any other conflict beyond its borders.
paras.zh: GNS谴责对利比亚港口内一艘船只的袭击，称这是对海上安全的侵犯和对其主权的攻击。声明称，利比亚没有参与俄罗斯-乌克兰战争或任何其他境外冲突。

paras.en: Separately, Libya's internationally recognised government in Tripoli - the Government of National Unity (GNU) - warned against hosting foreign forces and allowing them to use facilities in a statement published by state media.
paras.zh: 另外，利比亚国际公认的的黎波里政府——民族团结政府（GNU）——在官方媒体发表的一份声明中警告不要接待外国军队并允许他们使用设施。

paras.en: GNU said such activity raises "serious fears" about "risks that may result from involving ports and civilian facilities in activities related to external conflicts, and the resulting threat to the lives of citizens and the safety of national facilities and assets".
paras.zh: GNU表示，此类活动引发了“严重担忧”，即“港口和民用设施参与与外部冲突有关的活动可能带来的风险，以及由此对公民生命和国家设施和资产的安全造成的威胁”。

paras.en: Libya fractured into violence and instability after its leader Muammar Gaddafi was overthrown in 2011, leading to the opposing governments.
paras.zh: 2011 年领导人卡扎菲被推翻后，利比亚陷入暴力和不稳定，导致了对立政府的产生。

paras.en: Benghazi is more than 2,000 km (1,243 miles) away from the Russian capital Moscow.
paras.zh: 班加西距俄罗斯首都莫斯科 2,000 多公里（1,243 英里）。

paras.en: Although it has not been officially confirmed who was behind the attack, there is little doubt, according to Jalel Harchaoui, Libya specialist at the Royal United Services Institute (RUSI).
paras.zh: 皇家联合军种研究所 (RUSI) 利比亚问题专家贾勒尔·哈查维 (Jalel Harchaoui) 表示，虽然尚未正式确认此次袭击的幕后黑手是谁，但毫无疑问。

paras.en: "Ukraine is the only actor brazen enough to pull something like that off," he told the BBC. "If I were to bet my own money, I would bet that it was the Ukrainians."
paras.zh: “乌克兰是唯一一个厚颜无耻地做出这样的事情的演员，”他告诉英国广播公司。 “如果我用自己的钱打赌，我会打赌是乌克兰人。”

paras.en: If confirmed, it would not be the first time Ukrainian forces had carried out an operation of this sort. In March, Russia accused Ukraine of targeting the Russian tanker Arctic Metagaz in the Mediterranean between Libya and Malta with "uncrewed sea drones" launched from the Libyan coast.
paras.zh: 如果得到证实，这将不是乌克兰军队第一次进行此类行动。今年3月，俄罗斯指责乌克兰从利比亚海岸发射“无人海上无人机”，瞄准利比亚和马耳他之间地中海的俄罗斯油轮Arctic Metagaz。

paras.en: As well as having an economic impact on Russia, hampering the ability of their so-called shadow fleet of tankers to export oil and gas, attacks like this are seen as humiliating to the Kremlin, according to Harchaoui.
paras.zh: 哈沙维表示，此类袭击不仅对俄罗斯产生经济影响，阻碍其所谓影子油轮船队出口石油和天然气的能力，还被视为对克里姆林宫的侮辱。

paras.en: But it is not only Moscow that will want to react to this latest incident. The warship was in the region as part of a deal with the government of eastern Libya - allied with Khalifa Haftar, commander of the Libyan National Army.
paras.zh: 但想要对这一最新事件做出反应的不仅仅是莫斯科。这艘军舰是作为与利比亚东部政府（与利比亚国民军司令哈利法·哈夫塔尔结盟）达成的协议的一部分而进入该地区的。

paras.en: Harchaoui said Haftar will take the attack as a personal slight. "You're going to have a response by the Haftar family. They will ask questions about who is hosting the Ukrainians."
paras.zh: 哈沙维表示，哈夫塔尔将把这次袭击视为对他个人的侮辱。 “你将会得到哈夫塔尔家族的回应。他们会询问谁在接待乌克兰人。”

articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.

"For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
A Century of Innovation in Motion Control

For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration

To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.

A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.

To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.

Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: GEICO Donates $100,000 to Expand Collision Repair Tech Pipeline
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Collision Engineering Career Alliance announced a $100,000 grant from the GEICO Philanthropic Foundation, GEICO’s charitable arm, that will give partner colleges standardized tools to attract students, engage employers and strengthen the pipeline of skilled collision repair technicians nationwide.

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics projects 14,600 annual openings for collision repair technicians through 2034. Training programs supply only 42% of that demand, according to the TechForce Foundation 2026 Technician Supply, Demand & Opportunity Report.

Through a two-year associate degree and paid, hands-on apprenticeships, Collision Engineering helps students turn an interest in vehicle repair into a career. The grant will help partner colleges share that opportunity with more students.

“By donating to Collision Engineering, we’re opening doors for the next generation of technicians and helping address a workforce shortage that affects drivers, repair shops and insurers alike,” said Alan Durand, board member of the GEICO Philanthropic Foundation and head of associate experience at GEICO. “We’re proud to stand with Collision Engineering, educators and our industry partners to build a stronger workforce for the future.”
Grant to Support Recruitment and Employer Engagement
The contribution will support national infrastructure for student recruitment and employer engagement, including:
- A standardized recruitment framework and training for college recruiters, college staff and high school counselors
- Quarterly webinars and ongoing education
- A repeatable approach to student recruitment, employer engagement and placement
Together, these resources will help partner colleges reach more students, connect them with employers and expand the Collision Engineering model across the country.

“This donation gives Collision Engineering the national backbone every partner college needs to recruit more effectively, engage more employers and grow with confidence,” said Mary Mahoney, president of the Collision Engineering Career Alliance. “When industry, education and employers come together like this, we can offer more students in more communities hands-on training, paid apprenticeships and meaningful careers.”

Collision Engineering unites employers, colleges, industry partners and workforce leaders to build a stronger, more connected talent pipeline. The program combines a two-year associate degree with paid, hands-on apprenticeships at qualified collision repair facilities, and it is recognized by the U.S. Department of Labor as the standard for training collision engineering technicians. Students gain real-world experience, and employers gain access to a stronger pipeline of skilled talent.

“The collision repair industry talks a lot about the technician shortage, but solving it requires more than recognition,” said Laura Lozano, professor of collision repair technology and chair of the Automotive Department at Contra Costa College. “We need to introduce more young people to these careers and, just as importantly, connect them with employers willing to train and mentor them. GPF’s donation will help build those connections and give schools like ours the resources to reach more students and industry partners.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The Collision Engineering program is active at partner schools across the country, including College of Lake County in Grayslake, Ill.; Contra Costa College in San Pablo, Calif.; Parkland College in Champaign, Ill.; Metropolitan Community College in Omaha, Neb.; Sandhills Community College in Pinehurst, N.C.; North Dakota State College of Science in Wahpeton, N.D.; and El Camino College in Torrance, Calif.

“Through Collision Engineering, I graduated with a degree, real experience and a clear path forward,” said Karina Badillo, Collision Engineering graduate from the College of Lake County. “This industry is moving fast, and Collision Engineering prepared me to move with it. Donations like the one made possible by the GEICO Philanthropic Foundation will help more people get that same start.”
Employers, educators and others interested in helping students explore collision repair careers can learn about the program and ways to get involved at beacollisionengineer.com.

articles.title: Ohio Mutual Insurance Group launches ‘Trusted Repair Program’ DRP with CrashBay
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: CrashBay is now powering a direct repair program for Ohio Mutual Insurance Group.
According to CrashBay, Ohio Mutual announced the “Trusted Repair Program” earlier this year. CrashBay says Ohio Mutual was looking to streamline claims handling and improve shop relationships.
“Through its partnership with CrashBay, it now has one coordinated repair workflow that improves consistency, communication, and visibility across the entire process,” a CrashBay blog post states.
CrashBay says the workflow manages estimates, supplements, re-inspections, and communication between the carrier and its repair shops.

The post adds that the program “connects parties involved in automobile claims involving Ohio Mutual members with a trusted network of repair facilities and provides coordinated support throughout the repair process, from first notice of loss through completed repairs.”
CrashBay notes that it is the intelligence layer for collision coordination, and doesn’t own repair facilities nor perform repairs.

“Regional carriers like Ohio Mutual know their policyholders and their markets, and they want a repair program that reflects that without building the machinery to run one,” said John Harvey, founder and CEO of CrashBay, in the post. “We give them a coordinated, consistent repair process that fits how their claims team already works, so they get the benefits of a direct repair program without the administrative weight.”
The post adds that the program launch reflects a broader shift in how some regional carriers approach direct repair.
“Managing a shop network, keeping the workflow consistent, and coordinating communication no longer has to rest solely on internal resources,” the post states.

Clare Krumlauf, Ohio Mutual Insurance Group claims AVP, adds: “While insureds and claimants always retain the ultimate choice of which repair facility to use, the partnership with CrashBay adds another way for us to deliver on the trust our members place in Ohio Mutual. The program expands access to quality repair options while providing greater visibility and coordination throughout the repair process, helping those involved in a claim to navigate a challenging time with confidence.”

articles.title: CFA urges appointment of consumer-focused insurance commissioner in Texas
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: The Consumer Federation of America (CFA) urges Texas Governor-Elect Gina Hinojosa, in a letter sent to her this week, to appoint a new insurance commissioner who focuses on consumers.

“With escalating auto and homeowners insurance rates and harmful pricing practices that leave many consumers paying higher prices, the appointment of a pro-consumer Insurance Commissioner is essential to lowering the cost burden of insurance for millions of Texans,” states the letter signed by Douglas Heller, CFA director of insurance, and Michael DeLong, CFA research and advocacy associate.

According to the letter, the Texas Department of Insurance (TDI) is one of the best-resourced departments in the nation. However, over the last several years, the department has focused on protecting insurer interests and profits at the expense of consumers, the letter adds.
A consumer-focused leader at TDI could bring financial relief across the state, the letter states. Bob Hunter, a former TDI commissioner and CFA director of insurance, is pointed to as an example.
“Texas’s insurance market is one of the largest in the nation, worth about $294 billion and with more than $106 billion in direct written property and casualty premiums in 2025,” the letter states.
It adds that TDI is tasked with ensuring insurance rates are not excessive, inadequate, or unfairly discriminatory and that companies pay claims fairly and expeditiously.
TDI requires auto insurance, but the market is unaffordable for many Texans, the letter states. It adds that an estimated 14.5% of motorists in the state are uninsured.

“High prices disproportionately harm low-income consumers and communities of color because insurers include socioeconomic and personal characteristics of customers in their pricing models,” the letter states.

It adds that credit history pushes up auto insurance premiums for Texas drivers with perfect driving records. Texans with “poor” credit pay 126% more for basic coverage required by state law, it states.
CFA states that drivers with perfect driving records but “poor” or even “good” credit pay more for coverage than drivers with “excellent” credit who have been convicted of drunk driving.

“Legal and regulatory actions around the country are revealing insurers’ aggressive strategies to unfairly delay, low-ball, and deny claim payments to consumers,” CFA says. “Recently, the state of Oklahoma filed lawsuits against Allstate and State Farm for allegedly maintaining secret standards (reportedly also deployed in Texas, according to the State Farm lawsuit) where they attempted to close as many homeowners claims as possible without paying the customer anything and to reduce payments as much as possible, in spite of their massive advertising campaigns promising otherwise.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The letter also warns of increasing AI use by insurers in all aspects of the insurance product cycle with insufficient regulatory guidance or constraints.

“We expect that this will not only further disempower consumers when they buy insurance and file claims, but it will reinforce long-standing racial and ethnic biases that have harmed communities of color for decades,” the letter states.

The new commissioner must advocate for legislative reforms, including bans on socioeconomic factors insurers use to surcharge consumers higher premiums, and the creation of a low-cost auto insurance program for low-income drivers, the letter states.

“The commissioner must also provide guidance to insurers and consumers on how to reduce risk and hold insurers accountable for any mistreatment of consumers, including delays, denials, and minimizations of claims,” the letter adds.

articles.title: CIC committee tackles suggestions for AI use in claims handling
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: AI is involved in the auto claims handling process, but regulations have yet to catch up, Jill Tuggle, Auto Body Association of Texas executive director, said during the Collision Industry Conference’s most recent meeting held in Las Vegas.
The National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) approved a model bulletin in 2023 on insurer AI use that 25 states and Washington, D.C., have adopted, she said.
None of the states that have adopted the model require a human to make the final call on claim denials, she added.
An NAIC survey also found 88% of auto insurers are using or exploring AI, she said.
“We still have a long way to go,” Tuggle said.
AI now touches vehicle intake, photo review, estimating, valuation, and claim closure, she added.
Currently, a vehicle is often inspected by a shop and a field adjuster who agree on the required repairs, Tuggle explained. The estimate then goes to a central review team.

“We’re not really sure who is behind that right now,” Tuggle said. “AI is scrubbing the files in many cases, and these algorithms are built by the companies who are reviewing them. We’re not totally sure what the parameters are that are being set and how they’re writing the algorithms to take a look at these files.”
There are examples of automatic overrides for estimates that include more than eight hours of repair, Tuggle said.
A shop will reach out to a field adjuster to discuss the changes to the estimate, she adds. The shop is told the adjuster is no longer on the claim and the shop must call customer service.

“That’s when we start hitting brick walls,” Tuggle said. “So who actually made the final decision? So the issue here is the attribution gap. Who observed the car, the field adjuster? Who modified the estimate? The central team and their AI scrubbers? Who knows? That’s often very unclear. But the field adjuster is still named at the bottom.”
The CIC Governmental Committee found an example of an AI-handled claim where the shop estimate was about $2,500, Tuggle said. It came back from the central review team at $438.
The claim was closed because it was lower than the deductible, Tuggle said. She added there was no recourse for the customer on the claim decision.
“What consumers should be able to count on is knowing when AI material has shaped their claim and know who made the decision and how to reach out to them,” Tuggle said.
When asked, 67% of the CIC audience also believed consumers should know when AI is used in the claim handling process.

NAIC’s AI model is built on the existing Unfair Claims Settlement Practices Act, she explains. It covers claims and fraud detection; states controls should scale with potential harm to consumers; and states that decisions cannot be inaccurate, arbitrary, or unfairly discriminatory.
It also requires insurance companies to set clear decision authority and escalation paths, test data and models, monitor for drifts, keep records, notify consumers of AI use, and oversee vendors.

Tuggle said the bulletin doesn’t require claim-level notice that AI shaped the estimate. It also doesn’t require a change log or final author on the estimate, a named accountable reviewer, or duties for shops or vendors.
There should be more oversight depending on the consequence, Tuggle said.
For example, disclosure isn’t necessary for administrative work such as scheduling, transcription, and document searching.
Perhaps there should be AI disclosure for AI drafts with review by a qualified person and the ability to change the draft, she said.
In a third scenario, insurance companies should provide a disclosure with a named approver and a reason when AI removes repairs, totals a vehicle, or flags fraud, Tuggle said.
A meaningful human review needs to meet five criteria, she said.
- “Competence: Can spot the technical error;
- “Evidence: Sees the photos, not just AI summary;
- “Time: Not racing a productivity quota;
- “Authority: Can override without layers of approval; and
- “Permission: Can disagree without penalty.”
Tuggle asked, “At the end of the day, when you’ve got an estimate where so many different entities and people have influenced it, who owns it?”

”That’s kind of one of the major issues,” she continued. “You have your data provider who supplies the inputs and your AI vendor; they’re building the models, the algorithms for the scrubbing software that they’re using at the central review areas. And then we’ve got our estimating platform, which embeds it into the workflow. Insurers approve or deny the claim, and the repair facilities perform the repair.”
Tuggle asked whether there could be shared responsibility that is also symmetrical in the process.
The committee also suggests duties for consequential AI. This includes AI disclosing material and preserving every estimate version.

It should also attribute credit to who inspected the estimate, which system was used, changes made, and who made the changes, Tuggle said. She added that insurance companies should explain the basis for each change and provide an escalation option to a human who can reverse it.
The name also must mean something, she said.
“The field adjuster’s name at the bottom of the file is not enough, and it’s not really getting us anywhere right now,” she said. “So, proposed again, a human decides the safety and critical items.”

The committee also proposes that a qualified human must approve any cuts to procedures such as structural repairs, airbags, seatbelts, restraints, scans, ADAS calibration, fraud flags, and other safety-critical items.
“AI can advise it, but it can’t be the only reason for denial,” Tuggle said.
James Spears, Tractable head of automotive AI, said during a panel discussion that it would be difficult to imagine all the ways that AI touches insurance claims.

“AI begins at policy acquisition,” Spears said. “AI begins before they even have a customer, right? AI is used in the way that you market. AI is used once you close a policy. AI is used in underwriting. AI is used all throughout in a number of ways.”
Many assume AI has evil intent, but it can increase claim speed and accuracy, Spears said.
He explained that the AI models the general public uses aren’t as advanced as the models insurance companies use. However, he said AI will advance significantly in the coming years.
Jerry McNee of Ultimate Collision agreed that AI benefits the user.
Before AI, a shop manually went through everything and took time pulling the repair processes. It took additional time to verify, he added.
Humans also have errors and miss procedures, he said.

“We have to get ahead of it, and we have to understand it, and we have to put it to work,” McNee said. “There still has to be some human interaction and touch on it, in order to proof it and make sure.”

“The best way to employ AI is to only use it as a tool that takes some mundane task off of your team,” Spears said. “Then push that team towards the customer. That’s where you really make a difference.”
He added that he disagrees with “straight-through” processing where a human never touches a claim.
The insurance and repair industries should work together to create rules AI can work within, he said.

“Ninety-five percent of AI will get you to yes with shared rules very quickly,” Spears said. “The other 5%, that’s going to be your escalation, and that’s when you get humans talking about it. That’s the way I would play the game. If I was sitting in a carrier’s chair right now, I would have shared rules with every one of my DRPs.”
AI can help speed up parts and rental car deliveries, Spears added.
When Tuggle asked whether consumers should be notified of AI use, Spears said they should.
“But here’s the deal: It’s not going to shock a consumer,” Spears said. “Because everything in their life has AI.”
“Absolutely, consumers should be informed, especially on the decision-making when it comes to their vehicle or their policy or returning the car back to its previous condition,” McNee said.
Jill Tuggle, Auto Body Association of Texas executive director, James Spears, Tractable head of automotive AI, Jerry McNee of Ultimate Collision during CIC in Las Vegas.

articles.title: Brake Job: 2020–2026 Buick Encore GX
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: I was recently working on an ASE A5 test-prep article, and we reached the section on parking brakes. Most parking brakes act on the rear wheels, so the test is structured around that arrangement. But some vehicles have parking brakes on the front wheels. I knew that some older Saabs and Datsuns used front-wheel parking brakes. One modern example is the Buick Encore GX.

On these models, pulling the park-brake switch sends a signal to the Electronic Brake Control Module. The module supplies 12 volts to the apply-control circuits and ground to the release-control circuits, activating the left and right park-brake actuators and applying the brakes.

Pressing the switch sends a signal to the module to release the brakes. The module supplies 12 volts to the release-control circuits and ground to the apply-control circuits, activating the actuators and releasing the brakes. Depending on the vehicle, the switch may be a push-button style. Pressing it commands the parking brakes to apply or release based on their current position.

The parking brake will release automatically if the engine is running, the vehicle is shifted into gear, and the driver attempts to move off. Avoid rapid acceleration while the parking brake is applied to help preserve the parking-brake lining.
The Electronic Brake Control Module, also called the Brake System Control Module, controls the park-brake motor circuits and runs diagnostics to verify that they are operating properly.

To replace the brake pads, the park-brake caliper pistons must be fully retracted. There are two ways to put the parking brake into service mode. The preferred method is to use a scan tool with a service-mode function. If you do not have a compatible scan tool, use this procedure:
- Turn the ignition on with the engine off.
- Press the accelerator pedal halfway down.
- Move the park-brake switch to the release position and hold it for 10 seconds. Release the switch.
- Within five seconds, move the switch to the release position again.

The actuator bolts to the back of the caliper and is not included with a replacement caliper. If you remove the actuator, GM recommends replacing the caliper’s O-ring. Front-wheel parking brakes may be a novelty, but they make an interesting piece of trivia to test your technician friends on.

articles.title: What Tire Wear Reveals About Suspension and Alignments
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: A driver rolls into the shop complaining that their tires are wearing out faster than expected. The vehicle drives reasonably well, and there are no obvious suspension noises. But a closer look at the tread tells a different story.
paras.zh: 一名司机冲进商店，抱怨他们的轮胎磨损得比预期的要快。车辆行驶起来还算不错，没有明显的悬挂异响。但仔细观察胎面却发现了不同的情况。

paras.en: Uneven tire wear can reveal problems with alignment, suspension components, tire inflation and ride control. Learning how to recognize these patterns gives technicians a valuable diagnostic advantage.
paras.zh: 轮胎磨损不均匀会揭示定位、悬架部件、轮胎充气和行驶控制方面的问题。学习如何识别这些模式为技术人员提供了宝贵的诊断优势。

paras.en: The key is understanding what each wear pattern means and knowing which components to inspect next.
paras.zh: 关键是了解每种磨损模式的含义并知道接下来要检查哪些部件。

paras.en: Start With Tire Pressure and Tread Depth
paras.zh: 从轮胎压力和胎面深度开始

paras.en: Before recommending an alignment or replacing suspension components, check the basics.
paras.zh: 在建议对准或更换悬架部件之前，请先检查基础知识。

paras.en: Inspect all four tires. Measure and record tread depth across the inner, center and outer portions of each tire. Compare the readings to identify differences in wear.
paras.zh: 检查所有四个轮胎。测量并记录每个轮胎的内部、中心和外部部分的胎面深度。比较读数以识别磨损差异。

paras.en: Next, check inflation pressure against the vehicle manufacturer’s specifications. Underinflation often increases wear along both shoulders, while sustained overinflation can increase center tread wear.
paras.zh: 接下来，根据车辆制造商的规格检查充气压力。充气不足通常会增加两侧胎肩的磨损，而持续的充气过多会增加胎面中央的磨损。

paras.en: Don’t overlook the tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS). A warning light, damaged sensor or incorrect pressure setting may contribute to a problem that has gone unnoticed.
paras.zh: 不要忽视轮胎压力监测系统（TPMS）。警告灯、损坏的传感器或不正确的压力设置可能会导致未被注意到的问题。

paras.en: Also look for mismatched tires, damaged wheels and evidence of missed tire rotations.
paras.zh: 还要查找不匹配的轮胎、损坏的车轮以及错过轮胎换位的证据。

paras.en: These initial checks help determine whether the cause is tire maintenance, vehicle geometry or a mechanical problem.
paras.zh: 这些初步检查有助于确定原因是否是轮胎维护、车辆几何形状或机械问题。

paras.en: Inner-Edge Wear: Check Camber, Toe and Ride Height
paras.zh: 内缘磨损：检查外倾角、前束角和行驶高度

paras.en: When the inside shoulder wears faster than the rest of the tread, alignment geometry should be one of the first areas to investigate.
paras.zh: 当内侧胎肩比胎面其余部分磨损得更快时，对齐几何形状应该是首先要研究的区域之一。

paras.en: Negative camber means the top of the wheel tilts inward relative to the vehicle. Excessive negative camber can place additional load on the inner shoulder.
paras.zh: 负外倾角意味着车轮顶部相对于车辆向内倾斜。过大的负外倾角会给内肩带来额外的负载。

paras.en: Toe settings also matter. When wheels point too far inward or outward relative to the vehicle’s direction of travel, the tires scrub against the road instead of rolling cleanly.
paras.zh: 脚趾设置也很重要。当车轮相对于车辆行驶方向过于向内或向外时，轮胎会摩擦路面，而不是干净地滚动。

paras.en: - Problems with an air suspension system
paras.zh: - 空气悬架系统问题

paras.en: Independent rear suspensions deserve particular attention. Worn bushings can change wheel geometry during acceleration, braking and cornering.
paras.zh: 独立后悬架值得特别关注。磨损的衬套会在加速、制动和转弯过程中改变车轮的几何形状。

paras.en: Shop tip: Measure ride height before performing an alignment. If the suspension is sitting below specification, adjusting alignment angles alone may not solve the problem.
paras.zh: 商店提示：在进行对准之前测量行驶高度。如果悬架低于规格，仅调整对准角度可能无法解决问题。

paras.en: Outer-Edge Wear: Inspect Alignment and Body Control
paras.zh: 外缘磨损：检查对准和车身控制

paras.en: Excessive wear on the outside shoulder may indicate an alignment problem or excessive loading during cornering.
paras.zh: 外侧肩部过度磨损可能表明存在对准问题或转弯时负载过大。

paras.en: Positive camber, incorrect toe settings and worn suspension components can contribute to outer-edge wear.
paras.zh: 正外倾角、不正确的前束设置和磨损的悬架部件都会导致外缘磨损。

paras.en: Consider how the vehicle is driven. Crossovers and SUVs have relatively high centers of gravity, which can increase weight transfer during turns.
paras.zh: 考虑车辆的驾驶方式。跨界车和 SUV 的重心相对较高，这可以增加转弯时的重量转移。

paras.en: When springs, shocks or struts no longer control suspension movement effectively, the tire may experience additional loading and irregular wear.
paras.zh: 当弹簧、减震器或支柱不再有效控制悬架运动时，轮胎可能会承受额外的负载和不规则磨损。

paras.en: Diagnostic reminder: Outer-edge wear does not automatically mean the shocks are bad. Verify alignment and mechanical condition before recommending replacement parts.
paras.zh: 诊断提醒：外缘磨损并不自动意味着冲击不良。在建议更换零件之前，请验证对准和机械状况。

paras.en: Feathering occurs when the tread blocks develop a sharp edge on one side and a smoother, rounded edge on the other.
paras.zh: 当胎面花纹块的一侧形成尖锐边缘而另一侧形成更光滑的圆形边缘时，就会出现羽化现象。

paras.en: You may not notice feathering immediately during a visual inspection. Carefully running your hand across the tread in opposite directions can help identify the pattern.
paras.zh: 在目视检查期间您可能不会立即注意到羽化。小心地将手以相反的方向抚过胎面有助于识别花纹。

paras.en: Feathering commonly indicates an incorrect toe setting.
paras.zh: 羽化通常表明脚趾位置不正确。

paras.en: However, toe can change when worn steering or suspension components move under load. That means the alignment readings may not tell the entire story.
paras.zh: 然而，当磨损的转向或悬架部件在负载下移动时，前束可能会发生变化。这意味着对齐读数可能无法说明全部情况。

paras.en: Check for looseness in tie rods, control arm bushings and other steering components before making adjustments.
Remember that changing camber or caster can affect toe. That’s why toe is normally adjusted after other applicable alignment angles.
paras.zh: 请记住，改变外倾角或后倾角会影响前束。这就是为什么通常在其他适用的对准角度之后调整前束的原因。

paras.en: Cupping and Scalloping: Look Beyond Alignment
Cupping creates irregular high and low spots around the tire’s circumference. The pattern may resemble a series of shallow dips in the tread.
paras.zh: 拔罐会在轮胎圆周上产生不规则的高点和低点。该图案可能类似于胎面中的一系列浅凹陷。

paras.en: - Loose or damaged suspension components
paras.zh: - 悬挂部件松动或损坏

paras.en: Shocks and struts help control wheel movement as the vehicle travels over bumps. If they lose damping ability, the tire may move excessively and develop irregular wear.
paras.zh: 当车辆行驶在颠簸路面时，后减震器和前减震器有助于控制车轮的运动。如果它们失去阻尼能力，轮胎可能会过度移动并出现不规则磨损。

paras.en: However, wheel imbalance can create similar symptoms.
Shop example: A driver complains of a humming noise that increases with road speed. The rear tires show scalloped wear, but there is no obvious wheel-bearing play.
Before replacing a bearing, inspect the tire surfaces, check wheel balance and evaluate suspension condition. Tire noise can sometimes resemble a failing wheel bearing.
A vehicle’s suspension geometry is designed around a specified operating height.
paras.zh: 车辆的悬架几何形状是围绕指定的操作高度设计的。

paras.en: When springs weaken or suspension components wear, ride height can change. That affects camber, toe and the position of suspension control arms.
paras.zh: 当弹簧减弱或悬架部件磨损时，行驶高度可能会发生变化。这会影响外倾角、前束和悬架控制臂的位置。

paras.en: A small height difference may have a meaningful impact on tire wear.
paras.zh: 微小的高度差可能会对轮胎磨损产生有意义的影响。

paras.en: Measure ride height using the manufacturer’s procedure and compare the results against specification. Don’t assume that springs are healthy simply because the vehicle appears level.
On vehicles with electronic air suspension, check for leaks and verify that ride-height sensors and calibration are operating correctly.
paras.zh: 对于配备电子空气悬架的车辆，检查是否有泄漏并验证行驶高度传感器和校准是否正常运行。

paras.en: Don’t Forget Rear Alignment and Thrust Angle
paras.zh: 不要忘记后部对准和推力角

paras.en: Tire wear problems aren’t always limited to the front axle.
paras.zh: 轮胎磨损问题​​并不总是局限于前轴。

paras.en: The thrust angle describes the direction the rear wheels point relative to the vehicle’s centerline. If the rear wheels are not aligned correctly, the driver may need to compensate with the steering wheel to keep the vehicle moving straight.
paras.zh: 推力角描述了后轮相对于车辆中心线的方向。如果后轮未正确对准，驾驶员可能需要用方向盘进行补偿以保持车辆直线行驶。

paras.en: That condition can contribute to unusual tire wear and a steering wheel that appears off-center.
paras.zh: 这种情况可能会导致轮胎异常磨损和方向盘出现偏心。

paras.en: A four-wheel alignment can help identify these problems, particularly on vehicles with independent rear suspension.
paras.zh: 四轮定位可以帮助识别这些问题，特别是对于具有独立后悬架的车辆。

paras.en: When uneven tire wear enters the shop, use a consistent inspection process.
paras.zh: 当轮胎磨损不均匀进入车间时，请使用一致的检查流程。

paras.en: - Verify the complaint. Ask when the wear started and whether the vehicle pulls, vibrates or makes noise.
- Inspect the tires. Record tread depths, tire sizes, inflation pressures and visible wear patterns.
- Check the suspension. Inspect steering components, bushings, springs, shocks and struts.
- Measure ride height. Compare measurements with factory specifications.
paras.zh: - 测量行驶高度。将测量值与工厂规格进行比较。

paras.en: - Check alignment. Review camber, caster, toe and thrust angle where applicable.
paras.zh: - 检查对齐情况。如果适用，检查外倾角、主销后倾角、前束角和推力角。

paras.en: - Verify the repair. Correct the cause, evaluate tire safety and explain the findings to the customer.
The Takeaway: Let the Tires Guide Your Diagnosis
Tires are more than replaceable wear items. They provide clues about how the vehicle’s steering, suspension and alignment systems are working together.
Recognizing those clues helps technicians diagnose problems earlier, protect customers’ tire investments and avoid unnecessary repairs.
paras.zh: 识别这些线索有助于技术人员更早地诊断问题、保护客户的轮胎投资并避免不必要的维修。
