articles.title: Think Twice Before Erasing Trouble Codes
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Counter pros should avoid erasing diagnostic trouble codes when customers request it. Clearing codes without fixing the underlying problem will only temporarily turn off the check engine light.
paras.zh: 柜台专业人员应避免在客户要求时删除诊断故障代码。清除代码而不解决根本问题只会暂时关闭检查引擎灯。

paras.en: Erasing codes also deletes valuable freeze-frame data that technicians need for accurate diagnosis. Additionally, clearing codes resets emissions readiness monitors, potentially affecting vehicle emissions testing.
paras.zh: 擦除代码还会删除技术人员进行准确诊断所需的宝贵冻结帧数据。此外，清除代码会重置排放准备监视器，可能会影响车辆排放测试。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by The Pronto Network.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Pronto Network 赞助。

articles.title: NMG Gives UAC, Precision Vendor of the Year Awards
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: NexaMotion Group (NMG) named UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) and Precision International the recipients of its first annual Vendor of the Year award.
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group (NMG) 将 UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) 和 Precision International 授予其首个年度供应商奖。

paras.en: According to NMG, honorees were selected by NMG’s executive and supply chain leadership on “availability, quality and responsiveness, and on a harder test: how far the supplier was willing to go in service of NMG’s strategy and its customers’ success.”
paras.zh: 据 NMG 称，获奖者是由 NMG 的高管和供应链领导层根据“可用性、质量和响应能力，以及更严格的测试：供应商愿意在多大程度上为 NMG 的战略和客户的成功服务”而选出的。

paras.en: “Anyone can fill an order. Our best partners help us build the business,” said Scott Weinstein, president of NexaMotion Group. “UAC and Precision International show up in the planning room, not just on the loading dock. They bring us coverage before our customers ask for it, they invest in our people and our shops, and when we make bold moves as a company they are right beside us. That is partnership, and it is what this award was created to honor.”
paras.zh: “任何人都可以填写订单。我们最好的合作伙伴帮助我们发展业务，”NexaMotion Group 总裁 Scott Weinstein 说道。 “UAC 和 Precision International 出现在规划室，而不仅仅是装货码头。他们在客户提出要求之前就为我们提供报道，他们对我们的员工和商店进行投资，当我们作为一家公司采取大胆行动时，他们就在我们身边。这就是合作伙伴关系，这也是这个奖项的设立的目的。”

articles.title: NTN Volunteer Event Supports Local Food Pantry
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: NTN Bearing Corp. of America held its Community Spirit & Engagement Event at the Elk Grove Township Food Pantry in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, on Tuesday, October 27. A team of twelve NTN employees volunteered to help combat food insecurity and support local families ahead of Thanksgiving.
paras.zh: 美国 NTN 轴承公司于 10 月 27 日星期二在伊利诺伊州埃尔克格罗夫村的埃尔克格罗夫镇食品储藏室举办了社区精神与参与活动。由 12 名 NTN 员工组成的团队自愿在感恩节前帮助应对粮食不安全问题并为当地家庭提供支持。

paras.en: Volunteers spent the morning assembling approximately 400 Thanksgiving food bags that will be distributed to families throughout the community. Designed as a “trick-or-treat” style shopping experience, team members worked together at various food stations, collecting and packing items including cooking oil, canned vegetables, canned pumpkin, mashed potatoes, macaroni and cheese, gravy, brownie mix, and other household necessities.
paras.zh: 志愿者花了一上午的时间组装了大约 400 个感恩节食品袋，这些食品袋将分发给整个社区的家庭。设计为“不给糖就捣蛋”式的购物体验，团队成员在各个食品站一起工作，收集和包装物品，包括食用油、罐装蔬菜、罐装南瓜、土豆泥、通心粉和奶酪、肉汁、布朗尼蛋糕和其他家庭必需品。

paras.en: In the afternoon, NTN employees assisted pantry staff with organizing and storing five pallets of donated food. According to the food pantry manager, the work completed by the NTN team in a few hours would have taken the pantry’s regular staff and volunteers up to a month to accomplish.
paras.zh: 下午，NTN员工协助食品储藏室工作人员整理并存放了五托盘的捐赠食品。据食品储藏室经理称，NTN 团队在几个小时内完成的工作需要储藏室的正式员工和志愿者长达一个月的时间才能完成。

paras.en: NTN’s Community Spirit & Engagement Program, launched in January 2023, includes contributing time and resources to charitable organizations, encouraging employees to take an active role in the local community, and building partnerships with other groups and organizations.
paras.zh: NTN 的社区精神和参与计划于 2023 年 1 月启动，包括向慈善组织贡献时间和资源、鼓励员工在当地社区发挥积极作用，以及与其他团体和组织建立合作伙伴关系。

paras.en: The Elk Grove Township Food Pantry provides food assistance and related support services to residents facing food insecurity, serving approximately 1,100 families each month through a client-choice model that allows households to access nutritious food and household essentials in a dignified and convenient manner. Through partnerships with community organizations, donors, and volunteers, the pantry helps ensure local families have access to the resources they need throughout the year and is expected to distribute the Thanksgiving food bags assembled during the event to nearly 900 families this holiday season.
paras.zh: Elk Grove Township Food Pantry 为面临粮食不安全的居民提供粮食援助和相关支持服务，每月通过客户选择模式为约 1,100 个家庭提供服务，使家庭能够以有尊严和便捷的方式获得营养食品和家庭必需品。通过与社区组织、捐助者和志愿者的合作，食品储藏室帮助确保当地家庭能够获得全年所需的资源，并预计在这个节日期间将活动期间收集的感恩节食品袋分发给近 900 个家庭。

articles.title: NMG Gives UAC, Precision Vendor of the Year Awards
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: NexaMotion Group (NMG) named UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) and Precision International the recipients of its first annual Vendor of the Year award.
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group (NMG) 将 UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) 和 Precision International 授予其首个年度供应商奖。

paras.en: According to NMG, honorees were selected by NMG’s executive and supply chain leadership on “availability, quality and responsiveness, and on a harder test: how far the supplier was willing to go in service of NMG’s strategy and its customers’ success.”
paras.zh: 据 NMG 称，获奖者是由 NMG 的高管和供应链领导层根据“可用性、质量和响应能力，以及更严格的测试：供应商愿意在多大程度上为 NMG 的战略和客户的成功服务”而选出的。

paras.en: “Anyone can fill an order. Our best partners help us build the business,” said Scott Weinstein, president of NexaMotion Group. “UAC and Precision International show up in the planning room, not just on the loading dock. They bring us coverage before our customers ask for it, they invest in our people and our shops, and when we make bold moves as a company they are right beside us. That is partnership, and it is what this award was created to honor.”
paras.zh: “任何人都可以填写订单。我们最好的合作伙伴帮助我们发展业务，”NexaMotion Group 总裁 Scott Weinstein 说道。 “UAC 和 Precision International 出现在规划室，而不仅仅是装货码头。他们在客户提出要求之前就为我们提供报道，他们对我们的员工和商店进行投资，当我们作为一家公司采取大胆行动时，他们就在我们身边。这就是合作伙伴关系，这也是这个奖项的设立的目的。”

articles.title: AACF Golf Tournament Raises Record $700,000
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Automotive Aftermarket Charitable Foundation (AACF) celebrated the success of its 34th annual Bob Schoeberl Memorial Charity Golf Tournament. The event took place Nov. 1-2 at Spanish Trail Country Club in Las Vegas. The sold-out event brought together 216 golfers and other automotive aftermarket industry supporters for two days of networking and competition.
paras.zh: 汽车售后市场慈善基金会 (AACF) 庆祝其第 34 届年度鲍勃·舍伯尔纪念慈善高尔夫锦标赛取得成功。该活动于 11 月 1 日至 2 日在拉斯维加斯西班牙小径乡村俱乐部举行。此次活动门票全部售完，共有 216 名高尔夫球手和其他汽车售后市场行业支持者齐聚一堂，进行为期两天的交流和比赛。

paras.en: Fundraising activities included the tournament, live auction, prize drawings and golf pro experiences. These activities raised nearly $700,000, marking the highest total in the event’s history. The funds will help AACF provide financial assistance to aftermarket families facing unexpected hardships.
paras.zh: 筹款活动包括锦标赛、现场拍卖、抽奖和高尔夫职业体验。这些活动筹集了近 70 万美元，创下了该活动历史上的最高总额。这些资金将帮助 AACF 为面临意外困难的售后家庭提供经济援助。

paras.en: AACF Tournament Supports Aftermarket Families
paras.zh: AACF 锦标赛支持售后家庭

paras.en: “When a member of the automotive aftermarket community faces an unexpected hardship, the support of this industry can make all the difference,” said John Kairys, executive director of AACF. “The generosity of everyone who participated in this year’s tournament will help ensure that individuals and families facing some of life’s most difficult moments know they aren’t alone. We’re thankful and appreciative that this community comes together year after year for such an important cause.”
paras.zh: AACF 执行董事 John Kairys 表示：“当汽车售后市场社区的成员面临意想不到的困难时，该行业的支持可以发挥重要作用。” “参加今年比赛的每个人的慷慨将有助于确保面临生活中最困难时刻的个人和家庭知道他们并不孤单。我们感谢和赞赏这个社区年复一年地为了如此重要的事业聚集在一起。”

paras.en: Historic Hole-in-One Highlights Tournament
paras.zh: 历史性一杆进洞精彩赛事

paras.en: Among this year’s tournament highlights, Sean McLoraine became the first participant in the event’s 34-year history to win the hole-in-one contest. Interstate Batteries sponsored the contest, which featured a new 2026 Toyota Tundra as its grand prize.
paras.zh: 在今年赛事的亮点中，肖恩·麦克洛兰 (Sean McLoraine) 成为该赛事 34 年历史上第一位赢得一杆进洞比赛的参赛者。 Interstate Batteries 赞助了此次竞赛，其大奖为一辆全新 2026 款丰田坦途 (Toyota Tundra)。

paras.en: “I look forward to this tournament every year because I love seeing our industry come together to give back to the people who make it what it is,” said Jeff Helfrich, AACF golf committee chairman. “To raise a record amount for aftermarket families and have Sean McLoraine make the first hole-in-one for a vehicle in our 34 years of playing this event made this a year I’ll always remember. Congratulations to Sean on his new Toyota Tundra and thank you to Interstate Batteries for sponsoring the contest.”
paras.zh: AACF 高尔夫委员会主席杰夫·赫尔弗里奇 (Jeff Helfrich) 表示：“我每年都期待着这项赛事，因为我喜欢看到我们的行业齐心协力，回馈那些做出今天的贡献的人们。” “为售后家庭筹集了创纪录的金额，并让肖恩·麦克洛兰 (Sean McLoraine) 在我们参加这项赛事 34 年来首次打进一杆进洞，这让我永远铭记这一年。祝贺肖恩 (Sean) 拥有他的新丰田坦途 (Toyota Tundra)，并感谢 Interstate Batteries 对本次比赛的赞助。”

paras.en: AACF thanked the participants, sponsors, donors, volunteers and industry partners who supported this year’s tournament. Those interested in participating in or sponsoring the 2027 Bob Schoeberl Memorial Golf Tournament can click here for updates and additional information.
paras.zh: AACF 感谢支持今年比赛的参赛者、赞助商、捐助者、志愿者和行业合作伙伴。有兴趣参加或赞助 2027 年 Bob Schoeberl 纪念高尔夫锦标赛的人士可以点击此处获取更新和其他信息。

articles.title: Gates to Acquire Nitta’s Stakes in Five Asian Markets
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Gates Industrial Corporation Ltd. announced an agreement to acquire Nitta Corporation’s interests in five Asia-Pacific joint ventures. The transaction will give Gates full ownership of its power transmission businesses in China, India, Thailand, Korea and Singapore. Gates also will sell its interest in the Japan joint venture to Nitta.
paras.zh: 盖茨工业有限公司宣布达成协议，收购新田公司在五家亚太合资企业中的权益。此次交易将使盖茨完全拥有其在中国、印度、泰国、韩国和新加坡的输电业务。盖茨还将把其在日本合资企业的权益出售给新田。

paras.en: The joint venture helped broaden Gates’ reach into emerging economies in the Asia-Pacific region. Since 1986, Gates has held a 51% ownership stake in each joint venture entity. Gates has consolidated the entities’ financial results into its own reporting.
paras.zh: 该合资企业帮助盖茨扩大了在亚太地区新兴经济体的影响力。自1986年以来，盖茨在每个合资实体中持有51%的股权。盖茨已将这些实体的财务业绩合并到自己的报告中。

paras.en: The transaction will allow Gates to operate in Asia-Pacific through a wholly owned platform. It also reinforces the company’s long-term commitment to the region.
paras.zh: 此次交易将使盖茨能够通过全资平台在亚太地区开展业务。它还加强了公司对该地区的长期承诺。

paras.en: Gates anticipates several benefits from the transaction, including:
paras.zh: 盖茨预计此次交易将带来诸多好处，包括：

paras.en: - Increasing reported earnings per share by eliminating the noncontrolling interest associated with the joint venture. Gates estimates the transaction will increase annual adjusted earnings per share (EPS) by $0.02 on a pro forma basis.
paras.zh: - 通过消除与合资企业相关的非控股权益来增加每股报告收益。盖茨预计，此次交易将使年度调整后每股收益 (EPS) 预计增加 0.02 美元。

paras.en: - Expanding Gates’ strategic flexibility to independently pursue growth initiatives in the Asia-Pacific region.
paras.zh: - 扩大盖茨的战略灵活性，以独立追求亚太地区的增长计划。

paras.en: - Providing Gates with greater access to foreign cash reserves.
paras.zh: - 为盖茨提供更多获得外汇现金储备的机会。

paras.en: - Mitigating future restructuring investments.
paras.zh: - 减少未来的重组投资。

paras.en: - Simplifying Gates’ financial reporting.
paras.zh: - 简化盖茨的财务报告。

paras.en: Gates will pay Nitta approximately $40.2 million in dividends and a net $112 million for equity interests. The equity payment remains subject to certain post-closing adjustments.
paras.zh: 盖茨将向 Nitta 支付约 4020 万美元的股息和净额 1.12 亿美元的股权。股权支付仍需进行某些交割后调整。

paras.en: Gates has historically consolidated the joint venture for accounting purposes. As a result, a portion of the joint venture’s revenue and profitability will transfer to Nitta.
paras.zh: 盖茨历来出于会计目的合并了该合资企业。因此，合资企业的部分收入和盈利能力将转移给新田。

paras.en: Gates estimates the transaction will reduce its annualized 2027 consolidated sales by approximately $88 million to $108 million. The company also expects a reduction of approximately $26 million to $32 million in annualized 2027 adjusted EBITDA.
paras.zh: 盖茨估计，此次交易将使其 2027 年综合销售额减少约 8800 万美元至 1.08 亿美元。该公司还预计 2027 年年度调整后 EBITDA 将减少约 2600 万至 3200 万美元。

paras.en: “We have built a profitable, growing business under Gates’ leadership across Asia-Pacific through a longstanding, collaborative relationship with Nitta. Taking full ownership in these markets gives Gates greater flexibility to pursue our growth strategy in the region,” said Ivo Jurek, Chief Executive Officer of Gates Industrial Corporation. “In conjunction with Nitta, we will work closely with employees, customers, suppliers and relevant regulatory bodies to ensure continuity.”
paras.zh: 盖茨工业公司首席执行官伊沃·尤雷克 (Ivo Jurek) 表示：“通过与 Nitta 的长期合作关系，在盖茨的领导下，我们在亚太地区建立了盈利且不断增长的业务。完全掌控这些市场使盖茨能够更灵活地实施我们在该地区的增长战略。” “我们将与 Nitta 合作，与员工、客户、供应商和相关监管机构密切合作，以确保连续性。”

paras.en: The transaction will conclude the longstanding partnership. Gates expects to close the transaction in the first quarter of 2027. The closing remains subject to customary conditions, including required regulatory approvals.
paras.zh: 此次交易将结束双方的长期合作关系。盖茨预计将在 2027 年第一季度完成交易。该交易仍需满足惯例条件，包括所需的监管批准。

articles.title: VIVE Collision Appoints Charlie Drake Chief Operating Officer
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: VIVE Collision announced that it appointed Charlie Drake chief operating officer (COO) earlier this year. Drake brings nearly 40 years of industry experience and a people-first leadership approach that supports VIVE’s commitment to its teammates, customers and communities.
paras.zh: VIVE Collision 在今年早些时候宣布任命 Charlie Drake 为首席运营官 (COO)。 Drake 拥有近 40 年的行业经验和以人为本的领导方法，支持 VIVE 对团队成员、客户和社区的承诺。

paras.en: With two decades in operations leadership at national collision repair organizations, Drake combines experience managing multi-location businesses with a practical understanding of the work happening in each repair facility. He is known for building strong teams, linking culture to performance and creating systems that support accountability and a consistent customer experience.
paras.zh: 德雷克（Drake）在国家碰撞修复组织担任运营领导职务已有二十年，他将管理多地点业务的经验与对每个维修设施中发生的工作的实际了解结合起来。他以建立强大的团队、将文化与绩效联系起来以及创建支持责任和一致的客户体验的系统而闻名。

paras.en: “Growing VIVE means making sure our people have the leadership and support to do their best work,” said Vartan Jerian, Jr., CEO and founder of VIVE Collision. “Charlie understands what it takes to run a successful collision repair organization and how much of that success comes down to the people in each location. His experience and approach will help us strengthen our operations while keeping our teammates and customers at the center of every decision.”
paras.zh: VIVE Collision 首席执行官兼创始人 Vartan Jerian, Jr. 表示：“发展 VIVE 意味着确保我们的员工获得领导力和支持，以尽其所能。” “查理了解成功运营一个碰撞修复组织需要什么，以及这种成功在多大程度上取决于每个地点的员工。他的经验和方法将帮助我们加强运营，同时让我们的队友和客户成为每个决策的中心。”

paras.en: As COO, Drake will lead VIVE’s operations, working with its leadership teams to support performance across the organization. His appointment reinforces VIVE’s focus on “People, Process and Passion,” pairing investment in its people with the operational discipline needed to deliver high-quality repairs and earn customer trust.
paras.zh: 作为首席运营官，Drake 将领导 VIVE 的运营，与其领导团队合作以支持整个组织的绩效。他的任命强化了 VIVE 对“人员、流程和热情”的关注，将对人员的投资与提供高质量维修和赢得客户信任所需的运营纪律相结合。

paras.en: Read the full article on bodyshopbusiness.com.
paras.zh: 请在 bodyshopbusiness.com 上阅读全文。

articles.title: The 45-Day Rule: How Parts Stores Stop Financing Their Customers
articles.author: Bob Morgan

paras.en: Every parts store has an account like this. The shop buys a lot. The owner is a good guy. He pays — eventually. Meanwhile he’s 50 to 90 days out and asking for another special order “by Thursday.”
paras.zh: 每个配件店都有一个这样的帐户。店里买的很多。店主是个好人。他最终付出了代价。与此同时，他有 50 到 90 天的时间，并要求“在周四之前”再下一份特别订单。

paras.en: Here’s the hard truth I learned after about 15 years running stores on Long Island: volume you don’t collect isn’t volume. It’s a loan you never approved. Most stores aren’t short on sales. They’re short on cash because they’re quietly running a bank for their customers, with the special-order desk as the loan window.
paras.zh: 这是我在长岛经营商店大约 15 年之后学到的残酷事实：你不收集的数量就不是数量。这是一笔您从未批准过的贷款。大多数商店都不缺销售。他们缺乏现金，因为他们悄悄地为客户经营一家银行，以特殊订单柜台作为贷款窗口。

paras.en: The fix isn’t a collections agency or a nasty letter. It’s one rule, written down and used every single time.
paras.zh: 解决办法不是催收机构或令人讨厌的信件。这是一条规则，写下来并每次都使用。

paras.en: If an account is 45 or more days past due and they want a special order, the special waits until the money is in the building.
paras.zh: 如果账户逾期 45 天或以上，并且他们想要特殊订单，则特殊订单会等到钱到达大楼后才进行。

paras.en: That’s it. Shelf stock can still go out for cash. The relationship stays intact. But you stop ordering non-returnable, hard-to-restock parts for an account that hasn’t paid for the last batch.
paras.zh: 就是这样。货架库存仍然可以换取现金。关系保持完好。但您会停止为上一批尚未付款的帐户订购不可退货、难以补货的零件。

paras.en: Why special orders? A stocked part sold on account is a receivable. A special order for a slow-paying account is a receivable plus freight, a restocking fee and a part you may end up owning if the job falls through. That’s where slow accounts do the most damage, so that’s where the line goes.
paras.zh: 为什么要特殊订单？赊销的库存零件是应收账款。慢付款帐户的特殊订单是应收账款加上运费、补货费以及如果工作失败您最终可能拥有的部分。这就是缓慢的帐户造成最大损害的地方，所以这就是线路的所在。

paras.en: Before the rule works, everyone at the counter has to agree on what “45 days” means. I count days past the due date, not days since the invoice. A Net 30 invoice dated June 12 is due July 12. On September 2, it’s 52 days past due — over the line.
paras.zh: 在规则生效之前，柜台上的每个人都必须就“45 天”的含义达成一致。我计算的是到期日之后的天数，而不是发票后的天数。日期为 6 月 12 日的 Net 30 发票应于 7 月 12 日到期。到 9 月 2 日，已逾期 52 天。

paras.en: If you’d rather age from the invoice date, fine. Pick one method, write it on the rule and never switch mid-argument. If your company already has a hold policy, use its number. The discipline matters more than the exact day.
paras.zh: 如果您希望从发票日期算起，没问题。选择一种方法，将其写在规则上，并且永远不要在争论中途改变。如果您的公司已有保留政策，请使用其号码。纪律比具体的日子更重要。

paras.en: The 45-day rule works because nobody gets surprised by it. The steps before it do the heavy lifting:
paras.zh: 45 天的规则之所以有效，是因为没有人对此感到惊讶。完成繁重工作之前的步骤：

paras.en: - Day 30 — a reminder, not a threat. “Invoice 1844 is at 30. Card or check on the next stop?”
paras.zh: - 第 30 天——提醒，而不是威胁。 “发票 1844 是 30。下一站刷卡还是支票？”

paras.en: - Day 35–40 — a human call. Not another statement they’re already ignoring. A person, by name, on the phone.
paras.zh: - 第 35-40 天 — 人工召唤。这不是他们已经忽视的另一个声明。一个人，叫出名字，正在打电话。

paras.en: - Day 45 — credit hold for new specials. Shelf can still be cash. Specials wait.
paras.zh: - 第 45 天 — 新特价商品的积分保留。货架上还是可以现金的。特价等。

paras.en: - Day 60 — hard hold. No “just this once” unless a manager puts the amount and the date in writing.
paras.zh: - 第 60 天 — 坚守。除非经理以书面形式注明金额和日期，否则不能“仅此一次”。

paras.en: Most accounts never reach day 45 once the day-30 and day-35 touches actually happen. The rule is the backstop, not the first move.
paras.zh: 一旦第 30 天和第 35 天的接触实际发生，大多数帐户永远不会到达第 45 天。规则是后盾，而不是第一步。

paras.en: Give your counter people the exact words. Nobody should improvise a credit conversation with a regular at the register. At day 45:
paras.zh: 向柜台人员提供准确的词语。任何人都不应该在收银台与常客即兴进行信用对话。第 45 天：

paras.en: “I can keep selling you what’s here if we’re cash. I can’t put another special in motion until 1844 is clear. I need you current so I can keep saying yes.”
paras.zh: “如果我们有现金，我可以继续向你出售这里的商品。在 1844 年明确之前，我无法推出另一个特价商品。我需要你提供最新信息，这样我才能继续答应。”

paras.en: “I like working with you. I can’t keep shipping on a 60-day balance. Let’s pick an amount for this week and a date for the rest. Until that starts, we’re cash.”
paras.zh: “我喜欢和你一起工作。我无法在 60 天的余额中继续发货。让我们选择本周的金额和其余的日期。在那之前，我们都是现金。”

paras.en: Those lines don’t threaten and don’t apologize. They state the rule and offer a path back. “I need you current so I can keep saying yes” puts you and the customer on the same side.
paras.zh: 这些台词既不构成威胁，也不构成道歉。他们陈述规则并提供返回路径。 “我需要你保持最新状态，这样我才能一直说“是””让你和客户站在同一边。

paras.en: The most common way the rule breaks: “I’m not paying until you fix that core credit.” Freeze the one disputed line and research it. The rest of the balance is still due. Don’t let a $40 question hold up a $4,000 balance.
paras.zh: 最常见的违反规则的方式是：“在你修复核心信用之前，我不会付款。”冻结一条有争议的线路并进行研究。其余余额仍需支付。不要让 40 美元的问题占用 4,000 美元的余额。

paras.en: And if yelling breaks the rule, you’ve just taught every shop in town that yelling works. The rule has to hold for your biggest account, too.
paras.zh: 如果大喊大叫违反了规则，那么你就已经告诉镇上的每一家商店大喊大叫是有效的。该规则也必须适用于您最大的帐户。

paras.en: A rule nobody checks turns into a suggestion. Once a week — I do it in a short Monday meeting — pull your aging and look at three things:
paras.zh: 无人检查的规则变成了建议。每周一次——我在周一的一次简短会议上进行——拉动你的衰老，看看三件事：

paras.en: - Total dollars 45+ and 60+ days past due.
paras.zh: - 逾期 45 天以上和 60 天以上的总金额。

paras.en: - A name and a next-call date next to every one of those accounts.
paras.zh: - 每个帐户旁边都有姓名和下次通话日期。

paras.en: - Any special order that went out to a 45+ account, and who approved it.
paras.zh: - 发送至 45+ 帐户的任何特殊订单以及批准者。

paras.en: A simple example (invented numbers): a store has $6,940 at 45+ days past due across two accounts. A fleet account on that list calls for a special. The counter person checks the list and uses the day-45 line. The special gets placed the afternoon the check clears. No fight, no exception, and the store isn’t fronting more parts to a customer who already owes $4,200.
paras.zh: 一个简单的例子（虚构的数字）：一家商店的两个帐户逾期 45 天以上，有 6,940 美元。该名单上的车队帐户需要特殊服务。柜台人员检查清单并使用第 45 天的线路。特价商品将在支票兑现的下午进行。没有打架，没有例外，商店也不会向已经欠下 4,200 美元的顾客提供更多零件。

paras.en: - Export or write down your current aging.
paras.zh: - 导出或写下您当前的年龄。

paras.en: - Highlight everything 45+ and 60+ days past due.
paras.zh: - 突出显示逾期 45 天以上和 60 天以上的所有内容。

paras.en: - Put a name and a next-call date on every one.
paras.zh: - 在每个人身上写上姓名和下次通话日期。

paras.en: - Write the special-order rule on a sticky note at the counter where everyone can see it.
paras.zh: - 将特殊订单规则写在柜台的便利贴上，让每个人都能看到。

paras.en: You can like the shop. You can need the volume. You still collect. The 45-day rule is how a parts store stops financing its customers and gets back to selling them parts.
paras.zh: 你可以喜欢这家商店。您可能需要音量。你还是收藏吧。 45 天规则规定了零部件商店如何停止向客户提供融资并重新向他们销售零部件。

articles.title: AACF Golf Tournament Raises Record $700,000
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Automotive Aftermarket Charitable Foundation (AACF) celebrated the success of its 34th annual Bob Schoeberl Memorial Charity Golf Tournament. The event took place Nov. 1-2 at Spanish Trail Country Club in Las Vegas. The sold-out event brought together 216 golfers and other automotive aftermarket industry supporters for two days of networking and competition.
paras.zh: 汽车售后市场慈善基金会 (AACF) 庆祝其第 34 届年度鲍勃·舍伯尔纪念慈善高尔夫锦标赛取得成功。该活动于 11 月 1 日至 2 日在拉斯维加斯西班牙小径乡村俱乐部举行。此次活动门票全部售完，共有 216 名高尔夫球手和其他汽车售后市场行业支持者齐聚一堂，进行为期两天的交流和比赛。

paras.en: Fundraising activities included the tournament, live auction, prize drawings and golf pro experiences. These activities raised nearly $700,000, marking the highest total in the event’s history. The funds will help AACF provide financial assistance to aftermarket families facing unexpected hardships.
paras.zh: 筹款活动包括锦标赛、现场拍卖、抽奖和高尔夫职业体验。这些活动筹集了近 70 万美元，创下了该活动历史上的最高总额。这些资金将帮助 AACF 为面临意外困难的售后家庭提供经济援助。

paras.en: AACF Tournament Supports Aftermarket Families
paras.zh: AACF 锦标赛支持售后家庭

paras.en: “When a member of the automotive aftermarket community faces an unexpected hardship, the support of this industry can make all the difference,” said John Kairys, executive director of AACF. “The generosity of everyone who participated in this year’s tournament will help ensure that individuals and families facing some of life’s most difficult moments know they aren’t alone. We’re thankful and appreciative that this community comes together year after year for such an important cause.”
paras.zh: AACF 执行董事 John Kairys 表示：“当汽车售后市场社区的成员面临意想不到的困难时，该行业的支持可以发挥重要作用。” “参加今年比赛的每个人的慷慨将有助于确保面临生活中最困难时刻的个人和家庭知道他们并不孤单。我们感谢和赞赏这个社区年复一年地为了如此重要的事业聚集在一起。”

paras.en: Historic Hole-in-One Highlights Tournament
paras.zh: 历史性一杆进洞精彩赛事

paras.en: Among this year’s tournament highlights, Sean McLoraine became the first participant in the event’s 34-year history to win the hole-in-one contest. Interstate Batteries sponsored the contest, which featured a new 2026 Toyota Tundra as its grand prize.
paras.zh: 在今年赛事的亮点中，肖恩·麦克洛兰 (Sean McLoraine) 成为该赛事 34 年历史上第一位赢得一杆进洞比赛的参赛者。 Interstate Batteries 赞助了此次竞赛，其大奖为一辆全新 2026 款丰田坦途 (Toyota Tundra)。

paras.en: “I look forward to this tournament every year because I love seeing our industry come together to give back to the people who make it what it is,” said Jeff Helfrich, AACF golf committee chairman. “To raise a record amount for aftermarket families and have Sean McLoraine make the first hole-in-one for a vehicle in our 34 years of playing this event made this a year I’ll always remember. Congratulations to Sean on his new Toyota Tundra and thank you to Interstate Batteries for sponsoring the contest.”
paras.zh: AACF 高尔夫委员会主席杰夫·赫尔弗里奇 (Jeff Helfrich) 表示：“我每年都期待着这项赛事，因为我喜欢看到我们的行业齐心协力，回馈那些做出今天的贡献的人们。” “为售后家庭筹集了创纪录的金额，并让肖恩·麦克洛兰 (Sean McLoraine) 在我们参加这项赛事 34 年来首次打进一杆进洞，这让我永远铭记这一年。祝贺肖恩 (Sean) 拥有他的新丰田坦途 (Toyota Tundra)，并感谢 Interstate Batteries 对本次比赛的赞助。”

paras.en: AACF thanked the participants, sponsors, donors, volunteers and industry partners who supported this year’s tournament. Those interested in participating in or sponsoring the 2027 Bob Schoeberl Memorial Golf Tournament can click here for updates and additional information.
paras.zh: AACF 感谢支持今年比赛的参赛者、赞助商、捐助者、志愿者和行业合作伙伴。有兴趣参加或赞助 2027 年 Bob Schoeberl 纪念高尔夫锦标赛的人士可以点击此处获取更新和其他信息。

articles.title: Why do wolves howl?
articles.author: Charles Q. Choi

paras.en: Wolves can bark, whimper, yip, squeak and growl, but they are most known for their iconic howl.
paras.zh: 狼可以吠叫、呜咽、吠叫、吱吱声和咆哮，但它们最出名的是它们标志性的嚎叫。

paras.en: The eerie sound can travel vast distances and, if heard by other wolves, get them to join in with the chorus. But why do wolves howl in the first place?
paras.zh: 这种怪异的声音可以传播很远的距离，如果被其他狼听到，它们就会加入合唱。但狼为什么要嚎叫呢？

paras.en: Experts told Live Science that the behavior is triggered not by the sight of the moon, as is commonly believed, but by the need to maintain a complex social network.
paras.zh: 专家告诉《生活科学》杂志，这种行为并不是像人们普遍认为的那样是由看到月亮引发的，而是由维持复杂的社交网络的需要引起的。

paras.en: Wolves can howl by themselves and in groups. "If a lone wolf howls, it's probably because they're separated from their pack and want to regain contact," Arik Kershenbaum, a zoologist at the University of Cambridge, told Live Science. "Members of a pack can become quite dispersed, and when they need to hunt together, or to care for pups, or when their territory is being threatened by other wolves, they need a way of returning to each other."
paras.zh: 狼可以单独嚎叫，也可以成群嚎叫。剑桥大学动物学家阿里克·克申鲍姆 (Arik Kershenbaum) 告诉《生活科学》杂志：“如果一只独狼嚎叫，很可能是因为它们与狼群分开了，想要重新获得联系。” “狼群中的成员可能会变得相当分散，当它们需要一起狩猎、照顾幼崽、或者当它们的领地受到其他狼的威胁时，它们需要一种回到彼此身边的方式。”

paras.en: However, lone wolves that leave their packs may howl as well. This could be "a way of finding a new pack or mate to join," Kershenbaum said.
paras.zh: 然而，离开狼群的独狼也可能会嚎叫。克申鲍姆说，这可能是“寻找新狼群或伙伴加入的一种方式”。

paras.en: When a wolf pack howls together, they are sometimes advertising their territory to deter other packs. "Data shows that packs howl more in the center of their territory; they howl more when there are pups around and also when they have a carcass from a hunt," Tamás Faragó, an ethologist and bioacoustician at Eötvös Loránd University in Budapest, Hungary, told Live Science. "So group howling can have a repellent effect on neighboring packs."
paras.zh: 当狼群一起嚎叫时，它们有时是在宣传自己的领地，以威慑其他狼群。匈牙利布达佩斯罗兰大学的动物行为学家和生物声学学家塔马斯·法拉戈 (Tamás Faragó) 告诉《生活科学》杂志：“数据显示，狼群在领地的中心嚎叫得更多；当周围有幼崽时，或者在狩猎中获得尸体时，狼群会嚎叫得更多。” “因此群体嚎叫会对邻近的狼群产生排斥作用。”

paras.en: However, "most chorus howling is social — that is, they howl together to build what is technically called social cohesion," Kershenbaum said, "because it makes them feel good to be safe and surrounded by their pack mates. Faragó noted that this kind of group howling gets a pack in the same mood, "and is quite common before going out on a hunt."
paras.zh: 然而，“大多数合唱嚎叫都是社交性的——也就是说，它们一起嚎叫是为了建立技术上所谓的社会凝聚力，”克申鲍姆说，“因为这让它们感觉很安全，并被同伴包围着。法拉戈指出，这种集体嚎叫会得到一群心情相同的狼群，“这在外出狩猎之前很常见。”

paras.en: Feed your curiosity with an exclusive mystery every week, solved with science and delivered direct to your inbox before it's seen anywhere else.
paras.zh: 每周都会有一个独家谜题来满足您的好奇心，这些谜题将通过科学解决，并在其他地方看到之前直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Howling can trigger more howling. "When an individual wolf hears a howl, it has a very strong tendency to reply back," Faragó said. However, "if a lone wolf is accidentally wandering into the territory of its neighbors, and they hear the pack there howling, they won't respond. That would make it obvious that it's an intruder there."
paras.zh: 嚎叫可以引发更多的嚎叫。 “当一只狼听到嚎叫时，它有一种非常强烈的反应倾向，”法拉戈说。然而，“如果一只独狼不小心走进了邻居的领地，而它们听到狼群的嚎叫声，它们就不会做出反应。这会很明显表明它是那里的入侵者。”

paras.en: A wolf's howl can be heard up to 10 miles (16 kilometers) away in open terrain, according to the Wolf Conservation Center in South Salem, New York. The combination of low- and high-frequency sounds that make up howls ensures that "even if some of the lower-frequency sounds are attenuated by vegetation, the higher-frequency components can remain intact and carry a lot of information about the individuals that made the howls," Faragó said.
paras.zh: 据纽约州南塞勒姆狼保护中心称，在开阔地带，最远 10 英里（16 公里）外都可以听到狼的嚎叫声。构成嚎叫的低频和高频声音的组合确保了“即使一些低频声音被植被减弱，高频成分也可以保持完整，并携带有关发出嚎叫的个体的大量信息，”法拉戈说。

paras.en: Wolf howls differ among species and subspecies. A 2016 study of 13 species and subspecies of wolves, jackals, coyotes and dogs by Kershenbaum and his colleagues found that each has a kind of howling dialect that features different types of howls with varying regularity depending on the species or subspecies. For example, the howling repertoire of the timber wolf (Canis lycaon) is dominated by low, flat howls, while red wolves (Canis rufus) most frequently use high, looping howls.
paras.zh: 狼的嚎叫声因物种和亚种而异。 Kershenbaum 和他的同事在 2016 年对狼、豺狼、郊狼和狗的 13 个物种和亚种进行的一项研究发现，每种动物都有一种嚎叫方言，其特点是根据物种或亚种的不同，发出不同类型的嚎叫，其规律也不同。例如，木狼 (Canis lycaon) 的嚎叫方式主要是低沉、平缓的嚎叫，而红狼 (Canis rufus) 最常使用高亢、循环的嚎叫。

paras.en: The howling of dogs, which are descended from gray wolves (Canis lupus), can differ from wolf howling, but this depends very much on the breed. A 2023 study from Kershenbaum, Faragó and their colleagues found that more ancient dog breeds that are more closely related to wolves howl more often. In contrast, more modern dog breeds bark more often.
paras.zh: 狗的嚎叫是灰狼（Canis lupus）的后代，它的嚎叫可能与狼的嚎叫不同，但这在很大程度上取决于品种。 Kershenbaum、Faragó 及其同事在 2023 年进行的一项研究发现，与狼关系更密切的古老犬种会更频繁地嚎叫。相比之下，更现代的狗品种叫得更频繁。

paras.en: A question "that we all want to answer" is whether howling sounds might differ depending on their purpose, Kershenbaum said. "The problem is that most of the time when wolves howl, we don't know what they're doing at that time — they're either too far away, or it's nighttime."
paras.zh: 克申鲍姆说，“我们都想回答”的一个问题是，嚎叫声是否会根据其目的而有所不同。 “问题是，大多数时候，当狼嚎叫时，我们不知道它们当时在做什么——它们要么离得太远，要么是在夜间。”

paras.en: Generally, "we believe that howls made in different emotional states probably sound different," Kershenbaum said. "For example, perhaps when a wolf is feeling threatened in a territorial conflict, the howl goes up and down in pitch in a different way than when the wolf is relaxed. But this is a field of active research."
paras.zh: 一般来说，“我们认为不同情绪状态下发出的嚎叫听起来可能不同，”克申鲍姆说。 “例如，当狼在领土冲突中感到受到威胁时，嚎叫的音调升降方式可能与狼放松时不同。但这是一个活跃的研究领域。”

paras.en: A common belief is that wolves howl at the moon. "A myth, I'm afraid," Kershenbaum said. "There doesn't seem to be any correlation at all between them." He suggested that perhaps before electric lights, people were outdoors more often when there was a bright moon, "and that's when they heard the wolves."
paras.zh: 人们普遍相信狼对着月亮嚎叫。 “这恐怕是一个神话，”克申鲍姆说。 “它们之间似乎根本没有任何关联。”他认为，也许在电灯出现之前，当月亮明亮时，人们会更频繁地呆在户外，“那时他们就会听到狼的叫声。”

paras.en: What do you know about the animal kingdom? Test your knowledge with our animal quiz!
paras.zh: 关于动物王国，你了解多少？通过我们的动物测验测试您的知识！

articles.title: 'A future where EVs charge simply by parking': New positioning system could make wireless EV charging much more efficient
articles.author: Owen Hughes

paras.en: Researchers in Japan have developed a new technology that could enable electric vehicles (EVs) to charge "simply by parking".
paras.zh: 日本研究人员开发出一种新技术，可以让电动汽车（EV）“只需停车”即可充电。

paras.en: Wireless charging is still relatively nascent in the EV market, but scientists hope that integrating more wireless charging devices into roads and parking spaces will move the EV industry away from bulky plug-in infrastructure. It uses the same wireless power transfer technology found in modern smartphones and consumer electronics: a transmitter coil inside in a ground pad generates an oscillating magnetic field, which induces an electric current in a receiver coil underneath the vehicle. This current recharges the EV's battery cells.
paras.zh: 无线充电在电动汽车市场中仍相对较新，但科学家希望将更多无线充电设备集成到道路和停车位中将使电动汽车行业摆脱笨重的插入式基础设施。它使用与现代智能手机和消费电子产品相同的无线功率传输技术：接地垫内部的发射器线圈产生振荡磁场，从而在车辆下方的接收器线圈中感应出电流。该电流为电动汽车的电池充电。

paras.en: However, small misalignments between the two coils can affect how quickly and efficiently the battery recharges. This new system uses short-range radio signals to determine the position of the vehicle's magnetic charging coil relative to the charging device in the ground, including its distance and angle. This helps the EV and its driver get into the optimal position for efficient charging.
paras.zh: 然而，两个线圈之间的微小偏差会影响电池充电的速度和效率。这个新系统使用短程无线电信号来确定车辆磁性充电线圈相对于地面充电设备的位置，包括其距离和角度。这有助于电动汽车及其驾驶员进入高效充电的最佳位置。

paras.en: The technology could be particularly useful for driverless "robotaxis" and other autonomous vehicles that need to be able to recharge quickly and efficiently without human assistance, the researchers said. They detailed their findings in a study published Aug. 26 in the IEEE Open Journal of Vehicular Technology.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，该技术对于无人驾驶“机器人出租车”和其他需要能够在没有人工帮助的情况下快速有效充电的自动驾驶车辆特别有用。他们在 8 月 26 日发表在《IEEE 车辆技术开放期刊》上的一项研究中详细介绍了他们的发现。

paras.en: "We hope this research will lead to a future where EVs charge simply by parking, much like smartphones placed on wireless chargers," Ryotaro Hada, first author of the study and a master's student at the University of Osaka's Graduate School of Information Science and Technology, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 该研究的第一作者、大阪大学信息科学与技术研究生院的硕士生 Ryotaro Hada 在一份声明中表示：“我们希望这项研究将带来这样一个未来：电动汽车只需停车即可充电，就像智能​​手机放在无线充电器上一样。”

paras.en: Existing methods for aligning an EV's charging coil with a wireless charging pad use magnetic sensors or cameras. Magnetic systems work best when the coil is close to the pad, while cameras can struggle in rain, poor lighting or when dirt obscures the pad, the researchers explained.
paras.zh: 将电动汽车充电线圈与无线充电板对齐的现有方法使用磁性传感器或摄像头。研究人员解释说，当线圈靠近垫子时，磁性系统效果最佳，而在下雨、光线不足或灰尘遮挡垫子时，相机可能会表现不佳。

paras.en: This new system uses four ultra-wideband radio devices mounted around the vehicle's charging coil to communicate with four antennas around the charging pad.
paras.zh: 这个新系统使用安装在车辆充电线圈周围的四个超宽带无线电设备，与充电板周围的四个天线进行通信。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: By measuring how long radio waves take to travel between the ultra-wideband devices and the antennas, as well as detecting tiny differences in how the signals arrive at each of the vehicle's sensors, the system can pinpoint the position and angle of the EV's charging coil relative to the ground pad.
paras.zh: 通过测量无线电波在超宽带设备和天线之间传播的时间，以及检测信号到达每个车辆传感器的微小差异，该系统可以精确定位电动汽车充电线圈相对于接地垫的位置和角度。

paras.en: The same technology is used in some digital car keys. They use short radio pulses to detect when the driver is close by, allowing the driver to unlock their vehicle without requiring a physical key.
paras.zh: 一些数字汽车钥匙也使用了相同的技术。它们使用短无线电脉冲来检测驾驶员何时在附近，从而使驾驶员无需物理钥匙即可解锁车辆。

paras.en: In laboratory experiments using a scaled-down vehicle model, the system worked out where the vehicle's charging coil was to within 0.09 inches (2.32 millimeters) of its actual position and which direction it was facing to within 0.25 degrees. Correcting for distortions in the radio signals reduced the positioning error by around fivefold, the team said.
paras.zh: 在使用按比例缩小的车辆模型进行的实验室实验中，系统计算出车辆的充电线圈与实际位置的误差在 0.09 英寸（2.32 毫米）以内，并且其面向的方向误差在 0.25 度以内。研究小组表示，纠正无线电信号的失真可将定位误差减少约五倍。

paras.en: The researchers noted that the system still needs to be tested outdoors, on full-size EVs and under real charging conditions.
paras.zh: 研究人员指出，该系统仍需要在户外、全尺寸电动汽车上和真实充电条件下进行测试。

paras.en: Owen Hughes is a freelance writer and editor specializing in data and digital technologies. Previously a senior editor at ZDNET, Owen has been writing about tech for more than a decade, during which time he has covered everything from AI, cybersecurity and supercomputers to programming languages and public sector IT. Owen is particularly interested in the intersection of technology, life and work – in his previous roles at ZDNET and TechRepublic, he wrote extensively about business leadership, digital transformation and the evolving dynamics of remote work.
paras.zh: 欧文·休斯 (Owen Hughes) 是一位自由撰稿人和编辑，专门从事数据和数字技术。 Owen 曾担任 ZDNET 的高级编辑，十多年来一直在撰写有关技术的文章，在此期间，他涵盖了从人工智能、网络安全和超级计算机到编程语言和公共部门 IT 的所有内容。 Owen 对技术、生活和工作的交叉点特别感兴趣 - 在他之前在 ZDNET 和 TechRepublic 任职期间，他撰写了大量有关商业领导力、数字化转型和远程工作不断发展的动态的文章。

articles.title: Scientists put 78,000 letters of human DNA into a mouse — and unraveled how a rare disease worked
articles.author: Nicoletta Lanese

paras.en: Scientists have unraveled the workings of a rare disease by putting a large chunk of human DNA into a lab mouse.
paras.zh: 科学家们通过将大量人类 DNA 放入实验室小鼠体内，解开了一种罕见疾病的发病机制。

paras.en: The incurable disorder, called X-linked dystonia-parkinsonism (XDP), mostly affects men of Filipino descent and leads to early death. The new mouse studies revealed previously unknown aspects of the disease's biology that could point to new avenues for treatment.
paras.zh: 这种无法治愈的疾病被称为 X 连锁肌张力障碍帕金森症 (XDP)，主要影响菲律宾裔男性，并导致过早死亡。新的小鼠研究揭示了该疾病生物学之前未知的方面，可能为治疗指明新途径。

paras.en: The condition has long been thought of as a disease of neurons, as it triggers neuron death in a part of the brain that's key to controlling movement. But the new findings highlight an unsung role of neurons' support cells, called glial cells.
paras.zh: 长期以来，这种情况一直被认为是一种神经元疾病，因为它会引发大脑中控制运动的关键部分的神经元死亡。但新发现强调了神经元支持细胞（称为神经胶质细胞）的一个不为人知的作用。

paras.en: "This had never been described in this disease before," study co-author Shane Liddelow, an associate professor in the Institute for Translational Neuroscience at the NYU Grossman School of Medicine, said of the new findings. "It really sort of upended this idea of the disease" as primarily affecting neurons.
paras.zh: “以前从未在这种疾病中描述过这种情况，”该研究的共同作者、纽约大学格罗斯曼医学院转化神经科学研究所副教授谢恩·利德洛(Shane Liddelow)在谈到这一新发现时说道。 “这确实颠覆了这种疾病主要影响神经元的观念”。

paras.en: The two studies, published Thursday (Nov. 19) in the journal Cell, not only shed new light on this rare disease but also showcase a powerful technique for mimicking human conditions in laboratory animals. Known as "SwAP-In," it enables researchers to rewrite large portions of an organism's genetic code by inserting big chunks of synthetic DNA. In this case, the approach was used to insert a human gene into lab mice.
paras.zh: 这两项研究于周四（11 月 19 日）发表在《细胞》杂志上，不仅为这种罕见疾病提供了新的线索，而且还展示了一种在实验动物中模拟人类状况的强大技术。它被称为“SwAP-In”，它使研究人员能够通过插入大块合成 DNA 来重写生物体的大部分遗传密码。在本例中，该方法用于将人类基因插入实验室小鼠体内。

paras.en: "It is kind of a generic method that can be used to make extensively humanized mice," said study co-author Jef Boeke, director of the Institute for Systems Genetics at the NYU Grossman School of Medicine and a lead developer of the SwAP-In technique.
paras.zh: “这是一种通用方法，可用于制造广泛的人源化小鼠，”该研究的合著者、纽约大学格罗斯曼医学院系统遗传学研究所所长、SwAP-In 技术的主要开发者 Jef Boeke 说。

paras.en: Liddelow anticipates that this new method for humanizing mice, or tweaking their biology to more closely match that of humans, will prove useful for studying a wide range of diseases, from common conditions like Alzheimer's to "orphan" diseases like XDP, which are rare, underresearched and lacking effective treatments.
paras.zh: Liddelow 预计，这种将小鼠人性化的新方法，或者调整它们的生物学特性，使其更接近人类的生物学特性，将有助于研究多种疾病，从阿尔茨海默氏症等常见疾病到 XDP 等“孤儿”疾病，这些疾病罕见、研究不足且缺乏有效的治疗方法。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: XDP is a neurodegenerative condition that particularly impacts the striatum, part of the brain that's crucial for movement. The disease causes symptoms such as slowed movements, tremors, muscle stiffness and involuntary muscle contractions.
paras.zh: XDP 是一种神经退行性疾病，尤其影响纹状体，纹状体是大脑中对运动至关重要的部分。这种疾病会导致运动缓慢、颤抖、肌肉僵硬和不自主肌肉收缩等症状。

paras.en: On average, symptoms emerge around age 39 and patients live for 13 to 16 years after their symptoms appear. In late stages of the disease, problems with breathing and swallowing can lead to deadly complications such as malnutrition, aspiration pneumonia and respiratory failure. Historically, XDP has also carried a lot of social stigma, which has contributed to high rates of depression and suicide among those with the condition.
paras.zh: 平均而言，症状出现在 39 岁左右，患者在症状出现后还能存活 13 至 16 年。在疾病晚期，呼吸和吞咽问题可能导致致命的并发症，如营养不良、吸入性肺炎和呼吸衰竭。从历史上看，XDP 也带来了很多社会耻辱，这导致了患有这种疾病的人抑郁和自杀率很高。

paras.en: "Patients get sort of shunned and hidden away," Liddelow said. That, among other factors, made XDP difficult to study.
paras.zh: “病人有点被回避和隐藏起来，”利德洛说。除其他因素外，这使得 XDP 难以研究。

paras.en: Although XDP isn't fully understood, its underlying genetic cause is known. It stems from a mutation in TAF1, a gene on the X chromosome that helps translate DNA sequences into new proteins. Because males carry only one X chromosome — and thus have no backup copy of the gene — the condition affects far more males than females.
paras.zh: 尽管 XDP 尚未完全被了解，但其潜在的遗传原因已为人所知。它源于 TAF1 的突变，TAF1 是 X 染色体上的一个基因，有助于将 DNA 序列翻译成新的蛋白质。由于男性只携带一条 X 染色体，因此没有该基因的备份副本，因此这种情况影响的男性远多于女性。

paras.en: The mutation first appeared in a person on Panay, an island in the Philippines. Due to a phenomenon called the "founder effect," it has risen in prevalence among people of Filipino ancestry but is not seen in other demographics, Boeke explained. Studies suggest there are about 5.7 cases per 100,000 people in the Philippines.
paras.zh: 这种突变首先出现在菲律宾班乃岛的一个人身上。博克解释说，由于一种被称为“创始人效应”的现象，这种现象在菲律宾血统的人群中流行率有所上升，但在其他人群中却没有出现。研究表明，菲律宾每 10 万人中约有 5.7 例病例。

paras.en: XDP's rarity and associated stigma have made the condition difficult to study, but there's another layer of complexity: The mutation in TAF1 was originally caused by a "jumping gene" — a bit of DNA that changed its position within the genome. In this instance, the DNA happened to jump into the middle of TAF1 and disrupted its function, Boeke said.
paras.zh: XDP 的稀有性和相关的耻辱使得研究这种疾病变得困难，但还有另一层复杂性：TAF1 的突变最初是由“跳跃基因”引起的——一段改变了其在基因组中位置的 DNA。 Boeke 说，在这种情况下，DNA 碰巧跳到了 TAF1 的中间并破坏了它的功能。

paras.en: But the jumping gene in question is found only in primates. Ideally, if you wanted to study the disease in lab mice, you'd have to insert that jumping gene into their DNA — and that's exactly what the researchers did in the first of their two new studies.
paras.zh: 但所讨论的跳跃基因只在灵长类动物中发现。理想情况下，如果你想在实验小鼠中研究这种疾病，你必须将跳跃基因插入到它们的 DNA 中——而这正是研究人员在两项新研究中的第一项中所做的。

paras.en: Using SwAP-In, the team inserted 78,000 "letters" of human DNA code into mouse embryonic stem cells. This code included part of the human version of the TAF1 gene and the relevant jumping gene that causes XDP. In both lab dishes and living mice, this gene insertion triggered the telltale signs of XDP: low levels of the TAF1 protein, cell death and holes in the brain, especially in the striatum.
paras.zh: 使用 SwAP-In，该团队将 78,000 个人类 DNA 代码“字母”插入小鼠胚胎干细胞中。该代码包括人类版本的 TAF1 基因的一部分以及导致 XDP 的相关跳跃基因。在实验室培养皿和活体小鼠中，这种基因插入都引发了 XDP 的明显迹象：TAF1 蛋白水平低、细胞死亡和大脑（尤其是纹状体）中出现空洞。

paras.en: One big difference between mice and humans is that the mouse version of XDP progresses very quickly, with symptoms appearing in just 1.5 months, whereas the human disease takes years to show up. That may be because human bodies have safeguards to help offset the jumping gene's effects — at least for a while — while mice lack this safety net, the study authors theorized.
paras.zh: 小鼠和人类之间的一大区别是，小鼠版本的 XDP 进展非常快，仅 1.5 个月就出现症状，而人类疾病则需要数年时间才能显现。研究作者推测，这可能是因为人体有保护措施来帮助抵消跳跃基因的影响——至少在一段时间内——而小鼠则缺乏这种安全网。

paras.en: That difference in disease progression is actually a "huge advantage" for researchers, Boeke noted. "Because it's so sped up, it's possible to do experiments on therapeutics," he said. For instance, if an experimental drug is successfully fighting the disease, that should be obvious in the mice, whose condition would otherwise progress very quickly.
paras.zh: 博克指出，疾病进展的差异实际上对研究人员来说是一个“巨大的优势”。 “因为速度如此之快，所以可以进行治疗实验，”他说。例如，如果一种实验药物成功地对抗了这种疾病，那么这在小鼠身上应该是显而易见的，否则它们的病情会发展得很快。

paras.en: In the second of the team's new studies, they took a closer look at the new mice with XDP, to see how the disorder affected their brain cells. Through a battery of tests, they realized that glial cells known as oligodendrocytes showed dramatic changes in both their overall numbers and their gene activity.
paras.zh: 在该团队的第二项新研究中，他们仔细观察了患有 XDP 的新小鼠，以了解这种疾病如何影响它们的脑细胞。通过一系列测试，他们意识到被称为少突胶质细胞的神经胶质细胞在总数和基因活性方面都显示出巨大的变化。

paras.en: These cells would normally make a fatty insulating material called myelin, which wraps around the outgoing wires of neurons to help them send signals. To see how the cells were faring in the XDP mice, study co-author Priya Prakash, a postdoctoral scholar in Liddelow's lab, used a blue stain to label the cells within the mouse brain tissue.
paras.zh: 这些细胞通常会产生一种称为髓磷脂的脂肪绝缘材料，它包裹着神经元的输出线，帮助它们发送信号。为了了解这些细胞在 XDP 小鼠中的表现，研究合著者、Liddelow 实验室的博士后学者 Priya Prakash 使用蓝色染色来标记小鼠脑组织内的细胞。

paras.en: "Where you would normally see this beautiful blue brain, full of lipid, full of myelin, you essentially see a white brain, with none of this lipid there," Liddelow said. This was especially apparent in the striatum and the prefrontal cortex.
paras.zh: “你通常会看到美丽的蓝色大脑，充满脂质和髓磷脂，但你实际上看到的是白色大脑，那里没有任何脂质，”利德洛说。这在纹状体和前额皮质中尤其明显。

paras.en: Further experiments revealed that the mutation was preventing oligodendrocytes from fully maturing, and that reduced the amount of myelin made in these parts of the brain. They backed up these findings in brains of people with XDP that had been donated after death.
paras.zh: 进一步的实验表明，这种突变阻止了少突胶质细胞完全成熟，并减少了大脑这些部分产生的髓鞘质的数量。他们在死后捐赠的 XDP 患者大脑中支持了这些发现。

paras.en: The researchers think this extensive loss of insulation may leave neurons vulnerable to dying early, Liddelow said. In short, "this is a neurodegenerative disease that may not first be manifesting in neurons themselves," he emphasized. "I think that is, one, interesting from a biological standpoint, but two, profoundly important for how you might develop therapies to help these patients."
paras.zh: 利德洛说，研究人员认为，这种绝缘的广泛丧失可能会使神经元容易提前死亡。简而言之，“这是一种神经退行性疾病，可能不会首先在神经元本身中表现出来，”他强调说。 “我认为，第一，从生物学的角度来看很有趣，但第二，对于如何开发治疗方法来帮助这些患者来说非常重要。”

paras.en: Together, the studies raise several ideas for treating XDP. One treatment could involve cranking up the activity of the TAF1 gene to boost the levels of its related protein. This idea showed promise in experiments with mouse cells in the team's first paper. The second paper points to oligodendrocytes as potential targets for future therapies, and myelin loss as a potential early sign of the disease that might be useful for diagnosis.
paras.zh: 这些研究共同提出了治疗 XDP 的几种想法。一种治疗方法可能涉及提高 TAF1 基因的活性，以提高其相关蛋白质的水平。在该团队的第一篇论文中，这个想法在小鼠细胞实验中显示出了希望。第二篇论文指出少突胶质细胞是未来治疗的潜在靶标，髓磷脂缺失是该疾病的潜在早期征兆，可能有助于诊断。

paras.en: There's still much more to learn about the biology of XDP and what types of treatments might reverse the drivers of the disease, Liddelow and Boeke emphasized. But now, other scientists have access to a brand-new mouse model that can help them solve the disease's remaining mysteries.
paras.zh: Liddelow 和 Boeke 强调，关于 XDP 的生物学特性以及哪些类型的治疗可能逆转该疾病的驱动因素，还有很多东西需要了解。但现在，其他科学家已经获得了一种全新的小鼠模型，可以帮助他们解开该疾病的剩余谜团。

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Nicoletta Lanese is the health channel editor at Live Science and was previously a news editor and staff writer at the site. She is a recipient of the 2026 AHCJ International Health Study Fellowship, with a project focused on antibiotic stewardship practices in Japan and the U.S. They hold a graduate certificate in science communication from UC Santa Cruz and degrees in neuroscience and dance from the University of Florida. Beyond Live Science, Lanese's work has appeared in The Scientist, Science News, the Mercury News, Mongabay and Stanford Medicine Magazine, among other outlets. Based in NYC, she also remains involved in dance and performs in local choreographers' work.
paras.zh: Nicoletta Lanese 是 Live Science 的健康频道编辑，此前曾担任该网站的新闻编辑和特约撰稿人。她是 2026 年 AHCJ 国际健康研究奖学金的获得者，该项目的重点是日本和美国的抗生素管理实践。他们拥有加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的科学传播研究生证书以及佛罗里达大学的神经科学和舞蹈学位。除了《Live Science》之外，Lanese 的作品还出现在《科学家》、《科学新闻》、《水星新闻》、《Mongabay》和《斯坦福医学杂志》等媒体上。她以纽约为基地，仍然参与舞蹈并在当地编舞家的工作中表演。

articles.title: This Self-Charging Toothbrush Has Bristles That Generate Electricity to Help Kill Bacteria That Cause Cavities and Gum Disease

paras.en: Researchers in China have reinvented a familiar tool: the toothbrush.
paras.zh: 中国的研究人员重新发明了一种熟悉的工具：牙刷。

paras.en: Brushing your teeth is an important part of your oral care routine. Both regular and electric toothbrushes rely on physically scrubbing away bacteria that can cause cavities and gum disease. But a new design, described November 4 in the journal Science Advances, features bristles that generate bacteria-killing electricity when they bend, perhaps providing a long-awaited update to the hygiene tool.
paras.zh: 刷牙是日常口腔护理的重要组成部分。普通牙刷和电动牙刷都依靠物理方式清除可能导致蛀牙和牙龈疾病的细菌。但 11 月 4 日《科学进展》杂志上描述的一种新设计，其特点是刷毛弯曲时会产生杀菌电流，这或许为卫生工具带来了期待已久的更新。

paras.en: “Toothbrushes have undergone no substantive improvements beyond their mechanical function for about 1118 years to date,” the researchers write in the study. “Conventional toothbrushes often fail to establish an antibacterial environment on the tooth surface, allowing bacteria to recover and recolonize. Here, we developed an innovative self-charged toothbrush that integrates daily tooth brushing with piezoelectric functionality.”
paras.zh: 研究人员在研究报告中写道：“迄今为止，大约 1118 年以来，牙刷除了机械功能之外没有发生任何实质性改进。” “传统牙刷往往无法在牙齿表面建立抗菌环境，从而使细菌得以恢复和重新定殖。在这里，我们开发了一种创新的自充电牙刷，它将日常刷牙与压电功能融为一体。”

paras.en: Piezoelectric materials generate electricity when put under mechanical stress, like being squeezed or compressed. In the new study, researchers applied this property to the toothbrush by creating bristles from polyvinylidene fluoride, a material that produces an electrical charge when it bends.
paras.zh: 压电材料在受到机械应力（例如挤压或压缩）时会发电。在这项新研究中，研究人员通过用聚偏二氟乙烯制造刷毛，将这种特性应用到牙刷上，聚偏二氟乙烯是一种弯曲时会产生电荷的材料。

paras.en: The electricity doesn’t directly zap oral bacteria, however. Instead, the charge creates highly unstable molecules called reactive oxygen species in the saliva. These molecules disrupt the membranes of bacteria in dental plaque—a sticky layer of the harmful organisms, along with food particles and spit.
paras.zh: 然而，电流并不会直接杀死口腔细菌。相反，电荷会在唾液中产生高度不稳定的分子，称为活性氧。这些分子会破坏牙菌斑中的细菌膜（有害生物的粘性层）以及食物颗粒和唾液。

paras.en: “The concept is great,” Nicholas Jakubovics, an oral microbiologist at Newcastle University in England who did not participate in the research, tells New Scientist’s Christa Lesté-Lasserre. “Basically, the mechanical forces recharge the surface, so it’s really innovative. Anything that even slightly improves the way dental care works could have a benefit, because oral disease is just so widespread.” Experts estimate that almost 3.7 billion people worldwide have oral diseases, such as gum disease and tooth decay.
paras.zh: “这个概念很棒，”英国纽卡斯尔大学口腔微生物学家 Nicholas Jakubovics（未参与这项研究）告诉《新科学家》杂志的 Christa Lesté-Lasserre。 “基本上，机械力会为表面充电，因此它确实具有创新性。任何稍微改善牙科护理工作方式的方法都可能会带来好处，因为口腔疾病非常普遍。”专家估计，全世界有近 37 亿人患有口腔疾病，例如牙龈疾病和蛀牙。

paras.en: The researchers first conducted lab tests of the piezoelectric toothbrush using two key oral pathogens: Streptococcus mutans, which causes cavities, and Porphyromonas gingivalis, which causes gum disease. The charge-producing bristles killed about half of the cavity-causing bacteria and more than half of the gum disease agent present, while traditional nylon bristles eliminated only about 9 percent and 8 percent, respectively.
paras.zh: 研究人员首先使用两种主要的口腔病原体对压电牙刷进行了实验室测试：引起蛀牙的变形链球菌和引起牙龈疾病的牙龈卟啉单胞菌。产生电荷的刷毛可以杀死大约一半的蛀牙细菌和一半以上的牙龈疾病病原体，而传统的尼龙刷毛只能分别杀死大约 9% 和 8%。

paras.en: Then, they moved to a human trial. The team enrolled 115 participants with tooth decay or mild gum disease, called gingivitis. They asked some people to use the electricity-generating toothbrushes and others to use nylon-bristled brushes twice a day for three months.
paras.zh: 然后，他们进行了人体试验。该团队招募了 115 名患有蛀牙或轻度牙龈疾病（称为牙龈炎）的参与者。他们要求一些人使用发电牙刷，另一些人使用尼龙毛刷，每天两次，持续三个月。

paras.en: At the end of the study period, participants who brushed with the experimental tool had less plaque, gum inflammation and bleeding than regular toothbrush users, the team found.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，在研究结束时，使用实验工具刷牙的参与者比普通牙刷使用者的牙菌斑、牙龈炎症和出血更少。

paras.en: “It’s great to have new approaches that actually enhance the effect of mechanical cleaning,” Jakubovics tells Live Science’s Isha Ishtiaq. “The idea that the toothbrush surface itself is actively doing something is really interesting.”
paras.zh: “能够真正增强机械清洁效果的新方法真是太棒了，”Jakubovics 告诉 Live Science 的 Isha Ishtiaq。 “牙刷表面本身正在积极地做一些事情，这个想法真的很有趣。”

paras.en: One of the limits of the research, however, is the clinical trial’s short duration, he notes. “We would want to make sure that it is safe on the tissues for long-term use.”
paras.zh: 然而，这项研究的局限性之一是临床试验的持续时间较短，他指出。 “我们希望确保长期使用它在组织上是安全的。”

paras.en: Frank Scannapieco, a periodontist and microbiologist at the University of Buffalo who did not participate in the study, agrees that more research is necessary to prove the toothbrush is safe and effective, per Nature’s Elizabeth Gibney.
paras.zh: 布法罗大学牙周病学家和微生物学家弗兰克·斯坎纳皮科（Frank Scannapieco）没有参与这项研究，但据《自然》杂志的伊丽莎白·吉布尼（Elizabeth Gibney）报道，他同意需要进行更多研究来证明牙刷的安全性和有效性。

paras.en: This isn’t the first time researchers have taken a swing at upgrading toothbrushes. Previous designs have included bristles with antibacterial chemicals, but researchers aren’t sure if they have a lasting effect. Others produced charged particles to help clean teeth, but these require batteries.
paras.zh: 这并不是研究人员第一次尝试升级牙刷。以前的设计包括含有抗菌化学物质的刷毛，但研究人员不确定它们是否具有持久效果。其他人产生带电粒子来帮助清洁牙齿，但这些需要电池。

paras.en: “The toothbrush is humanity’s mightiest soldier in the battle against dental plaque,” according to a statement. The researchers behind the new study “have now upgraded this warrior.”
paras.zh: 一份声明称：“牙刷是人类对抗牙菌斑的最强大的战士。”这项新研究背后的研究人员“现在已经升级了这个战士”。

paras.en: Still, there’s a long way to go before this upgrade can sit on pharmacies’ oral health shelves.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，要让这一升级产品登上药店的口腔健康货架，还有很长的路要走。

articles.title: Have Archaeologists Finally Pieced Together the 'Parthenon Puzzle,' One of Ancient Greece's Greatest Mysteries?

paras.en: When the Parthenon was built some 2,500 years ago atop the Acropolis of Athens, one of the temple’s facades stood out for its striking imagery. Stretching for nearly 100 feet above the building’s eastern entrance, the marble-carved pediment depicted Athena being birthed from the head of a nearly 13-foot-tall Zeus; they were flanked on either side by 37 other intricately sculpted figures, including gods and goddesses. For its fine craftsmanship and potent symbolism, the pediment is widely considered by scholars to be one of antiquity’s most famous images.
paras.zh: 大约 2,500 年前，当帕台农神庙在雅典卫城顶上建成时，神庙的其中一个外墙因其引人注目的图像而引人注目。大理石雕刻的山形墙在建筑东入口上方延伸近 100 英尺，描绘了雅典娜从近 13 英尺高的宙斯头上诞生的情景；它们的两侧各有 37 个其他复杂的雕塑人物，其中包括男神和女神。由于其精湛的工艺和强有力的象征意义，山形墙被学者们广泛认为是古代最著名的图像之一。

paras.en: But no one alive today has ever looked upon the scene in its original glory. Sometime between the fifth century C.E. and 1670, the pediment was largely destroyed—fires, earthquakes and humans all played roles in its destruction. Only 20 percent of the ruins were recovered, and these fragments have since been scattered to museums across the world. Piecing together what the original artwork may have looked like has intrigued historians for centuries. Now, a team of researchers believe they have finally reached a solution to the Parthenon puzzle.
paras.zh: 但今天还活着的人都没有见过这个场景原来的辉煌。公元 5 世纪至 1670 年间，山墙大部分被毁——火灾、地震和人类活动都在其毁坏中发挥了作用。只有 20% 的废墟被回收，这些碎片随后被分散到世界各地的博物馆。几个世纪以来，历史学家一直对原始艺术作品的外观拼凑起来感兴趣。现在，一组研究人员相信他们终于找到了帕特农神庙之谜的解决方案。

paras.en: Open this week at the Liebieghaus Sculpture Collection in Frankfurt, Germany, “Athena, the Stage is Yours: The Parthenon Puzzle” offers visitors a chance to see what the institution is calling the first-ever “archaeologically grounded proposal” for what the pediment once looked like.
paras.zh: 本周，“雅典娜，舞台是你的：帕台农神庙之谜”在德国法兰克福利比格豪斯雕塑收藏馆开幕，为参观者提供了一个机会，一睹该机构所称的第一个“基于考古的提案”，了解山墙曾经的样子。

paras.en: “For around 200 years, archaeological research has sought to reconstruct the lost overall appearance of the Parthenon’s east pediment,” Philipp Demandt, the museum’s director, says in a statement. “With this exhibition, we are presenting our findings to the public for the first time and inviting visitors to take a fresh look at and discuss one of the most significant works of art from antiquity.”
paras.zh: “大约 200 年来，考古研究一直致力于重建帕台农神庙东山墙失去的整体外观，”博物馆馆长菲利普·德曼特 (Philipp Demandt) 在一份声明中说道。 “通过这次展览，我们首次向公众展示我们的发现，并邀请参观者重新审视和讨论古代最重要的艺术作品之一。”

paras.en: Recreating the image took decades of dedicated research. The museum’s effort was led by Vinzenz Brinkmann and his wife, Ulrike Koch-Brinkmann, who are both archaeologists. They began by referencing the most complete, existing body of work about the pediment. In the early 20th century, Arthur Hamilton Smith, a curator at the British Museum, produced plaster casts of more than 200 small surviving fragments from the pediment and meticulously documented their known placements in relation to each other.
paras.zh: 重建图像需要数十年的专门研究。博物馆的工作由 Vinzenz Brinkmann 和他的妻子 Ulrike Koch-Brinkmann 领导，他们都是考古学家。他们首先参考了有关山墙饰的最完整的现有著作。 20 世纪初，大英博物馆馆长阿瑟·汉密尔顿·史密斯 (Arthur Hamilton Smith) 用 200 多个幸存的三角墙小碎片制作了石膏模型，并仔细记录了它们之间已知的位置关系。

paras.en: The duo created digital renderings of these pieces, which still left massive gaps in the overall pediment. They then began scouring archives around the world for unidentified clues to the original design. A breakthrough came during a trip to the Hermitage Museum in St. Petersburg, Russia, in 2014. There, they observed an ancient Roman sarcophagus with a relief on its lid depicting the birth of Athena. The scene resembled nearly exactly what scholars envisioned of the pediment.
paras.zh: 两人对这些作品进行了数字渲染，但在整体山墙饰上仍然留下了巨大的空白。然后他们开始在世界各地的档案中搜寻原始设计的不明线索。 2014 年，他们在参观俄罗斯圣彼得堡艾尔米塔什博物馆时取得了突破。在那里，他们观察到了一座古罗马石棺，棺盖上有浮雕，描绘了雅典娜的诞生。这一场景几乎与学者们对山墙饰的想象一模一样。

paras.en: Brinkmann and Koch-Brinkmann are also noted for their painstaking work to accurately recreate the original color schemes of classical white marble statues. For authenticity, they used the same mineral and organic pigments available to the ancients.
paras.zh: 布林克曼和科赫-布林克曼还因其精确再现古典白色大理石雕像的原始配色方案的艰苦工作而闻名。为了保证真实性，他们使用了与古人相同的矿物和有机颜料。

paras.en: “It was really a chance discovery,” Brinkmann tells the Art Newspaper’s Catherine Hickley. “We noticed a figural relief on the lid of a sarcophagus that was clearly closely related to the composition of the east pediment. It refers to the few surviving figures from the corners of the pediment, such as Helios and Selene with their chariots, but also to figures that have repeatedly been proposed as having belonged to the east pediment, such as the Horae [and] Moirai.”
paras.zh: “这确实是一个偶然的发现，”布林克曼告诉《艺术报》的凯瑟琳·希克利。 “我们注意到石棺盖上的人物浮雕，显然与东山墙饰的构成密切相关。它指的是山墙饰角落里幸存的少数人物，例如赫利俄斯和塞勒涅及其战车，但也指那些一再被认为属于东山墙饰的人物，例如霍拉[和]莫伊莱。”

paras.en: Brinkmann’s team studied nine sarcophagi in total, mostly in the Vatican Museum and elsewhere in Rome. “The Romans copied everything the Greeks did,” he explains to the Art Newspaper.
paras.zh: 布林克曼的团队总共研究了九个石棺，大部分位于梵蒂冈博物馆和罗马其他地方。 “罗马人复制了希腊人所做的一切，”他向《艺术报》解释道。

paras.en: While no single sarcophagus showed the entire 39-figure scene, they each showed different aspects of the pediment, which the researchers were able to piece together digitally, with the help of 3D scanners. Earlier scholars noticed this connection between sarcophagi lids and the pediment, Brinkmann tells Deutsche Welle’s Katharina Abel. “But we really seized on the idea and never let go.”
paras.zh: 虽然没有一个石棺展示了整个 39 尊雕像的场景，但它们都展示了山形墙的不同方面，研究人员能够在 3D 扫描仪的帮助下以数字方式将其拼凑在一起。布林克曼告诉德国之声的凯瑟琳娜·阿贝尔，早期学者注意到石棺盖和山形墙之间的这种联系。 “但我们确实抓住了这个想法，从未放弃。”

paras.en: The researchers searched for missing artifacts that could piece together the lost scene. On the surviving fragments they studied drill holes and the edges of broken shards for clues about adjacent pieces. They referenced ancient texts for possible descriptions of the pediment’s positioning. They identified lost sculptures and worked with international institutions to ask and answer new questions as they arose.
paras.zh: 研究人员寻找丢失的文物，以拼凑出丢失的场景。在幸存的碎片上，他们研究了钻孔和破碎碎片的边缘，以寻找有关相邻碎片的线索。他们参考了古代文献来寻找对三角墙的位置的可能描述。他们识别了丢失的雕塑，并与国际机构合作提出并回答出现的新问题。

paras.en: “Piece by piece, the puzzle came together to form a new, archaeologically grounded overall picture of the Parthenon’s east pediment,” Brinkmann says in the statement.
paras.zh: 布林克曼在声明中说：“拼图一块一块地拼凑在一起，形成了一幅新的、以考古为基础的帕台农神庙东山墙的整体图景。”

paras.en: Inside the exhibit, the reconstructed pediment is presented as a 13 foot-long, 3D-printed model, at a scale of 1:7.7 compared to the original. There are also life-size reproductions of the largely missing central figures, Zeus, Athena and Hera, based on surviving fragments and comparable sculptures. Casts of the well-preserved figures at opposite ends of the pediment—Helios, the sun god, and Selene, the moon goddess—mark the passing of time from day to night. A colorful animation created especially for the exhibition brings the tale to life through a retelling of the myth of Athena’s birth.
paras.zh: 在展览中，重建的山墙饰以 13 英尺长的 3D 打印模型的形式呈现，与原始山墙墙的比例为 1:7.7。还有根据幸存的碎片和类似雕塑制作的基本失踪的中心人物宙斯、雅典娜和赫拉的真人大小复制品。山墙两端保存完好的雕像——太阳神赫利俄斯和月亮女神塞勒涅——标志着时间从白天到黑夜的流逝。专为展览制作的彩色动画通过重述雅典娜诞生的神话，将故事带入生活。

paras.en: “Research belongs in the public sphere. In particular, a museum can demonstrate how scientific knowledge is generated by interpreting traces, asking questions and correlating different sources,” Ina Hartwig, who heads the city of Frankfurt’s Department of Culture and Science, says in a statement. “The exhibition makes this process immediately comprehensible to visitors.”
paras.zh: “研究属于公共领域。特别是，博物馆可以通过解释痕迹、提出问题和关联不同来源来展示科学知识是如何产生的，”法兰克福市文化和科学部负责人伊娜·哈特维格(Ina Hartwig)在一份声明中表示。 “展览让参观者可以立即理解这一过程。”

paras.en: “Athena, the Stage is Yours: The Parthenon Puzzle” is on view at the Liebieghaus Sculpture Collection in Frankfurt through July 25, 2027.
paras.zh: “雅典娜，舞台是你的：帕台农神庙之谜”将于 2027 年 7 月 25 日在法兰克福 Liebieghaus 雕塑收藏馆展出。

articles.title: The NIH Has Decided to Move Its Last Group of Retired Research Chimpanzees to an Animal Sanctuary Next Year

paras.en: Roughly three dozen chimpanzees currently live at the Keeling Center for Comparative Medicine and Research in Bastrop, Texas. They used to serve as subjects in scientific studies. Next year, however, these primates—the last federally owned chimps at an American research facility—will move to a retirement home at an animal sanctuary, according to an announcement by the National Institutes of Health (NIH) on November 18.
paras.zh: 目前大约有三打黑猩猩生活在德克萨斯州巴斯特罗普的基林比较医学和研究中心。它们曾经作为科学研究的对象。然而，根据美国国立卫生研究院 (NIH) 11 月 18 日的公告，明年这些灵长类动物（美国研究机构中最后一批联邦拥有的黑猩猩）将搬到动物保护区的养老院。

paras.en: “Completing their transfers will fulfill NIH’s commitment, announced in November 2015, to retire all NIH-owned chimpanzees to sanctuary,” says Jay Bhattacharya, director of the agency, in the statement.
paras.zh: “完成它们的转移将履行 NIH 于 2015 年 11 月宣布的承诺，将 NIH 拥有的所有黑猩猩退休到庇护所，”该机构主任杰伊·巴塔查亚 (Jay Bhattacharya) 在声明中表示。

paras.en: The move has been a long time in the making. In 2000, the Chimpanzee Health Improvement Maintenance Protection (CHIMP) Act established a national sanctuary system for chimps no longer needed for federal biomedical research. Then, in 2015, the NIH announced it would end its funding and support of all research on the primate species. The agency committed to retire all its approximately 300 chimps and move them to Chimp Haven, a 200-acre federal sanctuary in Keithville, Louisiana.
paras.zh: 这一举措已经酝酿了很长时间。 2000 年，《黑猩猩健康改善维护保护 (CHIMP) 法案》为联邦生物医学研究不再需要的黑猩猩建立了国家保护区系统。随后，2015 年，美国国立卫生研究院 (NIH) 宣布将终止对所有灵长类动物研究的资助和支持。该机构承诺将其大约 300 只黑猩猩全部退休，并将它们转移到路易斯安那州基斯维尔占地 200 英亩的黑猩猩避难所联邦保护区。

paras.en: But the plan proceeded slowly. In 2019, the NIH veterinary panel determined that the 44 federally owned chimpanzees at the Alamogordo Primate Facility in New Mexico were too old or ill to move. Many of the retirees were near the upper end of their life expectancy in captivity and had severe health problems like heart disease. Two years later, the agency decided the same for the 51 primates at the Keeling Center and the 11 at the Southwest National Primate Research Center in San Antonio, Texas.
paras.zh: 但计划进展缓慢。 2019 年，美国国立卫生研究院 (NIH) 兽医小组认定，新墨西哥州阿拉莫戈多灵长类动物设施中的 44 只联邦政府拥有的黑猩猩年龄太大或病重，无法移动。许多退休人员在囚禁期间已接近预期寿命的上限，并且患有心脏病等严重的健康问题。两年后，该机构对基林中心的 51 只灵长类动物和德克萨斯州圣安东尼奥市西南国家灵长类动物研究中心的 11 只灵长类动物做出了同样的决定。

paras.en: However, in 2024, staffing changes at Alamogordo and public pressure—including a lawsuit filed by animal welfare organizations—forced the NIH to shift its plans for the remaining chimps at the facility. They finally moved to Chimp Haven last year, meaning only the Keeling Center chimps remained at an NIH facility, given that the Southwest National Primate Research Center stopped receiving funding from the agency.
paras.zh: 然而，2024 年，阿拉莫戈多的人员变动和公众压力（包括动物福利组织提起的诉讼）迫使 NIH 改变了对该设施中剩余黑猩猩的计划。去年，它们终于搬到了黑猩猩避难所，这意味着，鉴于西南国家灵长类研究中心停止接受该机构的资助，只有基林中心的黑猩猩留在 NIH 设施中。

paras.en: Although one elderly Alamogordo chimp died on the way to the sanctuary, the transfer prompted NIH leadership to revisit the potential transfer of Keeling Center animals, Bhattacharya says in the statement. “After careful analysis and internal consultations, NIH leadership decided to proceed.”
paras.zh: 巴塔查亚在声明中表示，尽管一只老年阿拉莫戈多黑猩猩在前往保护区的途中死亡，但这次转移促使美国国立卫生研究院领导层重新考虑基林中心动物的潜在转移。 “经过仔细分析和内部协商，NIH 领导层决定继续进行。”

paras.en: Animal advocacy organizations have welcomed the news.
paras.zh: 动物保护组织对这一消息表示欢迎。

paras.en: “This has been a long road and something that many people thought would never happen,” says Kathleen Conlee, vice president of animal research issues at the Humane World for Animals, to Emily Anthes at the New York Times. “It’s a really historic moment. This will be the end of the government’s use and confinement of chimps in labs.”
paras.zh: “这是一条漫长的道路，许多人认为永远不会发生，”动物人道世界负责动物研究问题的副总裁凯瑟琳·康利 (Kathleen Conlee) 对《纽约时报》的艾米丽·安西斯 (Emily Anthes) 说道。 “这确实是一个历史性的时刻。这将是政府在实验室中使用和限制黑猩猩的结束。”

paras.en: Biomedical research groups, on the other hand, oppose the transfer. They argue that the aging chimps would be safer staying at a place with staff they know, reports David Grimm at Science.
paras.zh: 另一方面，生物医学研究团体则反对转让。据《科学》杂志的大卫·格林报道，他们认为，年老的黑猩猩和他们认识的工作人员呆在一个地方会更安全。

paras.en: “These are sensitive and intelligent beings with complex social histories that include strong relationships with their chimp and human families,” says Cindy Buckmaster, former chair of Americans for Medical Progress, an advocacy organization that supports humane animal research, to Science.
paras.zh: “这些是敏感而聪明的生物，有着复杂的社会历史，其中包括与黑猩猩和人类家族的牢固关系，”支持人道动物研究的倡导组织美国医学进步协会前主席辛迪·巴克马斯特对《科学》杂志说。

paras.en: At the Keeling Center, chimps have access to large, open enclosures, she says. “They have everything they need where they are. We should leave them be and let them live the rest of their lives in peace.”
paras.zh: 她说，在基林中心，黑猩猩可以进入大型开放式围栏。 “他们拥有他们所需要的一切。我们应该离开他们，让他们平静地度过余生。”

paras.en: Staff at Chimp Haven, for their part, are excited to welcome the animals. The primates from Alamogordo appear to be acclimating well, says Rana Smith, the sanctuary’s president and CEO, to the Times. They hope to receive all the Keeling Center chimps by the end of next year, with some transfers beginning in January.
paras.zh: 黑猩猩天堂的工作人员很高兴欢迎这些动物。保护区主席兼首席执行官拉纳·史密斯 (Rana Smith) 向《泰晤士报》表示，阿拉莫戈多的灵长类动物似乎适应得很好。他们希望在明年年底之前接收所有基林中心的黑猩猩，其中一些转移从一月份开始。

paras.en: “When that very last chimp arrives from the Keeling Center, I think that is a milestone moment,” Smith says. “We’re just happy to be a part of it and provide the chimps with their happy ending.”
paras.zh: “当最后一只黑猩猩从基林中心抵达时，我认为这是一个里程碑时刻，”史密斯说。 “我们很高兴能成为其中的一部分，为黑猩猩带来幸福的结局。”

articles.title: Best Laptops for Travel (2026): Which to Take on the Road
articles.author: Luke Larsen

paras.en: As a laptop reviewer, I have plenty of devices to choose from when I travel for work. In some cases, my favorite overall laptop doesn’t translate into the one I want to travel with. When I’m squeezed into a plane, I’ll choose maximum battery life and portability over features like a bigger screen or more ports.
paras.zh: 作为一名笔记本电脑评测者，当我出差时，我有很多设备可供选择。在某些情况下，我最喜欢的整体笔记本电脑并不能转化为我想要携带的笔记本电脑。当我被挤进飞机时，我会选择最大的电池寿命和便携性，而不是更大的屏幕或更多的端口等功能。

paras.en: Fortunately, there are many great travel laptops, and you’ll still appreciate them when you aren’t on the road. Of the hundreds of laptops I’ve tested in my life, here are the ones I always choose to travel with.
paras.zh: 幸运的是，有很多很棒的旅行笔记本电脑，当您不在路上时，您仍然会欣赏它们。在我一生中测试过的数百台笔记本电脑中，以下是我总是选择随身携带的笔记本电脑。

paras.en: If there’s an obvious pick for the best travel laptop, it’s the Dell XPS 13. It’s been the best compact laptop you can buy for years, and that’s even more true in its latest incarnation. The key dimension to pay attention to on the XPS 13 is the depth, which is crucial for air travel. At 7.9 inches, it’s among the smallest laptops you can buy. Those economy-class seat-back tray tables on airplanes are only around 10 inches deep, and while that’s technically enough to accommodate even a 16-inch MacBook Pro, whether you can actually open the lid and use the laptop is another question. The XPS 13 is even smaller than the MacBook Neo, despite having a larger screen.
paras.zh: 如果有一个明显的最佳旅行笔记本电脑选择，那就是戴尔 XPS 13。多年来，它一直是您可以购买的最好的紧凑型笔记本电脑，在其最新版本中更是如此。 XPS 13 需要注意的关键尺寸是深度，这对于航空旅行至关重要。它的尺寸为 7.9 英寸，是您能买到的最小的笔记本电脑之一。飞机上的经济舱座椅靠背小桌板深度只有 10 英寸左右，虽然从技术上讲这足以容纳 16 英寸的 MacBook Pro，但能否真正打开盖子并使用笔记本电脑则是另一个问题。尽管屏幕更大，但 XPS 13 甚至比 MacBook Neo 还要小。

paras.en: The XPS 13 achieves this by using a 13.4-inch display (measured diagonally), compared to many of the 14-inch laptops on this list. Second, it has very narrow bezels around that screen, minimizing the device’s overall footprint. While 14-inch laptops have become more popular in recent years, that bigger display size also increases the overall footprint—and every millimeter counts when working on a plane. The XPS 13 still has enough room for your palms when typing (unless you have huge hands), and the keyboard is among my favorites to type on.
paras.zh: 与此列表中的许多 14 英寸笔记本电脑相比，XPS 13 通过使用 13.4 英寸显示屏（对角线测量）来实现这一目标。其次，它的屏幕边框非常窄，最大限度地减少了设备的整体占地面积。虽然 14 英寸笔记本电脑近年来变得越来越流行，但更大的显示屏尺寸也增加了整体占地面积 - 在飞机上工作时，每一毫米都很重要。 XPS 13 在打字时仍然有足够的空间容纳你的手掌（除非你有很大的手），而且键盘是我最喜欢打字的键盘之一。

paras.en: The other two major advantages for travel are weight and battery life. This little laptop only weighs 2.2 pounds, a full half-pound lighter than the 13-inch MacBook Air. You might forget you have it in your backpack while traveling.
paras.zh: 旅行的另外两个主要优势是重量和电池寿命。这款小型笔记本电脑仅重 2.2 磅，比 13 英寸 MacBook Air 轻了整整半磅。旅行时您可能会忘记背包里有它。

paras.en: Now, the XPS 13 isn't the most powerful laptop in the world—at least not the cheaper models. The standard version comes with only 8 GB of RAM and an Intel chip with only two Performance cores. It’s good enough for basic web tasks, but for real work, you might run into limitations. You can address this by opting for the 16 GB model (which keeps the price under $1,000) or upgrading to the much more powerful Core Ultra 7 355 processor. The latter is much more expensive and comes with twice the storage, but it doesn’t add extra weight or size. Regardless of the chip you choose, the XPS 13 gets absolutely fantastic battery life. It depends on what you're doing with it, but you could easily work through a long international flight without worrying about plugging in.
paras.zh: 现在，XPS 13 并不是世界上最强大的笔记本电脑，至少不是更便宜的型号。标准版本仅配备 8 GB RAM 和只有两个性能核心的 Intel 芯片。对于基本的 Web 任务来说它已经足够好了，但对于实际工作，您可能会遇到限制。您可以通过选择 16 GB 型号（价格低于 1,000 美元）或升级到功能更强大的 Core Ultra 7 355 处理器来解决此问题。后者要贵得多，并且存储空间是原来的两倍，但不会增加额外的重量或尺寸。无论您选择哪种芯片，XPS 13 都能获得绝对出色的电池续航时间。这取决于您用它做什么，但您可以轻松地完成长途国际航班，而无需担心充电问题。

paras.en: If weight is your primary concern, the Asus Zenbook A14 is another contender. Despite being larger overall than the XPS 13 (with a bigger screen), the Zenbook A14 weighs 2.16 pounds—a hair lighter than the Dell. That’s seriously impressive, and I still remember how astounded I was when I first picked it up. Asus debuts its “ceraluminum” material in the chassis, which gives you the sturdiness of aluminum with the lightness of plastic. It’s not quite as rigid as metal, but it’s not as flimsy as ultra-light laptops in the past.
paras.zh: 如果重量是您最关心的问题，那么华硕 Zenbook A14 是另一个竞争者。尽管整体比 XPS 13（屏幕更大）大，但 Zenbook A14 的重量为 2.16 磅，比戴尔轻了一根头发丝。这真是令人印象深刻，我仍然记得当我第一次拿起它时我是多么惊讶。华硕在机箱中首次采用“陶瓷铝”材料，既具有铝的坚固性，又具有塑料的轻盈性。它不像金属那么坚硬，但也不像过去的超轻笔记本电脑那么脆弱。

paras.en: If you’re less worried about working on the plane and more about lugging a laptop around, the Zenbook A14 is a good choice. The Zenbook A14 has several advantages over the XPS 13 that can be helpful on the go, including built-in ports like a headphone jack, USB-A, and HDMI. If you’re working out of a remote office or presenting to a client, these can definitely come in handy. The XPS 13 only has two USB-C ports and nothing else.
paras.zh: 如果您不太担心在飞机上工作，而更担心携带笔记本电脑到处走动，那么 Zenbook A14 是一个不错的选择。与 XPS 13 相比，Zenbook A14 具有多项优势，可以在旅途中提供帮助，包括耳机插孔、USB-A 和 HDMI 等内置端口。如果您在远程办公室工作或向客户演示，这些绝对可以派上用场。 XPS 13 只有两个 USB-C 端口，没有其他端口。

paras.en: There are a number of different versions of the Asus Zenbook A14 floating around out there. I’d stay away from the 8 GB model Asus sells and opt for the 16 GB model instead. There’s also a newer model that uses the Snapdragon X2 Elite chip, but I don’t think it’s worth the extra $450—especially not for a laptop focused on travel.
paras.zh: 市面上有许多不同版本的华硕 Zenbook A14。我不会选择华硕销售的 8 GB 型号，而是选择 16 GB 型号。还有一款使用 Snapdragon X2 Elite 芯片的较新型号，但我认为它不值得额外支付 450 美元，尤其是对于专注于旅行的笔记本电脑而言。

paras.en: The 13-inch MacBook Air also makes a great travel laptop. It’s relatively small, thanks to its 13.6-inch screen.
paras.zh: 13 英寸 MacBook Air 也是一款出色的旅行笔记本电脑。由于其 13.6 英寸的屏幕，它相对较小。

paras.en: In terms of portability, its main advantage over the XPS 13 and Zenbook A14 is its thinness. At 0.42 inches, it’s the thinnest laptop out there—and it doesn’t stick huge rubber feet on the bottom to compensate like other laptops do, such as the Razer Blade 14. You might not think thickness matters much in a travel laptop, but if you’re squeezing stuff into a backpack, every extra millimeter matters.
paras.zh: 在便携性方面，它相对于 XPS 13 和 Zenbook A14 的主要优势在于它的轻薄。它的厚度为 0.42 英寸，是市面上最薄的笔记本电脑，而且它不像其他笔记本电脑（例如 Razer Blade 14）那样在底部贴上巨大的橡胶脚垫来进行补偿。您可能认为厚度对于旅行笔记本电脑来说并不重要，但如果您将东西挤进背包中，那么每一毫米都非常重要。

paras.en: The MacBook Neo is also worth mentioning here. It’s not quite as thin as the MacBook Air, but because its screen is 0.4 inches smaller, it has a more compact overall footprint. Battery life is the bigger issue when taking the Neo on a trip, as it doesn’t last as long as the MacBook Air or Dell XPS 13. The 8 GB of RAM limitation doesn’t affect its use as a travel laptop much, but it's something to consider for a work laptop in general. That said, it has a very pretty screen for a laptop at this price.
paras.zh: MacBook Neo 在这里也值得一提。它不像 MacBook Air 那样薄，但由于其屏幕小了 0.4 英寸，因此整体占地面积更加紧凑。携带 Neo 旅行时，电池续航时间是一个更大的问题，因为它的续航时间不如 MacBook Air 或戴尔 XPS 13。8 GB RAM 限制不会对其作为旅行笔记本电脑的使用产生太大影响，但对于一般工作笔记本电脑来说，这是需要考虑的。也就是说，对于这个价位的笔记本电脑来说，它的屏幕非常漂亮。

paras.en: Budget laptops aren’t typically known for being particularly lightweight and travel-worthy. Most of them struggle, especially with battery life. The HP OmniBook 5 might be an exception. You can usually find it on sale for under $700, even with 16 GB of RAM and an OLED display.
paras.zh: 经济型笔记本电脑通常并不以特别轻巧和适合旅行而闻名。他们中的大多数人都在挣扎，尤其是在电池寿命方面。 HP OmniBook 5 可能是一个例外。即使配备 16 GB RAM 和 OLED 显示屏，您通常也能以低于 700 美元的价格找到它。

paras.en: The OmniBook 5 isn’t quite as compact as the MacBook Neo because of its larger screen, but it is also half an inch thick and weighs only 2.8 pounds. The Snapdragon X Plus also delivers solid battery life, plenty to feel comfortable traveling with. It’s not a laptop without compromises (like the poor touchpad), but it comes with 16 GB of RAM, unlike some other laptops at this price. That’s a solid deal if you need something to travel with on a budget.
paras.zh: 由于屏幕较大，OmniBook 5 不像 MacBook Neo 那样紧凑，但厚度也只有半英寸，重量仅为 2.8 磅。 Snapdragon X Plus 还提供稳定的电池续航时间，让您在旅行时倍感舒适。它不是一台没有任何妥协的笔记本电脑（比如糟糕的触摸板），但它配备了 16 GB RAM，与这个价位的其他一些笔记本电脑不同。如果您需要在预算范围内携带一些旅行物品，那么这是一个不错的选择。

paras.en: Good question. Tablets can make for great travel devices because of their size and ease of use. If you need a proper keyboard and touchpad—and the app support to handle a typical workday—you’re probably better off getting a laptop.
paras.zh: 好问题。平板电脑因其尺寸和易用性而成为出色的旅行设备。如果您需要合适的键盘和触摸板以及应用程序支持来处理典型的工作日，那么您最好购买笔记本电脑。

paras.en: The Surface Pro 12 is the two-in-one laptop I’d recommend first. It’s absolutely tiny for a computer, even though it runs the full version of Windows 11. Even with the detachable keyboard connected, it weighs only 1.8 pounds. The only real problem with bringing this on a plane is the kickstand, which adds some extra depth. It’s just small enough that it should fit while open on an airplane tray table, unlike the 13.8-inch Surface Pro model.
paras.zh: Surface Pro 12 是我首先推荐的二合一笔记本电脑。尽管它运行完整版的 Windows 11，但对于一台计算机而言，它绝对很小。即使连接了可拆卸键盘，它的重量也仅为 1.8 磅。将其带上飞机的唯一真正问题是支架，它增加了一些额外的深度。与 13.8 英寸 Surface Pro 型号不同，它足够小，打开时可以放在飞机托盘桌上。

paras.en: Of course, that kickstand is also a huge advantage for the Surface Pro 12 if you’re using it without the keyboard. While that would make work difficult, it’s ideal for watching movies. Set this up on your tray table with some movies downloaded, and you’ll be the envy of your aisle. And when you need to get some work done in a coffee shop or at a smaller table, you’ll be happy to have access to the keyboard and touchpad—both of which are very comfortable to use. Just know that it's sold separately.
paras.zh: 当然，如果您在没有键盘的情况下使用 Surface Pro 12，该支架对于 Surface Pro 12 来说也是一个巨大的优势。虽然这会让工作变得困难，但它非常适合看电影。把它放在你的小桌上，下载一些电影，你就会成为过道上的羡慕对象。当您需要在咖啡店或较小的桌子上完成一些工作时，您会很高兴能够使用键盘和触摸板，这两者使用起来都非常舒适。只要知道它是单独出售的。

paras.en: The iPad Air, paired with the Magic Keyboard, avoids the Surface Pro 12’s kickstand issue. And with only an 11-inch screen, it’s perfect for use in small spaces—with or without the keyboard (note that there is also a 13-inch version). If you can accomplish all your work on an iPad, more power to ya! The iPad Air should give you everything you need, so long as you get the Magic Keyboard. If your travels involve more leisurely activities, the iPad Air is a great device for reading by the pool or for playing games.
