paras.zh: iPad Air 与妙控键盘搭配使用，避免了 Surface Pro 12 的支架问题。它只有 11 英寸的屏幕，非常适合在狭小的空间中使用——无论有没有键盘（请注意，还有 13 英寸版本）。如果您可以在 iPad 上完成所有工作，那就更强大了！只要您拥有妙控键盘，iPad Air 就能满足您所需的一切。如果您的旅行涉及更多休闲活动，iPad Air 是在泳池边阅读或玩游戏的绝佳设备。

paras.en: One benefit of this latest version of the iPad Air is not only its performance (thanks to the M4 chip inside) but also the front-facing camera, which has been moved to landscape for more natural-feeling video calls. Of course, you could also opt for the 11-inch iPad Pro for extra performance (and the incredible tandem OLED screen). It’s also slightly thinner and lighter, though I don't think it's worth the significant price difference.
paras.zh: 最新版本 iPad Air 的优势之一不仅在于其性能（得益于内部的 M4 芯片），还在于前置摄像头，该摄像头已移至横向，以实现更自然的视频通话。当然，您也可以选择 11 英寸 iPad Pro 以获得额外的性能（以及令人难以置信的串联 OLED 屏幕）。它也稍微更薄更轻，但我认为不值得这么大的价格差异。

paras.en: Lastly, there’s definitely room here for laptops with 360-degree hinges—a different class of two-in-one laptops. I haven’t tested a recent Windows device with this form factor that I truly loved, but there’s no question it works well on an airplane. Just fold the screen back with the keyboard face down, and you have the perfect screen for watching movies. The Lenovo Yoga 9i 14 is a gorgeous option, though it’s incredibly expensive right now. But if you can afford it, you’ll love the 2-in-1 action combined with one of the slickest designs imaginable. The Framework Laptop 12 is also worth considering. While it’s a bit thick and heavy for a travel laptop, its smaller screen, touchscreen, and 360-degree hinge make it a good option. It’s also one of the cheaper options available, and it’s user-upgradeable.
paras.zh: 最后，这里绝对有空间容纳具有 360 度铰链的笔记本电脑——一种不同类别的二合一笔记本电脑。我还没有测试过具有我真正喜欢的这种外形尺寸的最新 Windows 设备，但毫无疑问它在飞机上运行良好。只需将屏幕向后折叠，键盘面朝下，您就拥有了观看电影的完美屏幕。联想 Yoga 9i 14 是一个不错的选择，尽管现在它的价格非常昂贵。但如果您负担得起，您一定会喜欢二合一动作与可以想象到的最时尚的设计之一。 Framework Laptop 12 也值得考虑。虽然对于旅行笔记本电脑来说它有点厚重，但其较小的屏幕、触摸屏和 360 度铰链使其成为一个不错的选择。它也是可用的更便宜的选项之一，并且用户可以升级。

paras.en: Whether you’re packing for a trip across the world or across the state, a proper travel laptop shouldn’t be heavy or overly large. That rules out 15-inch and 16-inch laptops, which are so big you can’t use them on airplane tray tables or at coffee shops. But even when you narrow it down to 14-inch laptops or smaller, there are three portability factors to consider.
paras.zh: 无论您是准备环游世界还是跨州旅行，合适的旅行笔记本电脑都不应该太重或太大。这就排除了 15 英寸和 16 英寸笔记本电脑，它们太大了，无法在飞机托盘桌上或咖啡店使用。但即使将范围缩小到 14 英寸或更小的笔记本电脑，也需要考虑三个便携性因素。

paras.en: - Thickness: The size of the laptop with the lid closed matters for travel, especially if you’re trying to stuff your bag with as much as possible (like I usually am). Thicker laptops also tend to be heavier. The MacBook Air is the standard bearer here at 0.42 inches thick, but I’d consider anything under 0.6 inches thin enough to travel with.
paras.zh: - 厚度：笔记本电脑合上盖子后的尺寸对于旅行来说很重要，尤其是当您想尽可能多地装东西时（就像我通常做的那样）。较厚的笔记本电脑也往往较重。 MacBook Air 是这里的标准，厚度为 0.42 英寸，但我认为任何厚度低于 0.6 英寸的设备都足以随身携带。

paras.en: - Dimensions: The laptop’s depth (measured from the bottom of the trackpad to the hinge) determines whether it fits on small tables. The width matters in some cases, especially if you’re trying to fit it into a smaller bag. Larger laptops are around 9 or 10 inches deep, while smaller ones like the Dell XPS 13 are under 8 inches.
paras.zh: - 尺寸：笔记本电脑的深度（从触控板底部到铰链测量）决定了它是否适合小桌子。在某些情况下，宽度很重要，尤其是当您试图将其放入较小的包中时。较大的笔记本电脑深度约为 9 或 10 英寸，而较小的笔记本电脑（如戴尔 XPS 13）深度低于 8 英寸。

paras.en: - Weight: This one is obvious, perhaps, but the difference between a 4-pound laptop and a 2-pound laptop is noticeable. When you’re on your feet for hours with lots of luggage, the lighter the load, the better. These days, I'd consider anything under 3 pounds to be light enough to travel with, while the ones closer to 2 pounds (like the Asus Zenbook A14) are among the lightest you can buy.
paras.zh: - 重量：这一点也许是显而易见的，但 4 磅笔记本电脑和 2 磅笔记本电脑之间的差异是显而易见的。当您带着大量行李连续行走数小时时，负载越轻越好。如今，我认为任何重量低于 3 磅的设备都足够轻，可以随身携带，而重量接近 2 磅的设备（如华硕 Zenbook A14）是您可以购买的最轻的设备之一。

paras.en: When you’re on the go, you want a laptop that doesn’t constantly make you worry about finding an outlet. Bringing a laptop power bank can help, but the biggest factor in staying sane while traveling is a device that can stay on. Many factors affect how long a laptop can last, including CPU efficiency, battery wattage, screen brightness and resolution, and more.
paras.zh: 当您在旅途中时，您想要一台不会经常让您担心找不到插座的笔记本电脑。带上笔记本电脑充电宝会有所帮助，但在旅行时保持理智的最大因素是可以保持开机状态的设备。许多因素会影响笔记本电脑的续航时间，包括 CPU 效率、电池瓦数、屏幕亮度和分辨率等。

paras.en: Long-lasting laptops, such as the Dell XPS 13, will get you through a long flight. The processor is the main thing to look out for. Qualcomm’s Snapdragon X series of chips are battery-efficient, as are Apple’s M-series chips. Intel also has some highly efficient CPUs in its most recent lineup, though you’ll need to pay close attention to the model number, as it can vary wildly depending on the specific CPU you’re using. To dig deeper, read my extensive guide on How to Buy the Right Laptop, which breaks down different CPU options.
paras.zh: 耐用的笔记本电脑（例如戴尔 XPS 13）将帮助您度过长途飞行。处理器是需要关注的主要内容。高通的 Snapdragon X 系列芯片具有电池效率，苹果的 M 系列芯片也是如此。英特尔在其最新的产品系列中也有一些高效的 CPU，但您需要密切关注型号，因为它可能会根据您使用的特定 CPU 的不同而有很大差异。要深入了解，请阅读我关于如何购买合适的笔记本电脑的详细指南，其中详细介绍了不同的 CPU 选项。

paras.en: The size of seat-back tray tables varies. There’s no exact size because of various factors, such as the airline, aircraft, cabin, and seat. Remember: Just because a laptop can physically fit on a tray table doesn’t mean you’ll have space to open and use it. With that in mind, here are the general averages to keep in mind. Airlines do not list tray table sizes, but you can expect one in economy to measure around 16 x 9 inches, while premium cabins will have larger tables depending on the seat.
paras.zh: 座椅靠背托盘桌的尺寸各不相同。由于航空公司、飞机、机舱和座位等多种因素的影响，没有确切的尺寸。请记住：仅仅因为笔记本电脑可以放在小桌板上，并不意味着您就有空间打开和使用它。考虑到这一点，以下是需要牢记的一般平均值。航空公司没有列出小桌板尺寸，但经济舱的小桌板尺寸约为 16 x 9 英寸，而高级客舱的小桌板尺寸则较大，具体取决于座位。

paras.en: I’ve included both tablets and laptops in my recommendations, but your choice will depend on why you’re traveling with a device. If it’s for a vacation and you really only need a device to read, watch, and play on (perhaps with the occasional email check), a tablet works perfectly. Lounging with a tablet, whether on a plane or by the pool, feels much more leisurely than using a laptop. More importantly, it'll help you avoid dipping back into work mode. Whether an Android tablet, iPad, or Windows tablet, just pair it with a compatible keyboard case—and you’re good to go.
paras.zh: 我的推荐中包括了平板电脑和笔记本电脑，但您的选择将取决于您携带设备旅行的原因。如果是为了度假，而您确实只需要一台设备来阅读、观看和玩耍（也许偶尔检查一下电子邮件），那么平板电脑就可以完美发挥作用。无论是在飞机上还是在泳池边，闲逛时使用平板电脑都比使用笔记本电脑感觉更悠闲。更重要的是，它将帮助您避免重新陷入工作模式。无论是 Android 平板电脑、iPad 还是 Windows 平板电脑，只需将其与兼容的键盘盒配对即可开始使用。

paras.en: However, if you’re traveling for work (or need to work while traveling), a proper laptop will be better. The one you already have may work just fine, but frequent fliers know they prefer a more compact device. And more specifically, a small laptop with a keyboard and trackpad will work better on your lap or on small desks than a tablet.
paras.zh: 但是，如果您出差旅行（或需要在旅行时工作），那么合适的笔记本电脑会更好。您已有的设备可能工作得很好，但经常乘坐飞机的人知道他们更喜欢更紧凑的设备。更具体地说，带有键盘和触控板的小型笔记本电脑比平板电脑更适合放在腿上或小桌子上。

articles.title: Our Top Tested Picks From Tineco’s Black Friday Sale (2026)
articles.author: Louryn Strampe

paras.en: Black Friday is associated with deals on high-end electronics, but it's also one of the best times of the year to pick up some new home essentials. Tineco makes some fantastic cleaning gadgets, and right now, many of our WIRED-tested favorites are on sale for up to 60 percent off. I've rounded up the highlights below, and you can check out the full sale here.
paras.zh: 黑色星期五与高端电子产品的促销有关，但它也是一年中购买一些新的家居必需品的最佳时机之一。 Tineco 制造了一些非常棒的清洁小工具，目前，许多经过 WIRED 测试的最爱产品都以高达 60% 的折扣进行促销。我总结了下面的重点内容，您可以在此处查看完整的促销信息。

paras.en: We're covering tons of early Black Friday deals and will be ramping up our deals coverage throughout Cyber Monday.
paras.zh: 我们正在报道大量早期的黑色星期五优惠，并将在整个网络星期一扩大我们的优惠报道。

paras.en: The Tineco Pure One Station 5 is a very solid cordless vacuum. We like its self-emptying docking station that's easy to set up (no drilling or fancy installation required). There's a handy headlight that makes it easier to spot dirt and debris, and we like the large canister capacity. It performs better on hardwood than on carpet, though. This is the best price we've seen for it.
paras.zh: Tineco Pure One Station 5 是一款非常坚固的无绳吸尘器。我们喜欢它的自清坞站，它易于设置（无需钻孔或精美的安装）。有一个方便的头灯，可以更容易地发现灰尘和碎片，而且我们喜欢大容量的罐子。不过，它在硬木上的表现比在地毯上更好。这是我们见过的最优惠的价格。

paras.en: This carpet cleaner is on the heavy side, but it's one of our favorites, especially with its easy-to-rinse tanks for the dirty and clean water. There's a large LED screen that shows which cleaning mode you're in, and the drying mode gets everything dried off in a flash. It'll pull old stains from your carpet and even comes with an accessory for upholstery.
paras.zh: 这款地毯清洁剂虽然重，但它是我们的最爱之一，尤其是它易于冲洗脏水和干净水的水箱。有一个大 LED 屏幕，显示您所处的清洁模式，而干燥模式则可以瞬间干燥所有东西。它可以去除地毯上的旧污渍，甚至还配有室内装饰配件。

paras.en: I haven't tested the newer version of this steam mop yet, but I've been testing models from other brands for an update to that buying guide, and this older Floor One S7 still holds up. It looks great on its docking station, and it cleans my floors efficiently without leaving behind too much water. It does struggle along baseboards, but I truthfully have yet to meet a steam mop that doesn't. It is easy to maneuver with its self-propulsion and also has a handy light that'll show you cleaning progress as you pass over an area. I like the built-in suction too, which means I don't have to use two gadgets to clean one floor.
paras.zh: 我还没有测试过这款蒸汽拖把的新版本，但我一直在测试其他品牌的型号以更新购买指南，而这款旧版 Floor One S7 仍然有效。它在扩展坞上看起来很棒，并且可以有效地清洁我的地板，而不会留下太多水。它确实很难沿着底板移动，但说实话，我还没有遇到过这样的蒸汽拖把。它具有自驱动功能，易于操作，并且还配有方便的灯，可以在您经过某个区域时显示清洁进度。我也喜欢内置吸力，这意味着我不必使用两个小工具来清洁一层地板。

articles.title: Sony Bravia 9 II Review (2026): Adjustable and Bright
articles.author: John Brandon

paras.en: The current flagship television from Sony, the Bravia 9 II, is an RGB TV model (Sony calls it “True RGB”) that brings to life even the darkest scenes in Game of Thrones. Much brighter than the midrange Bravia 7 II, the 9 II's best qualities are related to its black levels, picture quality, and excellent viewing angles that allow me to see Jon Snow and the GoT dragons perfectly, even when I'm sitting off to the side.
paras.zh: 索尼目前的旗舰电视 Bravia 9 II 是一款 RGB 电视型号（索尼称之为“True RGB”），即使是《权力的游戏》中最黑暗的场景也能栩栩如生。 9 II 比中端 Bravia 7 II 明亮得多，其最佳品质与它的黑电平、图像质量和出色的视角有关，这些角度让我即使坐在一边也能完美地看到琼恩·雪诺和 GoT 龙。

paras.en: This premium Sony television carries a premium price of $3,600 for the 65-inch model, but that’s still $1,400 less than the LG Micro RGB Evo, which retails for $5,000. I ended up preferring the overall picture quality of that LG model and some other OLED models, but—after my usual rigorous testing—I felt the Bravia 9 II came close to matching the high caliber of those other options. In fact, it’s just a notch or two lower than the absolute best television you might find.
paras.zh: 这款优质索尼电视的 65 英寸型号售价为 3,600 美元，但仍比零售价 5,000 美元的 LG Micro RGB Evo 低 1,400 美元。我最终更喜欢 LG 型号和其他一些 OLED 型号的整体图像质量，但经过我一贯的严格测试后，我觉得 Bravia 9 II 接近与其他选项的高品质相匹配。事实上，它只比您可能找到的绝对最好的电视低一两个档次。

paras.en: The Sony Bravia 9 II is all black, sits on two feet, and includes four HDMI ports (only two are HDMI 2.1, though, which allows for higher-bandwidth streaming and sound at 48 Gbps). Setup was a breeze; Google TV was up and running in less than five minutes, which is an impressive feat, given that both Samsung and LG televisions typically add a few extra steps to the install process, such as authenticating your login (with Samsung) or relying on an app (with the LG ThinQ).
paras.zh: 索尼 Bravia 9 II 是全黑的，有两个脚，包括四个 HDMI 端口（不过，只有两个是 HDMI 2.1，可实现 48 Gbps 的更高带宽流媒体和声音）。设置过程轻而易举； Google TV 在不到五分钟的时间内就启动并运行了，这是一个令人印象深刻的壮举，因为三星和 LG 电视通常都会在安装过程中添加一些额外的步骤，例如验证您的登录（使用三星）或依赖应用程序（使用 LG ThinQ）。

paras.en: The premium Sony Bravia 9 II also offers exceptional sound. It includes two upfiring tweeters for more realistic Dolby Atmos than the Bravia 7 II, which lacks these extra channels. When I watched House of the Dragon, the room-filling audio made me feel like I was flying a dragon or piloting a ship.
paras.zh: 优质的索尼 Bravia 9 II 还提供卓越的音质。它包括两个上发式高音扬声器，比 Bravia 7 II 更逼真的杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos)，而 Bravia 7 II 缺乏这些额外的声道。当我观看《龙之屋》时，充满整个房间的音频让我感觉自己在驾驶一条龙或驾驶一艘船。

articles.title: Gorillaz, CHVRCHES, Yung Lean & More: 5 Best Moments in Mexico City’s Corona Capital (Day 1)
articles.author: Isabela Raygoza

paras.en: Corona Capital’s opening day on Friday (Nov. 20) marked Gorillaz’s highly anticipated return to Mexico City after eight years away. The band delivered an emotional set packed with hits and gave a special shoutout to Mexico and its president. The British collective also brought out veteran guitarist Johnny Marr and Argentine rapper Trueno as special guests.
paras.zh: Corona Capital 于周五（11 月 20 日）开业，标志着 Gorillaz 在阔别八年后重返墨西哥城，备受期待。乐队演奏了充满激情的歌曲，并向墨西哥及其总统表示特别的赞扬。英国乐队还邀请了资深吉他手约翰尼·马尔和阿根廷说唱歌手特鲁诺作为特邀嘉宾。

paras.en: “I f— with Mexico because you have a revolutionary spirit here,” Gorillaz frontman Damon Albarn told the crowd. “This is an inspirational country.”
paras.zh: “我喜欢墨西哥，因为这里有革命精神，”Gorillaz 主唱达蒙·阿尔巴恩 (Damon Albarn) 对人群说道。 “这是一个鼓舞人心的国家。”

paras.en: The first day of the festival’s 16th edition featured established acts and rising artists across indie, soul, electro-pop, folk and contemporary rap. Female artists — performing solo or with their bands — were especially well represented, including CHVRCHES, Violet Grohl, Olivia Dean, CMAT, Grace Ives, Anna Luna and Darianna Everett.
paras.zh: 第 16 届音乐节的第一天，云集了独立音乐、灵魂乐、电子流行音乐、民谣和当代说唱等领域的知名表演者和新兴艺术家。女性艺术家——独奏或与乐队一起表演——尤其有代表性，包括 CHVRCHES、Violet Grohl、Olivia Dean、CMAT、Grace Ives、Anna Luna 和 Darianna Everett。

paras.en: Some 72,000 people attended the rock-filled day, according to promoter Ocesa. They also caught sets from James Blake, Mumford & Sons, Yung Lean, The Kooks, Jamie xx and Durand Jones & The Indications, among others.
paras.zh: 据发起人 Ocesa 称，约有 72,000 人参加了这一充满岩石的活动。他们还观看了 James Blake、Mumford & Sons、Yung Lean、The Kooks、Jamie xx 和 Durand Jones & The Inspirations 等公司的作品。

paras.en: The enthusiastic crowd kept the energy high throughout the marathon day of music, which stretched into the early hours of Saturday (Nov. 21) at Curva 4, the Formula 1 venue in Mexico City.
paras.zh: 在墨西哥城一级方程式赛车场 Curva 4 举行的音乐马拉松日中，热情的人群一直保持着高昂的能量，一直持续到周六（11 月 21 日）凌晨。

paras.en: Saturday’s lineup included Twenty One Pilots, The Offspring, Balu Brigada, Pierce the Veil, Underworld, Sébastien Tellier and Peaches and more. On Sunday (Nov. 21), The Strokes will be headlining the festival. Other performing acts will include The xx, Lola Young, Lil Yachty, The Black Crowes, Santigold, Manic Street Preachers, Tricky and more.
paras.zh: 周六的演出阵容包括二十一名飞行员、The Offspring、Balu Brigada、Pierce the Veil、Underworld、Sébastien Tellier 和 Peaches 等。周日（11 月 21 日），The Strokes 将成为音乐节的主角。其他表演团体包括 The xx、Lola Young、Lil Yachty、The Black Crowes、Santigold、Manic Street Preachers、Tricky 等。

paras.en: Here are five of the best moments from day one of Corona Capital 2026.
paras.zh: 以下是 Corona Capital 2026 第一天以来的五个最佳时刻。

paras.en: - The Triumphant Return of Gorillaz Gorillaz, Damon Albarn and Jamie Hewlett’s famous collective, returned to Mexico City after eight years for a memorable performance, with guitarist Johnny Marr and Argentine rapper Trueno joining as special guests. Albarn, the former Blur frontman, also praised Mexico’s “revolutionary spirit” and gave a shout-out to President Claudia Sheinbaum. Gorillaz headlined the festival’s opening day with a set focused mainly on their 2026 album The Mountain and the hits that have made the group one of pop’s biggest acts. Marr, former guitarist for The Smiths, joined the band for “The Empty Dream Machine” and “Casablanca.” Trueno came out for “THE MANIFESTO” and freestyled on “Clint Eastwood,” which closed the set. Mexican singer Luisa Almaguer also joined Gorillaz for “Latin Simone (Que Pasa Contigo),” originally recorded with the late Cuban star Ibrahim Ferrer for the band’s self-titled debut album.
paras.zh: - Gorillaz 凯旋归来 Gorillaz、达蒙·阿尔本 (Damon Albarn) 和杰米·休利特 (Jamie Hewlett) 组成的著名乐队时隔八年重返墨西哥城，进行了一场令人难忘的演出，吉他手约翰尼·马尔 (Johnny Marr) 和阿根廷说唱歌手特鲁诺 (Trueno) 作为特邀嘉宾加入。前 Blur 主唱阿尔巴恩也赞扬了墨西哥的“革命精神”，并向总统克劳迪娅·谢因鲍姆大声喊叫。 Gorillaz 的演出成为了音乐节开幕日的头条新闻，主要聚焦于他们 2026 年的专辑《The Mountain》以及使该乐队成为流行音乐界最伟大艺人之一的热门歌曲。马尔是史密斯乐队的前吉他手，加入乐队制作了“The Empty Dream Machine”和“Casablanca”。特鲁诺在《THE MANIFESTO》中出场，并在《克林特·伊斯特伍德》中即兴表演，结束了演出。墨西哥歌手路易莎·阿尔马格尔 (Luisa Almaguer) 也与 Gorillaz 一起录制了《拉丁西蒙 (Que Pasa Contigo)》，该歌曲最初是与已故古巴明星易卜拉欣·费雷 (Ibrahim Ferrer) 一起录制的乐队首张同名专辑。

paras.en: - CHVRCHES Bring Out New Songs The Scottish trio, led by vocalist Lauren Mayberry, surprised Mexican fans with new songs set to appear on their upcoming album, All The King’s Men. New singles “Roses” and “Evil,” which will be featured on the LP due in January, stood out for their memorable melodies and expansive synths. Classics like “Forever” and “Miracle” made for emotional moments with longtime fans.
paras.zh: - CHVRCHES 推出新歌 由主唱 Lauren Mayberry 领衔的苏格兰三人组合为墨西哥歌迷带来了他们即将发行的专辑《All The King's Men》中的新歌。新单曲“Roses”和“Evil”将于一月份收录在唱片中，它们以其令人难忘的旋律和广阔的合成器而脱颖而出。 《永远》和《奇迹》等经典歌曲为老粉丝带来了激动人心的时刻。

paras.en: - Violet Grohl Makes a Powerful Debut Violet Grohl, daughter of Dave Grohl — the Foo Fighters frontman and former Nirvana drummer — made her debut on Friday at the same Mexican festival her famous father has previously conquered. Backed by her rock band, the singer-songwriter showed she’s carrying on the family name with a direct, high-energy set featuring songs like “Bug In The Cake,” “THUM,” “Last Day I Loved You” and “Cool Buzz.”
paras.zh: - 维奥莱特·格罗尔 (Violet Grohl) 首次亮相在她的摇滚乐队的支持下，这位歌手兼作曲家通过一首直接、充满活力的歌曲展示了她继承了家族的名字，其中包括《Bug In The Cake》、《THUM》、《Last Day I Loved You》和《Cool Buzz》等歌曲。

paras.en: - Yung Lean, A Contemporary Rap Icon Swedish rapper Yung Lean, who won over the internet and a generation of listeners with his cloud rap and contemporary hip-hop sound, was also one of the day’s most anticipated acts. He took the main stage to show why he’s considered one of today’s standout artists in the genre, performing songs including “Ghostown,” “Kyoto,” “Forever Yung,” “Pikachu,” “Yoshi City” and “STORM II,” as well as his remix of Charli xcx’s “360.”
paras.zh: - Yung Lean，当代说唱偶像 瑞典说唱歌手 Yung Lean 以其云说唱和当代嘻哈音乐赢得了互联网和一代听众的青睐，也是当天最受期待的表演之一。他登上主舞台，展示了为什么他被认为是当今该流派中的杰出艺术家之一，表演的歌曲包括《Ghosttown》、《Kyoto》、《Forever Yung》、《皮卡丘》、《Yoshi City》和《STORM II》，以及他对 Charli xcx 的《360》的混音版。

paras.en: - Durand Jones & The Indications Bring Classic Soul Back to Life The U.S. band Durand Jones & The Indications also made its debut at the popular Mexican festival, drawing thousands to the NIVEA stage with a blend of contemporary R&B and soul. The group brought a sexy, danceable vibe to the evening with its upbeat, retro-soul sound, getting the crowd moving to songs like “Circles,” “The Way That I Do,” “Love Will Work It Out” and “Flower Moon.”
paras.zh: - Durand Jones & The Inspirations 让经典灵魂乐重获新生 美国乐队 Durand Jones & The Inspirations 也在这个颇受欢迎的墨西哥音乐节上首次亮相，以融合当代 R&B 和灵魂乐的风格吸引了数千人来到 NIVEA 舞台。该乐队以其乐观、复古灵魂乐的声音为当晚带来了性感、适合跳舞的氛围，让观众随着《Circles》、《The Way That I Do》、《Love Will Work It Out》和《Flower Moon》等歌曲而动起来。

articles.title: Miley Cyrus Marries Maxx Morando in Poolside Ceremony Led by the Flaming Lips’ Wayne Coyne
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Miley Cyrus married Maxx Morando on Saturday (Nov. 21) in a poolside ceremony in Palm Springs, Calif., with the Flaming Lips’ Wayne Coyne officiating, one month after the couple sang “Let’s Get Married” together on the Hollywood Bowl stage.
paras.zh: 周六（11 月 21 日），麦莉·赛勒斯 (Miley Cyrus) 与马克斯·莫兰多 (Maxx Morando) 在加利福尼亚州棕榈泉举行的池畔婚礼上结婚，由 Flaming Lips 乐队成员韦恩·科因 (Wayne Coyne) 主持，一个月前，这对夫妇在好莱坞露天剧场 (Hollywood Bowl) 舞台上共同演唱了《让我们结婚吧》(Let’s Get Married)。

paras.en: Coyne, who worked with Cyrus on her 2015 album Miley Cyrus & Her Dead Petz and joined her onstage at the Hollywood Bowl in October, led the vows as Cyrus, 33, and Morando, 28, stood beneath an arch of white flowers in front of family and friends, according to photos published by People. Cyrus wore a long-sleeved white satin gown with a high neck, open back and small train, and was photographed wiping away tears during the vows, while Morando wore a black suit.
paras.zh: 根据《人物》杂志发布的照片​​，科因曾与赛勒斯合作制作了她 2015 年的专辑《Miley Cyrus & Her Dead Petz》，并于 10 月在好莱坞露天剧场 (Hollywood Bowl) 与她一起登台，33 岁的赛勒斯和 28 岁的莫兰多站在家人和朋友面前的白花拱门下，共同宣誓。赛勒斯穿着一件高领、露背和小裾长袖白色缎面礼服，被拍到在宣誓时擦眼泪，而莫兰多则穿着黑色西装。

paras.en: Among the guests were her mother, Tish Cyrus, and husband Dominic Purcell; her sister Noah Cyrus; and her father, Billy Ray Cyrus, along with Elizabeth Hurley. The celebrations began the night before with a rehearsal dinner, glimpsed in Instagram photos posted by Cyrus’ stepsister Lily-Rose Purcell that showed tables dressed with dark red flowers and small candles, and a menu topped with an “M+M” monogram.
paras.zh: 客人中有她的母亲蒂什·赛勒斯 (Tish Cyrus) 和丈夫多米尼克·珀塞尔 (Dominic Purcell)。她的妹妹诺亚·赛勒斯；和她的父亲比利·雷·赛勒斯以及伊丽莎白·赫尔利。庆祝活动从前一天晚上的彩排晚宴开始，赛勒斯的继姐妹莉莉-罗丝·珀塞尔 (Lily-Rose Purcell) 在 Instagram 上发布了照片，照片中桌子上摆满了深红色的鲜花和小蜡烛，菜单上还印有“M+M”字母组合。

paras.en: The wedding caps a year in which the relationship moved from the edges of Cyrus’ public life to the center of her work. “Let’s Get Married,” which Morando co-wrote and co-produced, appears on Bass Persuades, her 10th studio album and her first released simply as Miley. Its black-and-white video, directed by Mert Alas and shot at West Hollywood’s Chateau Marmont, casts Morando opposite her — a dress rehearsal, as it turned out, for the real thing two months later.
paras.zh: 这场婚礼标志着这一年的结束，这段关系从赛勒斯公共生活的边缘转移到了她工作的中心。莫兰多与他人共同创作并联合制作的《Let’s Get Married》收录在她的第十张录音室专辑《Bass Persuades》中，这也是她第一张以 Miley 身份发行的专辑。这段黑白视频由默特·阿拉斯 (Mert Alas) 执导，在西好莱坞的马尔蒙城堡 (Chateau Marmont) 拍摄，莫兰多 (Morando) 站在她的对面——事实证明，这是两个月后真正的彩排。

paras.en: That album also brought Cyrus back to the top of the Billboard 200, debuting at No. 1 on the chart dated Oct. 3 with 61,000 equivalent album units, according to Luminate. It gave her a sixth No. 1 album and her first since Bangerz in 2013.
paras.zh: 根据 Luminate 的数据，这张专辑还让 Cyrus 重回 Billboard 200 榜首，并在 10 月 3 日的排行榜上以 61,000 份同等专辑销量排名第一。它为她带来了第六张排名第一的专辑，也是她自 2013 年 Bangerz 以来的第一张专辑。

paras.en: It marks a striking shift for a couple who spent years largely out of view. Morando, the drummer for Los Angeles rock band Liily, was first linked to Cyrus in late 2021, when the pair attended a Gucci event together. The two had been set up on a blind date — “Well, it was blind for me and not really for him,” she told British Vogue in 2023 — and he later joined her at the 2024 Grammy Awards, where “Flowers” won record of the year. Morando proposed in October 2025 in a garden on the grounds of their hotel in Kyoto, Japan, telling Wonderland he held out “until the very last moment of the very last day” to keep it a surprise. The engagement went public in early December 2025, when Cyrus wore the ring to the Dec. 1 premiere of Avatar: Fire and Ash in Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 对于这对多年来几乎不在人们视线中的夫妇来说，这标志着一个惊人的转变。洛杉矶摇滚乐队 Liily 的鼓手莫兰多 (Morando) 于 2021 年底首次与赛勒斯 (Cyrus) 产生联系，当时两人一起参加了一场 Gucci 活动。两人被安排相亲——“嗯，这对我来说是盲目的，但对他来说却不是，”她在 2023 年告诉英国版《Vogue》——后来他和她一起参加了 2024 年格莱美奖，其中《Flowers》赢得了年度唱片。莫兰多于 2025 年 10 月在日本京都酒店的花园里求婚，他告诉 Wonderland，他“一直坚持到最后一天的最后一刻”，以保持惊喜。订婚于 2025 年 12 月初公开，当时赛勒斯戴着这枚戒指出席 12 月 1 日在洛杉矶举行的《阿凡达：火与灰》首映式。

paras.en: It is Cyrus’ second marriage, following her December 2018 wedding to Liam Hemsworth, from whom she separated the following August. Speaking at a press conference for Avatar: Fire and Ash, she described her relationship with Morando as “about starting again,” reflecting “the consciousness of a more grown and adult person of what I want this time around.”
paras.zh: 这是赛勒斯的第二次婚姻，此前她于 2018 年 12 月与利亚姆·海姆斯沃斯 (Liam Hemsworth) 结婚，并于次年 8 月与利亚姆·海姆斯沃斯 (Liam Hemsworth) 分居。在《阿凡达：火与灰》的新闻发布会上，她将自己与莫兰多的关系描述为“关于重新开始”，反映了“一个更加成熟和成熟的人对我这次想要的东西的意识”。

paras.en: Billboard has reached out to Cyrus’ representatives for comment.
paras.zh: 《公告牌》已联系赛勒斯的代表征求意见。

articles.title: Britney Spears Apologizes to Her Family on Instagram: ‘I Just Miss Them Like Crazy’
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Britney Spears posted a public apology to her family on Saturday (Nov. 21), writing on Instagram that she regretted revisiting past conflicts in public.
paras.zh: 周六（11 月 21 日），布兰妮·斯皮尔斯在 Instagram 上向家人公开道歉，并写道，她对在公开场合重提过去的冲突感到遗憾。

paras.en: “I’m so very sorry for bringing up past issues, but I think I did because I realized I needed to protect my heart,” Spears wrote. “It’s the way I love, and when I love you, I really love you.”
paras.zh: 斯皮尔斯写道：“我对提起过去的问题感到非常抱歉，但我认为我这样做是因为我意识到我需要保护我的心。” “这就是我爱的方式，当我爱你时，我真的很爱你。”

paras.en: She described her own conduct as “childish and embarrassing,” adding: “Thoughts on the past, I’m obviously human, and there actually might be something to those things I said psychology-wise; either way, I’m sorry to my family for bringing up those memories.”
paras.zh: 她形容自己的行为“幼稚且令人尴尬”，并补充道：“回想过去，我显然也是人，我说的那些话实际上可能有心理学上的道理；无论如何，我很抱歉我的家人提起了这些记忆。”

paras.en: Spears said the conversation had never taken place directly. “I’ve never actually spoken to them face to face on it,” she wrote. “I just miss them like crazy! And I’m very sorry!” She also called herself “blessed to have such a beautiful family.”
paras.zh: 斯皮尔斯表示，这次谈话从未直接进行过。 “我从未真正与他们面对面交谈过，”她写道。 “我只是疯狂地想念他们！我很抱歉！”她还称自己“很幸运拥有如此美好的家庭”。

paras.en: Spears is the eldest child of Jamie and Lynne Spears, who are divorced. She has a brother, Bryan, and a sister, Jamie Lynn Spears.
paras.zh: 斯皮尔斯是杰米·斯皮尔斯和林恩·斯皮尔斯离婚的长子。她有一个兄弟布莱恩和一个妹妹杰米·林恩·斯皮尔斯。

paras.en: The relationship has been publicly strained for years. Spears spent 13 years under a conservatorship, established in February 2008 with her father as conservator, which gave others control over her finances, career and personal decisions. After an explosive court hearing in June 2021 in which she testified against the arrangement, a Los Angeles judge suspended Jamie Spears that September and terminated the conservatorship on Nov. 12, 2021.
paras.zh: 多年来，两国关系在公开场合一直处于紧张状态。斯皮尔斯在 2008 年 2 月设立的监管机构中度过了 13 年，她的父亲担任监管人，这让其他人可以控制她的财务、职业和个人决定。 2021 年 6 月，在一次爆炸性的法庭听证会上，杰米·斯皮尔斯 (Jamie Spears) 作证反对这一安排，之后，洛杉矶法官于当年 9 月暂停了杰米·斯皮尔斯 (Jamie Spears) 的职务，并于 2021 年 11 月 12 日终止了监管。

paras.en: In the years since, Spears has repeatedly addressed the fallout. “Honestly my family embarrassed me and hurt me deeply,” she wrote in December 2021, a month after the termination. Her 2023 memoir The Woman in Me detailed her account of the arrangement, including her view that it “stripped me of my womanhood, made me into a child,” and addressed tensions with her sister.
paras.zh: 此后的几年里，斯皮尔斯多次谈到了这一后果。 “老实说，我的家人让我感到尴尬，并深深伤害了我，”她在 2021 年 12 月（终止妊娠一个月后）写道。她在 2023 年出版的回忆录《我体内的女人》详细描述了她对这一安排的描述，包括她认为这“剥夺了我的女性气质，让我变成了一个孩子”，并解决了她与姐姐之间的紧张关系。

paras.en: The sisters’ relationship had already become public: Spears sent Jamie Lynn a cease and desist letter in early 2022 over claims in her sibling’s memoir Things I Should Have Said, published two months after the conservatorship ended. The pair appeared to move toward reconciliation in mid-2023, when Spears posted about visiting the set of Jamie Lynn’s film Zoey 102.
paras.zh: 姐妹俩的关系已经公开：斯皮尔斯于 2022 年初向杰米·林恩 (Jamie Lynn) 发出了一封停止信，原因是她的姐姐在监管结束两个月后出版的回忆录《我应该说的话》(Things I Should Have Said) 中提出了指控。 2023 年年中，斯皮尔斯发布了关于参观杰米·林恩 (Jamie Lynn) 的电影《佐伊 102》(Zoey 102) 片场的消息，两人似乎走向和解。

paras.en: Spears has continued releasing music since the conservatorship ended, including “Hold Me Closer” with Elton John in 2022 and “Mind Your Business” with will.i.am in 2023. Earlier this month, a 25th anniversary edition of her self-titled third album arrived with 11 bonus tracks, five of them previously unreleased.
paras.zh: 自保护期结束以来，斯皮尔斯继续发行音乐，包括 2022 年与埃尔顿·约翰 (Elton John) 合作的《Hold Me Closer》和 2023 年与 will.i.am 合作的《Mind Your Business》。本月早些时候，她的同名第三张专辑的 25 周年纪念版上市，其中包含 11 首额外曲目，其中 5 首之前未发行。

articles.title: Luca Guadagnino Says His ‘American Psycho’ Movie Not Moving Forward
articles.author: Lexi Carson

paras.en: Luca Guadagnino‘s adaptation of American Psycho is no longer moving forward.
paras.zh: 卢卡·瓜达尼诺 (Luca Guadagnino) 改编的《美国精神病人》不再继续上映。

paras.en: While appearing on Deadline‘s Crew Call podcast with Anthony D’Alessandro, Guadagnino confirmed that his new adaptation of Bret Easton Ellis’ bestselling novel is no longer happening.
paras.zh: 在与安东尼·达历山德罗一起出现在 Deadline 的 Crew Call 播客中时，瓜达尼诺确认他对布雷特·伊斯顿·埃利斯畅销小说的新改编不再发生。

paras.en: “Scott Z. Burns wrote a fantastic script. Unfortunately for me, as we speak, it’s not happening,” Guadagnino said.
paras.zh: “斯科特·Z·伯恩斯写了一个很棒的剧本。不幸的是，对我来说，就在我们说话的时候，这并没有发生，”瓜达尼诺说。

paras.en: The Call Me by Your Name filmmaker did not elaborate on why the project is no longer moving forward. Lionsgate did not respond to The Hollywood Reporter’s request for comment.
paras.zh: 《请以你的名字呼唤我》的电影制片人没有详细说明为什么该项目不再继续推进。狮门影业没有回应《好莱坞报道》的置评请求。

paras.en: The project was first announced in October 2024, with Frenesy Films producing. At the time, it was described as a new interpretation of Ellis’ novel rather than a remake of the original film.
paras.zh: 该项目于 2024 年 10 月首次宣布，由 Frenesy Films 制作。当时，它被描述为对埃利斯小说的新诠释，而不是对原版电影的翻拍。

paras.en: “We are thrilled to add another elite filmmaker to our upcoming slate,” Lionsgate Motion Picture Group chair Adam Fogelson said in a statement at the time. “Luca is a brilliant artist, and the perfect visionary to create a whole new interpretation of this potent and classic IP.”
paras.zh: 狮门影业集团主席亚当·福格尔森当时在一份声明中表示：“我们很高兴在我们即将推出的名单中加入另一位精英电影制作人。” “卢卡是一位才华横溢的艺术家，也是对这个强大而经典的 IP 进行全新诠释的完美远见者。”

paras.en: The original 2000 film starred Christian Bale as Patrick Bateman, an investment banker living a secret life as a serial killer. Its supporting cast included Jared Leto, Willem Dafoe, Chloë Sevigny and Reese Witherspoon.
paras.zh: 2000 年的原版电影由克里斯蒂安·贝尔 (Christian Bale) 饰演帕特里克·贝特曼 (Patrick Bateman)，他是一名投资银行家，过着连环杀手的秘密生活。其配角包括杰瑞德·莱托、威廉·达福、科洛·塞维尼和瑞茜·威瑟斯彭。

paras.en: When asked about the possibility of another actor taking on the role, Bale told THR in March, “Whoever wants to give it a shot, give it a pop. I loved making it with [director] Mary Harron so many years back, fantastic memories of it all. Bold choice of anyone to try to do a — I don’t know if they’re doing a remake or what, I don’t know anything else about it. But all the best to ’em; I like brave people.”
paras.zh: 当被问及是否有其他演员出演这个角色时，贝尔在三月份告诉《好莱坞报道》，“无论谁想尝试一下，就放手一搏。多年前我就喜欢和[导演]玛丽·哈伦一起制作这个角色，这一切都是美好的回忆。任何人尝试做这个角色都是大胆的选择——我不知道他们是在翻拍还是什么，我对此一无所知。但祝他们一切顺利；我喜欢勇敢的人。”

paras.en: Up next, Guadagnino’s Artificial, starring Andrew Garfield, follows the rise of OpenAI and the 2023 firing and rehiring of CEO Sam Altman. The film is set to hit theaters on Christmas Day from Neon.
paras.zh: 接下来，由安德鲁·加菲尔德 (Andrew Garfield) 主演的 Guadagnino 的《Artificial》讲述了 OpenAI 的崛起以及 2023 年首席执行官山姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 的解雇和重新聘用。这部电影将于圣诞节在 Neon 影院上映。

articles.title: Russell Brand Selling “Free Russell” Merch Via His Wellness Business While in Prison
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Russell Brand is selling merchandise calling for his freedom while he’s behind bars after being sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison after being found guilty of rape and sexual assault.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔·布兰德 (Russell Brand) 因强奸和性侵犯罪被判 10 年零 6 个月监禁，在狱中出售呼吁自由的商品。

paras.en: It is unclear how long the items have been available for purchase on Reborn, however the earliest reviews on the varying products date to Nov. 16 (he was sentenced Nov. 9). Brand recently received backlash for sharing a message from prison, delivered by his wife, Laura Brand, on his YouTube channel where he claimed he was innocent.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚这些物品在 Reborn 上可以购买多久，但对不同产品的最早评论可以追溯到 11 月 16 日（他于 11 月 9 日被判刑）。布兰德最近因在他的 YouTube 频道上分享妻子劳拉·布兰德 (Laura Brand) 在狱中发表的一条信息而遭到强烈反对，他声称自己是无辜的。

paras.en: “So Russell has asked me to read something to you today,” the actor’s wife said at the start of the video, before looking to a notebook to read her husband’s message. “Beloved brothers and sisters in Christ, God bless you for your support. As you know, I am not guilty for the offenses I have been jailed for, so something strange is happening.”
paras.zh: “所以拉塞尔今天让我读一些东西给你听，”演员的妻子在视频开始时说道，然后看着笔记本阅读她丈夫的信息。 “亲爱的基督里的兄弟姐妹们，愿上帝保佑你们的支持。如你们所知，我对自己入狱的罪行并无罪，所以奇怪的事情发生了。”

paras.en: Brand was sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison after being found guilty of rape and sexual assault. The trial lasted four weeks at Southwark Crown Court, with the jury finding him guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault (he was found not guilty on two other rape charges and not guilty of attempted indecent assault).
paras.zh: 布兰德因强奸和性侵犯罪被判入狱 10 年零 6 个月。南华克皇家法院的审判持续了四个星期，陪审团裁定他犯有一项强奸罪和三项性侵犯罪（他被判对另外两项强奸罪无罪，并且在未遂猥亵罪中被判无罪）。

paras.en: The actor has three items featuring “Free Russell” available for purchase on the website for Reborn, his wellness business. Every item is available for $34.99; a shirt with the words “Free Russell Brand“; a hat with the same text; and another shirt that reads “Free Russell” with an image of himself.
paras.zh: 这位演员在他的健康业务 Reborn 的网站上出售了三件以“Free Russell”为主题的商品。每件商品售价 34.99 美元；一件印有“Free Russell Brand”字样的衬衫；带有相同文字的帽子；还有另一件衬衫，上面写着“释放拉塞尔”，上面有他自己的照片。

paras.en: Upon visiting the Reborn website, images of the merch are displayed on its homepage with text that reads, “Stand with Russell against injustice” and “silenced for speaking out.” After clicking on the “Free Russell” section of the site, the items are labeled as “fundraiser apparel,” with a descriptor that additionally reads, “Silenced for speaking out against injustuce and corruption.”
paras.zh: 访问 Reborn 网站后，其主页上会显示商品图片，并附有文字，“与拉塞尔站在一起反对不公正”和“因直言不讳而被沉默”。点击网站的“释放拉塞尔”部分后，这些物品被标记为“筹款服装”，并附有描述符，另外还写着“因公开反对不公正和腐败而被压制”。

paras.en: After the YouTube video was shared, Google, the parent company of YouTube, told BBC News it was “aware of the new content and our teams are investigating,” adding, “We suspended Russell Brand’s channel from the YouTube Partner Program in September 2023. The channel has not been able to monetise on YouTube since then.”
paras.zh: YouTube 视频被分享后，YouTube 的母公司谷歌告诉 BBC 新闻，它“已获悉新内容，我们的团队正在调查”，并补充道，“我们于 2023 年 9 月暂停了拉塞尔·布兰德 (Russell Brand) 频道的 YouTube 合作伙伴计划。从那时起，该频道就无法在 YouTube 上获利。”

paras.en: BBC News also reported that Google declined a request from the Ministry of Justice to remove the video, saying none of its rules had been broken.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司新闻还报道称，谷歌拒绝了司法部删除该视频的请求，称其没有违反任何规定。

paras.en: His message, delivered by his wife in the YouTube video, drew criticism, with Britain’s Justice Secretary Alex Norris calling the broadcast of a statement from Brand while he is behind bars “completely unacceptable.”
paras.zh: 他的妻子在 YouTube 视频中传达的信息引起了批评，英国司法大臣亚历克斯·诺里斯 (Alex Norris) 称在布兰德身陷囹圄期间播出布兰德的声明“完全不可接受”。

paras.en: “Prisoners are rightly banned from making statements that cause distress to victims,” Norris wrote on X. “This is being urgently investigated, and I expect action to be taken if he is found to have broken the rules.”
paras.zh: 诺里斯在 X 上写道：“囚犯被禁止发表会给受害者带来痛苦的言论，这是正确的。”“这件事正在紧急调查中，如果发现他违反了规定，我预计将采取行动。”

articles.title: Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando Are Married
articles.author: Lexi Carson

paras.en: Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando are married.
paras.zh: 麦莉·赛勒斯和麦克斯·莫兰多结婚了。

paras.en: The couple tied the knot Saturday in Palm Springs, California, according to Entertainment Tonight. TMZ first reported that Cyrus, 33, and Morando, 28, were expected to wed over the weekend.
paras.zh: 据《今夜娱乐》报道，这对夫妇周六在加利福尼亚州棕榈泉喜结连理。 TMZ 首先报道称，33 岁的赛勒斯和 28 岁的莫兰多预计将在周末结婚。

paras.en: On Friday, the Grammy winner’s stepsister Lily-Rose Purcell shared photos on her Instagram Stories from the couple’s rehearsal dinner. One photo showed the dinner tables decorated with crimson flowers, along with a menu featuring “M+M,” the couple’s initials, printed at the top.
paras.zh: 周五，这位格莱美奖得主的继姐妹莉莉-罗丝·珀塞尔在她的 Instagram Stories 上分享了这对夫妇排练晚宴的照片。一张照片显示，餐桌上装饰着深红色的花朵，菜单顶部印有“M+M”（这对夫妇的名字首字母）。

paras.en: The “Flowers” singer and Morando, also a musician, met on a blind date in 2021, she told British Vogue in 2023. The pair have also worked together, collaborating on her albums Endless Summer Vacation and Something Beautiful.
paras.zh: 她在 2023 年告诉英国《Vogue》杂志，这位《Flowers》歌手和同为音乐家的 Morando 在 2021 年相亲时相识。两人还合作过她的专辑《Endless Summer Vacation》和《Something Beautiful》。

paras.en: The couple’s engagement was confirmed in December 2025 after Cyrus debuted a shiny gold band on her left ring finger while posing for photos with Morando at the premiere of Avatar: Fire and Ash, for which she contributed the song “Dream as One.” People confirmed the engagement the following day.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月，赛勒斯在《阿凡达：火与灰》首映式上与莫兰多合影时，在左手无名指上佩戴了一枚闪亮的金色戒指，并为这首歌曲创作了歌曲《Dream as One》，这对夫妇的订婚得以确认。人们第二天就确认了订婚。

paras.en: More than two weeks after the news of their engagement broke, Us Weekly reported that the couple had “talked about eloping” instead of having a traditional wedding.
paras.zh: 在他们订婚的消息传出两周多后，《美国周刊》报道称，这对夫妇“讨论过私奔”，而不是举行传统的婚礼。

paras.en: “Miley is really happy right now and in such a good, calm place,” an insider told the publication. “She’s not super into the idea of doing another wedding.”
paras.zh: 一位内部人士告诉该刊物：“麦莉现在真的很高兴，而且在一个如此美好、平静的地方。” “她不太愿意再举办一场婚礼。”

paras.en: Cyrus was previously married to Hunger Games actor Liam Hemsworth, whom she met while filming the 2010 film adaptation of Nicholas Sparks’s novel, The Last Song. After a decade-long, on-again, off-again relationship, the pair married in 2018 and divorced in 2020.
paras.zh: 赛勒斯此前曾与《饥饿游戏》演员利亚姆·海姆斯沃斯结婚，两人是在 2010 年拍摄改编自尼古拉斯·斯帕克斯小说的电影《最后一首歌》时相识的。经过长达十年时断时续的关系，两人于 2018 年结婚，并于 2020 年离婚。

articles.title: Tech outages are fueling a new doomsday economy

paras.en: Americans are shopping like there's no tomorrow.
paras.zh: 美国人购物就像没有明天一样。

paras.en: A spate of high-profile technology outages that grounded planes, halted email access and slowed bank transactions have left many people worried about artificial intelligence-driven cyberattacks and the state of the U.S. energy grid.
paras.zh: 一系列备受瞩目的技术中断导致飞机停飞、电子邮件访问中断和银行交易减慢，这让许多人对人工智能驱动的网络攻击和美国能源电网的状况感到担忧。

paras.en: Government officials have dismissed rumors and speculation circulating online that there could be a nefarious culprit for the series of malfunctions. Despite those assurances, consumers like Sabrina Cepeda are readying for a larger-scale technology blackout or other emergency event.
paras.zh: 政府官员驳斥了网上流传的谣言和猜测，即这一系列故障可能是罪魁祸首。尽管有这些保证，但像萨布丽娜·塞佩达这样的消费者仍在为更大规模的技术停电或其他紧急事件做好准备。

paras.en: In recent days, the Houston resident has purchased propane and lighter fluid for cooking and heating equipment that can be used without electricity. The mother of three also replenished her backup stockpiles of non-perishable foods, hygiene products and allergy medicine in the event that her family is homebound for several days.
paras.zh: 最近几天，这位休斯顿居民购买了丙烷和打火机油，用于无需电力即可使用的烹饪和取暖设备。这位三个孩子的母亲还补充了不易腐烂食品、卫生用品和抗过敏药物的备用库存，以备家人居家几天之需。

paras.en: "I have a way to keep my family fed, clean, hydrated, warm and safe," said Cepeda, 39. "You want to have these things and not need them, rather than need them and not have them."
paras.zh: 39 岁的塞佩达说：“我有办法让我的家人吃饱、干净、水分充足、温暖和安全。你想要拥有这些东西却不需要它们，而不是需要它们却没有它们。”

paras.en: The doomsday economy is catching a bid. Wall Street and retailers are taking note.
paras.zh: 世界末日经济正在竞标。华尔街和零售商正在注意到这一点。

paras.en: At least half a dozen major technology outages took place in the U.S. between Nov. 12 and Nov. 17. In that time frame, spending at brands specializing in emergency products spiked about 400% compared with the same period a year prior, according to card data analyzed exclusively for CNBC by Consumer Edge.
paras.zh: 11 月 12 日至 17 日期间，美国至少发生了六起重大技术故障。根据 Consumer Edge 为 CNBC 独家分析的银行卡数据，在此期间，专门从事紧急产品的品牌的支出与去年同期相比飙升了约 400%。

paras.en: At Ready America, which sells products like emergency survival kits, prepackaged water and high-calorie food bars, sales through e-commerce platforms have seen a roughly five-fold increase in recent days. In addition, corporate customers who keep the Vista, California-based company's supplies in their offices in case of emergency have called in to order more.
paras.zh: Ready America 销售紧急求生包、预包装水和高热量食品棒等产品，最近几天通过电子商务平台的销售额增长了大约五倍。此外，将这家总部位于加利福尼亚州维斯塔的公司的物资存放在办公室中以备不时之需的企业客户也已致电订购更多物资。

paras.en: The company has rarely seen this much demand since the Covid pandemic sent Americans into lockdown more than six years ago, said Ready America President Trevyn Reese. As a result, Ready America asked its suppliers to scale up production. The family-owned business has faced a shortage of water purification tablets, and redirected shoppers to alternative offerings like prepackaged water pouches.
paras.zh: Ready America 总裁特雷文·里斯 (Trevyn Reese) 表示，自六年多前新冠疫情导致美国人陷入封锁以来，该公司很少看到如此大的需求。因此，Ready America 要求其供应商扩大生产规模。这家家族企业面临净水片短缺的问题，因此将购物者转向预包装水袋等替代产品。

paras.en: "With everything going on in the news right now, we've seen a large spike of people wanting to get prepared," said Reese.
paras.zh: 里斯说：“随着现在新闻中发生的一切，我们看到大量的人想要做好准备。”

paras.en: While the string of outages brought power-related concerns to a boiling point, data shows that worries had been bubbling under the surface for weeks.
paras.zh: 尽管一连串的停电将与电力相关的担忧推向沸点，但数据显示，担忧情绪已经在表面上酝酿了数周。

paras.en: Shoppers began significantly ramping up buying from emergency preparedness brands late last month, according to Consumer Edge. Around that time, Fox News reported that the Pentagon was preparing U.S. military bases to operate for at least 90 days without external support. Exacerbating those fears was the ongoing war with Iran that President Donald Trump signaled could ramp back up.
paras.zh: 据 Consumer Edge 称，上个月末，消费者开始大幅增加对应急准备品牌的购买量。大约在那个时候，福克斯新闻报道称，五角大楼正在准备美国军事基地在没有外部支持的情况下运行至少 90 天。唐纳德·特朗普总统暗示与伊朗的持续战争可能会加剧，加剧了这些担忧。

paras.en: Firearm trade group NSSF said that gun sales rose about 8% in October from the same month a year prior. Retailers and gun manufacturers have anecdotally reported that demand has remained elevated into November, which NSSF said can be attributed to a combination of uncertainty tied to the midterm election and the recent outages.
paras.zh: 枪支贸易组织 NSSF 表示，10 月份枪支销量较去年同期增长约 8%。零售商和枪支制造商据传称，到 11 月份，需求仍然很高，NSSF 表示，这可能是由于中期选举和最近停电带来的不确定性造成的。

paras.en: "If people are investing in firearms and ammunition, they're telling you very directly, with their wallet, what their priority is," said Mark Oliva, NSSF's managing director of public affairs. "You're literally investing in a product that's going to be able to protect your life and protect the lives of your family."
paras.zh: NSSF 公共事务董事总经理马克·奥利瓦 (Mark Oliva) 表示：“如果人们投资枪支和弹药，他们会用钱包直接告诉你他们的首要任务是什么。” “你实际上是在投资一种能够保护你和家人生命的产品。”

paras.en: Now, the doomsday talk has begun making its way to Wall Street.
paras.zh: 现在，世界末日的言论已经开始蔓延到华尔街。

paras.en: Mizuho told clients on Monday that consumer worries about the outages — coupled with what the bank called "apocalyptic concerns" swirling on social media — drove shoppers to stock up on emergency supplies at Costco. As a result, Mizuho said it expects a key measure of non-fuel sales growth for Costco in November to rise above 10% for the first time since 2022.
paras.zh: 瑞穗银行周一告诉客户，消费者对停电的担忧，加上银行所说的“世界末日担忧”在社交媒体上蔓延，促使购物者在 Costco 囤积应急物资。因此，瑞穗表示，预计 Costco 11 月份非燃料销售增长的关键指标将自 2022 年以来首次升至 10% 以上。

paras.en: And RBC said so-called doomsday prepping has had a "real impact" on buying behavior around the globe over recent weeks. Still, the Canadian bank reported that the trend has so far boosted sales for only a small basket of items, such as shelf-stable proteins, water purification products and dry-pantry foods.
paras.zh: 加拿大皇家银行表示，所谓的末日准备对最近几周全球的购买行为产生了“真正的影响”。尽管如此，加拿大银行报告称，到目前为止，这一趋势仅促进了一小部分商品的销售，例如耐储存的蛋白质、水净化产品和干食品。

paras.en: Clients of Richard McWhorter, a private wealth advisor at SRM, have been rushing to Costco to buy goods in bulk and splurging for power generators. McWhorter said he's also fielded questions about how to prepare for a situation in which the financial system goes down.
paras.zh: SRM 私人财富顾问理查德·麦克沃特 (Richard McWhorter) 的客户纷纷涌入好市多 (Costco) 批量购买商品，并花钱购买发电机。麦克沃特表示，他还回答了如何为金融体系崩溃的情况做好准备的问题。

paras.en: "I've never seen anything like this in my life," McWhorter said. "There's the financial side of what I do, and then there's the psychological side. And the past two weeks have been much more psychological."
paras.zh: “我一生中从未见过这样的事情，”麦克沃特说。 “我所做的事情有财务方面，然后还有心理方面。过去两周更多的是心理方面。”

paras.en: Metal dealer American Hartford Gold reported an uptick in customer inquiries this week. Company president Max Baecker said he heard from some customers that their interest in products like gold — long considered a safe-haven asset during times of turmoil — was driven by newfound concern about being overly reliant on digital financial networks following a glitch at JPMorgan Chase that affected customer transactions for several hours.
paras.zh: 金属经销商美国哈特福德黄金公司报告称，本周客户询价有所增加。该公司总裁马克斯·贝克尔(Max Baecker)表示，他从一些客户那里听说，他们对黄金等产品的兴趣——长期以来被认为是动荡时期的避险资产——是由于摩根大通发生了一个故障，影响了客户交易几个小时后，人们对过度依赖数字金融网络产生了新的担忧。

paras.en: Vice President JD Vance abruptly canceled his appearance at a New York Times summit on Wednesday to attend meetings about the technology outages. A day prior, Jay Clayton, the U.S. director of national intelligence, told CNBC that the recent outages were not a cyberattack or a coordinated effort by a foreign nation.
paras.zh: 副总裁 JD Vance 突然取消了周三出席《纽约时报》峰会的活动，转而参加有关技术中断的会议。一天前，美国国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿 (Jay Clayton) 向 CNBC 表示，最近的中断并非网络攻击或外国的协调行动。

paras.en: Still, Sen. Mark Warner, D-Va., told CNBC on Wednesday that people were "freaked out" by the outages. Warner, who acts as the vice chairman of the Senate Intelligence Committee, said that the U.S. was "lucky" to have not yet seen a major AI-generated cyberattack or crisis due to AI agents going rogue.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，弗吉尼亚州民主党参议员马克·沃纳 (Mark Warner) 周三对 CNBC 表示，人们对停电感到“害怕”。担任参议院情报委员会副主席的华纳表示，美国“幸运”的是，尚未出现人工智能引发的重大网络攻击或因人工智能特工失控而引发的危机。

paras.en: Investors may begin pushing companies to accelerate their cybersecurity spending out of an abundance of caution around rogue AI agents following the outages, according to Macro Hive CEO Bilal Hafeez. Such a situation would be reminiscent of the antivirus software push seen during the dot-com boom, he said.
paras.zh: Macro Hive 首席执行官比拉尔·哈菲兹 (Bilal Hafeez) 表示，出于对网络中断后流氓人工智能代理的高度警惕，投资者可能会开始推动公司加快网络安全支出。他说，这种情况让人想起互联网繁荣时期的防病毒软件推广。

paras.en: The Global X Cybersecurity ETF (BUG) has climbed around 3% over the past two weeks, bucking the downtrend seen among AI stocks and the broader technology trade. The Nasdaq Composite on Friday fell into negative territory for 2026, putting the tech-heavy index on track for its first losing year since 2022.
paras.zh: 过去两周，Global X Cyber​​security ETF (BUG) 上涨了约 3%，逆势而上，人工智能股票和更广泛的科技行业出现下跌趋势。纳斯达克综合指数周五跌入 2026 年负值区域，这使得该以科技股为主的指数有望迎来自 2022 年以来的首次下跌。

paras.en: To be sure, not everyone on social media has bought into the idea that they should be prepping for a doomsday scenario. In satirical videos posted on TikTok, users joked that they were gearing up by placing orders in the Starbucks drive-thru or purchasing significant quantities of alcohol.
paras.zh: 可以肯定的是，并不是社交媒体上的每个人都相信他们应该为世界末日场景做好准备。在 TikTok 上发布的讽刺视频中，用户开玩笑说，他们正在通过在星巴克得来速下订单或购买大量酒类来做好准备。

paras.en: Still, the topic appears to be on the minds of a growing number of Americans. U.S. Google searches for the term "prepping" have more than doubled when comparing the past month with the same period a year prior. On YouTube, queries for videos about "survivalism," a term describing the practice of preparing for emergencies, have soared by more than 5,000% over the same time frame.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这个话题似乎仍在越来越多的美国人的脑海中浮现。与去年同期相比，美国谷歌对“准备”一词的搜索量上个月增加了一倍多。在 YouTube 上，有关“生存主义”（描述应对紧急情况的做法的术语）视频的查询量在同一时间段内飙升了 5,000% 以上。

paras.en: Cepeda, the Houston mom, sees emergency prep efforts as a way to be safe rather than sorry. She's previously tapped into backup food stashes during extreme weather events like Hurricane Harvey in 2017 and Winter Storm Uri in 2021.
paras.zh: 休斯顿的妈妈塞佩达认为，紧急准备工作是一种安全的方式，而不是后悔的方式。她之前曾在 2017 年飓风哈维和 2021 年冬季风暴乌里等极端天气事件期间动用过备用食物储备。

paras.en: But this year is the first time that she's felt she needed to be prepared for a potential emergency caused by technology outages, she said. Cepeda and her husband have ensured they have enough cash on hand and fuel in their cars if there's a broader hit to the U.S. power grid, she said.
paras.zh: 但她说，今年是她第一次觉得自己需要为技术中断引起的潜在紧急情况做好准备。她说，塞佩达和她的丈夫已经确保，如果美国电网受到更广泛的打击，他们手头有足够的现金，车里有足够的燃料。

paras.en: "We rely so much on technology," Cepeda said. "You need to be able to do these things the more traditional, old-fashioned way."
paras.zh: “我们非常依赖技术，”塞佩达说。 “你需要能够以更传统、更老式的方式来做这些事情。”

articles.title: Mexico captures top drug lord 'El Chapo Isidro,' latest in string of arrests

paras.en: Mexican military forces captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as "El Chapo Isidro," one of the FBI's 10 most wanted fugitives, and two other leaders of his drug-trafficking organization in Sinaloa state on Friday night, Mexico's security chief said on Saturday.
paras.zh: 墨西哥安全负责人周六表示，周五晚上，墨西哥军队在锡那罗亚州抓获了被称为“矮子伊西德罗”的联邦调查局十大通缉犯之一福斯托·伊西德罗·梅萨·弗洛雷斯及其贩毒组织的另外两名领导人。

paras.en: For over 20 years, according to the U.S. State Department, Meza Flores and his criminal organization smuggled vast amounts of heroin, methamphetamine, cocaine and marijuana into the U.S.
paras.zh: 据美国国务院称，20多年来，梅萨·弗洛雷斯及其犯罪组织向美国走私大量海洛因、冰毒、可卡因和大麻。

paras.en: He was considered one of the leaders of the Beltran Leyva cartel, previously a rival of the Sinaloa cartel. After Sinaloa cartel founder Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada was taken into U.S. custody in 2024, infighting began between two factions for control of the cartel, Los Chapitos and Los Mayos. Meza Flores' Beltran Leyva had recently allied with the Los Mayos faction, security experts say.
paras.zh: 他被认为是贝尔特兰·莱瓦贩毒集团的领导人之一，该贩毒集团以前是锡那罗亚贩毒集团的竞争对手。 2024 年，锡那罗亚贩毒集团创始人伊斯梅尔·“埃尔·梅奥”·赞巴达 (Ismael“El Mayo”Zambada) 被美国拘留后，洛斯查皮托斯 (Los Chapitos) 和洛斯梅约斯 (Los Mayos) 两个派系之间为了争夺该贩毒集团的控制权而发生内讧。安全专家称，梅萨·弗洛雷斯的贝尔特兰·莱瓦最近与洛斯·梅约斯派系结盟。

paras.en: The arrest is the latest in a string of captures and killings of high-profile suspected drug traffickers by Mexico, which is under pressure from U.S. President Donald Trump. He has threatened unilateral military action inside Mexico if the government does not do more against the cartels.
paras.zh: 这次逮捕是墨西哥在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的压力下抓捕和杀害知名毒贩的一系列行动中的最新一起。他威胁说，如果政府不对贩毒集团采取更多行动，他将在墨西哥境内采取单方面军事行动。

paras.en: Overnight on Friday, the military operation sparked a wave of violence in the state of Sinaloa, including armed clashes between Mexican security forces and cartel members, who set up flaming roadblocks in some areas.
paras.zh: 周五晚间，军事行动在锡那罗亚州引发了一波暴力事件，其中包括墨西哥安全部队与卡特尔成员之间的武装冲突，卡特尔成员在一些地区设置了燃烧的路障。

paras.en: Social media videos from Guasave, Sinaloa, where Meza Flores was captured on Friday night, showed Mexican security force helicopters firing at ground targets, residents scrambling to seek cover at a baseball game and others hiding for safety by a night market.
paras.zh: 周五晚上，梅萨·弗洛雷斯在锡那罗亚州瓜萨维被抓获，社交媒体视频显示，墨西哥安全部队直升机向地面目标开火，居民在一场棒球比赛中争先恐后地寻找掩护，其他人则躲在夜市旁寻求安全。

paras.en: Special forces from Mexico's army and National Guard carried out the capture in coordination with US and Mexican intelligence agencies, Mexico's Defense Ministry said in a post on X. The post said cartel members had set up roadblocks in nearby municipalities, but that security forces were deployed alongside local authorities to clear them.
paras.zh: 墨西哥国防部在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示，墨西哥军队和国民警卫队的特种部队与美国和墨西哥情报机构协调实施了抓捕行动。该帖子称，卡特尔成员在附近城市设置了路障，但安全部队与地方当局一起部署以清除路障。

paras.en: "The exchange of strategic intelligence between the United States and Mexico helped make this operation possible," U.S. Ambassador to Mexico Ronald Johnson wrote in a post on X, applauding Mexican security forces. "Results like these are not achieved overnight. They are the product of sustained cooperation and trust. This is what we can accomplish when we work together. We will continue pursuing criminals."
paras.zh: 美国驻墨西哥大使罗纳德·约翰逊在 X 上的一篇帖子中写道：“美国和墨西哥之间的战略情报交流使这次行动成为可能。”他对墨西哥安全部队表示赞赏。 “这样的结果不是一朝一夕就能取得的。它们是持续合作和信任的产物。这是我们共同努力才能实现的目标。我们将继续追捕罪犯。”

paras.en: Several U.S. agencies applauded the operation. Homeland Security Investigations said on X that the operation was "a MAJOR blow to one of Mexico's most powerful cartel networks." U.S. Northern Command congratulated Mexican forces, saying that its counter-cartel task force had worked with other U.S. interagency partners on information that led to the capture.
paras.zh: 一些美国机构对此次行动表示赞赏。国土安全调查局 X 表示，此次行动“对墨西哥最强大的卡特尔网络之一构成重大打击”。美国北方司令部向墨西哥军队表示祝贺，称其反卡特尔特遣部队与其他美国跨部门合作伙伴就导致抓获的信息进行了合作。

paras.en: Four Mexican Army infantry soldiers died in the operation, the Defense Ministry said in a statement posted on X that extended the institution's condolences to the families.
paras.zh: 墨西哥国防部在 X 上发布的一份声明中表示，四名墨西哥陆军步兵在此次行动中丧生，并向遇难者家属表示哀悼。

paras.en: The statement added that security forces killed seven attackers and arrested eight alleged criminals in the operation, including three transferred to Mexico City and five who were turned over to the Attorney General's Office in Culiacan, Sinaloa.
paras.zh: 声明还说，安全部队在行动中击毙了七名袭击者，并逮捕了八名涉嫌犯罪分子，其中三人被转移到墨西哥城，五人被移交给锡那罗亚州库利亚坎总检察长办公室。

paras.en: Meza Flores and his cousin, who was the second-in-command within the Beltran Leyva criminal organization, were taken to Mexico City at 5:20 a.m. (1120 GMT) and handed over to the Specialized Prosecutor's Office for Organized Crime. Also arrested and handed over was Meza Flores' brother-in-law, who was his financial operator.
paras.zh: 梅萨·弗洛雷斯 (Meza Flores) 和他的表弟（贝尔特兰·莱瓦犯罪组织的二号人物）于凌晨 5 点 20 分（格林尼治标准时间 1120）被带到墨西哥城，并移交给有组织犯罪特别检察官办公室。梅萨·弗洛雷斯的妹夫、金融操作员也被逮捕并移交。

paras.en: Security minister Omar Garcia Harfuch also extended his condolences to the families of the killed soldiers in a post on X and added that authorities seized, among other weapons, a .50-caliber rifle, a grenade launcher and two hand grenades in the operation.
paras.zh: 安全部长奥马尔·加西亚·哈富赫也在 X 上发帖向阵亡士兵家属表示哀悼，并补充说，当局在行动中缴获了一支 0.50 口径步枪、一个榴弹发射器和两枚手榴弹等武器。

paras.en: While Friday night social media posts showed scenes of roadblocks, cars being burned and a local reporter being forced to scramble for cover amid a gunfight, by Saturday the violence had substantially subsided.
paras.zh: 虽然周五晚上社交媒体上的帖子显示了路障、汽车被烧毁以及当地记者被迫在枪战中寻找掩护的场景，但到周六暴力事件已经大幅平息。

paras.en: Sinaloa state authorities said, "The situation is under control and being addressed by all levels of government." They added that they were monitoring highways and urban and rural areas of Guasave. Activities were focused on restoring mobility, and residents could resume normal activities, they said.
paras.zh: 锡那罗亚州当局表示，“局势已得到控制，各级政府正在处理中。”他们补充说，他们正在监控瓜萨韦的高速公路以及城乡地区。他们说，活动的重点是恢复行动能力，居民可以恢复正常活动。

paras.en: According to a local security official, a nervous atmosphere gripped the city as residents had been sheltering in place since Friday night. Businesses remained closed and streets were deserted, but there were no current bouts of generalized violence, the official said.
paras.zh: 据当地安全官员称，自周五晚上以来，居民们一直在原地避难，紧张的气氛笼罩着这座城市。这位官员表示，企业仍然关闭，街道空无一人，但目前没有发生普遍的暴力事件。

articles.title: Quantum computing’s first real-world payoff may come in energy, not drug discovery

paras.en: For years, the case for quantum computing has rested on ambitious promises, from discovering new drugs by simulating how molecules behave to optimizing supply chains and airline schedules. Many of the biggest aims are still likely to be years, if not decades, away.
paras.zh: 多年来，量子计算一直基于雄心勃勃的承诺，从通过模拟分子行为发现新药到优化供应链和航班时刻表。许多最大的目标仍然可能需要数年甚至数十年的时间才能实现。

paras.en: But quantum software, which uses algorithms designed to solve complex problems faster than conventional computers, is already being tested on a more immediate challenge: the energy transition, from keeping power grids stable to finding better materials for solar cells and hydrogen production.
paras.zh: 但量子软件使用的算法比传统计算机更快地解决复杂问题，它已经在接受更紧迫的挑战的测试：能源转型，从保持电网稳定到寻找更好的太阳能电池和氢气生产材料。

paras.en: Phasecraft, a quantum software company founded in Bristol, England, in 2019, is one of the firms putting the technology to work in energy. It raised $34 million in Series B funding in 2025, and in September this year announced plans to set up U.S. headquarters in Arlington, Virginia.
paras.zh: Phasecraft 是一家量子软件公司，于 2019 年在英国布里斯托尔成立，是将该技术应用于能源领域的公司之一。该公司于 2025 年筹集了 3400 万美元的 B 轮融资，并于今年 9 月宣布计划在弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿设立美国总部。

paras.en: There are enormous opportunities to solve problems that are both important for energy security and commercially valuable, Ashley Montanaro, co-founder and CEO of Phasecraft, told CNBC.
paras.zh: Phasecraft 联合创始人兼首席执行官阿什利·蒙塔纳罗 (Ashley Montanaro) 向 CNBC 表示，解决对能源安全既重要又具有商业价值的问题有巨大的机会。

paras.en: Phasecraft isn't alone in applying quantum software to the energy industry.
paras.zh: Phasecraft 并不是唯一一家将量子软件应用于能源行业的公司。

paras.en: Quantinuum, which was formed by the merger of Cambridge Quantum and Honeywell Quantum Solutions and listed on Nasdaq in June, is using the technology to model materials for hydrogen fuel cells for transportation. It is also working with partners on materials for carbon capture.
paras.zh: Quantinuum 由 Cambridge Quantum 和 Honeywell Quantum Solutions 合并而成，并于 6 月在纳斯达克上市，该公司正在利用该技术对运输用氢燃料电池的材料进行建模。它还与合作伙伴合作开发碳捕获材料。

paras.en: Another U.K. player, ORCA Computing, a spinout from the University of Oxford, has partnered with BP to better understand how a molecule's physical, chemical and biological properties are governed. That could help explain how biofuels burn and how to make them burn more efficiently
paras.zh: 另一家英国公司 ORCA Computering（牛津大学的衍生公司）已与 BP 合作，以更好地了解分子的物理、化学和生物特性是如何受到控制的。这可能有助于解释生物燃料如何燃烧以及如何使它们更有效地燃烧

paras.en: In a separate project, ORCA worked with Japanese software company JIJ on a challenge power companies face: deciding which generators to switch on or off, and when, to meet demand at the lowest cost.
paras.zh: 在一个单独的项目中，ORCA 与日本软件公司 JIJ 合作解决电力公司面临的挑战：决定何时打开或关闭哪些发电机，以最低的成本满足需求。

paras.en: That project also involved BP and the National Quantum Computing Centre (NQCC), the U.K.'s national laboratory for quantum computing, which is part of the government-backed U.K. Research and Innovation. The involvement of the NQCC, like that of ARPA-E, suggests governments are paying close attention to quantum software's potential role in energy, as are companies such as BP.
paras.zh: 该项目还涉及英国石油公司和国家量子计算中心（NQCC），该中心是英国的量子计算国家实验室，是政府支持的英国研究与创新的一部分。与 ARPA-E 一样，NQCC 的参与表明各国政府正在密切关注量子软件在能源领域的潜在作用，英国石油公司 (BP) 等公司也是如此。

paras.en: For Phasecraft, a priority is grid stability and optimization. It has partnered with the National Energy System Operator (NESO), the independent system planner that balances energy supply and demand in England, Scotland and Wales, on grid optimization tasks, including managing power exchanges and isolating network sections during emergencies. The company says its software can complete these tasks up to 1,000 times faster than conventional computing.
paras.zh: 对于 Phasecraft 来说，首要任务是电网稳定性和优化。它与国家能源系统运营商（NESO）合作，后者是平衡英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士能源供需的独立系统规划者，负责电网优化任务，包括管理电力交换和在紧急情况下隔离网络部分。该公司表示，其软件完成这些任务的速度比传统计算快 1000 倍。

paras.en: Phasecraft believes its grid software could be particularly sought after in Asia, where electrification is rapidly expanding, increasing the need for grid resilience to balance high and growing demand with the intermittent supply offered by renewables.
paras.zh: Phasecraft 认为，其电网软件在亚洲可能特别受欢迎，因为亚洲电气化正在迅速扩张，这增加了对电网弹性的需求，以平衡不断增长的高需求与可再生能源提供的间歇性供应。

paras.en: The company is also working with U.K. solar cell maker Oxford PV on the development of new materials for photovoltaic cells capable of operating more efficiently than existing ones.
paras.zh: 该公司还与英国太阳能电池制造商 Oxford PV 合作开发光伏电池新材料，该材料能够比现有光伏电池更高效地运行。

paras.en: Separately, it has teamed up with London-listed specialty materials developer Johnson Matthey, Harvard University and Boston-based quantum hardware specialist QuEra, in work overseen by the U.S. government's Advanced Research Projects Agency–Energy (ARPA-E), to discover novel catalysts that would reduce reliance on scarce metals like iridium — which is currently critical in the production of hydrogen.
paras.zh: 另外，它还与伦敦上市的特种材料开发商庄信万丰(Johnson Matthey)、哈佛大学和波士顿量子硬件专家QuEra合作，在美国政府能源高级研究计划局(ARPA-E)的监督下开展工作，发现新型催化剂，以减少对铱等稀有金属的依赖——铱目前在氢生产中至关重要。

paras.en: Asked why Phasecraft is focusing on energy rather than sectors that might seem more lucrative, Montanaro said the returns were there too.
paras.zh: 当被问及为什么 Phasecraft 专注于能源而不是看起来更有利可图的行业时，蒙塔纳罗表示回报也在那里。

paras.en: "When you get this right, the commercial returns are real: more efficient energy networks mean lower operating costs and more value from existing infrastructure," he said.
paras.zh: “当你做到这一点时，商业回报是真实的：更高效的能源网络意味着更低的运营成本和现有基础设施的更多价值，”他说。

articles.title: The U.S. Army is about to blow up a cache of dangerous lead azide in Iowa—here’s what to know

paras.en: Editor’s Note (11/20/26): On Thursday evening Acting Secretary of the Army Adam Telle said the detonation would be postponed until next Monday in a post on X. Telle said the delay would put the detonation off “until the latest possible moment” before a forecasted temperature drop that would make the lead azide even more unstable.
paras.zh: 编者按（26 年 11 月 20 日）：周四晚上，代理陆军部长 Adam Telle 在 X 上发帖表示，爆炸将推迟到下周一。Telle 表示，推迟爆炸将推迟到“直到最晚可能的时刻”，然后预计温度会下降，从而使叠氮化铅变得更加不稳定。

paras.en: The U.S. Army’s plan to blow up 68 drums’ worth of a toxic compound could cause significant health problems for the local community, experts warn.
paras.zh: 专家警告称，美国陆军计划炸毁 68 桶有毒化合物，可能会给当地社区带来严重的健康问题。

paras.en: Next Monday the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant will detonate 68 drums of lead azide, which is used in the manufacture of detonators, blasting caps and other components of explosives. As the chemical ages and degrades, it can form unstable crystals that can spontaneously explode at room temperature. The planned detonation is to prevent that from happening and must be done on-site because of the potential dangers of trying to transport it.
paras.zh: 下周一，爱荷华州陆军弹药厂将引爆 68 桶叠氮化铅，这些叠氮化铅用于制造雷管、雷管和炸药的其他部件。随着化学物质的老化和降解，它会形成不稳定的晶体，在室温下会自发爆炸。计划中的爆炸是为了防止这种情况发生，并且必须在现场进行，因为试图运输它存在潜在的危险。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The explosion will likely lead to large amounts of particulate matter in the air. While sodium azide, one of the two necessary components used to synthesize lead azide, poses no danger, according to the National Institutes of Health, lead is a highly dangerous substance.
paras.zh: 爆炸可能会导致空气中产生大量颗粒物。据美国国立卫生研究院称，虽然叠氮化钠是合成叠氮化铅的两种必要成分之一，不会造成任何危险，但铅是一种高度危险的物质。

paras.en: The greatest risk is to children, but it’s not limited to them, warns Ellen Wells, a public health professor at Purdue University.
paras.zh: 普渡大学公共卫生教授埃伦·威尔斯警告说，最大的风险是儿童，但不仅限于儿童。

paras.en: “The literature shows that they can have lifetime impacts from exposure at a young age,” she says. “Even at very low levels, it has shown that lead can influence neurological health, and that means [lower] IQ in children or cognitive development in children.”
paras.zh: “文献表明，年轻时接触这些物质可能会对一生产生影响，”她说。 “即使水平非常低，研究表明铅也会影响神经系统健康，这意味着儿童的智商或认知发展会降低。”

paras.en: “But it can also influence cardiovascular health,” she says, including in adults. “There’s been a lot of studies in adults that even low levels of lead in adults can contribute, population-wise, to increased cardiovascular mortality.”
paras.zh: “但它也会影响心血管健康，”她说，包括成年人。 “对成年人进行的大量研究表明，即使成年人体内的铅含量较低，也会导致人口心血管死亡率增加。”

paras.en: Lead is considered a probable carcinogen by the Environmental Protection Agency, although the International Agency for Research on Cancer has found insufficient evidence as to whether lead exposure causes cancer.
paras.zh: 尽管国际癌症研究机构没有发现足够的证据证明铅暴露是否会导致癌症，但环境保护署仍将铅视为可能的致癌物。

paras.en: Local authorities have warned residents of the impending explosion. In a Facebook post on November 16, the city of Middletown, Iowa, acknowledged that the detonation will lead to lead-containing particles in the air. It warned residents in affected areas to stay inside with windows and doors closed on the day of the explosion and to have heating and cooling systems set to recirculate to avoid having outdoor air enter their homes. The post also asked residents to clean indoor and outdoor surfaces after the exposure period has ended.
paras.zh: 地方当局已警告居民即将发生爆炸。爱荷华州米德尔敦市在 11 月 16 日的 Facebook 帖子中承认，爆炸将导致空气中产生含铅颗粒。它警告受影响地区的居民在爆炸当天留在室内并关闭门窗，并设置供暖和制冷系统再循环，以避免室外空气进入家中。该帖子还要求居民在暴露期结束后清洁室内外表面。

paras.en: “If individuals take some actions to prevent lead from getting into their house, that can probably prevent longer-term exposure,” Wells says.
paras.zh: “如果个人采取一些行动来防止铅进入他们的房子，这可能可以防止长期接触，”威尔斯说。

paras.en: But even if residents follow all safety procedures, Wells says the danger could remain because of lead settling into the soil, where it can stay for decades.
paras.zh: 但威尔斯表示，即使居民遵守所有安全程序，危险也可能仍然存在，因为铅会沉淀到土壤中，并可以在土壤中停留数十年。

paras.en: “If people are walking around in the soil or using the soil, then they have a chance to get exposed to it again,” she says. “I would recommend trying to get your soil tested. Or, especially if you have children, try to get their blood lead tested, maybe even a few times after. Blood lead is reflective of exposures over the past 30 days or so, and blood lead tests are generally free, especially for younger children.”
paras.zh: “如果人们在土壤中行走或使用土壤，那么他们就有机会再次接触土壤，”她说。 “我建议尝试测试土壤。或者，特别是如果你有孩子，尝试测试他们的血铅，甚至可能是几次。血铅反映了过去 30 天左右的暴露情况，血铅测试通常是免费的，特别是对于年幼的孩子。”

paras.en: The Environmental Protection Agency issued an emergency permit for the detonation to the Army. In it, the EPA has tasked the Army with performing daily environmental monitoring measures to detect any residue in the area and with conducting a cleanup operation of any high-touch surfaces where lead is detected, such as parks and public facilities.
paras.zh: 环境保护局向陆军颁发了爆炸紧急许可证。其中，美国环保署责成陆军执行日常环境监测措施，以检测该地区的任何残留物，并对检测到铅的任何高接触表面（例如公园和公共设施）进行清理操作。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the Army did not respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 陆军发言人没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: That cleanup doesn’t necessarily have to be complicated, Wells says.
paras.zh: 威尔斯说，清理工作不一定很复杂。

paras.en: “With really, really highly contaminated sites, the procedure has been to remove the soil and replace it,” she says. “However, there has been some research showing that even if you put one inch of topsoil on top of soil that has been contaminated with lead, that can sort of trap the lead in the soil, so you reduce the immediate exposures.”
paras.zh: “对于污染非常非常严重的地点，程序就是去除土壤并更换它，”她说。 “然而，有一些研究表明，即使你在被铅污染的土壤上放置一英寸的表土，也会将铅困在土壤中，从而减少直接接触。”

articles.title: Two probes are about to arrive at Mercury for an up-close look at this puzzling planet

paras.en: After eight years of a winding journey across the inner Solar System, a new spacecraft is about to arrive at Mercury—or rather, two spacecraft, one from Europe and one from Japan, that have traveled together for eight years over some six billion miles (10 billion kilometers). They will be our first visitors to Mercury in more than a decade as they pursue a mission to scour this strange world in greater detail than ever before. What they discover could help enable something unprecedented: a first-ever lander on Mercury.
paras.zh: 经过八年蜿蜒穿越内太阳系的旅程后，一艘新的航天器即将抵达水星——或者更确切地说，两艘航天器，一艘来自欧洲，一艘来自日本，已经一起旅行了八年，超过了大约六十亿英里（一百亿公里）。他们将是我们十多年来首次造访水星，他们的使命是比以往任何时候都更详细地探索这个陌生的世界。他们的发现可能有助于实现前所未有的事情：水星上的第一个着陆器。

paras.en: The mission, called BepiColombo, is due to enter into orbit around Mercury on November 21 after an almighty trek. The two spacecraft launched entwined from Earth in October 2018 and have since completed nine planetary flybys—one of Earth, two of Venus and six of Mercury—to gradually slow their precession enough to be captured by Mercury’s orbit.
paras.zh: 这项名为 BepiColombo 的任务将于 11 月 21 日经过一次艰难的跋涉后进入水星周围的轨道。这两艘航天器于 2018 年 10 月从地球上缠绕发射，此后已完成九次行星飞越——一次飞越地球，两次飞越金星，六次飞越水星——逐渐减慢其进动速度，足以被水星轨道捕获。

paras.en: The last spacecraft to visit Mercury, and the only prior spacecraft to orbit it, was NASA’s MESSENGER mission, which circled the planet from 2011 to 2015. The only other spacecraft to venture there, one of the most difficult places to reach in the solar system, given its proximity to the sun, was NASA’s Mariner 10, which flew by Mercury three times in 1974 and 1975.
paras.zh: 最后一艘访问水星的航天器，也是之前唯一一艘环绕水星运行的航天器，是美国宇航局的信使号任务，该任务于 2011 年至 2015 年绕行水星。唯一一艘前往水星的航天器是美国宇航局的水手 10 号航天器，该航天器是太阳系中最难到达的地方之一，因为它靠近太阳，它在 1974 年和 1975 年三次飞越水星。

paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “For a long time, people didn’t think it was possible to get to Mercury orbit,” says Shoshana Weider, Mercury science lead at NASA Headquarters in Washington, D.C. BepiColombo is named for the man who worked out how to do it, Italian mathematician and engineer Giuseppe (Bepi) Colombo, who died in 1984.
paras.zh: “很长一段时间以来，人们认为不可能进入水星轨道，”美国宇航局华盛顿总部水星科学负责人 Shoshana Weider 说道。 BepiColombo 是以研究如何实现水星轨道的意大利数学家兼工程师朱塞佩·科伦坡 (Giuseppe (Bepi) Colombo) 的名字命名的，他于 1984 年去世。

paras.en: The reasons for going are plentiful. Mercury is bizarre, at times more like an exoplanet than a true planet of our sun. It has a bafflingly large iron-rich core that extends about 85 percent of the way from the planet’s center to its surface; in contrast, Earth’s core extends just 55 percent of the way to our world’s surface. Mercury has an extreme surface that’s alternately bathed in solar radiation and then plunged into darkness, experiencing temperature swings of about 800 degrees Fahrenheit in daylight to –290 degrees F at night, as well as wisps of an atmosphere, called an exosphere, that scientists are eager to study.
paras.zh: 去的理由有很多。水星很奇怪，有时更像是一颗系外行星，而不是真正的太阳行星。它有一个大得令人费解的富含铁的核心，从行星中心延伸到其表面约 85% 的距离；相比之下，地核仅延伸到地球表面的 55%。水星有一个极端的表面，交替地沐浴在太阳辐射下，然后陷入黑暗，经历白天约 800 华氏度到夜间零下 290 华氏度的温度波动，以及科学家们渴望研究的一缕被称为外逸层的大气层。

paras.en: Bizarrely, it also seems to have ice trapped in craters at its poles, something that should be impossible so close to the sun; Mercury circles our star at some 36 million miles away, about three times closer than Earth does. “The leading theory is that material came from either a volatile asteroid or comet impact,” says Carolyn Ernst, a planetary scientist at the Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory in Maryland. “That ties back to how Earth got its water.”
paras.zh: 奇怪的是，它的两极似乎也有冰被困在陨石坑中，这在离太阳这么近的地方是不可能发生的；水星在距我们约 3600 万英里的地方绕着我们的恒星运行，大约比地球近三倍。马里兰州约翰·霍普金斯大学应用物理实验室的行星科学家卡罗琳·恩斯特说：“主要理论是，物质来自不稳定的小行星或彗星撞击。” “这与地球如何获取水有关。”

paras.en: BepiColombo’s orbital insertion was relatively straightforward, a weak capture as the spacecraft edged toward the planet, although it was delayed by a year because of a thruster malfunction. The true drama, though, should come on December 9. That’s when, following a series of thruster burns that will lower and stabilize the spacecraft around Mercury, the two mission components—the Mercury Planetary Orbiter (MPO) from the European Space Agency (ESA) and the Mercury Magnetospheric Orbiter (Mio) from the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA)—will separate and say goodbye.
paras.zh: 贝皮科伦坡号的轨道插入相对简单，在航天器逐渐接近行星时进行了微弱的捕获，尽管由于推进器故障而推迟了一年。然而，真正的戏剧性事件应该在 12 月 9 日上演。到那时，在一系列推进器燃烧将降低并稳定水星周围的航天器之后，两个任务组件——欧洲航天局 (ESA) 的水星行星轨道飞行器 (MPO) 和日本宇宙航空研究开发机构 (JAXA) 的水星磁层轨道飞行器 (Mio)——将分离并告别。

paras.en: The separation will be one of the most tense and difficult moments in space exploration history. These twin spacecraft, orbiting another world, will pry themselves apart to enter different orbits around Mercury. Latches will unclasp, wires connecting the two spacecraft will be cut, and a spring will push them apart slower than walking speed. “It’s the most complex mission I have worked on by far,” says Ignacio Tanco, head of inner solar system mission operations at ESA, “and probably the most complex mission that ESA has operated ever. It’s extremely challenging.”
paras.zh: 这次分离将是太空探索史上最紧张、最困难的时刻之一。这些绕着另一个世界运行的双胞胎航天器将把自己撬开，进入围绕水星的不同轨道。闩锁将松开，连接两个航天器的电线将被切断，弹簧将以低于步行速度的速度将它们推开。欧空局内太阳系任务运营负责人伊格纳西奥·坦科（Ignacio Tanco）表示：“这是迄今为止我参与过的最复杂的任务，也可能是欧空局有史以来执行过的最复杂的任务。这极具挑战性。”

paras.en: Presuming everything goes to plan, Mio will enter an orbit of some nine hours around Mercury, and MPO will move slightly closer to a two-hour orbit over three months. Both spacecraft will loop over the Mercury’s poles, enabling them to see most of the planet, which is two fifths the size of Earth in total, as it rotates underneath.
paras.zh: 假设一切按计划进行，Mio 将进入绕水星约九小时的轨道，而 MPO 将在三个月内稍微接近两小时的轨道。两艘航天器都将绕行水星两极，使它们能够看到水星在水星下方旋转时的大部分区域，水星的总大小有地球的五分之二。

paras.en: Although MESSENGER saw the majority of the surface during its mission, BepiColombo will give us renewed views across the planet (including any new craters that have formed in the past decade) and precise measurements of that surface, particularly of the south pole, which was not seen in detail by its predecessor. Europe’s MPO has a camera to take high-resolution images. “It will tell us whether what we saw in the north is also found in the south,” including by looking for signs of ice in the shadowed craters, says Sean Solomon of Columbia University, former lead for MESSENGER.
paras.zh: 尽管信使号在其任务期间看到了大部分表面，但贝皮科伦坡号将为我们提供整个地球的新视野（包括过去十年中形成的任何新陨石坑）以及该表面的精确测量，特别是南极，这是它的前身没有详细看到的。欧洲的 MPO 拥有可以拍摄高分辨率图像的相机。信使号前负责人、哥伦比亚大学的肖恩·所罗门 (Sean Solomon) 表示，“它将告诉我们，我们在北方看到的东西是否也在南方发现了”，包括在阴影陨石坑中寻找冰的迹象。

paras.en: Mercury has a range of mysteries that MPO and Mio will investigate. It has signs of past volcanism on its surface stretching back billions of years, which might be linked to strange holes known as hollows, where parts of the surface of Mercury have collapsed. “We don’t understand what’s causing the volcanism,” says David Rothery, a planetary geoscientist at the Open University in England, who works on two of MPO’s instruments.
paras.zh: 水星存在一系列谜团，MPO 和 Mio 将对此进行调查。它的表面有数十亿年前火山活动的迹象，这可能与被称为空洞的奇怪洞有关，水星表面的部分区域已经塌陷。 “我们不明白是什么导致了火山活动，”英国开放大学的行星地球科学家 David Rothery 说道，他负责 MPO 的两台仪器。

paras.en: The planet also appears to be shrinking ever so slightly as the planet cools, forming vast escarpments, “a couple of kilometers high,” where chunks of its surface have been scraped over one another, Rothery says. “And some of these thrust faults are still moving, so Mercury’s tectonics haven’t finished.”
paras.zh: 罗瑟里说，随着行星冷却，这颗行星似乎也在轻微收缩，形成巨大的悬崖，“几公里高”，其表面的大块区域相互刮擦。 “其中一些逆冲断层仍在移动，因此水星的构造尚未结束。”

paras.en: Having two spacecraft in orbit around Mercury enables some novel science. Both MPO and Mio will measure Mercury’s magnetic field simultaneously; Mercury is the only rocky planet in our solar system, besides Earth, that generates a global magnetic field from its core, albeit one about 100 times weaker than our own. Measuring it in two locations at once will show us how it responds to the charged particles from the sun—the solar wind—and perhaps tell us more about how it arises under Mercury’s surface.
paras.zh: 在水星轨道上有两艘航天器可以实现一些新颖的科学。 MPO 和 Mio 将同时测量水星的磁场；水星是太阳系中除地球之外唯一一颗能够从其核心产生全球磁场的岩石行星，尽管其磁场比我们的磁场弱约 100 倍。同时在两个地点对其进行测量将向我们展示它如何响应来自太阳的带电粒子（太阳风），或许还能告诉我们更多关于它是如何在水星表面下产生的信息。

paras.en: Another tool on MPO called Strofio will measure the thin atmosphere around Mercury, called an exosphere, “which is basically little particles that follow a ballistic trajectory off the surface and then fall back down,” says Weider, who is program scientist for the NASA-funded instrument. It will capture some of these particles and reveal how they are kicked up into space.
paras.zh: MPO 上的另一个名为 Strofio 的工具将测量水星周围的稀薄大气层，称为外逸层，“它基本上是沿着弹道轨迹离开表面然后落回的小粒子，”美国宇航局资助的仪器的项目科学家韦德说。它将捕获其中一些粒子并揭示它们是如何被踢入太空的。

paras.en: The two spacecraft will begin science operations in April 2027 and should spend at least a couple of years studying Mercury before their orbits decay and they crash into the planet. Following this mission, scientists are hopeful that our next foray to Mercury will be a trip to its surface, once we have learned everything we can from space, similar to how our exploration of Mars has progressed. “After BepiColombo, we will have done all of the things that we can think of today from orbit,” Solomon says. “If we want to learn more about Mercury, we have to go to the surface.”
paras.zh: 这两艘航天器将于 2027 年 4 月开始科学运行，在轨道衰变并撞向水星之前，应该至少花几年时间研究水星。在这次任务之后，一旦我们从太空中了解到了一切，就像我们对火星的探索所取得的进展一样，科学家们希望我们对水星的下一次尝试将是一次前往水星表面的旅行。 “在贝皮科伦坡之后，我们将在轨道上完成今天能想到的所有事情，”所罗门说。 “如果我们想更多地了解水星，我们就必须到水星表面去。”

paras.en: Such an undertaking would be immensely challenging, given that Mercury—which is roughly the size of Mars and has similar gravity—has no atmosphere to slow the descent of a spacecraft. Yet there are proposals on the table, including one from Ernst and her colleagues that was drawn up in 2020. “It is not impossible,” she says. BepiColombo, too, once had a lander earmarked for the mission, but it was scrapped for cost and complexity reasons. If a subsequent lander could include a means of launching back to Earth from the surface, we could get our hands on material from Mercury for the first time ever.
paras.zh: 鉴于水星的大小与火星大致相同且具有相似的重力，因此这样的任务将具有巨大的挑战性，因为它没有大气层来减缓航天器的下降速度。然而，已经有一些提案摆在桌面上，其中包括恩斯特和她的同事在 2020 年起草的一项提案。“这并非不可能，”她说。贝皮科伦坡也曾经有一个专门用于该任务的着陆器，但由于成本和复杂性原因被废弃。如果后续的着陆器可以包括从表面发射回地球的方法，我们就可以有史以来第一次从水星获得材料。

paras.en: For now, it is BepiColombo’s turn, which should give us a nearly complete picture of this unusual world. “Mercury is a strange little oddball,” Weider says. It doesn’t fit with the rest of the solar system. Maybe, in the next few years, we’ll finally find out why.
paras.zh: 现在轮到 BepiColombo 了，它应该能让我们对这个不寻常的世界有一个近乎完整的了解。 “水星是一个奇怪的小怪，”韦德说。它与太阳系的其他部分不相符。也许，在接下来的几年里，我们最终会找到原因。

paras.en: “Every time we go to Mercury, we are surprised,” Solomon says. “I expect that to repeat.”
paras.zh: “每次我们去水星，我们都会感到惊讶，”所罗门说。 “我预计这种情况会重演。”

articles.title: How one lemur species evolved to sing like an opera star

paras.en: Rachel Feltman: For Scientific American’s Science Quickly, I’m Rachel Feltman.
paras.zh: 雷切尔·费尔特曼：《科学美国人》的《科学快报》，我是雷切尔·费尔特曼。

paras.en: You know that song at the beginning of [Disney’s 1991] Beauty and the Beast where Belle talks about how boring all her neighbors are for, like, having jobs and chores and stuff? The one that starts with everyone popping out of their windows to say ...
paras.zh: 你知道[迪士尼 1991 年]《美女与野兽》开头的那首歌吗？贝儿在歌曲中谈到她所有的邻居都是多么无聊，比如工作、做家务之类的？一开始每个人都从窗户里跳出来说……

paras.en: [CLIP: Townsperson in Beauty and the Beast: “Bonjour!”]
paras.zh: [剪辑：《美女与野兽》中的镇民：“Bonjour！”]

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Well, this is apparently pretty similar to what goes on every morning in the rainforest in eastern Madagascar.
paras.zh: 嗯，这显然与马达加斯加东部雨林每天早上发生的事情非常相似。

paras.en: Valeria Ferrario: When a group starts singing, advertising their position, basically, mainly in the morning, so you wake up with one indri group singing, and it—at the same time, all the other groups start singing.
paras.zh: 瓦莱里娅·费拉里奥（Valeria Ferrario）：当一群人开始唱歌时，基本上主要是在早上，广告他们的位置，所以你醒来时会有一个 indri 团体唱歌，与此同时，所有其他团体也开始唱歌。

paras.en: Ferrario: So you’re, like, in the middle of the forest, and you’re completely surrounded by all the groups that start singing one after the other because one starts saying, “Oh, I’m here today,” and the others want to advertise their position, also.
paras.zh: 费拉里奥：所以你就像在森林中央，你完全被所有的团体包围，他们开始一个接一个地唱歌，因为其中一个开始说，“哦，我今天在这里，”其他人也想宣传他们的立场。

paras.en: Feltman: That’s Valeria Ferrario, a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Turin in Italy.
