A total solar eclipse will sweep across the country, passing directly over Luxor and plunging some of ancient Egypt's greatest surviving monuments into darkness. Totality will begin in Luxor at approximately 1:02 p.m. EEST and last 6 minutes 22 seconds, according to Time and Date.
paras.zh: 太阳系是一个可以双向运行的时钟。 2027 年 8 月 2 日，该时钟将把月球的黑暗中央阴影（一条全食路径）带回埃及。日全食将席卷整个国家，直接掠过卢克索，让一些古埃及现存最伟大的古迹陷入黑暗。全食将于下午 1:02 左右在卢克索开始。根据时间和日期，EEST 和最后 6 分 22 秒。

paras.en: We know when it will happen because we can calculate the motions of Earth and the moon centuries in advance. But run the same celestial clock backward and eclipses become one of nature's most precise timestamps.
paras.zh: 我们知道它何时会发生，因为我们可以提前几个世纪计算地球和月球的运动。但如果将同样的天体时钟倒转，日食就会成为自然界最精确的时间戳之一。

paras.en: Astronomers can reconstruct where the moon's shadow fell thousands of years ago, even when nobody left a record of it. When an ancient text reliably describes an eclipse, it can anchor a moment in history to a specific place and time.
paras.zh: 天文学家可以重建数千年前月球阴影落在的地方，即使没有人留下任何记录。当古代文献可靠地描述日食时，它可以将历史上的某个时刻锚定在特定的地点和时间。

paras.en: We know from astronomical calculations that eclipses crossed Egypt long before anyone left an identifiable written record of one. On April 1, 2471 B.C., a total solar eclipse swept across northern Egypt during the age of the great pyramid builders. In research published in 2025, archaeoastronomer Giulio Magli at the Polytechnic University of Milan proposed that the eclipse may help explain why Pharaoh Shepseskaf broke with tradition and built a huge rectangular tomb at South Saqqara instead of a pyramid. It's a tantalizing hypothesis, but no surviving Egyptian text records the eclipse.
paras.zh: 我们从天文学计算中得知，早在任何人留下可识别的书面记录之前，日食就已经穿过埃及。公元前2471年4月1日，伟大的金字塔建造者时代，一场日全食席卷了埃及北部。在 2025 年发表的研究中，米兰理工大学的考古天文学家 Giulio Magli 提出，这次日食可能有助于解释为什么谢普塞斯卡夫法老打破传统，在南萨卡拉建造了一座巨大的矩形坟墓而不是金字塔。这是一个诱人的假设，但幸存的埃及文字没有记录这次日食。

paras.en: Astronomers can calculate that an eclipse happened, but using it as a historical timestamp requires evidence that someone actually saw it and recorded it. That's where an eclipse almost 1,300 years later becomes particularly intriguing.
paras.zh: 天文学家可以计算出日食的发生，但将其用作历史时间戳需要证据证明有人确实看到并记录了它。这就是近 1,300 年后的日食变得特别有趣的地方。

paras.en: Is the oldest recorded eclipse hidden in the Bible?
paras.zh: 圣经中隐藏着最古老的日食记录吗？

paras.en: A passage in the Old Testament book of Joshua describes the sun and moon as if they stopped in the sky. After leading the people of Israel into Canaan — modern-day Israel and Palestine — Joshua prayed: "Sun, stand still at Gibeon, and moon, in the Valley of Aijalon. And the sun stood still, and the moon stopped, until the nation took vengeance on their enemies." Ancient Gibeon is about six miles (10 kilometers) northwest of Jerusalem.
paras.zh: 旧约约书亚记中有一段描述太阳和月亮仿佛停在空中。在带领以色列人民进入迦南（今天的以色列和巴勒斯坦）后，约书亚祈祷：“太阳停在基遍，月亮停在亚雅仑谷。太阳停住了，月亮停住了，直到这个国家向他们的敌人报仇。”古基遍位于耶路撒冷西北约六英里（10 公里）处。

paras.en: In research published in 2017, researchers Colin Humphreys and Graeme Waddington at Cambridge University in the U.K. claimed it could refer to an annular solar eclipse on Oct. 30, 1207 B.C. It's a controversial interpretation, not least because it depends on exactly how the ancient Hebrew text is translated. However, if correct, it could be the oldest recorded solar eclipse with a date that has been identified — and it could also more accurately date the reign of Ramesses II. Also known as Ramesses the Great, he reigned for 66 years during Egypt's New Kingdom, commissioned Abu Simbel, made major additions to Karnak and Luxor Temple, and lived to be over 90. His reign marked the final peak of ancient Egyptian imperial power. According to the BBC, he is the "Jupiter" of the pharaonic system. However, the precise dates of his reign remain subject to debate, with historians using a combination of archaeological, historical and astronomical evidence to reconstruct the chronology.
paras.zh: 英国剑桥大学的研究人员 Colin Humphreys 和 Graeme Waddington 在 2017 年发表的研究中声称，它可能指的是公元前 1207 年 10 月 30 日的日环食。这是一个有争议的解释，尤其是因为它取决于古希伯来文本的翻译方式。然而，如果正确的话，这可能是有记录的最古老的日食，并且日期已确定，而且它也可以更准确地确定拉美西斯二世统治的日期。他也被称为拉美西斯大帝，在埃及新王国时期统治了 66 年，委托阿布辛贝勒建造，对卡纳克神庙和卢克索神庙进行了重大修缮，享年超过 90 岁。他的统治标志着古埃及皇权的最后巅峰。据BBC报道，他是法老体系的“朱庇特”。然而，他统治的确切日期仍然存在争议，历史学家结合考古、历史和天文证据来重建年表。

paras.en: Now in the Egyptian Museum in Cairo, the Merneptah Stele is a large inscribed granite monument written in the fifth year of Pharaoh Merneptah's reign, successor to Ramesses II. Discovered in 1896 at Merneptah's mortuary temple on the west bank of the Nile, opposite modern-day Luxor, it describes an Egyptian military campaign in Canaan and mentions Israelites. Egyptologists generally date Merneptah's reign to around 1213 — 1203 B.C., placing his fifth year around 1209/1208 B.C. That means the Israelites were already living in Canaan by then.
paras.zh: 梅内普塔石碑现藏于开罗埃及博物馆，是一座大型花岗岩纪念碑，刻于拉美西斯二世继任者法老梅内普塔统治第五年。它于 1896 年在尼罗河西岸的 Merneptah 太平间寺庙中发现，位于现代卢克索对面，描述了埃及在迦南的军事行动，并提到了以色列人。埃及古物学家普遍将梅尔内普塔的统治时间定为公元前 1213 年至 1203 年左右，将他的第五年定为公元前 1209/1208 年左右。这意味着以色列人那时已经生活在迦南地了。

paras.en: Using calculations that accounted for changes in Earth's rotation over thousands of years, Humphreys and Waddington identified an annular eclipse visible from Canaan for five minutes on the afternoon of Oct. 30, 1207 B.C. If the biblical passage does describe this event, that's a fixed astronomical date that could be used to refine the chronology of the Egyptian pharaohs. The researchers proposed that it occurred during the second, third or fourth year of Merneptah's reign.
paras.zh: 通过计算数千年来地球自转的变化，汉弗莱斯和沃丁顿确定了公元前 1207 年 10 月 30 日下午，在迦南可以看到一次持续五分钟的日环食。如果圣经段落确实描述了这一事件，那么这就是一个固定的天文日期，可以用来完善埃及法老的年表。研究人员推测，这件事发生在梅尔内普塔统治的第二年、第三年或第四年。

paras.en: If Humphreys and Waddington's interpretation of the biblical text is correct, the eclipse of 1207 B.C. could be the oldest solar eclipse identified in a written record. The researchers propose that Ramesses II reigned from approximately 1276 to 1210, with an uncertainty of about a year, slightly different from the conventional dates of 1279-1213 B.C. used by the British Museum.
paras.zh: 如果汉弗莱斯和沃丁顿对圣经文本的解释是正确的，那么公元前 1207 年的日食就发生了。可能是有书面记录的最古老的日食。研究人员推测，拉美西斯二世在位时间约为公元前1276年至1210年，不确定性约为一年，与传统的公元前1279年至1213年略有不同。大英博物馆使用。

paras.en: So an eclipse can be like a timestamp on an undated photograph, but this one does not show that the book of Joshua actually describes an eclipse. The interpretation of the Hebrew has been challenged by Marinus Anthony van der Sluijs, whose paper argues that the biblical narrative states that the sun was standing over Gibeon and the moon was over the Valley of Aijalon simultaneously — so not an eclipse at all.
paras.zh: 因此，日食就像一张未注明日期的照片上的时间戳，但这并不能表明约书亚记实际上描述了一次日食。马里努斯·安东尼·范德斯鲁伊斯对希伯来语的解释提出了挑战，他的论文认为，圣经的叙述指出太阳位于基遍上空，月亮同时位于艾雅隆山谷上空——所以根本不是日食。

paras.en: On Aug. 2, 2027, there will be no such ambiguity. We already know where the moon's shadow will cross Egypt, when it will reach Luxor and how long darkness will last. Almost 4,500 years separate that eclipse from the one that crossed Egypt in 2471 B.C. and 3,233 years from 1207 B.C., but both are movements of the same celestial clock. Run it forwards, and it predicts the future. Run it backward, and occasionally an eclipse of the sun can put a date on history.
paras.zh: 到了2027年8月2日，就不会有这样的歧义了。我们已经知道月影将在哪里穿过埃及、何时到达卢克索以及黑暗将持续多久。那次日食与公元前 2471 年穿越埃及的日食相隔近 4,500 年。公元前1207年起的3,233年，但两者都是同一个天钟的运动。向前运行它，它就能预测未来。倒推一下，偶尔一次日食就能在历史上留下一个日期。

paras.en: Jamie is an experienced science and travel journalist, stargazer and eclipse chaser who writes about exploring the night sky, solar and lunar eclipses, the Northern Lights, moon-gazing, astro-travel, astronomy and space exploration. He is the editor of WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com, author of A Stargazing Program For Beginners, co-author of The Eclipse Effect, and a senior contributor at Forbes.
paras.zh: 杰米是一位经验丰富的科学和旅行记者、观星者和日食追踪者，撰写有关探索夜空、日食和月食、北极光、观月、天文旅行、天文学和太空探索的文章。他是 WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com 的编辑、《A Stargazing Program For Beginners》的作者、《The Eclipse Effect》的合著者以及《福布斯》的高级撰稿人。

articles.title: European-Japanese BepiColombo probe arrives in orbit around Mercury today
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: Mercury is about to receive a robotic visitor from Earth.
paras.zh: 水星即将迎来一位来自地球的机器人访客。

paras.en: The BepiColombo mission — a joint effort of the European Space Agency (ESA) and the Japanese Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) — will arrive in orbit around Mercury today (Nov. 21), more than eight years after leaving its home planet.
paras.zh: BepiColombo 任务是欧洲航天局 (ESA) 和日本宇宙航空研究开发机构 (JAXA) 的共同努力，将于今天（11 月 21 日）抵达水星周围的轨道，距离开其母星已有八年多了。

paras.en: The big moment will come after an orbit-insertion burn, which is scheduled to begin today at 1:24 p.m. EST (1824 GMT) and last for 37 minutes.
paras.zh: 重要时刻将在定于今天下午 1:24 开始的轨道插入燃烧之后到来。美国东部时间 (1824 GMT) 持续 37 分钟。

paras.en: BepiColombo consists of two main spacecraft: ESA's Mercury Planetary Orbiter (MPO) and JAXA's Mercury Magnetospheric Orbiter (MMO), also known as Mio.
paras.zh: BepiColombo 由两个主要航天器组成：ESA 的水星行星轨道飞行器 (MPO) 和 JAXA 的水星磁层轨道飞行器 (MMO)，也称为 Mio。

paras.en: The duo launched — along with a power and propulsion element called the Mercury Transfer Module (MTM) — aboard an Ariane 5 rocket from French Guiana in October 2018, beginning a long and looping trip through the inner solar system.
paras.zh: 2018 年 10 月，两人乘坐阿丽亚娜 5 号火箭从法属圭亚那发射升空，连同一个名为水星传输模块 (MTM) 的动力和推进元件，开始了穿越内太阳系的漫长而循环的旅程。

paras.en: Mercury is a difficult planet to reach because it's so close to the sun. Spacecraft approaching the solar system's innermost planet are accelerated to high velocities by the immense gravitational pull of our star and must shed a great deal of kinetic energy to be captured by Mercury's much weaker tug.
paras.zh: 水星是一颗难以到达的行星，因为它距离太阳非常近。接近太阳系最内层行星的航天器会在恒星的巨大引力作用下加速到高速，并且必须释放大量动能才能被水星较弱的牵引力捕获。

paras.en: So the BepiColombo team designed a trajectory that featured one flyby of Earth, two of Venus and six of Mercury over the course of about seven years. That flight time was increased by a year, however, after the mission suffered an issue with its solar panels, which reduced the power available for the MTM's electric thrusters.
paras.zh: 因此，BepiColombo 团队设计了一条轨道，在大约七年的时间里飞越地球一次、金星两次、水星六次。然而，在任务中太阳能电池板出现问题，导致 MTM 电动推进器的可用功率减少后，飞行时间增加了一年。

paras.en: Today's orbital insertion is the latest milestone in BepiColombo's Mercury arrival phase, which is expected to take about six months in total.
paras.zh: 今天的入轨是 BepiColombo 水星到达阶段的最新里程碑，预计总共需要大约六个月的时间。

paras.en: Arrival began on Sept. 3, when the MTM released MPO and Mio. The two orbiters remain connected today; they won't separate until Dec. 9 or thereabouts.
paras.zh: 9 月 3 日，MTM 发布了 MPO 和 Mio，抵达时间开始。两个轨道飞行器至今仍保持连接状态。他们要到 12 月 9 日左右才会分开。

paras.en: Shortly thereafter, Mio will settle into its final orbit, a highly elliptical path that will take it over Mercury's poles. MPO is also destined for a polar orbit, though a much less elliptical one than Mio's; the ESA probe will conduct a series of engine burns before finally getting there on March 10, 2027.
paras.zh: 此后不久，Mio 将进入其最终轨道，这是一条高度椭圆的路径，将带它越过水星的两极。 MPO 也注定会进入极地轨道，尽管它的椭圆度比 Mio 的要小得多。 ESA 探测器将进行一系列发动机燃烧，最终于 2027 年 3 月 10 日抵达目的地。

paras.en: BepiColombo won't start doing science work until April 6, 2027. The two probes will gather complementary data from their two different vantage points, shedding a great deal of light on a mysterious world.
paras.zh: BepiColombo 直到 2027 年 4 月 6 日才会开始进行科学研究。这两个探测器将从两个不同的有利位置收集互补数据，为神秘世界提供大量线索。

paras.en: "The mission will study all aspects of Mercury, from the structure and dynamics of its magnetosphere and how it interacts with the solar wind, to its internal structure with its large iron core, and the origin of the planet’s magnetic field," ESA officials wrote in a BepiColombo mission description.
paras.zh: 欧洲航天局官员在 BepiColombo 任务描述中写道：“该任务将研究水星的各个方面，从磁层的结构和动力学以及它如何与太阳风相互作用，到其巨大铁芯的内部结构，以及行星磁场的起源。”

paras.en: "The data will enable scientists to understand more about the origin and evolution of a planet located close to its parent star, and a better understanding of the overall evolution of our solar system," they added.
paras.zh: 他们补充说：“这些数据将使科学家能够更多地了解靠近其母星的行星的起源和演化，并更好地了解太阳系的整体演化。”

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: SpaceX will retire 1st Starship upper stage ever caught by 'chopsticks,' Elon Musk says
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: The first Starship upper stage that SpaceX ever successfully recovered won't fly again.
paras.zh: SpaceX 成功回收的第一艘星际飞船上部级将不会再次飞行。

paras.en: That vehicle, known as Ship 42, launched Nov. 13 on Starship's 15th test flight. A day later, it returned from orbit, nestling softly into the "chopstick" arms of its launch tower at SpaceX's Starbase site in South Texas.
paras.zh: 这艘名为“Ship 42”的飞行器于 11 月 13 日在 Starship 的第 15 次试飞中升空。一天后，它从轨道返回，轻轻地坐落在德克萨斯州南部 SpaceX Starbase 发射塔的“筷子”臂中。

paras.en: Ship 42 made it through Flight 15 in good condition, according to SpaceX founder and CEO Elon Musk, who said it "could probably be reflown with a few weeks of refurbishment." But that's not going to happen.
paras.zh: SpaceX 创始人兼首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 表示，42 号船在 15 号航班上状态良好，“经过几周的整修后，它可能会重新飞行”。但这不会发生。

paras.en: "In this case, because it's kind of an historic ship, we're going to, I think, not take any chances with the ship and just kind of leave it for public display, because what it's done is historic," Musk said on Wednesday (Nov. 18) during a discussion at the TomorrowX Summit.
paras.zh: 周三（11 月 18 日），马斯克在 TomorrowX 峰会的一次讨论中表示：“在这种情况下，因为它是一艘具有历史意义的船，我认为我们不会对这艘船抱任何侥幸心理，只是将其留给公众展示，因为它所做的事情具有历史意义。”

paras.en: He didn't say where Ship would be put on display, but the likeliest locale is Starbase, SpaceX's Starship manufacturing and launch hub. (SpaceX plans to shift most Starship launches to its new Starbase Louisiana site, but construction has yet to begin on that $100 billion complex.)
paras.zh: 他没有透露 Ship 将在哪里展示，但最有可能的地点是 Starbase，SpaceX 的星际飞船制造和发射中心。 （SpaceX 计划将大部分星际飞船发射转移到路易斯安那州的新 Starbase 基地，但这个耗资 1000 亿美元的综合体的建设尚未开始。）

paras.en: Musk participated virtually in the TomorrowX conversation, which was moderated by two friends of his, the venture capitalists Gavin Baker and Antonio Gracias. (TomorrowX took place in Austin, Texas, but Musk was in China on Wednesday as part of President Trump's delegation for his meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping.)
paras.zh: 马斯克实际上参与了 TomorrowX 对话，该对话由他的两位朋友风险投资家加文·贝克 (Gavin Baker) 和安东尼奥·格拉西亚斯 (Antonio Gracias) 主持。 （TomorrowX 在德克萨斯州奥斯汀举行，但马斯克周三作为特朗普总统代表团的成员来到中国，与中国国家主席习近平会面。）

paras.en: The world's richest man expounded on Ship 42's historic achievement, explaining that it gets SpaceX much closer to the "holy grail of rocketry" — a fully and rapidly reusable launch vehicle.
paras.zh: 这位世界首富阐述了 42 号船的历史性成就，解释说它让 SpaceX 更接近“火箭技术的圣杯”——一种完全、快速可重复使用的运载火箭。

paras.en: Before Flight 15, SpaceX had already caught Starship's first-stage booster, known as Super Heavy, on three separate occasions, and it had reflown a booster twice. But the company had never attempted a Ship catch, which is a taller order, given how much faster and farther Starship upper stages fly.
paras.zh: 在 15 号航班之前，SpaceX 已经在三个不同的场合捕获了 Starship 的第一级助推器（称为 Super Heavy），并且还两次重新发射了助推器。但该公司从未尝试过捕获飞船，考虑到星际飞船上层飞行速度更快、距离更远，这是一个更高的要求。

paras.en: So snagging Ship on the first try was a very big deal, according to Musk.
paras.zh: 因此，马斯克表示，第一次尝试就抓住 Ship 是一件非常大的事情。

paras.en: "Everyone knew, within SpaceX, at least, how important this milestone was, and that it was really something fundamental and profound — that Starship will be the first-ever fully reusable orbital space system," he told Baker and Gracias on Wednesday.
paras.zh: “至少在 SpaceX 内部，每个人都知道这一里程碑有多么重要，而且这确实是一件根本性且意义深远的事情——星际飞船将成为有史以来第一个完全可重复使用的轨道空间系统，”他周三告诉贝克和格拉西亚斯。

paras.en: And SpaceX is very serious about Starship reuse. Musk has said that the company wants to launch about 10,000 Starship missions per year by 2030.
paras.zh: 而且 SpaceX 对于星际飞船的重复利用非常重视。马斯克表示，该公司希望到 2030 年每年发射约 10,000 次星际飞船任务。

paras.en: This mind-boggling cadence will help the company build out two enormous megaconstellations in low Earth orbit — the next iteration of its Starlink broadband network, which will consist of about 100,000 satellites, and its Starmind AI data-center constellation, which will be 10 times bigger than that.
paras.zh: 这种令人难以置信的节奏将帮助该公司在近地轨道上建造两个巨大的巨型星座——下一代的 Starlink 宽带网络，将由约 10 万颗卫星组成，以及 Starmind AI 数据中心星座，其规模将是其 10 倍。

paras.en: Assembly of that new Starlink network is already underway. Ship carried 26 of the next-gen internet spacecraft up for the first time on Flight 14, which launched on Sept. 28, and repeated the feat on Flight 15.
paras.zh: 新的星链网络的组装已经开始。 9 月 28 日发射的 14 号航班首次搭载了 26 艘下一代互联网航天器，并在 15 号航班上重复了这一壮举。

He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.

articles.title: Moog Marks 25 Years Since ESPA Design Milestone: Innovating Space Rideshare
articles.author: Moog Inc.

paras.en: East Aurora, N.Y. — Moog Inc. (NYSE: MOG.A and MOG.B) marks 25 years since the Evolved Secondary Payload Adapter (ESPA) ring completed its Critical Design Review in 2001. The pioneering technology helped advance space rideshare by enabling multiple payloads to share a launch and broadening access to orbit for commercial, government, and defense missions.
paras.zh: 纽约州东奥罗拉 — 穆格公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：MOG.A 和 MOG.B）庆祝演进型辅助有效载荷适配器 (ESPA) 环于 2001 年完成关键设计审查以来 25 周年。这项开创性技术通过支持多个有效载荷共享发射并拓宽商业、政府和国防任务的轨道通道，帮助推进了太空共享出行。

paras.en: Development of ESPA began in 1999 through a collaborative government-industry initiative, culminating in the successful completion of its Critical Design Review on January 18, 2001. The ESPA ring enabled launch vehicles to carry multiple secondary payloads by efficiently using previously unused volume beneath primary satellites. This approach lowered costs and increased mission flexibility, supporting commercial satellite constellations, technology demonstrations, and critical defense operations.
paras.zh: ESPA 的开发始于 1999 年，通过政府与行业的合作倡议，最终于 2001 年 1 月 18 日成功完成了关键设计审查。ESPA 环使运载火箭能够通过有效利用主卫星下方以前未使用的空间来携带多个辅助有效载荷。这种方法降低了成本并提高了任务灵活性，支持商业卫星星座、技术演示和关键防御行动。

paras.en: “ESPA helped redefine access to space by enabling additional payloads to share a launch with primary missions. Its impact continues across commercial, government, and military space—and its story reflects the value of enduring collaboration between Air Force Research Lab (AFRL) and industry partners such as Moog,” said Dr. Darren Raspa, chief historian, AFRL Space and Directed Energy Systems.
paras.zh: AFRL 空间和定向能源系统首席历史学家达伦·拉斯帕 (Darren Raspa) 博士表示：“ESPA 通过启用额外的有效载荷与主要任务共享发射，帮助重新定义了太空访问。它的影响持续遍及商业、政府和军事太空，它的故事反映了空军研究实验室 (AFRL) 与穆格等行业合作伙伴之间持久合作的价值。”

paras.en: Over the past 25 years, the ESPA family has evolved into a versatile, modular platform supporting varied payload sizes and interface configurations. ESPA-derived designs have also served as the structural foundation for spacecraft buses. Today, the platform continues to support mission planning for NASA, the U.S. government, and commercial space ventures worldwide.
paras.zh: 在过去的 25 年里，ESPA 系列已发展成为一个多功能的模块化平台，支持各种有效负载大小和接口配置。 ESPA 衍生设计也成为航天器总线的结构基础。如今，该平台继续支持 NASA、美国政府和全球商业航天企业的任务规划。

paras.en: Moog continues to offer a family of ESPA configurations, including Standard ESPA, ESPA Heavy, and ESPA Grande, designed to accommodate evolving payload and mission requirements. The platform’s modular architecture and adaptable interfaces support rideshare missions, payload integration, and spacecraft applications across the growing space market.
paras.zh: 穆格继续提供一系列 ESPA 配置，包括标准 ESPA、ESPA Heavy 和 ESPA Grande，旨在适应不断变化的有效载荷和任务要求。该平台的模块化架构和适应性强的接口支持不断增长的太空市场中的乘车共享任务、有效载荷集成和航天器应用。

paras.en: “The ESPA ring began as a technical solution to a practical challenge: maximizing every launch opportunity,” said Timothy Pargett, general manager, Moog Payload Adapters and Isolation business. “Today, it stands as a cornerstone of how missions, large and small, gain cost-effective, reliable access to orbit through rideshare. Its enduring legacy reflects visionary innovation and trusted partnerships across the aerospace community.”
paras.zh: “ESPA 环最初是作为应对实际挑战的技术解决方案：最大化每个发射机会，”穆格有效负载适配器和隔离业务总经理 Timothy Pargett 说道。 “如今，它已成为大大小小的任务如何通过拼车获得具有成本效益且可靠的轨道访问的基石。它的持久遗产反映了整个航空航天界的富有远见的创新和值得信赖的合作伙伴关系。”

paras.en: In conjunction with the anniversary, a Moog flight-qualified ESPA ring will be on display at the National Museum of Nuclear Science & History in Albuquerque, N.M., from November 7, 2026, through January 10, 2027.
paras.zh: 为庆祝周年纪念日，一枚符合穆格飞行资格的 ESPA 环将于 2026 年 11 月 7 日至 2027 年 1 月 10 日在新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基的国家核科学与历史博物馆展出。

paras.en: Museum visitors will have the opportunity to see firsthand the hardware that helped advance rideshare and enable diverse space missions.
paras.zh: 博物馆参观者将有机会亲眼目睹有助于推进乘车共享和实现多样化太空任务的硬件。

paras.en: As ESPA enters its next chapter, Moog continues to advance spacecraft payload integration and develop adaptable solutions that expand flexible, cost-effective access to orbit for future space exploration and defense missions.
paras.zh: 随着 ESPA 进入新篇章，穆格将继续推进航天器有效载荷集成，并开发适应性强的解决方案，为未来的太空探索和防御任务扩展灵活、经济高效的轨道接入方式。

paras.en: Moog is a worldwide designer, manufacturer, and systems integrator of high-performance precision motion and fluid controls and control systems. Moog’s high-performance systems control military and commercial aircraft, satellites, and space vehicles, launch vehicles, defense systems, missiles, automated industrial machinery, marine, and medical equipment. Additional information about the Company can be found at www.moog.com or www.moog.com/space.
paras.zh: 穆格是高性能精密运动和流体控制及控制系统的全球设计商、制造商和系统集成商。穆格的高性能系统控制军用和商用飞机、卫星和航天器、运载火箭、防御系统、导弹、自动化工业机械、船舶和医疗设备。有关公司的更多信息，请访问 www.moog.com 或 www.moog.com/space。

articles.title: What role does industry play in Europe’s space sovereignty push?
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Jason Rainbow interviews Atle Woello, the CEO and senior vice president of the space systems and surveillance business unit at Kongsberg NanoAvionics. They discuss the role space plays for defense systems that are increasingly interconnected across domains, as well as the role that the European industrial base can play in the continent’s recent political and fundraising push to bolster sovereignty, independence and resilience in space.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Jason Rainbow 采访了 Kongsberg NanoAvionics 空间系统和监视业务部门的首席执行官兼高级副总裁 Atle Woello。他们讨论了太空对于跨领域互联日益紧密的防御系统的作用，以及欧洲工业基础在欧洲大陆最近为加强太空主权、独立和复原力而进行的政治和筹款活动中可以发挥的作用。

paras.en: This episode is sponsored by Xiphos Systems.
paras.zh: 本集由 Xiphos Systems 赞助。

paras.en: Xiphos Systems develops compact, high-performance embedded computing solutions for spacecraft and aerospace applications. Founded in 1996 and based in Montreal, the company specializes in commercial off-the-shelf processing platforms designed for space, combining processors, programmable logic, storage, networking, and RF capabilities in low size, weight, power, and cost designs. Its portfolio includes processor boards, onboard computers, RF payload systems, and AI-capable computing platforms for satellites, launch vehicles, lunar missions, and robotics. With more than two decades of experience and over 1,000 processor cards delivered, Xiphos supports customers from system integration through deployment, helping bring reliable computing closer to the mission.
paras.zh: Xiphos Systems 为航天器和航空航天应用开发紧凑、高性能的嵌入式计算解决方案。该公司成立于 1996 年，总部位于蒙特利尔，专注于为太空设计的商用现成处理平台，将处理器、可编程逻辑、存储、网络和射频功能与低尺寸、重量、功耗和成本设计相结合。其产品组合包括处理器板、机载计算机、射频有效载荷系统以及用于卫星、运载火箭、月球任务和机器人的人工智能计算平台。 Xiphos 拥有二十多年的经验和交付的 1,000 多个处理器卡，为客户提供从系统集成到部署的支持，帮助实现可靠的计算更接近使命。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.
paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对热爱谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

articles.title: Commercial Space Federation Welcomes CesiumAstro as a New Associate Member
articles.author: Commercial Space Federation

paras.en: November 13, 2026— Washington, D.C.—The Commercial Space Federation (CSF) is pleased to welcome CesiumAstro as its newest Associate Member. A global leader in advanced connectivity solutions for the space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. CesiumAstro’s addition further strengthens CSF’s diverse membership and the Federation’s work to advance a competitive, innovative, and sustainable U.S. commercial space economy.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月 13 日——华盛顿特区——商业航天联合会 (CSF) 很高兴欢迎 CesiumAstro 成为其最新准会员。 CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。 CesiumAstro 的加入进一步加强了 CSF 的多元化成员资格以及联合会推动竞争性、创新性和可持续的美国商业太空经济的工作。

paras.en: CesiumAstro is a lobal leader in advanced connectivity solutions for space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. Its full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads and advanced computing systems. CesiumAstro maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards. Headquartered near Austin, Texas, the company operates additional facilities in Colorado, California, Washington, D.C., Florida, the United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore, Taiwan, and Japan.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，CesiumAstro 提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。其全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。 CesiumAstro 保持与内部设计、制造和测试能力的完全垂直整合，并通过了 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证。该公司总部位于德克萨斯州奥斯汀附近，在科罗拉多州、加利福尼亚州、华盛顿特区、佛罗里达州、英国、德国、新加坡、台湾和日本设有其他工厂。

paras.en: CesiumAstro recently announced the closing of $730 million in Series D financing, valuing the company at more than $4.5 billion, and unveiled Synchronicity, a planned 737-satellite, AI-enabled constellation. The new capital will support advanced technologies, expansion of U.S. manufacturing capacity, development and production of next-generation spacecraft, Synchronicity deployment, and international growth.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 最近宣布完成 7.3 亿美元的 D 轮融资，公司估值超过 45 亿美元，并推出了 Synchronicity，这是一个计划中的 737 颗卫星、支持人工智能的星座。新资金将支持先进技术、美国制造能力的扩张、下一代航天器的开发和生产、同步部署和国际增长。

paras.en: In the past 12 months, CesiumAstro has expanded its capabilities through three strategic acquisitions: Jariet Technologies, 1Aardvark, and Vidrovr, strengthening the company’s capabilities across semiconductor technology, mission software, and artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 在过去的 12 个月中，CesiumAstro 通过三项战略收购扩大了其能力：Jariet Technologies、1Aardvark 和 Vidrovr，增强了公司在半导体技术、任务软件和人工智能方面的能力。

paras.en: CesiumAstro’s full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads, and advanced compute systems. The company maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 的全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。该公司与通过 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证的内部设计、制造和测试能力保持完整的垂直整合。

paras.en: “A thriving commercial economy in low Earth orbit needs reliable communications and a clear path from development to operations. CesiumAstro is joining CSF’s Commercial LEO Council to bring our communications expertise to that effort. We look forward to advancing policies that encourage investment, expand government use of commercial services, and support companies building the next generation of space infrastructure.”
paras.zh: “近地轨道蓬勃发展的商业经济需要可靠的通信以及从开发到运营的清晰路径。CesiumAstro 正在加入 CSF 的商业 LEO 委员会，将我们的通信专业知识用于这一努力。我们期待推进鼓励投资、扩大政府对商业服务的使用以及支持企业建设下一代空间基础设施的政策。”

paras.en: – Josh Ingersoll, Director of Spectrum and Regulatory Affairs at CesiumAstro
paras.zh: – Josh Ingersoll，CesiumAstro 频谱和监管事务总监

paras.en: Founded in 2006, the Commercial Space Federation (CSF) and its members are laying the foundation for democratizing access to outer space for scientists, students, civilians, and businesses. All while working towards the goal of expanding the U.S. Commercial Space Economy. Through the promotion of technological innovation, CSF and its diverse membership are guiding the bolstering of U.S. leadership in aerospace and inspiring America’s next generation of engineers and explorers. CSF also serves as the commercial space industry’s primary advocate with the U.S. Congress and the Administration, helping inform the development and implementation of policy priorities. By engaging with congressional players, CSF is able to provide recommendations on commercial space issues that will impact the commercial space industry in the short and long term.
paras.zh: 商业太空联盟 (CSF) 及其成员成立于 2006 年，正在为科学家、学生、平民和企业进入外太空的民主化奠定基础。同时努力实现扩大美国商业太空经济的目标。通过促进技术创新，CSF 及其多元化成员正在指导巩固美国在航空航天领域的领导地位，并激励美国下一代工程师和探险家。 CSF 还担任美国国会和政府商业航天业的主要倡导者，帮助为政策优先事项的制定和实施提供信息。通过与国会参与者合作，CSF 能够就商业航天问题提供建议，这些问题将在短期和长期影响商业航天行业。

articles.title: The Stormy Southwest Pacific

paras.en: Even as the unusually quiet 2026 storm season winds down in the North Atlantic, seas have begun to stir on the other side of the world in the Southwest Pacific. On November 15, 2026, the Fiji Meteorological Service began issuing updates about a slow-moving tropical disturbance northeast of Samoa and the Cook Islands. Within just a few days, it had become one of the most intense November tropical cyclones the region has seen in decades.
paras.zh: 尽管 2026 年北大西洋异常平静的风暴季节即将结束，但世界另一端西南太平洋的海水却开始骚动起来。 2026 年 11 月 15 日，斐济气象局开始发布有关萨摩亚和库克群岛东北部缓慢移动的热带扰动的最新信息。短短几天内，它就成为该地区数十年来最强烈的 11 月热带气旋之一。

paras.en: Named Xavier, the system intensified rapidly, thriving in an environment with minimal wind shear and sea surface temperatures of 29 degrees Celsius (84 degrees Fahrenheit)—well above the threshold required to sustain and strengthen developing tropical cyclones. Xavier was the basin’s second named storm of the season, following only Wati, a short-lived storm that emerged in October.
paras.zh: 该系统被命名为“泽维尔”，它的强度迅速增强，在风切变最小、海面温度高达 29 摄氏度（84 华氏度）的环境中蓬勃发展，远高于维持和加强正在发展的热带气旋所需的阈值。泽维尔是该盆地本季第二个被命名的风暴，仅次于 10 月份出现的短暂风暴瓦蒂。

paras.en: As Xavier developed, NASA satellite data showed the storm churning along the southwestern edge of a massive tongue of warm water spanning from the west coast of South America to the central Pacific—a telltale sign of the El Niño that has been present in the region since June.
paras.zh: 随着泽维尔的发展，美国宇航局卫星数据显示，这场风暴沿着从南美洲西海岸到太平洋中部的巨大温水舌的西南边缘翻腾，这是自六月以来该地区出现的厄尔尼诺现象的明显迹象。

paras.en: When the MODIS (Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer) on NASA’s Aqua satellite captured this image at 02:53 Universal Time on November 17, 2026 (4:53 p.m. Cook Islands Time on November 16), forecasters estimated Xavier had maximum winds of about 195 kilometers (120 miles) per hour. Winds reached a peak intensity of 220 kilometers (140 miles) per hour later that day, a Category 5 storm on the cyclone intensity scale used in the region or a Category 4 on the Saffir-Simpson scale.
paras.zh: 当美国宇航局 Aqua 卫星上的 MODIS（中分辨率成像光谱仪）于 2026 年 11 月 17 日世界时间 02:53（库克群岛时间 11 月 16 日下午 4:53）拍摄到这张图像时，预报员估计泽维尔的最大风速约为每小时 195 公里（120 英里）。当天晚些时候，风速达到每小时 220 公里（140 英里）的峰值强度，根据该地区使用的气旋强度等级为 5 级风暴，根据萨菲尔-辛普森等级为 4 级风暴。

paras.en: The storm ranks as the strongest November tropical cyclone east of the international date line on record, noted Colorado State University hurricane expert Phil Klotzbach. Xavier’s formation east of the date line, near the northern Cook Islands, was unusual, but its easterly position aligns with research that indicates that storm activity in the region typically shifts northeast during El Niño years. Research also shows that El Niño tends to fuel storms that strengthen at an unusually rapid pace.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州立大学飓风专家 Phil Klotzbach 指出，这场风暴是国际日期变更线以东有记录以来最强的 11 月热带气旋。泽维尔在库克群岛北部附近的日期变更线以东形成是不寻常的，但其偏东的位置与研究一致，表明该地区的风暴活动通常在厄尔尼诺年期间向东北方向移动。研究还表明，厄尔尼诺现象往往会加剧风暴，并以异常快的速度增强。

paras.en: According to news reports, Xavier damaged homes and caused power disruptions as it passed the northern Cook Islands. It then encountered dry air and a less favorable wind shear environment and slowly weakened as it pushed westward, reducing the threat that it posed to Samoa and American Samoa.
paras.zh: 据新闻报道，泽维尔在经过库克群岛北部时损坏了房屋并造成电力中断。随后遇到干燥空气和不太有利的风切变环境，在向西推进的过程中逐渐减弱，减少了对萨摩亚和美属萨摩亚的威胁。

paras.en: Xavier is likely one of the first of several storms to affect the region in the coming months. A seasonal outlook from the Fiji Meteorological Service projects that the region could see between 11 and 15 named tropical cyclones this season, with the greatest risk east of the international date line. Storm activity in the Southwest Pacific basin typically peaks in February.
paras.zh: 泽维尔可能是未来几个月影响该地区的几场风暴中的第一场。斐济气象局的季节性展望预计，本季节该地区可能会出现 11 至 15 个热带气旋，其中国际日期变更线以东的风险最大。西南太平洋盆地的风暴活动通常在二月达到顶峰。

paras.en: George Russell hits the barrier after a lock-up when trying to overtake team-mate Kimi Antonelli at the Las Vegas Grand Prix, much to the delight of rival Max Verstappen.
paras.zh: 乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯大奖赛上试图超越队友基米·安东内利时，在锁死后撞上了障碍物，这让竞争对手马克斯·维斯塔潘非常高兴。

articles.title: Verstappen wins wild Las Vegas GP as Ferraris collide again

paras.en: Las Vegas GP: Max Verstappen wins wild race as Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc collide again
paras.zh: 拉斯维加斯大奖赛：法拉利车手刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔再次相撞，马克斯·维斯塔潘赢得狂野比赛

paras.en: Max Verstappen wins wild Las Vegas Grand Prix; Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri claim double podium for McLaren after late Mercedes collapse saw George Russell and Kimi Antonelli drop back; Charles Leclerc penalised for causing collision with Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton
paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘 (Max Verstappen) 赢得狂野的拉斯维加斯大奖赛；兰多·诺里斯 (Lando Norris) 和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里 (Oscar Piastri) 为迈凯伦夺得了双领奖台，而在梅赛德斯车队后期的崩溃导致乔治·拉塞尔 (George Russell) 和基米·安东内利 (Kimi Antonelli) 退居二线之后；查尔斯·勒克莱尔因与法拉利队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿发生碰撞而受到处罚

paras.en: Max Verstappen produced a remarkable drive to win a wild Las Vegas Grand Prix that saw him withstand extreme pressure from George Russell and Kimi Antonelli before a late Mercedes collapse.
paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘 (Max Verstappen) 表现出色，赢得了疯狂的拉斯维加斯大奖赛，在梅赛德斯后期崩溃之前，他顶住了乔治·拉塞尔 (George Russell) 和基米·安东内利 (Kimi Antonelli) 的巨大压力。

paras.en: Pole-sitter Verstappen retained the lead at the start but the enormous power of a slipstream on the long straights of the Las Vegas Strip Circuit made it impossible for the Dutchman to pull clear, and resulted in 35 changes of the lead and 352 total overtakes in the 50-lap race.
paras.zh: 杆位得主维斯塔潘在发车时保持领先，但拉斯维加斯大道长直道上巨大的尾流力量使荷兰人无法超越，并导致在 50 圈的比赛中 35 次领先，总共 352 次超车。

paras.en: First Russell, and then later newly crowned world champion Antonelli were each able to pass Verstappen on multiple occasions but the Red Bull driver calmly retook the lead within a few corners every time, expertly managing the deployment of his power.
paras.zh: 先是拉塞尔，然后是新加冕的世界冠军安东内利，都曾多次超越维斯塔潘，但这位红牛车手每次都在几个弯道内冷静地重新取得领先，熟练地管理着自己的力量部署。

paras.en: - F1 2026 Calendar | F1 2026 Standings | F1 Gossip Column
paras.zh: - F1 2026 日历 | F1 2026 积分榜 | F1八卦专栏

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream F1 with no contract 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: Russell, trying to pass his team-mate for second with three laps remaining, ran into a barrier after overshooting a corner and dropped down the order, before Antonelli made an error with his deployment at the start of the final lap that allowed Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri to snatch a double podium for McLaren.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔在还剩三圈时试图超越队友获得第二名，但在冲过弯道后撞上了障碍物，排名下降，随后安东内利在最后一圈开始时的部署失误，让兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里为迈凯轮夺得了双领奖台。

paras.en: "That was crazy. Really, really surreal and something I've never seen before in F1 myself," Verstappen said.
paras.zh: “这太疯狂了。真的，真的超现实，这是我自己在 F1 中从未见过的，”维斯塔潘说道。

paras.en: "I think we had it (deployment) set up well and it was a crazy amount of fighting, and the slipstream was so big that it was just impossible to drive off, and it was just crazy how many people were following."
paras.zh: “我认为我们（部署）设置得很好，这是一场疯狂的战斗，尾流太大了，根本不可能开走，而且有这么多人跟随，这真是太疯狂了。”

paras.en: There was more unwanted drama for Ferrari as team-mates Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc collided again as they battled for sixth with 12 laps remaining, with the latter given a 10-second penalty by the stewards for causing the incident.
paras.zh: 法拉利车队还发生了更多不受欢迎的戏剧性事件，队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔在比赛还剩 12 圈时争夺第六名时再次发生碰撞，后者因引发事故而被赛会干事处以 10 秒的处罚。

paras.en: Pierre Gasly took fifth ahead of his team-mate Franco Colapinto to secure a major points haul for Alpine, with Hamilton recovering to seventh, having served a 10-second penalty himself earlier in the race for overtaking Norris off track.
paras.zh: 皮埃尔·加斯利 (Pierre Gasly) 领先队友佛朗哥·科拉平托 (Franco Colapinto) 获得第五名，为阿尔派 (Alpine) 赢得了重要积分，而汉密尔顿 (Hamilton) 在比赛早些时候因超越诺里斯 (Norris) 冲出赛道而受到 10 秒的处罚，恢复到第七位。

paras.en: Carlos Sainz snatched eighth from Russell on the run to the finish line to equal Williams' best result of the season, while Leclerc claimed the final point in 10th.
paras.zh: 卡洛斯·塞恩斯在冲向终点线时从拉塞尔手中夺取了第八名，追平了威廉姆斯的赛季最佳成绩，而勒克莱尔则以第十名的成绩获得了最后一分。

paras.en: The result all but secures second in the drivers' standings for Verstappen, who made it four wins in six races to pull 37 points clear of third-placed Hamilton with two rounds to go in Qatar and Abu Dhabi.
paras.zh: 这一成绩几乎让维斯塔潘稳坐车手积分榜第二位，在卡塔尔和阿布扎比比赛还剩两轮比赛时，维斯塔潘在六场比赛中取得四场胜利，领先第三名汉密尔顿 37 分。

paras.en: McLaren's late gains enabled them to close within nine points of Red Bull in the battle for third in the constructors' standings, with Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar unfortunate to finish outside the points after a front-wing failure - moments after a Safety Car stoppage that had bunched the field - dropped him from third to last.
paras.zh: 迈凯伦队最后的胜利使他们在车队积分榜第三名的争夺战中与红牛队的差距缩小到了九分之差，而维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈贾尔不幸在前翼故障后失去了积分——在安全车停赛后不久，他从第三名跌至最后一名。

paras.zh: 一级方程式赛车将前往中东参加卡塔尔大奖赛，从本周五开始，天空体育 F1 将进行现场直播。通过 NOW 直播天空体育

articles.title: Fernandes: Man Utd have offered new deal but now is not time for talks

paras.en: Bruno Fernandes: Man Utd captain confirms contract offer but says negotiations are on hold
paras.zh: 布鲁诺·费尔南德斯：曼联队长确认了合同报价，但表示谈判暂停

paras.en: Bruno Fernandes speaks exclusively to Sky Sports about his Man Utd future after rejecting two contract offers, insisting he will leave if the club want him to go; he also discusses his ambitions, Michael Carrick's departure and his first impressions of new boss Mauricio Pochettino
paras.zh: 布鲁诺·费尔南德斯在拒绝了两份合同后，向天空体育独家谈论了他在曼联的未来，并坚称如果俱乐部希望他离开，他就会离开；他还讨论了他的抱负、迈克尔·卡里克的离开以及他对新主帅毛里西奥·波切蒂诺的第一印象

paras.en: Bruno Fernandes exclusively told Sky Sports that Manchester United have offered him a new contract but he has put discussions on hold as he insists the club's priority must be returning to winning ways.
paras.zh: 布鲁诺·费尔南德斯独家告诉天空体育，曼联已经向他提供了一份新合同，但他已经搁置了讨论，因为他坚称俱乐部的首要任务必须是重返胜利之路。

paras.en: Fernandes has rejected two contract offers from United, Sky Sports News understands, with his current deal due to expire at the end of the season. The club's initial proposal was made in the summer when discussions first began over a new deal, but was turned down by the Portuguese, who signed his last contract in August 2024.
paras.zh: 据天空体育新闻了解，费尔南德斯拒绝了曼联的两份合同，他目前的合同将于本赛季末到期。俱乐部的最初提议是在今年夏天提出的，当时首次开始讨论新合同，但被葡萄牙人拒绝，他于 2024 年 8 月签署了最后一份合同。

paras.en: United hold an option to extend the 32-year-old's stay at Old Trafford by a further year, which would also prevent him from speaking to foreign clubs in January over the possibility of a free transfer.
paras.zh: 曼联可以选择将这位32岁的球员在老特拉福德的停留时间再延长一年，这也将阻止他在一月份与外国俱乐部就自由转会的可能性进行对话。

paras.en: - Transfer Centre LIVE! | Man Utd news & transfers🔴
paras.zh: - 换乘中心上线！ |曼联新闻和转会🔴

paras.zh: - 曼联赛程和比分|免费曼联精彩集锦▶️

paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 PL 比赛📺

paras.en: The United captain, who has repeatedly been linked with a move away from Old Trafford, confirmed an offer has been made but dismissed suggestions that negotiations are ongoing or that he has demanded more money or an extended deal.
paras.zh: 这位多次与离开老特拉福德联系在一起的曼联队长证实已经提出了一份报价，但否认了有关谈判正在进行或他要求更多资金或延长合同的说法。

paras.en: Fernandes also made clear he would not stand in the club's way if they decided his future lay elsewhere, insisting he has always prioritised United and would not simply stay to run down his contract.
paras.zh: 费尔南德斯还明确表示，如果俱乐部决定他的未来在其他地方，他不会阻止俱乐部，并坚称他一直优先考虑曼联，不会简单地留下来履行合同。

paras.en: Asked for an update on his contract situation, Fernandes said: "No, there's no negotiations ongoing, but I've seen people saying that he's asked for more money, he's asked for more years. If I wanted more money, I wouldn't be here. I had somewhere to go to get much more money than being at Manchester United.
paras.zh: 当被问及他的合同情况的最新情况时，费尔南德斯说：“不，没有正在进行的谈判，但我看到人们说他要求更多的钱，他要求更多的年限。如果我想要更多的钱，我就不会在这里。我可以去某个地方获得比在曼联更多的钱。”

paras.en: "I could have been in a place that is much warmer than Manchester.
paras.zh: “我本来可以去一个比曼彻斯特温暖得多的地方。

paras.en: "Two summers ago, three summers ago, last summer, I always had the chance to leave and I always chose to be here. The thing is, I've always showed how much I care about the club and how much I want to win at this club. And I always said, in the moment the club thinks it's time for me to move on, I will move on.
paras.zh: “两年前、三年前、去年夏天，我总是有机会离开，但我总是选择留在这里。问题是，我总是表现出我有多么关心俱乐部，我有多么想在这个俱乐部赢得胜利。我总是说，当俱乐部认为我该继续前进的时候，我就会继续前进。”

paras.en: "I'm not going to be the player that I've seen many in this time at Manchester United. They're going to stay here just by staying, just finish my contract and then we will see. In the moment the club says, 'Bruno, it's time to part ways', I'm going to be the first one walking out the door.
paras.zh: “我不会成为我在曼联见过的那种球员。他们只会留在这里，完成我的合同，然后我们就会看到。当俱乐部说‘布鲁诺，是时候分道扬镳’的那一刻，我将成为第一个走出大门的人。

paras.en: "Yeah, the club offered me a new contract, so I think that, from their side, shows that they want me to stay. And as you said, there are no negotiations going on.
paras.zh: “是的，俱乐部向我提供了一份新合同，所以我认为，从他们的角度来看，这表明他们希望我留下来。正如你所说，没有任何谈判正在进行。

paras.en: "We spoke about the contract at the end of last season, we came in the beginning of this season speaking about the contract, but about the context of the team and the club, I just put that to a side because I don't think it's the right moment, neither for me, nor for the club, to be talking about negotiations because the most important thing now is that the club gets back to win games."
paras.zh: “我们在上赛季末谈到了合同，本赛季初谈到了合同，但关于球队和俱乐部的背景，我只是把它放在一边，因为我认为现在不是讨论谈判的合适时机，无论是对我还是对俱乐部来说，因为现在最重要的是俱乐部重新赢得比赛。”

paras.en: 'I still want to win Premier League and Champions League with Man Utd'
paras.zh: “我仍然想和曼联一起赢得英超联赛和欧冠联赛”

paras.en: Fernandes insists his ambitions at United have not changed, despite the club's struggles, and remains determined to bring major honours back to Old Trafford.
paras.zh: 费尔南德斯坚称，尽管俱乐部处境艰难，但他在曼联的雄心壮志没有改变，并仍然决心将重大荣誉带回老特拉福德。

paras.en: "My aim will always be to win the Premier League and the Champions League within the club I am," he said.
paras.zh: “我的目​​标永远是在我所在的俱乐部内赢得英超联赛和欧冠冠军，”他说。

paras.en: The midfielder refused to accept that simply qualifying for the Champions League should become United's primary target. "I will never hide from that, I will never say, no, our position at the moment needs to be to get top four."
paras.zh: 这位中场球员拒绝接受仅仅获得欧冠资格就应该成为曼联的首要目标。 “我永远不会隐瞒这一点，我永远不会说，不，我们目前的位置需要是进入前四。”

paras.en: Fernandes acknowledged winning the Premier League this season was likely to be beyond United but insisted that was not his expectation when the campaign began.
paras.zh: 费尔南德斯承认，本赛季赢得英超冠军的可能性超出了曼联，但他坚称这并不是他在赛季开始时的预期。

paras.en: He also believes supporters have been too patient with the club, recognising their frustration after years without a league title.
paras.zh: 他还认为球迷们对俱乐部过于耐心，他们认识到多年来没有获得联赛冠军后的沮丧。

paras.en: "They've been far too patient with us," he said.
paras.zh: “他们对我们太有耐心了，”他说。

paras.en: 'There was never a problem with Carrick'
paras.zh: “卡里克从来没有问题”

paras.en: Fernandes dismissed suggestions of a breakdown in his relationship with former United boss, Michael Carrick, following his comments during an interview after a 4-1 defeat to Como last month and his subsequent spell on the bench.
paras.zh: 费尔南德斯否认了有关他与前曼联主帅迈克尔·卡里克关系破裂的说法，他在上个月1-4输给科莫后接受采访时发表了评论，随后他又坐在了替补席上。

paras.en: The United captain revealed Carrick had personally explained his decision to leave him out against Bournemouth, insisting it had nothing to do with his interview.
paras.zh: 曼联队长透露，卡里克亲自解释了他在对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中不让他出场的决定，并坚称这与他的采访无关。

paras.en: "The manager came to speak to me after that game, or before the Bournemouth game, to say, 'look, I'm not going to start you tomorrow' and everything.
paras.zh: “那场比赛结束后，或者对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛之前，主教练来找我说话，说，‘听着，我明天不会让你首发’等等。

paras.en: "There's nothing to do with the words of Como, I know people will make it around that. I just want to tell you that we need to change something, I need to make a change, performances have not been great, so I just want you to know that there's nothing to do with that," Fernandes said.
paras.zh: “这与科莫的话无关，我知道人们会绕开这一点。我只是想告诉你，我们需要改变一些东西，我需要做出改变，表现并不好，所以我只是想让你知道这与这无关，”费尔南德斯说。

paras.en: He added that he subsequently approached Carrick to clear up any potential misunderstanding, with the manager reassuring him there was no personal issue.
paras.zh: 他补充说，他随后联系卡里克以消除任何潜在的误会，主教练向他保证不存在个人问题。

paras.en: "I told him, 'I think that you probably got our words in the wrong way, and you might be upset with me, and rightly so, if you got it in the way everyone is speaking about it'. And he said, 'Bruno, I'm not; I just put you on the bench because I thought it was the best for the team'."
paras.zh: “我告诉他，‘我认为你可能以错误的方式理解了我们的话，你可能会对我感到不安，这是正确的，如果你以每个人都在谈论的方式理解的话’。他说，‘布鲁诺，我没有；我只是把你放在替补席上，因为我认为这对球队来说是最好的’。”

paras.en: Fernandes said his return to the starting XI the following game was further evidence that there had been no fallout between the pair.
paras.zh: 费尔南德斯表示，他在接下来的比赛中重返首发阵容进一步证明了两人之间没有任何冲突。

paras.en: 'Pochettino brings good, positive energy'
paras.zh: “波切蒂诺带来了良好的正能量”

paras.en: Fernandes offered a positive early assessment of new United manager Mauricio Pochettino after beginning work with him.
paras.zh: 费尔南德斯在与新任曼联主教练毛里西奥·波切蒂诺开始合作后，对他做出了积极的早期评价。

paras.en: The captain described the new boss as energetic and demanding, revealing Pochettino had already made clear the standards he expects from his players.
paras.zh: 队长形容新主帅充满活力且要求严格，并透露波切蒂诺已经明确了他对球员的期望标准。

paras.en: "He's someone that likes to bring a very good energy to the team, someone very positive, very strong, strict, said it straight away that he won't allow us to not give him what he demands from the team, from each player," Fernandes said.
paras.zh: 费尔南德斯说：“他是一个喜欢给球队带来非常好的能量的人，一个非常积极、非常坚强、严格的人，他立即表示，他不会允许我们不满足他对球队、每个球员的要求。”

paras.en: "He wants the club to succeed so much, he wants to win games, and that's pretty clear and obvious by the way he and his staff speak and want us to improve."
paras.zh: “他非常希望俱乐部取得成功，他希望赢得比赛，从他和他的员工的讲话方式中可以清楚地看出这一点，他希望我们能够进步。”

paras.en: Fernandes revealed he came close to joining Tottenham in 2019 when Pochettino was in charge at the north London club.
paras.zh: 费尔南德斯透露，2019年波切蒂诺执教北伦敦俱乐部时，他曾一度差点加盟热刺。

paras.en: The midfielder confirmed he met with Tottenham's board, who outlined how he could fit into the manager's system, with the prospect of playing alongside Harry Kane, Dele Alli and Heung-Min Son proving attractive.
paras.zh: 这位中场球员证实他与托特纳姆热刺董事会进行了会面，董事会概述了他如何融入主教练的体系，与哈里·凯恩、德勒·阿里和孙兴慜并肩作战的前景被证明很有吸引力。

paras.en: "Obviously I was a very young player that was eager to come to the Premier League. They had Kane there, they had Dele Alli, Son, the chance of playing with those players in front was very attractive," he said.
paras.zh: “显然，我是一名非常年轻的球员，渴望来到英超。他们那里有凯恩，他们有德勒·阿里，孙兴慜，与前面这些球员一起踢球的机会非常有吸引力，”他说。

articles.title: Trump urges nuclear arms control in historic meeting with Putin and Xi
articles.author: Abigail Williams

paras.en: SHENZHEN, China — It’s unclear what decisions may come from this historic meeting.
paras.zh: 中国深圳——目前尚不清楚这次历史性会议可能会做出什么决定。

paras.en: But the spectacle of President Donald Trump’s meeting with Russia’s Vladimir Putin and China’s Xi Jinping may be what delivers the defining image.
paras.zh: 但唐纳德·特朗普总统与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和中国国家主席习近平会晤的盛况可能会传达出决定性的形象。

paras.en: On Thursday, Trump, Putin and Xi met on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in the Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen. Sitting around a huge, doughnut-shaped table at the Kylin Villa resort were leaders of three of the world’s most powerful nations: the U.S. with its largest economy, Russia with its biggest nuclear arsenal, and China its largest standing army and manufacturing sector.
paras.zh: 周四，特朗普、普京和习近平在中国科技中心深圳举行的亚太经济合作峰会期间会面。麒麟山庄度假村的一张巨大的甜甜圈形状的桌子周围坐​​着世界上三个最强大国家的领导人：拥有最大经济体的美国、拥有最大核武库的俄罗斯以及拥有最大常备军和制造业的中国。

paras.en: “We are really making history,” Trump said.
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“我们确实在创造历史。”

paras.en: The sight of Trump expressing such warmth toward two authoritarian strongmen will have left many American allies outside the room dismayed. After Trump called Putin his “friend,” Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk posted to X, “God, protect us from such friends.” Russia has invaded Ukraine and waged a yearslong campaign of sabotage, cyberattacks and misinformation against the West.
paras.zh: 看到特朗普对两位独裁强人表达如此热情，会让在场外的许多美国盟友感到沮丧。在特朗普称普京为他的“朋友”后，波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克在X上发帖称，“上帝啊，请保护我们免受这样的朋友的伤害。”俄罗斯入侵乌克兰，并对西方发动了长达数年的破坏、网络攻击和错误信息活动。

paras.en: Others were concerned about the prospect of a “Yalta 2.0,” a reprise of the 1945 Yalta Conference in which the U.S., Britain and the then-Soviet Union met to carve up the postwar world.
paras.zh: 其他人则担心“雅尔塔2.0”的前景，即1945年雅尔塔会议的重演，当时美国、英国和当时的苏联齐聚一堂，瓜分战后世界。

paras.en: After Thursday’s meeting finished, Russia and China issued a brief statement that was light on detail or major announcements. The U.S. did not immediately release a version.
paras.zh: 周四的会议结束后，俄罗斯和中国发表了一份简短声明，但没有透露细节或重大公告。美国没有立即发布版本。

paras.en: The “China-Russia-U.S. Declaration on Peace” agreed to “reform” the United Nations “so that it can more effectively respond to global challenges.” (Russia and China have long sought to shift the body away from Western human rights concerns, while Trump has been a strident critic of the world body.) The declaration agreed to boost the production and supply of petroleum products, which have been disrupted by the Ukraine and Iran wars, and it rebuked the International Criminal Court not to abuse its power. (The ICC has issued an arrest warrant for Putin.)
paras.zh: 《中俄美和平宣言》同意“改革”联合国，“使其能够更有效地应对全球挑战”。 （俄罗斯和中国长期以来一直寻求让该机构摆脱西方人权问题，而特朗普一直是该世界机构的尖锐批评者。）该声明同意增加石油产品的生产和供应，石油产品的生产和供应因乌克兰和伊朗战争而中断，并谴责国际刑事法院不要滥用其权力。 （国际刑事法院已向普京发出逮捕令。）

paras.en: The final point was that the leaders vowed to take steps to avoid nuclear war, although no specifics were mentioned.
paras.zh: 最后一点是，领导人誓言要采取措施避免核战争，但没有提及具体细节。

paras.en: The last remaining treaty between Washington and Moscow, New START, lapsed in February, but China, which has a far smaller nuclear arsenal than the other two, has resisted calls to be included in a new agreement.
paras.zh: 华盛顿和莫斯科之间的最后一项条约《新削减战略武器条约》于二月失效，但拥有比其他两国小得多的核武库的中国拒绝了将其纳入新协议的呼吁。

paras.en: “As the world’s three largest nuclear powers, by far, the United States, Russia, and China are uniquely positioned to discuss how to reduce the number of nuclear weapons on Earth, and to lessen the risk that those weapons will ever be used,” Trump said in the public section of the meeting.
paras.zh: 特朗普在会议的公开部分表示：“到目前为止，作为世界上最大的三个核大国，美国、俄罗斯和中国在讨论如何减少地球上核武器的数量并降低使用这些武器的风险方面处于独特的地位。”

paras.en: “Once you have the nuclear weapons, it’s very hard to not have them, it’s very hard to give them up,” he added. “That’s the way life works.”
paras.zh: “一旦拥有核武器，就很难不拥有它们，也很难放弃它们，”他补充道。 “这就是生活的方式。”

paras.en: Xi referred to nuclear weapons as a “sword of Damocles” hanging over humanity and said the world’s three biggest nuclear powers were responsible for global peace, according to the state-run news agency Xinhua.
paras.zh: 据官方通讯社新华社报道，习近平将核武器称为悬在人类头上的“达摩克利斯之剑”，并表示世界三大核大国对全球和平负有责任。

paras.en: “The world today is no longer made up of isolated islands,” he said via a translator. “Humanity lives in the same global village, where everyone’s fortunes are intertwined and where all share a common destiny.”
paras.zh: “当今世界不再由孤岛组成，”他通过翻译说道。 “人类生活在同一个地球村，命运休戚相关，休戚与共。”

paras.en: It was up to the U.S., Russia and China to “set an example, work together to address global challenges, jointly safeguard world peace and stability, and make greater contributions to human progress,” Xinhua quoted Xi as saying.
paras.zh: 新华社援引习近平的话说，美国、俄罗斯和中国要“发挥榜样，携手应对全球性挑战，共同维护世界和平稳定，为人类进步作出更大贡献”。

paras.en: Putin said via a translator that, “Our three states are the victors in World War II, and we hold joint responsibility for maintaining international peace and security.”
paras.zh: 普京通过翻译表示，“我们三个国家都是二战的战胜国，我们对维护国际和平与安全负有共同责任。”

paras.en: The Russian leader said it was up to them to “strengthen the system of international law,” as well as work on issues such as food and energy security. (Russia has been accused of war crimes in Ukraine, a charge it denies.)
paras.zh: 这位俄罗斯领导人表示，他们有责任“加强国际法体系”，并致力于解决粮食和能源安全等问题。 （俄罗斯被指控在乌克兰犯有战争罪，但俄罗斯否认了这一指控。）

paras.en: The meeting represents a major shift from Washington’s post-Cold War policy of driving a wedge between Moscow and Beijing, said Ali Wyne, a senior adviser for U.S.-China relations at the International Crisis Group, a think tank based in Belgium.
paras.zh: 总部位于比利时的智库国际危机组织美中关系高级顾问阿里·韦恩表示，这次会议代表了华盛顿冷战后挑拨莫斯科和北京关系的政策的重大转变。

paras.en: Now, Trump and Putin “are currying favor with President Xi,” he added. “The symbolism is going to be very powerful.”
paras.zh: 他补充说，现在特朗普和普京“正在讨好习主席”。 “象征意义将非常强大。”

paras.en: On the nuclear issue, China is reluctant to engage on the subject when its estimated nuclear arsenal of 600 warheads, though growing rapidly, is still eclipsed by the more than 5,000 each held by the U.S. and Russia.
paras.zh: 在核问题上，中国不愿介入这个话题，因为中国的核武库估计有 600 枚弹头，尽管增长迅速，但与美国和俄罗斯各拥有 5000 多枚弹头相比，仍然黯然失色。

paras.en: “When the leaders of the three largest nuclear powers sit down to discuss how to reduce the proliferation of these weapons, that is always important,” said John B. Emerson, a former U.S. diplomat who served as ambassador to Germany under President Barack Obama.
paras.zh: “当三个最大核大国的领导人坐下来讨论如何减少这些武器的扩散时，这总是很重要的，”曾在巴拉克·奥巴马(Barack Obama)总统领导下担任驻德国大使的美国前外交官约翰·B·爱默生(John B. Emerson)说。

paras.en: Getting Beijing to join real talks on nuclear arms reduction would be a “long shot,” according to Craig Singleton, a China expert at the Washington-based Foundation for Defense of Democracies.
paras.zh: 总部位于华盛顿的保卫民主基金会的中国问题专家克雷格·辛格尔顿表示，让北京加入真正的削减核武器谈判的可能性“不大”。

paras.en: Trump, who has also sought to resume talks with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un over his sanctioned nuclear program, “sees denuclearization as a legacy deal,” Singleton said.
paras.zh: 辛格尔顿表示，特朗普还寻求与朝鲜领导人金正恩就其受制裁的核计划恢复谈判，“将无核化视为一项遗留协议”。

paras.en: “He’s betting that his relationships can get leaders into a room that other presidents couldn’t assemble,” he said in written comments.
paras.zh: “他打赌，他的关系可以让领导人进入一个其他总统无法聚集的房间，”他在书面评论中说。

paras.en: Moscow, meanwhile, has made clear that it wants Ukraine on the agenda although not at the table. This comes as the U.S. and Russian officials have called for negotiations over Europe’s wider security arrangements to be part of any lasting peace settlement — something that deeply alarms long-standing American allies.
paras.zh: 与此同时，莫斯科明确表示希望将乌克兰问题列入议程，尽管不在谈判桌上。在此之际，美国和俄罗斯官员呼吁就欧洲更广泛的安全安排进行谈判，将其作为任何持久和平解决方案的一部分——这让美国的长期盟友深感震惊。

paras.en: This arrangement has also worried Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, who said last month that “we really don’t want this to turn into ‘Yalta 2, 3, 4’ with a redistribution of influence.”
paras.zh: 这种安排也让乌克兰总统泽伦斯基感到担忧，他上个月表示，“我们真的不希望这变成‘雅尔塔2、3、4’，影响力重新分配。”

paras.en: Yalta saw the great powers of the day carve up Berlin into occupied zones, sowing the seeds for communist control of Eastern Europe and the beginning of the Cold War.
paras.zh: 雅尔塔见证了当时的大国将柏林瓜分为占领区，为共产主义控制东欧和冷战的开始播下了种子。

paras.en: European leaders said Thursday that they are willing to negotiate with Russia to end the war in Ukraine, but any discussions would take place on neutral ground and include both Ukraine and the United States.
paras.zh: 欧洲领导人周四表示，他们愿意与俄罗斯进行谈判以结束乌克兰战争，但任何讨论都将在中立立场上进行，乌克兰和美国都包括在内。

paras.en: Speaking alongside the leaders of France and the United Kingdom, German Chancellor Frederick Merz said the talks “are to take place very soon” and suggested the United Arab Emirates as one acceptable venue.
paras.zh: 德国总理弗雷德里克·梅尔茨与法国和英国领导人一起发表讲话，表示会谈“很快就会举行”，并建议阿拉伯联合酋长国作为一个可以接受的地点。

paras.en: Merz hosted twenty-five leaders, including Zelenskyy, in Berlin on Thursday, along with U.S. envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, for a “Coalition of the Willing” in support of Ukraine just hours after the summit between Trump, Putin and Xi in Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 周四，特朗普、普京和习近平在深圳举行峰会后数小时，默茨在柏林接待了包括泽连斯基在内的 25 名领导人，以及美国特使贾里德·库什纳和史蒂夫·威特科夫，组成了支持乌克兰的“意愿联盟”。

paras.en: In a press conference following the meeting in Shenzen, Putin invited the European leaders to Moscow, but said Russia needed to understand their position before any dialogue could continue with Ukraine.
paras.zh: 在深圳会议后的新闻发布会上，普京邀请欧洲领导人前往莫斯科，但表示俄罗斯需要先了解他们的立场，然后才能继续与乌克兰进行对话。

paras.en: “We’re not against it, but we need to understand what Europe brings to these negotiations,” Putin said.
paras.zh: 普京表示：“我们并不反对，但我们需要了解欧洲会给这些谈判带来什么。”

paras.en: U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Europe is united in its negotiating position and ready to “enter serious discussions on European security,” but it must come after a peace agreement between Ukraine and Russia.
paras.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆表示，欧洲在谈判立场上是一致的，并准备“就欧洲安全问题进行认真的讨论”，但这必须在乌克兰和俄罗斯达成和平协议之后进行。

paras.en: Zelenskyy warned the leaders in Berlin that they must ensure Russia engages in substantial discussions and does not waste time “because our people, Ukrainians, are dying, and we don’t want Russia to drag it all out into the winter.”
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基警告柏林领导人，他们必须确保俄罗斯参与实质性讨论，不要浪费时间，“因为我们的乌克兰人民正在死去，我们不希望俄罗斯将这一切拖到冬天。”

paras.en: “Putin has spurned every proposal: de-escalation regarding energy infrastructure, de-escalation in the Black Sea, other ceasefire arrangements,” Zelenskyy said. “Russia’s answer to all of them has been the same: rejection.”
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基说：“普京拒绝了每一项建议：能源基础设施方面的降级、黑海局势的降级以及其他停火安排。” “俄罗斯对所有这些问题的回答都是一样的：拒绝。”

paras.en: Kushner, on the other hand, touted the progress the U.S. had made with Moscow, noting that the Russians were now comfortable with an arrangement where, after the war ended, any security guarantee for Ukraine would have to be similar to the NATO treaty’s Article Five defense clause — a pledge for NATO members that an attack on one is an attack on all.
paras.zh: 另一方面，库什纳赞扬了美国与莫斯科取得的进展，指出俄罗斯现在对这样一种安排感到满意，即战争结束后，对乌克兰的任何安全保障都必须类似于北约条约第五条防御条款——向北约成员国承诺，对一个国家的攻击就是对所有国家的攻击。

paras.en: “I think that that comes with at least what the Russians are saying, which is their intention is when this war is over to not have another war in the future,” Kushner said. “And I know that there’s a lot of skepticism and disbelief on that concept in Russia, but that’s why it’s important to restart the dialogue between Europe and Russia.”
paras.zh: 库什纳说：“我认为这至少符合俄罗斯人的说法，他们的目的是当这场战争结束时，未来不再发生另一场战争。” “我知道俄罗斯对这个概念有很多怀疑和不相信，但这就是为什么重启欧洲和俄罗斯之间的对话很重要。”

paras.en: Senior U.S. officials told reporters ahead of Trump’s trip that the Ukraine war was a separate “track” that China is not part of and that it would not be “appropriate” for the three leaders to discuss it. Beijing has also signaled its reluctance to discuss Ukraine without European leaders at the table.
paras.zh: 美国高级官员在特朗普出访前告诉记者，乌克兰战争是一个单独的“轨道”，中国不属于其中，三位领导人讨论这个问题“不合适”。北京还表示不愿在欧洲领导人不在场的情况下讨论乌克兰问题。

paras.en: Even if Trump, Putin and Xi don’t decide anything on Ukraine at their meeting, the fact that it’s happening at all only reinforces Ukraine’s suspicion “that Washington is increasingly negotiating with Moscow to the detriment of Kyiv, or perhaps even siding with Moscow,” Wyne said.
paras.zh: 韦恩表示，即使特朗普、普京和习近平在会晤中没有就乌克兰问题做出任何决定，这种情况的发生也只会加剧乌克兰的怀疑，“华盛顿越来越多地与莫斯科进行不利于基辅的谈判，甚至可能站在莫斯科一边”。

paras.en: China, which has said this week’s trilateral meeting has “groundbreaking significance,” had nonetheless tried to manage expectations.
paras.zh: 中国表示，本周的三边会议具有“开创性意义”，但仍试图控制预期。

paras.en: Da Wei, director of the Center for International Security and Strategy at Tsinghua University in Beijing, said he didn’t expect anything concrete to come from the meeting but that it was a “starting point” that could promote international stability.
paras.zh: 北京清华大学国际安全与战略研究中心主任戴维表示，他预计这次会议不会产生任何具体成果，但这是一个可以促进国际稳定的“起点”。

paras.en: “No matter we like them or not, these three leaders and these three countries are major shapers of the international order,” he said in an interview Wednesday. “So for that reason, I think the meeting among the three is a good thing.”
paras.zh: “无论我们喜欢与否，这三位领导人和这三个国家都是国际秩序的主要塑造者，”他在周三接受采访时表示。 “因此，我认为三人的会面是一件好事。”

paras.en: Jennifer Jett and Janis Mackey Frayer reported from Shenzhen, and Alexander Smith from London.
paras.zh: Jennifer Jett 和 Janis Mackey Frayer 从深圳报道，Alexander Smith 从伦敦报道。

articles.title: Trump pushes for three-way nuclear deal as Russia and China show little interest
articles.author: Abigail Williams

paras.en: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump has repeatedly placed nonproliferation near the top of the agenda for his trilateral meeting Thursday with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, although his counterparts have expressed little interest in committing to new limitations on their nuclear arsenals.
paras.zh: 华盛顿——唐纳德·特朗普总统在周四与中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京举行的三边会议上多次将防扩散问题列为首要议程，尽管他的同行们并没有表示有兴趣承诺对其核武库实施新的限制。

paras.en: Trump has been pushing for China to join the U.S. and Russia in a new nuclear arms control agreement since his first term in office. Still, he has sought to limit expectations for any major progress in Shenzhen, China, where the world’s top three nuclear powers are meeting on the sidelines of a summit of Asia-Pacific leaders.
paras.zh: 特朗普自第一任期以来一直在推动中国加入美国和俄罗斯的行列，签署新的核军控协议。尽管如此，他还是试图限制对中国深圳取得任何重大进展的预期，世界三大核大国正在亚太领导人峰会期间举行会议。

paras.en: Russia suspended its participation in New START, its last remaining nuclear arms pact with the U.S., when it invaded Ukraine in 2022, denying inspections of its nuclear sites. Ahead of the treaty’s expiration this past February, Russia said it would keep to the deal’s limitations on its arsenal for another year, but Trump insisted a new agreement must include China and possibly other nuclear powers.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯在 2022 年入侵乌克兰并拒绝检查其核设施时，暂停了其与美国签署的最后一项核武器条约《新削减战略武器条约》的参与。在该条约今年二月到期之前，俄罗斯表示将在一年内继续遵守该协议对其核武库的限制，但特朗普坚称新协议必须包括中国以及可能的其他核大国。

paras.en: China has said an arms control agreement should remain between the U.S. and Russia, which together hold nearly 90% of the world’s nuclear arsenal, with more than 5,000 warheads each. China has about 600, according to Pentagon estimates, though by 2030 it could have up to 1,000 if its arsenal continues to expand at the current rate.
paras.zh: 中国表示，美国和俄罗斯之间应保留军控协议，两国合计拥有世界核武库的近90%，各自拥有超过5000枚弹头。据五角大楼估计，中国拥有约 600 枚核武器，但如果其军火库继续以目前的速度扩张，到 2030 年中国的数量可能会达到 1,000 枚。

paras.en: “China is building up its nuclear arsenal to a very significant degree, and it will continue to do so, and wants to continue to do so,” David Sacks, a senior fellow for Asia studies at the Council on Foreign Relations, told reporters Wednesday.
paras.zh: 美国外交关系委员会亚洲研究高级研究员戴维·萨克斯周三对记者表示：“中国正在大力建设其核武库，并将继续这样做，并且希望继续这样做。”

paras.en: The Chinese foreign ministry has declined to say whether nuclear arms control will be discussed at the trilateral meeting on Thursday, with spokesperson Mao Ning saying earlier this week that the three leaders “will have an in-depth exchange of views on important issues bearing on global peace.”
paras.zh: 中国外交部拒绝透露周四的三边会议是否会讨论核军控问题，发言人毛宁本周早些时候表示，三位领导人“将就事关全球和平的重要问题深入交换意见”。

paras.en: In a call last week, Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi “agreed on the importance of meaningful leader-level conversations to advance goals such as peace and denuclearization,” according to a U.S. readout of the call. The Chinese readout made no reference to such a discussion.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥和中国外交部长王毅在上周的通话中“一致认为，进行有意义的领导人级别对话对于推进和平与无核化等目标的重要性”。中方的宣读内容没有提及此类讨论。

paras.en: Trump has admitted that it will be difficult to get Russia and China to consider reducing their nuclear arsenals.
paras.zh: 特朗普承认，很难让俄罗斯和中国考虑削减核武库。

paras.en: “So we’re going to talk about denuclearization. Tough subject because it’s very hard for any of us to say we’ll get rid of our nukes, right? But especially since you do have other countries,” he said Monday. “But we’re going to be talking about denuclearization.”
paras.zh: “所以我们将讨论无核化。这是一个棘手的话题，因为我们中的任何人都很难说我们会摆脱核武器，对吧？但特别是因为确实有其他国家，”他周一表示。 “但我们将讨论无核化。”

paras.en: Even in the hours leading up to this week’s Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, the world’s top two nuclear powers were making shows of force. On Tuesday, the U.S. launched an unarmed intercontinental ballistic missile in a previously unannounced test at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California. Hours later, Russia landed two strategic bombers in Vietnam to coincide with Putin’s arrival in China.
paras.zh: 即使在本周深圳亚太经济合作峰会召开前的几个小时，世界前两个核大国也在炫耀武力。周二，美国在加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地进行了一次未经宣布的测试，发射了一枚非武装洲际弹道导弹。几小时后，俄罗斯在越南降落了两架战略轰炸机，恰逢普京抵达中国。

paras.en: While one meeting is not likely to produce dramatic breakthroughs, it could kick-start a process that leads to sustained, formal bilateral or multilateral negotiations on nuclear risk reduction, arms control and disarmament, said Daryl Kimball, executive director of the Washington-based Arms Control Association.
paras.zh: 华盛顿军备控制协会执行主任达里尔·金博尔表示，虽然一次会议不太可能取得重大突破，但它可以启动一个进程，就减少核风险、军备控制和裁军问题进行持续、正式的双边或多边谈判。

paras.en: “A top priority for all three leaders should be to head off a costly, escalatory nuclear arms race involving the further buildup of nuclear forces and the resumption of nuclear testing by any state,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“三位领导人的首要任务应该是阻止代价高昂、不断升级的核军备竞赛，包括进一步增强核力量以及任何国家恢复核试验。”

paras.en: Da Wei, director of the Center for International Security and Strategy at Tsinghua University in Beijing, said nuclear arms control was not a “proper topic” for the trilateral meeting given the complexity of the issue and how little time Trump, Putin and Xi will have together.
paras.zh: 北京清华大学国际安全与战略研究中心主任戴维表示，鉴于问题的复杂性以及特朗普、普京和习近平会面的时间有限，核军控不是三边会议的“合适话题”。

paras.en: But if the three leaders “can say something about nuclear stability, like a nuclear war is not winnable and should not be fought, I think that will be helpful,” he said in an interview Wednesday.
paras.zh: 但他在周三接受采访时表示，如果三位领导人“能够就核稳定性发表一些看法，比如核战争是无法获胜且不应该打的，我认为这将会有所帮助”。

paras.en: Rubio has acknowledged that a new agreement could take some time.
paras.zh: 卢比奥承认达成新协议可能需要一些时间。

paras.en: “Past agreements, including New START, took years to negotiate and were built upon decades of precedent. They were also between two powers, not three or more,” he wrote on Substack in February. “However, just because something is hard does not mean we should not pursue it or settle for less.”
paras.zh: “过去的协议，包括《新削减战略武器条约》，花了数年时间进行谈判，并且是建立在数十年先例的基础上的。它们也是两个国家之间的协议，而不是三个或更多国家之间的协议，”他二月份在 Substack 上写道。 “然而，仅仅因为某件事很难，并不意味着我们不应该追求它或满足于更少。”

articles.title: 'One-in-2,000-year weather' to be investigated post-blackout

paras.en: ElectraNet's contention that "one-in-2,000-year weather" was the likely cause of the Eyre Peninsula blackout will form part of investigations into the incident, the SA government says.
paras.zh: 南澳政府表示，ElectraNet 认为“2000 年一遇的天气”可能是艾尔半岛停电的原因，这将成为该事件调查的一部分。

paras.en: Electricity supply to the peninsula and the state's West Coast was cut on Thursday afternoon when two transmission towers collapsed and a third was severely damaged during intense storms.
paras.zh: 周四下午，半岛和该州西海岸的电力供应被切断，两座输电塔在强烈风暴中倒塌，第三座输电塔严重受损。

paras.en: ElectraNet says it is conducting a "complete and thorough review" into the power outage.
paras.zh: ElectraNet 表示正在对停电事件进行“全面彻底的审查”。

paras.en: The SA government says the suggestion that a "one-in-2,000-year weather event" was responsible for the Eyre Peninsula blackout will be critically examined amid ongoing fallout from the incident.
paras.zh: 南澳政府表示，鉴于该事件的持续影响，有关“2000年一遇的天气事件”导致艾尔半岛停电的说法将受到严格审查。

paras.en: Electricity supply to the peninsula and the state's West Coast was cut on Thursday afternoon when two transmission towers collapsed and a third was severely damaged during intense storms, leaving more than 20,000 properties without power.
paras.zh: 周四下午，半岛和该州西海岸的电力供应被切断，两座输电塔倒塌，第三座输电塔在强烈风暴中严重受损，导致 20,000 多处房屋停电。

paras.en: Power was gradually restored to most of those properties over the following 24 hours, but the blackout has again raised the question of energy security, 10 years on from the 2016 statewide blackout.
paras.zh: 在接下来的 24 小时内，大部分房屋逐渐恢复供电，但自 2016 年全州停电已有 10 年之后，这次停电再次引发了能源安全问题。

paras.en: ElectraNet — which is responsible for the state's high-energy transmission lines — on Sunday confirmed it was conducting a "complete and thorough review" into the recent outage.
paras.zh: 负责该州高能输电线路的 ElectraNet 周日证实，正在对最近的停电事件进行“全面彻底的审查”。

paras.en: On Friday, the company suggested the towers were likely brought down by a "one-in-2,000-year weather event" — a contention SA Premier Peter Malinauskas said would be considered during investigations into the incident.
paras.zh: 周五，该公司表示，这些塔楼可能是由“2000年一遇的天气事件”造成的——南澳州长彼得·马利纳斯卡斯表示，在调查该事件期间将考虑这一论点。

paras.en: "There are one of two possibilities here," Mr Malinauskas said.
paras.zh: “这里有两种可能性之一，”马利纳斯卡斯先生说。

paras.en: "Either this was a genuine 'one-in-2,000-year weather event' here that understandably nothing can withstand — or, two, something went wrong in terms of the specifications of that infrastructure.
paras.zh: “这要么是这里真正的‘2000年一遇的天气事件’，任何东西都无法承受，这是可以理解的——要么，第二，基础设施的规格出了问题。

paras.en: "That's what the investigation will examine, and that's what we're very keen to look at before we rush to make a judgement."
paras.zh: “这就是调查将要检查的内容，也是我们在急于做出判断之前非常渴望看到的内容。”

paras.en: The high-voltage transmission line along which the towers collapsed was completed only a few years ago, at a cost of $300 million.
paras.zh: 导致双塔倒塌的高压输电线路几年前才完工，耗资 3 亿美元。

paras.en: ElectraNet executive Alex Trento told 891 ABC Adelaide on Friday the transmission towers were "built to a one-in-2,000-year weather event", and to withstand wind speeds of up to 172km/h.
paras.zh: ElectraNet 高管亚历克斯·特伦托 (Alex Trento) 周五告诉 891 ABC 阿德莱德，这些输电塔“是为了应对 2000 年一遇的天气事件而建造的”，能够承受高达 172 公里/小时的风速。

paras.en: "What we think has occurred is that the weather in this localised region has been even stronger than the winds that it was designed for,"
paras.zh: “我们认为发生的情况是，这个局部地区的天气甚至比设计时的风力还要强，”

paras.en: He said ElectraNet was "always in contact with the bureau" but said there was no advance warning of an event on the scale of what occurred on Thursday.
paras.zh: 他表示，ElectraNet“始终与该局保持联系”，但表示没有事先警告过周四发生的规模如此大的事件。

paras.en: But he added that what had occurred was "a very unique, very rare occurrence in a very localised area".
paras.zh: 但他补充说，所发生的事情是“在一个非常局部地区发生的非常独特、非常罕见的事件”。

paras.en: "I don't think we could have done anything better from that perspective."
paras.zh: “从这个角度来看，我认为我们本可以做得更好。”

paras.en: The Bureau of Meteorology said while wind speeds of around 100km/h were recorded at Roxby Downs on Thursday, gusts of around 170km/h were "unlikely".
paras.zh: 气象局表示，虽然周四 Roxby Downs 记录到的风速约为 100 公里/小时，但阵风“不太可能”达到 170 公里/小时左右。

paras.en: "When we're talking wind gusts of more than 170km/h — those are the wind gusts you typically only see in tropical cyclones or associated with tornadoes," senior meteorologist Jonathan How said last week.
paras.zh: “当我们谈论时速超过 170 公里的阵风时，这些阵风通常只会在热带气旋或与龙卷风相关的情况下出现，”高级气象学家乔纳森·豪 (Jonathan How) 上周表示。

paras.en: "There was no evidence of tornadoes that we could see [on Thursday] across the Eyre Peninsula.
paras.zh: “没有证据表明我们（周四）可以在艾尔半岛上看到龙卷风。

paras.en: "So certainly, 170km/h is something we couldn't really confirm. It's probably unlikely at this stage because the state record for South Australia is 167km/h. That was set in Woomera back in 1979."
paras.zh: “所以，当然，170 公里/小时是我们无法真正确认的。现阶段这可能不太可能，因为南澳大利亚的州记录是 167 公里/小时。这是 1979 年在伍默拉创下的。”

paras.en: The images of collapsed and damaged towers at Wharminda on Eyre Peninsula are reminiscent of the scenes that accompanied the 2016 statewide blackout, when towers were felled in the state's mid north.
paras.zh: 艾尔半岛沃明达 (Wharminda) 塔楼倒塌和受损的画面让人想起 2016 年全州停电期间的场景，当时该州中北部的塔楼被倒塌。

paras.en: At a media conference on Friday afternoon, Mr Trento said that following the 2016 event, transmission line design standards were improved.
paras.zh: 在周五下午的媒体发布会上，特伦托先生表示，继 2016 年事件之后，输电线路设计标准得到了提高。

paras.en: Asked whether there was a structural fault in the new towers, Mr Trento conceded that was a possibility, but expressed confidence that the towers had been constructed in accordance with the appropriate standards.
paras.zh: 当被问及新塔楼是否存在结构性故障时，特伦托先生承认有可能，但表示相信塔楼是按照适当标准建造的。

paras.en: "We are investigating … but at this point in time, seeing the localisation of the event, we do think that the towers have been designed and constructed effectively,"
paras.zh: “我们正在调查......但目前，看到事件的本地化，我们确实认为这些塔楼的设计和建造是有效的，”

paras.en: "We think the wind that has entered those towers has been above the specification that we've constructed it to.
paras.zh: “我们认为进入这些塔的风已经超出了我们建造塔的规格。

paras.en: "We could have been looking at a 250km/h wind session. We just don't know."
paras.zh: “我们本来可以看到时速 250 公里的风。我们只是不知道。”

paras.zh: 该局距离印度 2016 年对阵英格兰队的历史最高测试成绩 7 分 759 分还差 39 分。

articles.title: Elon Musk looks to break up with MAGA. To what end?
articles.author: Mark Gollom

paras.en: Elon Musk looks to break up with MAGA. To what end?
paras.zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 希望与 MAGA 分手。为了什么目的？

paras.en: 'I'm not MAGA', Musk said this week, 2 years after declaring himself 'dark MAGA'
paras.zh: 在宣称自己是“黑暗的 MAGA”两年后，马斯克本周表示，“我不是 MAGA”

paras.en: From his first time donning a black MAGA hat and declaring himself "dark MAGA" at an October 2024 rally for Donald Trump to his multimillon-dollar splurge on Republican candidates ahead of this month's midterms, Elon Musk has certainly seemed to embrace the Make America Great Again movement.
paras.zh: 从他在 2024 年 10 月支持唐纳德·特朗普的集会上首次戴上黑色 MAGA 帽子并宣称自己为“黑暗 MAGA”，到本月中期选举前向共和党候选人挥霍数百万美元，埃隆·马斯克似乎无疑支持“让美国再次伟大”运动。

paras.en: Why does that matter? Because the Tesla and Space X CEO now appears to be distancing himself from his MAGA bonafides, saying that he never really considered himself a MAGA adherent.
paras.zh: 为什么这很重要？因为这位特斯拉和 Space X 的首席执行官现在似乎与他的 MAGA 真诚者保持距离，称他从未真正认为自己是 MAGA 的追随者。

paras.en: "I'm not MAGA," Musk declared earlier this week, in an interview with The New York Times.
paras.zh: “我不是 MAGA，”马斯克本周早些时候在接受《纽约时报》采访时宣称。

paras.en: "I'm not sure what MAGA means," he said during the newspaper's DealBook Summit. "If that means sort of blind adherence to a set of policies by the Republican Party, then I certainly don't have that. I think there are positives and negatives in both parties."
paras.zh: “我不确定 MAGA 是什么意思，”他在该报的 DealBook 峰会上说道。 “如果这意味着盲目遵守共和党的一系列政策，那么我当然不会这样做。我认为两党都有积极和消极的一面。”

paras.en: That may come as a surprise considering Musk made at least five appearances between 2024 and 2025 in which he associated himself with the movement, according to Mediaite, a news website.
paras.zh: 据新闻网站 Mediaite 报道，考虑到马斯克在 2024 年至 2025 年间至少五次露面，并在其中将自己与该运动联系起来，这可能会让人感到意外。

paras.en: But Musk's MAGA split appears to come at a time when association to the brand could prove to be a business and legal liability for the world's richest man.
paras.zh: 但马斯克的 MAGA 分裂似乎是在与该品牌的关联可能被证明是世界首富的商业和法律责任之际发生的。

paras.en: "It's so transparently convenient," said Matthew Dallek, a professor of political management and historian at the D.C.-based George Washington University, who has researched the MAGA movement.
paras.zh: “这显然很方便，”华盛顿乔治华盛顿大学政治管理学教授和历史学家马修·达莱克（Matthew Dallek）说，他研究了 MAGA 运动。

paras.en: Musk's comments follow the Republicans' disastrous showing in the U.S. midterms and the so-called Democratic blue wave that saw the party take control of the House and the Senate.
paras.zh: 马斯克发表此番言论之前，共和党在美国中期选举中表现不佳，并在所谓的民主党蓝色浪潮中控制了众议院和参议院。

paras.en: Along with MAGA-boosting appearances, Musk also spent more than $400 million U.S. on Trump-aligned Republican candidates in the midterms — the most money of any individual campaign donor.
paras.zh: 除了“MAGA”的亮相外，马斯克还在中期选举中向与特朗普结盟的共和党候选人花费了超过 4 亿美元——这是所有个人竞选捐助者中投入最多的。

paras.en: "Now that [MAGA]'s on the losing side, all of a sudden, he's not MAGA," said Todd Belt, a professor of political management at George Washington University.
paras.zh: 乔治华盛顿大学政治管理学教授托德·贝尔特 (Todd Belt) 表示：“现在，[MAGA] 处于失败的一方，突然之间，他就不再是 MAGA。”

paras.en: "I mean, come on. This is just laughable. This is the guy who glossed himself 'dark MAGA' and had black MAGA stuff put together ... when Trump took over. He was completely in with it."
paras.zh: “我的意思是，拜托。这太可笑了。这个人把自己打扮成‘黑暗的MAGA’，并把黑色的MAGA东西放在一起……当特朗普上任时。他完全参与其中。”

paras.en: Prof. Matthew Dallek says Elon Musk, seen speaking before Donald Trump at a campaign rally on Oct. 27, 2024, made his 'MAGA bed' and now must lie in it. (Evan Vuccu/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 马修·达莱克教授表示，人们看到埃隆·马斯克在 2024 年 10 月 27 日的竞选集会上在唐纳德·特朗普面前发表讲话，他为自己准备了“MAGA 床”，现在必须躺在上面。 （埃文·武库/美联社）

paras.en: Dallek said Musk has spent years making his "MAGA bed."
paras.zh: 达莱克说，马斯克花了数年时间打造他的“MAGA床”。

paras.en: "Now he's got to lie in it, even when it's politically uncomfortable."
paras.zh: “现在他必须撒谎，即使这在政治上令人不安。”

paras.en: Musk, who also urged his followers on X to vote Republican, now says he feels "pretty foolish" for spending so much money on the midterms. He also said in his NYT interview that ideologically he is "quite moderate" and doesn't have any "extreme political views."
paras.zh: 马斯克还敦促 X 上的追随者投票给共和党，现在他表示，他觉得在中期选举上花了这么多钱“非常愚蠢”。他还在《纽约时报》采访中表示，在意识形态上他“相当温和”，没有任何“极端政治观点”。

paras.en: But Dallek said if he's really such a moderate and not part of the MAGA ranks, there were non-MAGA Republicans he could have backed during the elections.
paras.zh: 但达莱克表示，如果他真的是一个温和派，并且不属于“让美国再次伟大”的行列，那么他本可以在选举期间支持一些非“让美国再次伟大”的共和党人。
