paras.en: Instead, Musk spent around $200 million US backing Texas Senate nominee Ken Paxton, who Dallek called, "arguably the most MAGA of all the midterm candidates."
paras.zh: 相反，马斯克花费了约 2 亿美元支持德克萨斯州参议院候选人肯·帕克斯顿，达莱克称他“可以说是所有中期候选人中最伟大的”。

paras.en: - Elon Musk calls documentary about him a 'hit piece' after buzzy debut
paras.zh: - 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 称有关他的纪录片在首映后成为“热门作品”

paras.en: - Satellite limitations imposed by Musk's SpaceX pose danger for Ukraine, Zelenskyy says
paras.zh: - 泽连斯基表示，马斯克旗下 SpaceX 实施的卫星限制对乌克兰构成危险

paras.en: Musk has based himself and several of his companies in Texas, including Tesla, SpaceX and a planned chipmaking venture between the two. But the state is almost all blue following the U.S. midterms.
paras.zh: 马斯克将自己和他的几家公司的总部设在德克萨斯州，包括特斯拉、SpaceX 以及两家公司计划成立的芯片制造合资企业。但在美国中期选举之后，该州几乎全是蓝色的。

paras.en: "The government is no longer in the hands of his allies," Dallek said. "He is in a very vulnerable position. Businesses are very vulnerable."
paras.zh: “政府不再掌握在他的盟友手中，”达莱克说。 “他处于非常脆弱的地位。企业也非常脆弱。”

paras.en: Dallek also questioned just how "moderate" Musk is, as he's has turned X into a platform for extremist views. As well, a February 2025 NBC News report said Musk had been encouraging right-wing political movements, policies and administrations in at least 18 countries as part of a global push to slash immigration and curtail regulation of business.
paras.zh: 达莱克还质疑马斯克到底有多“温和”，因为他已经将 X 变成了极端主义观点的平台。此外，NBC 新闻 2025 年 2 月的一篇报道称，马斯克一直在至少 18 个国家鼓励右翼政治运动、政策和政府，作为全球推动削减移民和限制商业监管的一部分。

paras.en: "It's just transparently false when he says, 'I'm a moderate,'" Dallek said.
paras.zh: “当他说‘我是温和派’时，这显然是错误的，”达莱克说。

paras.en: One reason: The MAGA brand is at its lowest net favourability ever, said CNN’s chief data analyst Harry Enten.
paras.zh: 原因之一是：美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 首席数据分析师哈里·恩滕 (Harry Enten) 表示，MAGA 品牌的净好感度正处于历史最低水平。

paras.en: "It is a brand that is failing amongst the American public," he said.
paras.zh: “这个品牌在美国公众中正在失败，”他说。

paras.en: But perhaps more importantly, Musk may be trying to engender better relations with Democrats as he faces government probes and red tape.
paras.zh: 但也许更重要的是，在面临政府调查和繁文缛节之际，马斯克可能正试图与民主党建立更好的关系。

paras.en: Democrats have indicated they may want to investigate the months Musk spent in 2025 spearheading the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE).
paras.zh: 民主党人表示，他们可能想要调查马斯克在 2025 年领导政府效率部 (DOGE) 的几个月。

paras.en: DOGE team activities led to widespread dismantling of foreign aid programs, as well as allegations that team members breached privacy laws by illegally accessing the sensitive data of Americans.
paras.zh: DOGE 团队的活动导致对外援助计划的广泛取消，并指控团队成员非法访问美国人的敏感数据，违反了隐私法。

paras.en: Musk may also face slower approvals for the billions of dollars Space X plans to invest in data centre campuses in Texas and Arizona.
paras.zh: SpaceX 计划投资德克萨斯州和亚利桑那州数据中心园区的数十亿美元，马斯克也可能面临审批缓慢的情况。

paras.en: "They're going to be turning their eyes toward him and his space facilities, and the environmental issues that they're causing and tax issues," Belt said. "Things that could really make life difficult for him. He doesn't want to poke the bear."
paras.zh: 贝尔特说：“他们将把目光转向他和他的太空设施，以及它们造成的环境问题和税收问题。” “这些事情确实会让他的生活变得困难。他不想戳熊。”

paras.en: With files from The Associated Press and Reuters
paras.zh: 来自美联社和路透社的文件

articles.title: Israeli settler violence at unprecedented levels during Palestinian olive harvest
articles.author: Margaret Evans

paras.en: Israeli settler violence at unprecedented levels during Palestinian olive harvest
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦橄榄收获期间以色列定居者的暴力行为达到前所未有的水平

paras.en: Critics say Netanyahu’s far-right government is letting it happen
paras.zh: 批评者称内塔尼亚胡的极右翼政府任由这种情况发生

paras.en: "It’s so random and doesn’t have any rules. You don’t know where it could come from, or in which intensity. Which weapon, how many?"
paras.zh: “它是如此随机，没有任何规则。你不知道它从哪里来，也不知道它的强度如何。哪种武器，有多少？”

paras.en: Wala Zoran is talking about attacks by Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank during the annual olive harvest.
paras.zh: 瓦拉·佐兰正在谈论以色列定居者在每年橄榄收获期间在被占领的约旦河西岸发动的袭击。

paras.en: We met her on Oct. 11 while she was standing with a group of fellow Palestinians, warily watching some settlers standing alongside Israeli soldiers on the other side of an olive grove in the village of Abu Mash’al. One settler had a rifle slung across his back.
paras.zh: 10 月 11 日，我们见到了她，当时她正与一群巴勒斯坦同胞站在一起，警惕地看着一些定居者与以色列士兵站在 Abu Mash’al 村橄榄园的另一边。一名定居者背上挂着一支步枪。

paras.en: Zoran and her family, including her elderly grandparents, were attacked by settlers in the grove the day before while trying to harvest their olives.
paras.zh: 佐兰和她的家人，包括她年迈的祖父母，前一天在树林里试图收割橄榄时遭到了定居者的袭击。

paras.en: "They started throwing big stones at us and we realized that we can’t take the olives — we can’t take anything, actually," she said. "We started running, but they were so close. Everybody was hit with the stones, like my father, my sister. I was. My cousin was shot in the leg, actually, and had to spend the night in hospital."
paras.zh: “他们开始向我们扔大石头，我们意​​识到我们不能拿走橄榄——实际上，我们不能拿走任何东西，”她说。 “我们开始逃跑，但他们离得太近了。每个人都被石头击中，比如我的父亲、我的妹妹。我也是。实际上，我表弟的腿中弹了，不得不在医院过​​夜。”

paras.en: Wala Zoran and her family were attacked by settlers on Oct. 10, while trying to harvest their olives in the West Bank village of Abu Mash’al. (CBC)
paras.zh: 10 月 10 日，瓦拉·佐兰 (Wala Zoran) 和她的家人在约旦河西岸的阿布·马什阿尔 (Abu Mash’al) 村庄试图采摘橄榄时遭到定居者的袭击。 （加拿大广播公司）

paras.en: This despite their efforts to avoid a confrontation.
paras.zh: 尽管他们努力避免对抗，但情况还是如此。

paras.en: There have been more settler attacks against Palestinians and their property during this year’s olive harvest than in 20 years of record-keeping by the United Nations.
paras.zh: 今年橄榄收获期间，定居者针对巴勒斯坦人及其财产的袭击次数比联合国记录的 20 年来还要多。

paras.en: Like many Palestinians, Zoran’s family has changed how they harvest in a bid to stay safe. They try to gather their olives in quick bursts, not waiting until the big tarpaulins they put on the ground to catch the olives are full before ferrying them back home.
paras.zh: 和许多巴勒斯坦人一样，佐兰的家人改变了收割方式，以确保安全。他们试图快速收集橄榄，而不是等到铺在地上的大防水布满了才把它们运回家。

paras.en: They also wait to begin picking until other families from the village are able to join.
paras.zh: 他们还要等到村里的其他家庭能够加入才开始采摘。

paras.en: Israeli soldiers and settlers are seen side by side in Abu Mash’al in the Occupied West Bank. According to the United Nations, Israeli settler attacks, often with Israeli military protection, numbered close to 400 for October alone. (CBC)
paras.zh: 在被占领的约旦河西岸的阿布马沙勒，以色列士兵和定居者肩并肩。据联合国称，仅 10 月份，以色列定居者发动的袭击（通常是在以色列军事保护下）就接近 400 起。 （加拿大广播公司）

paras.en: Zoran lives in France but returns home to help her family with the annual harvest. She’s worried her parents will have to make another attempt this year to finish the harvest.
paras.zh: 佐兰住在法国，但回到家乡帮助家人收获每年的庄稼。她担心父母今年必须再次尝试才能完成收成。

paras.en: "People depend on olive oil here," she said. "We can’t just say, 'OK, I don’t feel like doing it this year.'"
paras.zh: “这里的人们依赖橄榄油，”她说。 “我们不能只是说，‘好吧，我今年不想这样做。’”

paras.en: The olive industry contributes up to 15 per cent of agricultural GDP in the Palestinian economy.
paras.zh: 橄榄产业占巴勒斯坦经济农业国内生产总值的 15%。

paras.en: A family harvests olives in the Palestinian town of Beit Surik, on the western edge of the occupied West Bank. Some groves lie behind the separation barrier built by Israel in the early 2000s, which snakes onto Palestinian land in some parts, cutting farmers off from their trees. (CBC)
paras.zh: 一个家庭在被占领的约旦河西岸西部边缘的巴勒斯坦小镇拜特苏里克收获橄榄。一些树林位于以色列 2000 年代初期修建的隔离墙后面，隔离墙的某些部分蜿蜒延伸到巴勒斯坦土地上，切断了农民与树木的联系。 （加拿大广播公司）

paras.en: On the other side of the family's olive grove, the IDF soldiers eventually left after lobbing tear gas into the trees where a few Palestinians had remained.
paras.zh: 在自家橄榄园的另一边，以色列国防军士兵向树上投掷催泪瓦斯，那里还剩下一些巴勒斯坦人，最终他们离开了。

paras.en: The settlers then gathered up the olives left behind and drove off with them in the direction of what’s known as an outpost.
paras.zh: 然后，定居者收集了留下的橄榄，并带着它们朝所谓的前哨站的方向出发。

paras.en: All Israeli settlements in the occupied territories, including East Jerusalem, are illegal under international law. Israel continues to expand them while also tolerating — and often facilitating — a growing number of outposts, small camps from which Jewish extremists try to push Palestinians from their land. Even Israel considers them illegal, at least on paper.
paras.zh: 根据国际法，以色列在包括东耶路撒冷在内的被占领土上的所有定居点都是非法的。以色列继续扩大这些基地，同时也容忍并经常为越来越多的前哨基地和小型营地提供便利，犹太极端分子试图将巴勒斯坦人从他们的土地上赶走。就连以色列也认为它们是非法的，至少在纸面上是这样。

paras.en: More than 180 outposts have been created since 2023, according to the Israeli settlement watch group Peace Now, many of them close to Palestinian population centres.
paras.zh: 据以色列定居点观察组织“立即和平”称，自 2023 年以来已建立了 180 多个前哨基地，其中许多前哨基地靠近巴勒斯坦人口中心。

paras.en: Political analyst and researcher Ibrahim Rabaya’a says it’s one reason violence is surging during this year’s harvest. He describes the speed with which the outposts are spreading as a "strategic escalation" by settlers emboldened by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanhayu and his far-right government.
paras.zh: 政治分析家兼研究员易卜拉欣·拉巴亚 (Ibrahim Rabaya’a) 表示，这是今年收获期间暴力事件激增的原因之一。他将前哨基地的扩张速度描述为定居者在以色列总理本杰明·内塔哈尤及其极右翼政府的鼓励下的“战略升级”。

paras.en: "We are talking about … a very organized process, very organized players," said Rabaya’a during an interview at his home in Ramallah. "[The settlers] are well-trained. They are working in general as an army, militias."
paras.zh: “我们正在谈论……一个非常有组织的过程，非常有组织的参与者，”拉巴亚在拉马拉的家中接受采访时说道。 “[定居者]训练有素。他们总体上像军队、民兵一样工作。”

paras.en: It's especially striking how emboldened the settlers are compared to even a year ago — whether in groups of two or three harassing Palestinian herders and their livestock or forming battle lines in large numbers, masked and terrifying.
paras.zh: 与一年前相比，定居者的胆量尤其令人震惊——无论是两三人一组骚扰巴勒斯坦牧民及其牲畜，还是大批戴着面具、令人恐惧地排成战线。

paras.en: CBC News witnessed the latter while visiting Abu Falah, one of a cluster of villages in the central West Bank, on Oct. 13.
paras.zh: 10 月 13 日，CBC 新闻在访问阿布法拉赫（Abu Falah）时目睹了后者，阿布法拉赫是约旦河西岸中部的一个村庄群之一。

paras.en: We arrived just a few hours after settlers had descended from a hilltop outpost above the town and taken axes to dozens of olive trees.
paras.zh: 就在我们抵达几个小时后，定居者从小镇上方的山顶前哨站下来，用斧头砍倒了数十棵橄榄树。

paras.en: The residents had blocked the road leading from the base of the hill into the town with heavy stones to stop the settlers from going any further by vehicle.
paras.zh: 居民们用重石封锁了从山脚通往城镇的道路，以阻止定居者乘车继续前行。

paras.en: When the Palestinians led our news crew to see the damaged trees on foot, the settlers spotted us and started back down the hill, some on foot, running at full speed with sticks and slingshots. Others were driven down in the backs of white pickup trucks. They were masked and dressed in black.
paras.zh: 当巴勒斯坦人带领我们的新闻工作人员步行查看受损的树木时，定居者发现了我们，并开始下山，有些人是步行的，拿着棍棒和弹弓全速奔跑。其他人则被装在白色皮卡车的后座上。他们戴着面具，身穿黑衣。

paras.en: When the call went out to Abu Falah’s residents to defend their groves, they picked up rocks of their own on the way, moving through the olive trees to the outer perimeter, later firing firecrackers at the settlers as they advanced.
paras.zh: 当阿布法拉赫的居民接到保护他们的树林的号召时，他们在路上捡起了自己的石头，穿过橄榄树到达外围，随后在定居者前进时向他们发射鞭炮。

paras.en: "Every single day we have attacks and every single day we’re out in the field defending people," said Diyaa Murra, a university student volunteering with the Palestinian Red Crescent.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦红新月会志愿者大学生迪亚·穆拉 (Diyaa Murra) 表示：“我们每天都会遇到袭击，我们每天都在前线保护人民。”

paras.en: Palestinian emergency services are under increased pressure during the harvest, with the Israeli NGO Yesh Din charting more than 25 settler incidents a day during the harvest, from vandalism to physical assault.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦紧急服务部门在收割期间面临着越来越大的压力，以色列非政府组织 Yesh Din 记录了收割期间每天发生超过 25 起定居者事件，从破坏公物到人身攻击。

paras.en: Ambulances try to position themselves in areas where repeat attacks take place to avoid being delayed by Israeli military checkpoints or imposed closures.
paras.zh: 救护车试图将自己安置在经常发生袭击的地区，以避免被以色列军事检查站延误或强行关闭。

paras.en: "I think the only way to defend ourselves from the settlers is to engage with everybody in defending the village," said Murra, who was born in Abu Falah. "So I decided to work with the Red Crescent to be part of the defence system. That’s the only way."
paras.zh: 出生于阿布法拉赫的穆拉说：“我认为，保护自己免受定居者侵害的唯一方法是与每个人一起保卫村庄。” “所以我决定与红新月会合作，成为防御系统的一部分。这是唯一的方法。”

paras.en: The melee continued in Abu Falah until the Israeli Defence Forces (IDF) arrived, firing tear gas canisters in the direction of the Palestinians retreating from the bottom of the hill.
paras.zh: 阿布法拉赫的混战一直持续到以色列国防军抵达，并向从山下撤退的巴勒斯坦人发射催泪弹。

paras.en: A few days later, the settlers attacked Abu Falah again, making international headlines after a U.S. photojournalist for the Washington Post named Heidi Levine was severely beaten by settlers who surrounded her.
paras.zh: 几天后，定居者再次袭击阿布·法拉赫，《华盛顿邮报》的美国摄影记者海蒂·莱文 (Heidi Levine) 被包围她的定居者毒打，成为国际头条新闻。

paras.en: Before we left Abu Falah on the day we visited, we counted at least 40 settlers involved in the attack clearly visible and back up on top of the hill.
paras.zh: 参观那天，在我们离开阿布法拉赫之前，我们数了一下，参与袭击的至少 40 名定居者清晰可见，并回到了山顶。

paras.en: Yet we witnessed only one arrest: a Palestinian man handcuffed and blindfolded as Israeli soldiers led him toward a military vehicle.
paras.zh: 然而，我们只目睹了一次逮捕：一名巴勒斯坦男子被戴上手铐并蒙住眼睛，以色列士兵将他带向一辆军车。

paras.en: Later, we learned the father of five had been held for three days and fined for throwing stones.
paras.zh: 后来我们得知，这位五个孩子的父亲因投掷石块而被拘留了三天并被罚款。

paras.en: The Palestinians say they have little else with which to defend themselves.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦人表示，他们没有其他手段可以保卫自己。

paras.en: "[Palestinians know] most of the settlers are protected by the army," said Mohammad Ahmad, a Palestinian American waiting for the olives he managed to collect to be processed at a mill in Silwad, a town about 10 kilometres from Abu Falah.
paras.zh: “（巴勒斯坦人知道）大多数定居者都受到军队的保护，”巴勒斯坦裔美国人穆罕默德·艾哈迈德在距离阿布法拉赫约 10 公里的锡尔瓦德镇的一家工厂里等待他设法收集的橄榄进行加工。

paras.en: "Even the young settlers [… ] under the age of 18 and 17 years old, they have weapons, you know."
paras.zh: “即使是 18 岁和 17 岁以下的年轻定居者 [...]，他们也拥有武器，你知道。”

paras.en: Olives picked in the West Bank are processed at a mill in Silwad, a town about 10 kilometres from Abu Falah. (CBC)
paras.zh: 在西岸采摘的橄榄在锡尔瓦德 (Silwad) 的一家工厂进行加工，该镇距离阿布法拉赫 (Abu Falah) 约 10 公里。 （加拿大广播公司）

paras.en: Ahmad says this season’s violence is impacting livelihoods and yields, including his own.
paras.zh: 艾哈迈德说，本季的暴力事件正在影响人们的生计和产量，包括他自己的。

paras.en: "I have never experienced or felt the way we’re feeling right now, because of the settlers and because of what’s going on," he said. "And we’re not allowed to reach most of our lands."
paras.zh: “我从未经历过或感受到我们现在的感受，因为定居者和正在发生的事情，”他说。 “而且我们不被允许到达我们的大部分土地。”

paras.en: Many Palestinians are required to co-ordinate access to their own olive trees with the IDF, depending on where they’re located.
paras.zh: 许多巴勒斯坦人需要与以色列国防军协调获取自己橄榄树的事宜，具体取决于他们所在的位置。

paras.en: On Tuesday, the IDF issued a statement on social media saying that 90 per cent of what it called "co-ordinated harvests" had been completed. It also denied claims that security forces were deliberately preventing the olive harvest.
paras.zh: 周二，以色列国防军在社交媒体上发表声明称，其所谓的“协调收割”工作已完成 90%。它还否认有关安全部队故意阻止橄榄收获的说法。

paras.en: The Palestinian Farmers Union responded, saying that as of late October, 55 per cent of the overall olive crop "remained inaccessible or unharvested."
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦农民联盟回应称，截至 10 月底，55% 的橄榄作物“仍然无法获取或尚未收获”。

paras.en: Israeli forces arrived early in the morning of October 21st, keeping the Palestinian villagers of Deir Jarir from reaching their olive groves. (CBC)
paras.zh: 以色列军队于 10 月 21 日清晨抵达，阻止代尔贾里尔的巴勒斯坦村民进入他们的橄榄园。 （加拿大广播公司）

paras.en: Israeli security forces can often declare areas of confrontation between Palestinians and settlers closed military zones.
paras.zh: 以色列安全部队经常可以宣布巴勒斯坦人和定居者之间的对抗地区为军事区。

paras.en: That’s what happened when our crew arrived in Deir Jarir, another town in the central West Bank, on Oct. 21.
paras.zh: 这就是 10 月 21 日我们的工作人员抵达约旦河西岸中部另一个城镇代尔贾里尔时所发生的情况。

paras.en: After settlers ambushed an initial attempt to harvest olives, the Palestinians invited Israeli and international activists to accompany them on a second try, hoping they might offer protection.
paras.zh: 定居者在第一次采摘橄榄的尝试中遭到伏击后，巴勒斯坦人邀请以色列和国际活动人士陪同他们进行第二次尝试，希望他们能够提供保护。

paras.en: But when they arrived at the muster point carrying ladders and olive rakes, the villagers found an armoured vehicle and a handful of IDF soldiers blocking the road.
paras.zh: 但当他们带着梯子和橄榄耙到达集合点时，村民们发现一辆装甲车和几名以色列国防军士兵挡住了道路。

paras.en: "They are telling us that our farms are closed military zones and we cannot leave, and we’re stuck here," 72-year-old Abu Asif told CBC News.
paras.zh: 72 岁的阿布·阿西夫 (Abu Asif) 告诉 CBC 新闻：“他们告诉我们，我们的农场是军事禁区，我们无法离开，我们被困在这里。”

paras.en: The IDF has said its security forces operate to "prevent friction and violence, enabling residents to harvest safely."
paras.zh: 以色列国防军表示，其安全部队的行动是为了“防止摩擦和暴力，使居民能够安全收割”。

paras.en: In some instances, Israeli soldiers themselves have uprooted entire olive groves, saying they could be used by Palestinians to hide in and as a launching point for attacks.
paras.zh: 在某些情况下，以色列士兵自己连根拔起整个橄榄园，称巴勒斯坦人可能会利用它们隐藏并作为袭击的发起点。

paras.en: Palestinians say it’s simply one more way Israel is trying to remove them from their land.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦人表示，这只是以色列试图将他们从自己的土地上赶走的又一种方式。

paras.en: "Our life under occupation has always been difficult," said Abu Asif. "But this time, this season, it’s the most difficult and the hardest."
paras.zh: “我们在占领下的生活一直很困难，”阿布·阿西夫说。 “但这一次，这个赛季，是最困难、最艰难的。”

paras.en: Prime Minister Netanyahu has dismissed the settler attacks as the work of a "small minority."
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡总理将定居者的袭击斥为“少数人”所为。

paras.en: But Israeli lawyer and peace activist Daniel Seideman says that what’s happening in the West Bank couldn’t be done without Netanyahu's "knowledge, consent and blessing."
paras.zh: 但以色列律师兼和平活动家丹尼尔·塞德曼表示，如果没有内塔尼亚胡的“知情、同意和祝福”，西岸发生的事情就不可能发生。

paras.en: "The Palestinians are defenceless," he said in an interview at his office in Jerusalem. "The military is either in bed with the settlers, doing the settlers' bidding or turning a blind eye and saying, 'This isn’t our responsibility.'"
paras.zh: “巴勒斯坦人毫无防御能力，”他在耶路撒冷的办公室接受采访时说。 “军方要么与定居者同床共枕，执行定居者的命令，要么视而不见并说，‘这不是我们的责任。’”

paras.en: "It’s clear that the settlers see this as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to ethnically cleanse the West Bank," Seideman said, adding that he didn’t use the term lightly.
paras.zh: 塞德曼说：“很明显，定居者认为这是对西岸进行种族清洗的千载难逢的机会。”他补充说，他并没有轻易使用这个词。

paras.en: Seideman spoke to CBC News ahead of last month’s Israeli election, which many believed would see Netanyahu’s tenure come to an end. At the time of publication, it's still unclear who will ultimately form a government.
paras.zh: 塞德曼在上个月以色列大选前接受了 CBC 新闻采访，许多人认为这次大选将导致内塔尼亚胡的任期结束。截至本文发布时，尚不清楚最终谁将组建政府。

paras.en: Analyst Ibrahim Rabaya’a says while a change in government could rein in some of the settler violence, few Palestinians believe it would slow the de facto annexation of the West Bank.
paras.zh: 分析师易卜拉欣·拉巴亚表示，虽然政府更迭可能会遏制一些定居者的暴力行为，但很少有巴勒斯坦人相信这会减缓对约旦河西岸事实上的吞并。

paras.en: "It is also a strategy for other political players in Israel, but they try to do so without bringing anger from international society," he said. "What we can [call] silent annexation."
paras.zh: “这也是以色列其他政治参与者的策略，但他们试图这样做而不引起国际社会的愤怒，”他说。 “我们可以称之为无声吞并。”

paras.en: Political analyst Ibrahim Rabaya’a says the proliferation of settler outposts in the West Bank is one reason violence is surging during this year’s olive harvest. (CBC)
paras.zh: 政治分析家易卜拉欣·拉巴亚 (Ibrahim Rabaya’a) 表示，约旦河西岸定居者前哨基地的激增是今年橄榄收获期间暴力事件激增的原因之一。 （加拿大广播公司）

paras.en: None of the other main Jewish political parties are on the record supporting a Palestinian state, although Yair Golan’s Democrats have indicated they would potentially support it in the future.
paras.zh: 尽管亚伊尔戈兰的民主党人表示他们未来可能会支持巴勒斯坦国，但其他主要犹太政党都没有记录支持巴勒斯坦国。

paras.en: The olive harvest is a favourite target for Israeli hard-liners, precisely because it is such a potent cultural symbol of Palestinians' connection to the land.
paras.zh: 橄榄收获是以色列强硬派最喜欢的目标，正是因为它是巴勒斯坦人与土地联系的强有力的文化象征。

paras.en: Rabaya’a says that in addition to the daily hardships of living under occupation, the settlers have been trying to increase psychological pressure on Palestinians.
paras.zh: 拉巴亚说，除了在占领下生活的日常艰辛外，定居者还试图增加对巴勒斯坦人的心理压力。

paras.en: Over the past several months, Israeli flags have started appearing along the main road from Ramallah up to the northern cities of Nablus and Jenin.
paras.zh: 在过去的几个月里，从拉马拉到北部城市纳布卢斯和杰宁的主要道路上开始出现以色列国旗。

paras.en: And along that road in the town of Luban al Sharqiya, settlers arrived one night in October to completely swamp a Palestinian roadside café with Israeli flags.
paras.zh: 十月的一个晚上，定居者沿着卢班阿尔沙奇亚镇的那条路抵达，把一家挂着以色列国旗的巴勒斯坦路边咖啡馆完全淹没了。

paras.en: The owner, Muayad Hussein, who lives with his family in a house just behind the café, says that when he heard them, he was too afraid to come out.
paras.zh: 店主穆亚德·侯赛因 (Muayad Hussein) 和家人住在咖啡馆后面的一所房子里，他说，当他听到他们的声音时，他不敢出来。

paras.en: He showed CBC News the images captured by his security camera: dozens of young Jewish extremists pounding the flags into the ground. An Israeli police car can be seen parked on the other side of the road. Someone hands out drinks as they work.
paras.zh: 他向加拿大广播公司新闻频道展示了他的安全摄像头拍摄到的图像：数十名年轻的犹太极端分子将旗帜砸在地上。可以看到一辆以色列警车停在路的另一边。有人在工作时分发饮料。

paras.en: Hussein told us one of the settlers from a nearby outpost warned him that if he took the flags down, they would come back.
paras.zh: 侯赛因告诉我们，附近前哨站的一名定居者警告他，如果他取下旗帜，他们就会回来。

paras.en: He’s afraid they will. So the flags remain.
paras.zh: 他担心他们会的。所以旗帜仍然存在。

paras.en: Muayad Hussein, who owns a roadside café in the town of Luban al Sharqiya, looks at the Israeli flags that were hammered into the ground outside his shop by a group of settlers. (CBC)
paras.zh: 穆亚德·侯赛因 (Muayad Hussein) 在卢班阿尔沙奇亚 (Luban al Sharqiya) 镇拥有一家路边咖啡馆，他看着店外一群定居者将以色列国旗钉在地上。 （加拿大广播公司）

articles.title: UN talks on AI in warfare end with no commitment to binding rules
articles.author: Sarah Petz

paras.en: UN talks on AI in warfare end with no commitment to binding rules
paras.zh: 联合国关于战争中人工智能的谈判结束，但没有承诺制定具有约束力的规则

paras.en: Most countries supported working towards treaty, but some major military powers resisted
paras.zh: 大多数国家支持签署条约，但一些主要军事大国抵制

paras.en: UN-backed talks this week on regulating AI in warfare ended Saturday with nations agreeing to further discussions, but without a consensus on developing firm rules on how to rein in deadly autonomous weapons.
paras.zh: 联合国支持的本周关于在战争中监管人工智能的谈判于周六结束，各国同意进一步讨论，但没有就制定如何控制致命自主武器的严格规则达成共识。

paras.en: Proponents for regulations including UN Secretary General António Guterres had called for a legally binding treaty within a short time frame on AI weapons like drones that could identify and kill without human involvement.
paras.zh: 包括联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯在内的法规支持者呼吁在短时间内就无人驾驶飞机等人工智能武器制定一项具有法律约束力的条约，这些武器可以在没有人类参与的情况下进行识别和杀戮。

paras.en: The discussions ran Monday to Friday at a Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons meeting in Geneva. More than 100 countries that are party to the convention, including Canada, were expected to take part.
paras.zh: 周一至周五在日内瓦举行的《特定常规武器公约》会议上进行了讨论。预计包括加拿大在内的 100 多个公约缔约国将参加。

paras.en: Though most countries supported working towards the treaty, some military powers like the U.S. and Russia resisted committing to binding rules that would limit them in developing such high-tech weapons. That resulted in a softened agreement to "elaborate" a possible accord on such lethal autonomous weapons systems by 2028.
paras.zh: 尽管大多数国家支持为该条约而努力，但美国和俄罗斯等一些军事大国拒绝承诺制定限制其开发此类高科技武器的约束性规则。这导致了一项软化的协议，即到 2028 年就此类致命自主武器系统“详细阐述”可能达成的协议。

paras.en: Izumi Nakamitsu, the UN high representative for disarmament affairs, hailed a "significant achievement" but acknowledged a "glass half full or half empty" scenario, citing Guterres's hopes for a legally binding deal this year.
paras.zh: 联合国裁军事务高级代表中满泉对这一“重大成就”表示欢迎，但也承认存在“半满或半空”的情况，并表示古特雷斯希望今年达成一项具有法律约束力的协议。

paras.en: However, some advocacy groups bemoaned the blocking of stronger language at a time when AI is increasingly becoming a factor in deadly strikes.
paras.zh: 然而，一些倡导团体对在人工智能日益成为致命袭击的一个因素之际屏蔽更强硬的语言表示遗憾。

paras.en: "States have agreed it is sufficient to just talk about the issue, for the 14th year, while these weapons enable atrocities," said Max Tegmark, a machine learning specialist at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and founder of the Future of Life Institute.
paras.zh: 麻省理工学院机器学习专家、未来生命研究所创始人 Max Tegmark 表示：“各国已经同意，在这些武器助长暴行的同时，已经连续 14 年只讨论这个问题了。”

paras.en: The outcome is disappointing but expected, said Branka Marijan, senior fellow at the Centre for International Governance Innovation and senior researcher with anti-war organization Project Ploughshares.
paras.zh: 国际治理创新中心高级研究员、反战组织“犁铧计划”高级研究员布兰卡·马里詹表示，结果令人失望，但也在意料之中。

paras.en: Marijan says military superpowers like the U.S. and Russia have resisted legally binding rules.
paras.zh: 马里詹表示，美国和俄罗斯等军事超级大国一直抵制具有法律约束力的规则。

paras.en: "There is a real issue here of political will. There's just no political will among the major militaries to have legally binding instruments and hard laws," she said.
paras.zh: “这里存在一个真正的政治意愿问题。主要军队之间没有政治意愿来制定具有法律约束力的文书和硬性法律，”她说。

paras.en: AI is being used increasingly in conflicts around the world to gain advantage in battle.
paras.zh: 人工智能在世界各地的冲突中越来越多地被使用，以在战斗中获得优势。

paras.en: Both Russia and Ukraine are using AI to track targets and plan attacks in the war entering its fifth year. In Ukraine, there are reports that autonomous drones operated by Russia have killed civilians, while Ukraine has also reportedly tested such weapons.
paras.zh: 在进入第五个年头的战争中，俄罗斯和乌克兰都在使用人工智能来跟踪目标并计划攻击。在乌克兰，有报道称俄罗斯操作的自主无人机杀死了平民，而乌克兰也据报道测试了此类武器。

paras.en: The U.S. has made a major push to increase its use of AI in combat, and is testing advanced fighter drones that fly themselves.
paras.zh: 美国大力推动人工智能在战斗中的应用，并正在测试先进的自动飞行战斗机。

paras.en: The need for regulation has become more urgent as the world sees this "incredibly dangerous move" towards the development and deployment of increasingly capable autonomous weapons systems — without any guardrails, Marijan said.
paras.zh: 马里詹说，随着世界看到这种在没有任何护栏的情况下开发和部署能力日益增强的自主武器系统的“极其危险的举动”，监管的必要性变得更加迫切。

paras.en: "I think there's extreme scenarios, but there are very immediate risks and concerns if you think about the fact that each country could deploy these systems now and there are no real constraints," she said.
paras.zh: “我认为存在极端情况，但如果你考虑到每个国家现在都可以部署这些系统并且没有真正的限制这一事实，就会存在非常直接的风险和担忧，”她说。

paras.en: CBC News reached out to Global Affairs Canada and the Department of National Defence for comment.
paras.zh: 加拿大广播公司新闻联系了加拿大全球事务部和国防部征求评论。

paras.en: - The age of AI warfare has dawned. Is Canada ready?
paras.zh: - 人工智能战争时代已经到来。加拿大准备好了吗？

paras.en: - Military commander vows fast action on AI and robots, sees 'untapped potential' for Canada
paras.zh: - 军事指挥官誓言对人工智能和机器人迅速采取行动，看到加拿大“未开发的潜力”

paras.en: In a statement sent to CBC News earlier this month, the Department of National Defence said the Canadian Armed Forces supports the development of autonomous functionality on the condition that it would be "operated within a responsible chain of human command and control and commits to uphold the reliable and lawful use of such weapon systems."
paras.zh: 在本月早些时候发给加拿大广播公司新闻的一份声明中，国防部表示，加拿大武装部队支持自主功能的开发，条件是该功能将“在负责任的人类指挥和控制链内运行，并承诺维护此类武器系统的可靠和合法使用”。

paras.en: Canada was among the countries that agreed to a declaration on how to govern use of artificial intelligence in warfare at a military AI summit in Spain in February.
paras.zh: 加拿大是二月份在西班牙举行的军事人工智能峰会上同意就如何管理战争中人工智能的使用发表声明的国家之一。

paras.en: In 2025, Canada also supported a UN resolution calling on countries to lay the groundwork for possible negotiations on a treaty governing the use of lethal autonomous weapons systems.
paras.zh: 2025年，加拿大还支持一项联合国决议，呼吁各国为可能的关于管理致命自主武器系统使用的条约的谈判奠定基础。

paras.en: The UN's Nakamitsu called for countries to begin work towards a deal as early as Monday and "start thinking about how to get as strong as possible [an] instrument to prohibit and regulate lethal autonomous weapon systems."
paras.zh: 联合国的中满呼吁各国最早在周一开始努力达成协议，并“开始考虑如何建立尽可能强大的工具来禁止和监管致命性自主武器系统”。

paras.en: With files from Jennifer Yoon and The Associated Press
paras.zh: 来自 Jennifer Yoon 和美联社的文件

articles.title: Anthropic researcher uses AI to solve math's greatest riddle

paras.en: A mathematician working for AI giant Anthropic says he used the company's Claude AI tool to solve one of mathematics most famous problems.
paras.zh: 人工智能巨头 Anthropic 的一位数学家表示，他使用该公司的 Claude AI 工具解决了最著名的数学问题之一。

paras.en: The Riemann hypothesis dates back to 1859 and centers on the distribution of prime numbers underpinning a much wider scope of mathematical work.
paras.zh: 黎曼假设可以追溯到 1859 年，其核心是素数分布，支撑着更广泛的数学工作。

paras.en: Levent Alpoge, a member of Anthropic's technical staff, made the announcement on his website. "I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis," Levent Alpoge wrote in a note released Friday.
paras.zh: Anthropic 技术人员 Levent Alpoge 在他的网站上宣布了这一消息。 “我相信我与克劳德合作，发现了黎曼猜想的证明，”莱文特·阿尔波格在周五发布的一份报告中写道。

paras.en: The proof still has to be verified and confirmed by other mathematicians. If it withstands independent examination, it would be a major milestone both in mathematics and the growing role of artificial intelligence (AI) in scientific research.
paras.zh: 该证明仍有待其他数学家的验证和确认。如果它经受住独立检验，这将是数学和人工智能（AI）在科学研究中日益重要的作用的一个重要里程碑。

paras.en: The Riemann hypothesis is the latest and most important in a string of famous mathematical problems that were tackled with the help of AI.
paras.zh: 黎曼假设是人工智能帮助解决的一系列著名数学问题中最新且最重要的一个。

paras.en: What did Alpoge say about the breakthrough?
paras.zh: Alpoge 对这一突破有何评价？

paras.en: Alpoge said that the collaboration with AI had generated more than 250,000 pages of mathematical material, adding that he had not yet mastered all the mathematics involved.
paras.zh: Alpoge 表示，与 AI 的合作生成了超过 25 万页的数学材料，并补充说他尚未掌握所涉及的所有数学知识。

paras.en: "Claude and I have had a great time together with such breadth in recent months, but this time Claude far outpaced me near the finish line," he wrote. "No, Claude flew, and danced, and sparkled near that finish line."
paras.zh: “近几个月来，克劳德和我一起度过了一段美好的时光，但这次克劳德在终点线附近远远超过了我，”他写道。 “不，克劳德在终点线附近飞翔、跳舞、闪闪发光。”

paras.en: The Riemann Hypothesis is one of seven major mathematical problems, the so-called Millennium Prize Problems, selected by the Clay Mathematics Institute, which offers $1 million for a solution to each of those.
paras.zh: 黎曼猜想是克莱数学研究所选出的七大数学问题之一，即所谓的“千年奖问题”，该研究所为每个问题的解决方案提供 100 万美元。

paras.en: "This is an announcement of historic significance," Martin Bridson, president of the institute, said in a statement quoted by news agency AP.
paras.zh: 该研究所所长马丁·布里德森在美联社援引的一份声明中表示：“这是一项具有历史意义的公告。”

paras.en: He added it "holds the promise of a dramatic transformation in the perception of what is possible in the struggle to extend the human understanding of mathematics."
paras.zh: 他补充说，它“有望在扩展人类对数学理解的斗争中实现巨大转变。”

paras.en: "But the journey from today’s announcement to a place of real understanding will be long and difficult."
paras.zh: “但从今天的宣布到真正理解的过程将是漫长而艰难的。”

paras.en: Formulated by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in the 19th century, the hypothesis is about the distribution of prime numbers, which are numbers that can only be divided by themselves and the number 1.
paras.zh: 该假设由德国数学家伯恩哈德·黎曼 (Bernhard Riemann) 在 19 世纪提出，涉及素数的分布，素数是只能被自身和数字 1 整除的数字。

paras.en: The hypothesis describes a fundamental pattern of how these numbers are distributed as they become ever larger. Confirming that hypothesis is thought to have crucial implications for a wide range of further mathematical research.
paras.zh: 该假设描述了这些数字在变得越来越大时如何分布的基本模式。证实这一假设被认为对广泛的进一步数学研究具有至关重要的影响。

paras.en: The potential breakthrough by Alpoge and Claude AI comes amid a growing number of examples where artificial intelligence systems are making significant contributions to advanced mathematical research.
paras.zh: Alpoge 和 Claude AI 的潜在突破正值越来越多的例子表明人工智能系统正在为高级数学研究做出重大贡献。

paras.en: In September, rival AI company OpenAI said its technology had helped solve a problem involving the Navier-Stokes equations.
paras.zh: 9 月，竞争对手人工智能公司 OpenAI 表示，其技术帮助解决了涉及纳维-斯托克斯方程的问题。

paras.en: The equations, which describe the movement of fluids such as water and air, are another of the seven Millennium Prize Problems, but the claim that they've been solved also still needs independent verification.
paras.zh: 这些描述水和空气等流体运动的方程是七个千年奖问题中的另一个，但声称它们已被解决的说法仍然需要独立验证。

articles.title: Russia strikes Zelenskyy's hometown, killing 2

paras.en: Russian ballistic missile strikes on Ukraine's southern city of Kryvyi Rih — President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's hometown — killed two people and wounded dozens of others, local officials said Saturday.
paras.zh: 当地官员周六表示，俄罗斯弹道导弹袭击了乌克兰南部城市克里沃罗格（总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基的家乡），造成两人死亡、数十人受伤。

paras.en: The attacks come amid little progress in talks to end the nearly five-year-old war and after Ukraine, on three occasions this week, struck the Kerch bridge linking Russian-occupied Crimea with Russia.
paras.zh: 这些袭击发生之际，结束近五年战争的谈判几乎没有取得任何进展，而且乌克兰本周三度袭击了连接俄罗斯占领的克里米亚和俄罗斯的刻赤大桥。

paras.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin had vowed a "painful" response to the Kerch attack, as the bridge is vital for war supplies for Russian forces in the south.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京誓言将对刻赤袭击事件做出“痛苦”回应，因为这座桥对于俄罗斯南部军队的战争补给至关重要。

paras.en: Among the dead in Friday evening's double-tap strikes on Kryvyi Rih were a 7-year-old boy and a 20-year-old woman, while several children were among the 60 wounded, the Ukrainian officials said.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员称，周五晚上对克里沃罗格的两次袭击造成死者包括一名 7 岁男孩和一名 20 岁妇女，60 名伤者中有几名儿童。

paras.en: Several fires broke out and damage was caused to about 25 apartment buildings, a hospital, schools and an industrial facility, Oleksandr Vilkul, the head of the city administration, wrote on Telegram.
paras.zh: 市政府负责人 Oleksandr Vilkul 在 Telegram 上写道，发生了多起火灾，约 25 栋公寓楼、一家医院、学校和一处工业设施遭到破坏。

paras.en: Moscow, meanwhile, confirmed a further strike on Friday night in Kryvyi Rih.
paras.zh: 与此同时，莫斯科确认周五晚上在克里沃罗格发动进一步罢工。

paras.en: Russia's Defense Ministry said a thermal power plant in the city was hit, along with a power substation in the region of Rivne, on the opposite side of the country.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部表示，该市的一座火力发电厂以及该国另一侧罗夫诺地区的一座变电站均遭到袭击。

paras.en: Both facilities supply electricity to the industry supporting Ukraine's military, the ministry added.
paras.zh: 该部补充说，这两个设施都为支持乌克兰军队的行业提供电力。

paras.en: Elsewhere in the nearly five-year-long war, Russia also struck a cargo vessel near Odesa, which Moscow said was carrying dual-use goods for the Ukrainian military.
paras.zh: 在这场近五年战争的其他地方，俄罗斯还在敖德萨附近袭击了一艘货船，莫斯科称这艘货船正在为乌克兰军方运送军民两用物资。

paras.en: Eleven people, including two children, were wounded when a Russian drone attacked a five-story apartment building in the northeastern Kharkiv region, Ukraine’s State Emergency Service said Saturday.
paras.zh: 乌克兰国家紧急服务部门周六表示，一架俄罗斯无人机袭击了哈尔科夫东北部地区的一栋五层公寓楼，造成包括两名儿童在内的 11 人受伤。

paras.en: One person was wounded in a Russian attack on the capital, Kyiv, according to the service.
paras.zh: 据该部门称，俄罗斯在首都基辅发动的袭击中造成一人受伤。

paras.en: In Russia, local officials said Saturday that Ukrainian drone attacks wounded three people in the Bryansk and Belgorod border regions.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯，当地官员周六表示，乌克兰无人机袭击在布良斯克和别尔哥罗德边境地区造成三人受伤。

paras.en: Finland, meanwhile, said it detected a drone attack on Saturday morning on a Russian cargo ship in the eastern Baltic Sea, prompting Prime Minister Petteri Orpo to warn that the war is "spilling over into our immediate vicinity."
paras.zh: 与此同时，芬兰表示，周六早上，它在波罗的海东部发现一艘俄罗斯货船遭到无人机袭击，促使芬兰总理佩特里·奥尔波警告称，战争正在“蔓延到我们附近”。

paras.en: After damage to Russia's Kerch bridge to Crimea, Zelenskyy warned in an interview with US broadcaster NBC that the structure "will not remain standing anyway."
paras.zh: 俄罗斯通往克里米亚的刻赤大桥遭到破坏后，泽连斯基在接受美国全国广播公司采访时警告称，该建筑“无论如何都不会保持原样”。

articles.title: Dozens missing as deadly fire hits Indonesian candy factory

paras.en: Indonesian rescue teams are searching for 36 workers who remained unaccounted for after a fire at a candy-making factory killed at least three people, officials said on Sunday.
paras.zh: 印尼官员周日表示，一家糖果制造厂发生火灾，造成至少三人死亡，印尼救援队正在寻找 36 名下落不明的工人。

paras.en: The fire occurred at the Fonusa Agung Mulia factory, around 50 kilometers (31 miles) west of the capital, Jakarta, in the Serang district of Banten province.
paras.zh: 火灾发生在位于首都雅加达以西约 50 公里（31 英里）处万丹省 Serang 区的 Fonusa Agung Mulia 工厂。

paras.en: What do we know about the Indonesian confectionery factory fire?
paras.zh: 我们对印度尼西亚糖果厂火灾了解多少？

paras.en: The factory caught fire on Saturday afternoon, local search and rescue agency official Rizky Dwianto said.
paras.zh: 当地搜救机构官员里兹基·德维安托 (Rizky Dwianto) 表示，该工厂于周六下午起火。

paras.en: "All elements of the joint SAR (search-and-rescue) team are making maximum effort to locate the victims while prioritizing the safety of personnel in the field," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“联合搜救队的所有人员都在尽最大努力寻找受害者，同时优先考虑现场人员的安全。”

paras.en: Rizky said four people injured in the blaze had been taken to a nearby hospital and health clinic. Eleven more were said to have been rescued alive.
paras.zh: 里兹基说，四名在火灾中受伤的人已被送往附近的医院和诊所。据说还有11人被生还。

paras.en: The governor of Banten province, Andra Soni, told reporters overnight that 60 people were believed to have been inside the factory when the fire broke out.
paras.zh: 万丹省省长安德拉·索尼 (Andra Soni) 连夜告诉记者，据信火灾发生时工厂内有 60 人。

paras.en: Drone footage shows the fire destroyed large sections of the three-story building, bringing down the roof in some places.
paras.zh: 无人机拍摄的画面显示，大火摧毁了这座三层建筑的大部分区域，部分地方的屋顶被烧毁。

paras.en: Survivors said the fire started in a cooling unit on the third floor.
paras.zh: 幸存者表示，火灾是从三楼的一个冷却装置开始的。

paras.en: The factory produces Milkita, an Indonesian brand of milk-based candies and snack products.
paras.zh: 该工厂生产印度尼西亚品牌 Milkita 的牛奶糖果和零食产品。

paras.en: Indonesia has seen a series of deadly industrial fires in recent years, raising questions about the country's workplace safety standards into question.
paras.zh: 近年来，印度尼西亚发生了一系列致命的工业火灾，引发了对该国工作场所安全标准的质疑。

paras.en: Among other disasters, at least 22 people were killed in a fire last December that broke out in a seven-story building in Jakarta after a suspected drone battery explosion, police said.
paras.zh: 警方表示，去年 12 月，雅加达一栋七层建筑疑似无人机电池爆炸，引发火灾，造成至少 22 人死亡。

paras.en: An explosion in a nickel-processing plant in the east of the country killed at least 13 people in 2023.
paras.zh: 2023 年，该国东部一家镍加工厂发生爆炸，造成至少 13 人死亡。

articles.title: Displaced Darfur families face volatile winter as Sudan aid cuts bite

paras.en: Omdurman, Sudan – When Fatima Mohamed Haroun was displaced from West Darfur state at the start of Sudan’s war in 2023, she never imagined she would find herself caring for four of her grandchildren far from her home.
paras.zh: 苏丹恩图曼 — 2023 年苏丹战争爆发时，法蒂玛·穆罕默德·哈龙 (Fatima Mohamed Haroun) 从西达尔富尔州流离失所，她从未想过自己会在远离家乡的地方照顾四个孙子。

paras.en: Haroun, who believes she is aged about 60, said her son went missing a year ago. His wife died after giving birth, leaving Haroun as the sole guardian of her four grandchildren.
paras.zh: 哈伦 (Haroun) 认为自己大约 60 岁，她说她的儿子一年前失踪。他的妻子在生下孩子后去世，哈伦成为她四个孙子的唯一监护人。

paras.en: Now living in a crumbling mudbrick building in al-Ghadir, north of Omdurman, in Khartoum state, she has received no humanitarian assistance since her displacement.
paras.zh: 她现在住在喀土穆州恩图曼北部加迪尔一栋摇摇欲坠的泥砖建筑里，自从流离失所以来，她没有得到过任何人道主义援助。

paras.en: Without an income, it is only the goodwill of her neighbours that prevents Haroun and her grandchildren from starving. But every day is a battle to find food, water or medicine, and with winter fast approaching, proper shelter, warm clothes, and blankets for the children are another priority.
paras.zh: 没有收入，只有邻居的善意才让哈伦和她的孙子们免于挨饿。但每天都是寻找食物、水或药品的战斗，随着冬天的临近，为孩子们提供适当的住所、保暖的衣服和毯子是另一个优先事项。

paras.en: “I cannot work or earn money, so we depend on neighbours who occasionally give us food. But even our neighbours sometimes have nothing to eat. When they have no food, my grandchildren and I go to bed hungry,” she told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “我无法工作或赚钱，所以我们依靠邻居偶尔给我们食物。但即使是我们的邻居有时也没有东西吃。当他们没有食物时，我和我的孙子们就饿着肚子上床睡觉，”她告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: “We have no supplies to help us cope with the cold, not even blankets to keep us warm. We sleep on the ground with only the sky above us. The cold is severe, and the children are suffering. We appeal to the government and humanitarian organisations to provide food, blankets, covers and other basic necessities to help us endure the cold and protect our children.”
paras.zh: “我们没有御寒物资，甚至连保暖的毯子都没有。我们睡在地上，头顶是天空。天气很冷，孩子们很痛苦。我们呼吁政府和人道主义组织提供食物、毯子、被子和其他基本生活必需品，帮助我们抵御严寒，保护我们的孩子。”

paras.en: Temperatures can drop significantly in Omdurman during the winter, and at night al-Ghadir can be particularly cold due to its location close to mountainous areas. Displaced families living in temporary shelters here are especially vulnerable because they lack blankets, winter clothing and heating facilities.
paras.zh: 恩图曼冬季气温会大幅下降，而加迪尔由于靠近山区，晚上会特别寒冷。居住在这里的临时避难所的流离失所家庭尤其容易受到伤害，因为他们缺乏毯子、冬衣和取暖设施。

paras.en: The war in Sudan, which broke out between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary in April 2023, has led to one of the world’s worst humanitarian crises.
paras.zh: 2023 年 4 月，苏丹武装部队 (SAF) 和准军事部队快速支援部队 (RSF) 之间爆发的苏丹战争导致了世界上最严重的人道主义危机之一。

paras.en: Khartoum state, which was initially one of the epicentres of the war but is now relatively more stable, continues to host large numbers of people forced to flee their homes, particularly from southern and western Sudan where fighting is ongoing. Millions of people in areas such as Darfur have experienced or are at risk of horrific violence, forcing them to flee to other parts of Sudan or neighbouring countries where they live in horrendous conditions.
paras.zh: 喀土穆州最初是战争的震中之一，但现在相对更加稳定，继续收容大量被迫逃离家园的人，特别是来自战斗正在进行的苏丹南部和西部的人。达尔富尔等地区的数百万人经历过或面临可怕暴力的风险，迫使他们逃往苏丹其他地区或邻国，在那里他们的生活条件极其恶劣。

paras.en: As of July 30, Khartoum state was hosting 414,252 internally displaced people, according to data from the International Organization for Migration’s (IOM) Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM).
paras.zh: 根据国际移民组织 (IOM) 流离失所追踪矩阵 (DTM) 的数据，截至 7 月 30 日，喀土穆州收容了 414,252 名境内流离失所者。

paras.en: Winter is expected to worsen conditions for families living in temporary shelters or unfinished buildings without adequate blankets and warm clothing.
paras.zh: 对于居住在临时避难所或未完工的建筑中、没有足够的毯子和保暖衣物的家庭来说，冬季的情况预计会更加恶化。

paras.en: Sudan has more than 8.5 million internally displaced people, according to DTM Sudan, with the IOM and the United Nations refugee agency (UNHCR) warning that millions are still without a roof over their heads and risk losing access to emergency shelters due to funding shortages.
paras.zh: 据 DTM 苏丹统计，苏丹有超过 850 万境内流离失所者，国际移民组织和联合国难民署 (UNHCR) 警告称，数百万人仍然无家可归，并且由于资金短缺而面临无法进入紧急避难所的风险。

paras.en: About 15.4 million people in Sudan need emergency shelter and basic household items. The agencies said funding shortages mean humanitarian organisations can prioritise assistance for only 10 percent of those in need, leaving millions without support.
paras.zh: 苏丹约有 1540 万人需要紧急住所和基本生活用品。这些机构表示，资金短缺意味着人道主义组织只能优先为 10% 有需要的人提供援助，导致数百万人得不到支持。

paras.en: Fighting, general insecurity, drone attacks on civilian infrastructure and camps, as well as other logistical challenges were all obstructing aid deliveries, the agencies said. Less than half of the funding for Sudan’s 2026 Humanitarian Response Plan, which requires $2.9bn to assist 20.4 million people in need, had been received, forcing humanitarian agencies to scale back some services.
paras.zh: 这些机构表示，战斗、普遍的不安全局势、无人机对民用基础设施和营地的袭击以及其他后勤挑战都阻碍了援助的运送。苏丹2026年人道主义应对计划需要29亿美元来援助2040万有需要的人，但该计划收到的资金还不到一半，迫使人道主义机构缩减了部分服务。

paras.en: Abdelaziz Suleiman Ori, director of culture and information for the Darfur regional government, said his administration was monitoring the conditions for displaced people in host states, including Khartoum, and coordinating humanitarian assistance.
paras.zh: 达尔富尔地区政府文化和信息主任阿卜杜拉齐兹·苏莱曼·奥里表示，他的政府正在监测包括喀土穆在内的东道国流离失所者的状况，并协调人道主义援助。

paras.en: The regional government has drawn up a winter plan that includes blankets, clothing and food to respond to the impending crisis, but Ori acknowledged that available resources were so far insufficient.
paras.zh: 地方政府已经制定了冬季计划，其中包括毯子、衣服和食物，以应对即将到来的危机，但奥里承认，迄今为止可用的资源不足。

paras.en: “Since the outbreak of the war on April 15, Governor Minni Arko Minawi has dispatched humanitarian convoys from Port Sudan to el-Fasher, passing through Madani, Kosti and El Obeid. We are also in contact with international organisations and UN agencies to monitor the situation of displaced people in different states,” Ori told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “自4月15日战争爆发以来，明尼·阿尔科·米纳维州长已从苏丹港派遣人道主义车队，途经马达尼、科斯蒂和奥贝德前往法希尔。我们还与国际组织和联合国机构保持联系，以监测不同州流离失所者的情况，”奥里告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: “Our winter plan includes blankets, clothing, food and children’s necessities. But our resources are not enough to meet the needs of the large number of displaced people. We appeal to humanitarian partners to provide more support.”
paras.zh: “我们的冬季计划包括毯子、衣服、食物和儿童必需品。但我们的资源不足以满足大量流离失所者的需求。我们呼吁人道主义伙伴提供更多支持。”

paras.en: Ori said that only a collective response – involving regional government, host states, local authorities and NGOs – can properly respond to the crisis.
paras.zh: 奥里表示，只有地方政府、东道国、地方当局和非政府组织参与的集体应对措施才能妥善应对危机。

paras.en: “Responsibility for displaced people is shared between the regional government, host states, local communities and humanitarian organisations,” he said.
paras.zh: “流离失所者的责任由地区政府、东道国、当地社区和人道主义组织共同承担，”他说。

paras.en: “We coordinate efforts, seek relief assistance and monitor their conditions with local authorities. We bear part of the responsibility, but need greater cooperation to ease their suffering.”
paras.zh: “我们与地方当局协调努力，寻求救援援助并监测他们的状况。我们承担部分责任，但需要加强合作以减轻他们的痛苦。”

paras.en: Kheira Matar Hassan, a resident of Darfur, passed through Renk, Rabak and Khartoum at the start of the war before settling in al-Ghadir camp in 2023. She became separated from her husband when he went looking for work in a gold mining area in Chad at the same time.
paras.zh: 达尔富尔居民凯拉·马塔尔·哈桑 (Kheira Matar Hassan) 于战争爆发时途经伦克、拉巴克和喀土穆，并于 2023 年在加迪尔难民营定居。当丈夫前往乍得金矿区寻找工作时，她与丈夫失散。

paras.en: She has received no word from him since he disappeared and has been left alone to support their seven children. They live in a dilapidated home built of bricks and mud bricks with damaged areas covered with cloth and plastic sheeting.
paras.zh: 自从他失踪后，她就没有收到他的任何消息，只能独自抚养他们的七个孩子。他们住在一栋用砖和泥砖搭建的破旧房屋里，受损的地方用布和塑料布覆盖。

paras.en: Hassan said she has received no support from the government or NGOs, and to support her children, she washes and irons clothes for families in the area, earning just enough money to buy food.
paras.zh: 哈桑说，她没有得到政府或非政府组织的支持，为了养活她的孩子，她为该地区的家庭洗熨衣服，赚的钱只够买食物。

paras.en: But her income is irregular, and if she has no customers, her family goes hungry. Lacking blankets or adequate shelter, she fears the impact that falling winter temperatures will have on her children. It stands in stark contrast to their former life, when her father worked as a farmer, and the family had enough food to eat.
paras.zh: 但她的收入不稳定，如果没有顾客，家人就会挨饿。由于缺乏毯子或足够的住所，她担心冬季气温下降会对孩子们产生影响。这与他们以前的生活形成了鲜明的对比，当时她的父亲是一名农民，一家人有足够的食物吃。

paras.en: “We are just here, trying to get by. Our circumstances are extremely difficult; we are really struggling here,” she told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “我们只是在这里，试图度过难关。我们的处境极其困难；我们真的在这里挣扎，”她告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: “We came from an area where we were not poor. We had our land, cultivated it and lived off what it produced. But the war brought us here. Please look at us and consider our circumstances. We are really suffering.”
paras.zh: “我们来自一个并不贫穷的地区。我们有自己的土地，耕种土地，靠土地生产为生。但战争把我们带到了这里。请看看我们，考虑一下我们的处境。我们真的很痛苦。”

articles.title: Kenya’s internet metering bill raises privacy and affordability concerns

paras.en: The Kenya Information and Communications (Amendment) Bill, 2025, sponsored by Aldai MP Marianne Jebet Kitany, seeks to make consumption-based internet billing mandatory. It would require providers to assign each customer a unique meter number, monitor usage, convert it into readable details and issue invoices based on consumption.
paras.zh: 由 Aldai 议员 Marianne Jebet Kitany 发起的 2025 年肯尼亚信息和通信（修正案）法案旨在强制实施基于消费的互联网计费。这将要求提供商为每个客户分配一个唯一的电表编号，监控使用情况，将其转换为可读的详细信息，并根据消耗情况开具发票。

paras.en: The debate has intensified as the National Assembly’s Departmental Committee on Communication, Information and Innovation considers the legislation. The regulator has urged legislators not to make metered billing compulsory, while Telkom Kenya has warned of potential consequences for privacy, affordability and investment.
paras.zh: 随着国民议会通信、信息和创新部门委员会审议该立法，争论变得更加激烈。监管机构敦促立法者不要强制实行计量计费，而肯尼亚电信公司则警告称，这可能会给隐私、负担能力和投资带来潜在后果。

paras.en: The International Commission of Jurists (ICJ) Kenya has questioned the necessity of mandatory metering, arguing that the regulator already has powers to address billing complaints and protect consumers.
paras.zh: 国际法学家委员会（ICJ）肯尼亚质疑强制计量的必要性，认为监管机构已经有权解决计费投诉并保护消费者。

paras.en: Demas Kiprono of ICJ Kenya has argued that the proposed system raises questions about whether the collection of identifiable usage information is necessary and proportionate to the Bill’s stated consumer-protection objective.
paras.zh: 国际法院肯尼亚分部的德马斯·基普罗诺 (Demas Kiprono) 认为，拟议的系统提出了关于收集可识别使用信息是否必要以及是否与该法案规定的消费者保护目标相称的问题。

paras.en: Kenya’s Data Protection Act, 2019, already provides a framework for processing personal information. Opponents of the Bill say Parliament should make clear how those protections would apply to the proposed metering system.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚 2019 年数据保护法已经提供了处理个人信息的框架。该法案的反对者表示，议会应该明确这些保护措施将如何适用于拟议的计量系统。

paras.en: Questions about telecommunications data have also featured in court proceedings involving university student David Ooga Mokaya.
paras.zh: 有关电信数据的问题也出现在涉及大学生 David Ooga Mokaya 的法庭诉讼中。

paras.en: He was arrested in November 2024 over a social media post concerning President William Ruto and charged with publishing false information. On February 19 this year, Senior Principal Magistrate Caroline Nyaguthii acquitted him under Section 215 of the Criminal Procedure Code, finding that the prosecution had not proved its case beyond reasonable doubt.
paras.zh: 他于 2024 年 11 月因在社交媒体上发布有关总统威廉·鲁托的帖子而被捕，并被指控发布虚假信息。今年2月19日，高级首席法官卡罗琳·尼亚古蒂（Caroline Nyaguthii）根据《刑事诉讼法》第215条宣告他无罪，认为检方未能毫无合理怀疑地证明其案件。

paras.en: On February 25, Justice Bahati Mwamuye issued interim conservatory orders restraining the respondents and interested parties from transferring, sharing or disclosing Mokaya’s personal data without his written consent, a valid court order or an express provision of written law permitting disclosure.
paras.zh: 2 月 25 日，法官巴哈蒂·姆瓦穆耶 (Bahati Mwamuye) 发布临时保护令，禁止被告和利害关系方在未经其书面同意、有效的法院命令或允许披露的成文法明确规定的情况下转让、共享或披露 Mokaya 的个人数据。

paras.en: The orders were issued pending further proceedings in the case. They do not establish that the proposed internet metering system would be used for surveillance. They do, however, illustrate the legal questions that can arise over the collection and disclosure of telecoms data.
paras.zh: 这些命令是在案件进一步审理期间发出的。他们没有确定拟议的互联网计量系统将用于监视。然而，它们确实说明了电信数据收集和披露可能出现的法律问题。

paras.en: Privacy is not the only concern. Mandatory consumption-based billing could also affect how households and businesses budget for connectivity.
paras.zh: 隐私并不是唯一的问题。强制性的基于消费的计费也可能影响家庭和企业的连接预算。

paras.en: In a submission to parliament on November 3, the Communications Authority cautioned against making metered billing compulsory across the sector. It said the approach could have unintended consequences for affordability, digital inclusion and consumer choice, particularly among low-income households, students, small businesses and communities in underserved areas.
paras.zh: 在 11 月 3 日向议会提交的一份文件中，通信管理局警告不要在整个行业强制实行计量计费。报告称，这种做法可能会对负担能力、数字包容性和消费者选择产生意想不到的影响，特别是对低收入家庭、学生、小企业和服务欠缺地区的社区。

paras.en: The regulator noted that background applications, software updates, streaming and cloud services can consume data without users closely monitoring their usage.
paras.zh: 监管机构指出，后台应用程序、软件更新、流媒体和云服务可能会消耗数据，而无需用户密切监控其使用情况。

paras.en: The Authority’s position is that consumer protection can be strengthened through regulations and licensing requirements without requiring every provider to adopt consumption-based pricing.
paras.zh: 该管理局的立场是，可以通过法规和许可要求加强消费者保护，而不要求每个提供商都采用基于消费的定价。

paras.en: The financial impact of a change would depend on providers’ pricing and individual patterns of internet use. Customers who consume relatively little data could benefit from paying according to usage, while those who rely on large or continuous data allowances could face different costs. The Bill does not set the retail prices providers would charge.
paras.zh: 变化的财务影响将取决于提供商的定价和个人的互联网使用模式。消耗相对较少数据的客户可以从按使用量付费中受益，而那些依赖大量或连续数据限额的客户可能会面临不同的成本。该法案没有规定提供商收取的零售价格。

paras.en: Telecommunications companies have questioned whether the proposed changes could impose additional costs on providers and affect investment in broadband services.
paras.zh: 电信公司质疑拟议的变更是否会给提供商带来额外成本并影响宽带服务的投资。

paras.en: Telkom Kenya Chief Executive Officer Mugo Kibati told the parliamentary committee on November 10 that mobile internet accounts for about 96 percent of data subscriptions and is already billed by volume. The proposed changes would therefore mainly affect fixed broadband services, which account for the remaining share, he said.
paras.zh: Telkom Kenya 首席执行官 Mugo Kibati 于 11 月 10 日向议会委员会表示，移动互联网约占数据订阅量的 96%，并且已经按流量计费。他表示，拟议的变化将主要影响占剩余份额的固定宽带服务。

paras.en: Carole Kairuki, chief executive of the Kenya Private Sector Alliance, also raised concerns about the potential effect of mandatory metering on businesses. In an interview with Al Jazeera, she said changes to internet billing could increase compliance costs and make connectivity expenses less predictable for businesses, particularly smaller enterprises.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚私营部门联盟首席执行官卡罗尔·凯鲁基也对强制计量对企业的潜在影响表示担忧。她在接受半岛电视台采访时表示，互联网计费的变化可能会增加合规成本，并使企业（尤其是小型企业）的连接费用更难以预测。

paras.en: The Bill’s memorandum says the proposed amendments are intended to protect consumers from exploitation and secure their economic interests under Article 46 of the Constitution. It also states that the legislation does not limit fundamental rights and freedoms.
paras.zh: 该法案的备忘录称，拟议的修正案旨在保护消费者免受剥削，并根据宪法第 46 条保障他们的经济利益。它还指出，该立法不限制基本权利和自由。

paras.en: The debate comes amid wider public scrutiny of digital rights and the handling of online activity in Kenya, particularly following the 2024 protests against the Finance Bill. Kelvin Kubai, an Advocate of the High Court of Kenya, told Al Jazeera that internet access is important to young people’s civic participation and their ability to hold public officials accountable. He argued that any new regulatory framework should take those uses into account.
paras.zh: 此次辩论正值公众对肯尼亚的数字权利和在线活动处理进行更广泛的审查，特别是在 2024 年针对《金融法案》的抗议活动之后。肯尼亚高等法院律师凯尔文·库拜 (Kelvin Kubai) 告诉半岛电视台，互联网接入对于年轻人的公民参与和追究公职人员责任的能力非常重要。他认为任何新的监管框架都应该考虑到这些用途。

paras.en: Parliament must weigh the Bill’s consumer-protection objective against concerns raised by the regulator, internet providers and civil society groups. The Communications Authority has proposed greater billing transparency, usage alerts and independent audits as alternatives to compulsory consumption-based billing.
paras.zh: 议会必须权衡该法案的消费者保护目标与监管机构、互联网提供商和民间社会团体提出的担忧。通信管理局提议提高计费透明度、使用警报和独立审计，作为强制消费计费的替代方案。

paras.en: Telkom CEO Kibati warned politicians against imposing obligations that could undermine a developing sector.
paras.zh: Telkom 首席执行官基巴蒂警告政界人士不要强加可能损害发展中行业的义务。

paras.en: “Sometimes you can go overboard in trying to protect consumers that you actually kill a nascent, growing sector,” he told the parliamentary committee.
paras.zh: 他对议会委员会表示：“有时，你可能会太过于试图保护消费者，但实际上却扼杀了一个新兴的、不断增长的行业。”

articles.title: What Sandpapergate reveals about Australian cricket

paras.en: “I knew it was wrong. I knew that using sandpaper was not simply pushing the boundaries of the laws of cricket. It was cheating,” former Australian Test cricketer Cameron Bancroft wrote in a 4,000-word expose.
paras.zh: “我知道这是错误的。我知道使用砂纸不仅仅是突破板球规则的界限。这是作弊，”前澳大利亚测试板球运动员卡梅伦·班克罗夫特在一篇 4000 字的揭露中写道。

paras.en: His frank admission that he knowingly cheated and then lied to investigators and the Australian public was raw.
paras.zh: 他坦率地承认自己故意作弊，然后向调查人员和澳大利亚公众撒谎，这一点很原始。

paras.en: The footage of Bancroft shoving sandpaper down the front of his trousers, in an attempt to hide his illegal ball tampering during the 2018 Test series between South Africa and Australia, has been seen all over the world; the act of cheating has never been in question.
paras.zh: 班克罗夫特在 2018 年南非和澳大利亚之间的测试系列赛中，将砂纸塞进裤子前面，试图掩盖他非法篡改球的镜头，这一镜头已在全世界流传；作弊行为从来没有受到过质疑。

paras.en: But the fallout, eight years in the making, no longer centres on a square of sandpaper. It revolves around a culture that placed winning above sound ethics. It created such deep-seated fear that lying – both directly and by omission – became a means to survive, and ultimately exposed the national belief that Australian men’s cricket was underpinned by a sacred sense of “mateship” – standing above self-interest – as a myth.
paras.zh: 但经过八年的酝酿，其后果不再集中在一块砂纸上。它围绕着一种将胜利置于健全道德之上的文化。它造成了如此根深蒂固的恐惧，以至于说谎——无论是直接的还是不经意的——成为一种生存手段，并最终暴露了一种全国性的信念，即澳大利亚男子板球运动是由神圣的“伙伴关系”意识支撑的——高于个人利益——是一个神话。

paras.en: The basic facts of Australia’s ball-tampering scandal have long been established. Bancroft, with the tacit encouragement of teammate David Warner and under then-captain Steve Smith, who elected to look the other way, executed a premeditated plan to alter the ball’s surface during the third Test in Cape Town, in order to promote reverse swing.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚篡球丑闻的基本事实早已确定。班克罗夫特在队友大卫·华纳和时任队长史蒂夫·史密斯的默许下，在开普敦的第三次测试中执行了一项有预谋的计划，改变球的表面，以促进反向挥杆。

paras.en: Once he was caught, the public outrage and revulsion were overwhelming. Cricket Australia, the national cricket governing body, rushed through an inadequate investigation, omitting many of the touring party, and concluding that knowledge of the plan was confined to Bancroft, Warner and Smith. It imposed draconian penalties: yearlong bans for Smith and Warner, nine months for Bancroft.
paras.zh: 他被捕后，引起了公众的愤怒和反感。国家板球管理机构澳大利亚板球协会匆忙进行了一次不充分的调查，遗漏了许多巡演人员，并得出结论认为，只有班克罗夫特、华纳和史密斯知道该计划。它施加了严厉的处罚：史密斯和华纳被禁赛一年，班克罗夫特被禁赛九个月。

paras.en: Coach Darren Lehmann eventually stood down, followed out the door by several support staff, administrators and board members.
paras.zh: 达伦·莱曼教练最终下台，几名支持人员、管理人员和董事会成员也跟着走出了门。

paras.en: The cone of silence surrounding the affair cracked open with the release of Usman Khawaja’s autobiography, Sabr, in which he alleged everyone in the dressing room was in on the plan. Players and coaching staff came out publicly to either back Khawaja’s story or reject his version of events.
paras.zh: 随着乌斯曼·卡瓦贾 (Usman Khawaja) 的自传《萨布尔》(Sabr) 的出版，围绕这件事的沉默锥被打破，他在书中声称更衣室里的每个人都参与了这一计划。球员和教练组公开表示要么支持卡瓦贾的故事，要么拒绝他对事件的说法。

paras.en: Current team captain Pat Cummins, who was also part of the team in 2018, publicly insisted that he did not know about the use of sandpaper. This was reportedly the final straw for Bancroft: “It made me feel angry, betrayed and alone,” he wrote.
paras.zh: 现任队长帕特·康明斯（Pat Cummins）也是2018年球队的一员，他公开坚称他不知道砂纸的使用。据报道，这是压垮班克罗夫特的最后一根稻草：“这让我感到愤怒、被背叛和孤独，”他写道。

paras.en: For eight years he had borne the brunt of being labelled a cheat and watched his former teammates carry on with their Test careers – including Smith and Warner, after serving their bans.
paras.zh: 八年来，他首当其冲地被贴上了作弊者的标签，并看着他的前队友继续他们的测试生涯——包括史密斯和华纳，他们在禁赛结束后。

paras.en: Within hours of Cricket Australia’s announcement of an independent “truth forum” that would provide a “safe place” for discussion – a belated effort to stem the tide of damaging public confessions – Bancroft’s self-penned expose was published in The West Australian newspaper.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚板球协会宣布成立一个独立的“真相论坛”，为讨论提供一个“安全的场所”——这是为阻止破坏性的公开认罪浪潮而做出的迟来的努力——几小时后，班克罗夫特自笔的揭露就发表在《西澳大利亚报》上。

paras.en: Not only did he insist that everyone was in on the scheme, but it was not an isolated occurrence, as the investigation had concluded; he had also used sandpaper in the second Test in Gqeberha that year.
paras.zh: 他不仅坚称每个人都参与了这个计划，而且正如调查得出的结论，这并不是一个孤立的事件；那年在格克贝哈举行的第二次测试中他还使用了砂纸。

paras.en: “I made a terrible decision because I wanted to belong in the Australian team,” Bancroft wrote.
paras.zh: “我做出了一个糟糕的决定，因为我想加入澳大利亚队，”班克罗夫特写道。

paras.en: The context of his choice shouldn’t be overlooked. He was a 24-year-old adult, yet a junior member of the side playing in his seventh Test, and he desperately wanted to fit in.
paras.zh: 他的选择的背景不应该被忽视。他已经是一名 24 岁的成年人，但还是球队的初级成员，正在参加第七次测试，他非常想融入球队。

paras.en: The years leading up to the South Africa tour were defined by an increasingly toxic culture in which the boundaries of sportsmanship were tested, stretched and treated as pliable when convenient.
paras.zh: 南非之旅之前的几年是一种日益有毒的文化，在这种文化中，体育精神的界限受到考验、延伸，并在方便的时候被视为灵活的。

paras.en: The Australian men’s team were the self-appointed guardians of “the line”, their own behaviour consistently justified as being on the right side of what was acceptable under the mantra of playing “hard but fair”. There was a lack of strong and ethical leadership in the dressing room, from the coaching staff all the way up to the Cricket Australia boardroom.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚男队自封为“底线”的守护者，在“努力但公平”的口号下，他们自己的行为始终被认为是站在可接受的正确一边。从教练组一直到澳大利亚板球协会的董事会，更衣室里都缺乏强有力的、有道德的领导力。

paras.en: An independent, wide-ranging review by ethics nonprofit organisation The Ethics Centre, conducted in the aftermath of the affair, exposed a culture of “winning without counting the costs” that seeped throughout Cricket Australia. It was a culture in which staff and players feared the consequences of speaking honestly. It is no wonder that silence and dishonesty flourished in order to protect the brand and ensure self-preservation.
paras.zh: 事件发生后，道德非营利组织道德中心进行了一项独立、广泛的审查，揭露了澳大利亚板球运动中渗透的“不计成本获胜”的文化。在这种文化中，工作人员和球员都担心诚实说话的后果。难怪为了保护品牌和确保自我保护，沉默和不诚实行为盛行。

paras.en: “We were frightened,” Bancroft wrote. “We were under pressure. We were trying to manage a situation that was rapidly getting away from us.”
paras.zh: “我们很害怕，”班克罗夫特写道。 “我们面临着压力。我们正在努力应对正在迅速远离我们的局面。”

paras.en: While the on-field reputation of the Australian Test team has improved since 2018, fronted by captains Tim Paine and then Cummins, the blackened seeds sown were nourished by years of resentment and grievance, and have now emerged fully grown in blighted and twisted ugliness.
paras.zh: 尽管自 2018 年以来，在队长蒂姆·潘恩和康明斯的带领下，澳大利亚测试队在场上的声誉有所提高，但播下的黑色种子在多年的怨恨和委屈的滋养下，现在已经在枯萎和扭曲的丑陋中完全成熟。

paras.en: The complexity and nuance of ball-tampering have been overtaken by accusations of who knew what and a tug-of-war over who owns the truth – not to mention an administration that desperately hoped a web of half-truths and omissions would hold.
paras.zh: 篡改球的复杂性和细微差别已经被对谁知道什么的指控以及谁拥有真相的拉锯战所取代 — — 更不用说一个迫切希望半真半假和遗漏的网络能够维持下去的政府了。

paras.en: It has held a confronting mirror to the wider public’s veneration of “mateship”, the close bond of brotherhood that Australians have long held as core to their national identity. The baggy green cap worn by the country’s Test cricketers has been its unofficial symbol. Friendship may be universal, but mateship – that’s unique to Australia. The cap looks increasingly frayed with every public disclosure.
paras.zh: 它反映了广大公众对“伙伴关系”的崇敬，澳大利亚人长期以来一直将这种亲密的兄弟情谊作为其民族认同的核心。该国测试板球运动员所戴的宽松绿色帽子一直是其非官方标志。友谊可能是普遍的，但伙伴关系——这是澳大利亚独有的。随着每次公开披露，上限看起来都越来越磨损。

paras.en: For Australians to accept that a young player would consider cheating, and then lie about cheating, as the best way of fitting in with his “mates”, it would mean questioning this idea of national exceptionalism. It would mean accepting that self-interest would trump the sacrosanct bonds of selfless “mateship”.
paras.zh: 对于澳大利亚人来说，接受年轻球员会考虑作弊，然后谎称作弊是与“队友”相处的最佳方式，这将意味着质疑这种国家例外论的想法。这意味着接受自我利益将胜过无私“伙伴关系”的神圣纽带。

paras.en: There have been widespread calls for Australian cricket to move on and a growing collective weariness that this unseemly and unflattering saga continues to dominate the news landscape. Perhaps the reflection in the mirror is simply too confronting to sustain the gaze.
paras.zh: 人们普遍呼吁澳大利亚板球运动继续前进，并且越来越多的集体厌倦了这一不体面且不讨人喜欢的传奇故事继续主导新闻版图。也许镜子中的倒影实在是太过直面，无法让人凝视。

paras.en: There is an alternate universe in which Cricket Australia, in the aftermath of Newlands, could have stood the three central players down for the final Test, pending a full and thorough investigation that would have included all members of the touring party, rather than a select few. The players could have been supported and could have had the moral fortitude to be completely honest. An open and mature public conversation could have taken place about the nature of ball-tampering and any disciplinary action better reflected the nature of the “crime”. Responsibility could have been shared and Cricket Australia could have accepted its full portion.
paras.zh: 在另一个宇宙中，在纽兰兹之后，澳大利亚板球协会可以让三名核心球员参加最后的测试，等待全面彻底的调查，调查将包括巡回赛的所有成员，而不是精选的少数人。球员们本来可以得到支持，也可以有完全诚实的道德毅力。本来可以就篡改球的性质进行公开和成熟的公开对话，任何纪律处分都可以更好地反映“犯罪”的性质。责任本来可以分担，澳大利亚板球协会也可以接受全部责任。

paras.en: It wouldn’t have been easy; it would still have been controversial, but it would likely not have been what is now: an omnishambles of human and reputational wreckage that may yet prematurely end careers.
paras.zh: 这并不容易。它仍然会引起争议，但它可能不会是现在的样子：人类和声誉的废墟，可能会过早结束职业生涯。

paras.en: In 2018, Bancroft thought the Australian team “were down the rabbit hole so far”.
paras.zh: 2018年，班克罗夫特认为澳大利亚队“到目前为止已经陷入困境”。

paras.en: Eight years later, Australian cricket has yet to reckon with its own shortcomings, still stuck in a hole of its own making.
paras.zh: 八年后，澳大利亚板球尚未正视自己的缺点，仍然深陷自己造成的困境。

paras.en: The views expressed in this article are the author’s own and do not necessarily reflect Al Jazeera’s editorial stance.
paras.zh: 本文表达的观点是作者自己的观点，并不一定反映半岛电视台的编辑立场。

articles.title: A grieving family in Lebanon returns to their village
articles.author: Jane Arraf

paras.en: A grieving family in Lebanon returns to their village
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩一个悲痛的家庭返回村庄

paras.en: In Southern Lebanon, the Army is taking over after Israeli forces withdraw. One grieving family returns to their village to find almost everything in their house destroyed.
paras.zh: 在黎巴嫩南部，以色列军队撤出后，陆军正在接管。一个悲痛的家庭回到村庄，发现房子里的几乎所有东西都被毁了。

paras.en: In Southern Lebanon, the U.S. brokered a deal for the Lebanese Army to move into areas after the Israeli military withdrew. So far the deal, aimed at pushing out Hezbollah, has gone ahead in only one village. NPR's Jane Arraf and Jawad Rizkallah traveled there and met one family coping with a trail of death and devastation.
paras.zh: 在黎巴嫩南部，美国促成了一项协议，让黎巴嫩军队在以色列军队撤军后进入该地区。到目前为止，这项旨在驱逐真主党的协议仅在一个村庄取得了进展。 NPR 的简·阿拉夫 (Jane Arraf) 和贾瓦德·里兹卡拉 (Jawad Rizkallah) 前往那里，见到了一个正在应对死亡和破坏的家庭。

paras.en: JANE ARRAF, BYLINE: After years of working as an electrician in Saudi Arabia, Atef Kadouh built his house in the village of Zawtar al-Gharbiyah. He and his wife, Somiya Yaghi, raised five children, all born in the house. Now there are four.
paras.zh: 简·阿拉夫连线：阿提夫·卡杜在沙特阿拉伯做了多年电工后，在扎塔尔·加尔比亚村建造了自己的房子。他和妻子索米亚·亚吉 (Somiya Yaghi) 养育了五个孩子，全都出生在这所房子里。现在有四个。

paras.en: ARRAF: A photo of the youngest, Adel, is propped up in a basket of dried flowers near the doorway.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：门口附近的一篮干花里放着一张最小的阿德尔的照片。

paras.en: KADOUH: My son who drive a ambulance (ph), 27 years, 27.
paras.zh: KADOUH：我开救护车的儿子（ph），27 岁，27 岁。

paras.en: ARRAF: Adel, clean-cut with a trimmed beard, was a sports teacher and a basketball champion. He was about to travel to France for his doctorate when the war with Israel began. Instead, he volunteered as an ambulance driver. The Israeli military killed him and four other medics on March 28 in a drone strike as they helped bury a 75-year-old man who had died in hospital.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：阿德尔面容干净，胡须修剪整齐，是一名体育老师和篮球冠军。当与以色列的战争开始时，他正准备前往法国攻读博士学位。相反，他自愿担任救护车司机。 3 月 28 日，以色列军方在无人机袭击中杀死了他和其他四名医护人员，当时他们正在帮助埋葬一名在医院去世的 75 岁男子。

paras.en: ARRAF: "This one broke me," his father says. "He was my youngest son, 27 years old. You attack a paramedic rescuing wounded people, children? He was not a fighter at the front."
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：“这让我心碎，”他的父亲说道。 “他是我最小的儿子，27 岁。你袭击一名救护伤员、孩子的护理人员？他不是前线战士。”

paras.en: Lebanon's health ministry says Israel has killed more than 135 first responders and medical staff in the past two years. Asked about this air strike, the Israeli military replied, without providing proof, that militants routinely pose as paramedics and transport weapons in ambulances. It did not respond to follow-up questions pointing out the five were not killed in an ambulance.
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩卫生部表示，以色列在过去两年中杀害了超过 135 名急救人员和医务人员。当被问及这次空袭时，以色列军方在没有提供证据的情况下回答说，武装分子经常冒充医护人员并用救护车运输武器。它没有回应后续问题，指出五人并未在救护车中丧生。

paras.en: The Kadouh family returned to the village in July when Zawtar al-Gharbiyah became the first, until now, only test of a U.S.-brokered plan for Israeli forces to withdraw and the Lebanese army to take over. The couple found that Israeli soldiers had occupied their house.
paras.zh: 卡杜一家于 7 月返回村庄，当时 Zawtar al-Gharbiyah 成为美国斡旋的以色列军队撤军和黎巴嫩军队接管计划的第一个也是迄今为止唯一一个测试。这对夫妇发现以色列士兵占领了他们的房子。

paras.en: And right next to this completely blackened door with a huge chunk taken out of it, there are names written in blue pen, blue marker on the walls that seem to be the names of Israeli soldiers.
paras.zh: 就在这扇完全变黑、被掏出一大块的门旁边，墙上用蓝色钢笔、蓝色记号笔写着名字，似乎是以色列士兵的名字。

paras.en: Almost everything in the house had been destroyed, every window shattered, furniture broken. The fridge, freezer and washing machine had bullet holes in them.
paras.zh: 房子里的几乎所有东西都被摧毁了，每扇窗户都被打破，家具也被打破。冰箱、冰柜和洗衣机都有弹孔。

paras.en: ARRAF: Kadouh points out shattered floor tiles, kitchen cupboards wrenched from the walls. "They left nothing," he says. The Israeli soldiers set fire to the house before they left, the family says.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：卡杜指着破碎的地砖、从墙上撬下来的厨房橱柜。 “他们什么也没留下，”他说。家人称，以色列士兵在离开前放火烧毁了房子。

paras.en: SOMIYA YAGHI: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: SOMIYA YAGHI：（非英语口语）。

paras.en: ARRAF: His wife shows me their 18-month-old grandson's room, where trails of soot from a scorched ceiling drip down on walls decorated with images of teddy bears and hot air balloons.
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：他的妻子向我展示了他们 18 个月大的孙子的房间，烧焦的天花板上留下的烟灰痕迹滴落在装饰着泰迪熊和热气球图案的墙壁上。

paras.en: All of the things were moved out of this room and thrown either on the balcony or thrown over the balcony. It's just a mess of baby shoes and clothing and books.
paras.zh: 所有的东西都被搬出了这个房间，要么扔到阳台上，要么扔到阳台上。里面只是一堆婴儿鞋、衣服和书籍。

paras.en: In some rooms, there are piles of half-burned trash - rotting sandwiches along with fruit boxes and cans of energy drinks, hundreds of mustard and ketchup packages, all labeled in Hebrew. There's an engine casing marked in English, propulsion unit, tactical - the kind used in missiles or drones - and bullets throughout the house.
paras.zh: 在一些房间里，有成堆的半烧毁的垃圾——腐烂的三明治、水果盒和能量饮料罐、数百个芥末和番茄酱包装，所有这些都用希伯来语标记。发动机外壳上标有英文、推进装置、战术——导弹或无人机中使用的那种——房子里到处都是子弹。

paras.en: She's just handed me a bullet, and she says there are a lot of them. It looks like a rifle bullet.
paras.zh: 她刚刚递给我一颗子弹，她说子弹很多。它看起来像步枪子弹。

paras.en: They have no running water or electricity. Kadouh says the Israeli military destroyed their solar panels. Among all the damage, the destruction of their trees cuts the deepest.
paras.zh: 他们没有自来水或电力。卡杜说，以色列军方摧毁了他们的太阳能电池板。在所有的损失中，树木的毁坏影响最深。

paras.en: ARRAF: "I tended to them as if they were small children. They're all dear to me," Kadouh says. "The olive tree, that was 60 years old. I planted it when I first built the house."
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：“我照顾他们就像照顾小孩子一样。他们对我来说都很亲爱，”卡杜说。 “这棵橄榄树，已经有60年树龄了，是我刚建房子时种下的。”

paras.en: She's saying the bulldozer came through here and uprooted the trees, the huge pine trees, where they used to get pine nuts from, which are really valuable, a delicacy, as well as the olive trees. And then they carried on through and destroyed the garage.
paras.zh: 她说推土机经过这里，把树木连根拔起，巨大的松树，他们曾经从那里获取松子，松子非常有价值，是一种美味，还有橄榄树。然后他们继续前进并摧毁了车库。

paras.en: "Now we're back to square one," Kadouh says, "starting from scratch." But it's worse than square one. Despite a ceasefire, there are Israeli airstrikes in the adjoining village. We see smoke rising just a few hundred yards away. "Please record this," Yaghi says.
paras.zh: 卡杜说：“现在我们又回到了起点，从头开始。”但这比第一方更糟糕。尽管停火，以色列还是对邻近的村庄进行了空袭。我们看到几百码外冒着浓烟。 “请记录下来，”亚吉说。

paras.en: ARRAF: "Our land is a paradise with everything in it," she tells me. "Our life is this land. Our life is our homes. Even if we were to die in our homes, it would be much better than living outside."
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：“我们的土地是一个拥有一切的天堂，”她告诉我。 “我们的生命就是这片土地，我们的生命就是我们的家园，即使死在家里，也比活在外面好得多。”

paras.en: The Lebanese Army told them that when it reentered the village, it dismantled explosives left by Israeli forces in their house and others. The Israeli army did not reply to NPR queries about why the house was damaged and set on fire. It said military policy bars burning homes or leaving explosives.
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩军队告诉他们，当他们重新进入村庄时，他们拆除了以色列军队留在他们房屋和其他地方的爆炸物。以色列军队没有回复国家公共广播电台关于房屋为何被损坏并着火的询问。报告称，军事政策禁止焚烧房屋或留下爆炸物。

paras.en: ARRAF: Kadouh says, "after all the killing and destruction, maybe someday there will be peace with Israel." But not in his lifetime and not with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. "Netanyahu is the one who killed my son," he says. "How could I put my hand in his? If they want to be our neighbors, do good. Instead, they burn us."
paras.zh: 阿拉夫：卡杜说，“在经历了所有的杀戮和破坏之后，也许有一天会与以色列实现和平。”但不是在他有生之年，也不是与以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡在一起。 “内塔尼亚胡是杀害我儿子的人，”他说。 “我怎么能把手放在他的手里呢？如果他们想成为我们的邻居，就做好事。相反，他们会烧死我们。”

paras.en: Jane Arraf, NPR News, Zawtar al-Gharbiyah, Lebanon.
paras.zh: Jane Arraf，NPR 新闻，Zawtar al-Gharbiyah，黎巴嫩。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of transcripts for NPR programming may vary. Transcript text may also be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 节目文字记录的准确性和可用性可能会有所不同。转录文本也可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。音频可以在其原始广播或出版后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: Highlights and challenges from covering an historic month in South America
articles.author: Rob Schmitz

paras.en: Highlights and challenges from covering an historic month in South America
paras.zh: 报道南美历史性月份的亮点和挑战

paras.en: NPR's South America Correspondent discusses her work covering an historic election upset and a papal visit.
paras.zh: NPR 南美记者讨论了她报道历史性选举失利和教皇访问的工作。

paras.en: ROB SCHMITZ, BYLINE: As an international correspondent, sometimes you're on hand to witness history in the making as NPR's Mike Shuster did in 1989 as East Germany was collapsing...
paras.zh: 罗布·施密茨连线：作为一名国际记者，有时您会亲眼见证历史的形成，就像 1989 年东德崩溃时 NPR 的迈克·舒斯特 (Mike Shuster) 所做的那样……

paras.en: MIKE SHUSTER: The East German authorities took a giant hammer to the wall last night and simply knocked a bit of it down. With a large digging machine, the workmen smashed two 40-feet-wide holes in the wall to the cheers of crowds on both sides.
paras.zh: 迈克·舒斯特：东德当局昨晚拿了一把大锤子砸在墙上，只是把它的一部分敲掉了。工人们用大型挖掘机在墙上挖了两个40英尺宽的洞，两边人群欢呼雀跃。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: ...Or NPR's former Johannesburg bureau chief Ann Cooper, heard here reporting from South Africa in 1994 as Nelson Mandela was inaugurated as the country's first Black president.
paras.zh: 施密茨：...或者 NPR 前约翰内斯堡分社社长安·库珀 (Ann Cooper) 在这里听到了 1994 年纳尔逊·曼德拉 (Nelson Mandela) 就任该国第一位黑人总统时来自南非的报道。

paras.en: ANN COOPER: There was a lot of symbolism today of the reconciliation that Mandela preaches, and I think this - you know, the great variety of South African guests, you know, was a very potent symbol of that.
paras.zh: 安·库珀：曼德拉宣扬的和解今天有很多象征意义，我认为——你知道，各种各样的南非客人，你知道，是一个非常有力的象征。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: It's rare, though, that two historic events occur on your watch just weeks apart. Well, that was exactly what happened for NPR South America correspondent Carrie Kahn. Last month, she covered an historic election in Brazil, where President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva came from behind to win a runoff. And then Pope Leo XIV's first visit to Latin America as pope. So when we sat down for Reporter's Notebook, I asked her what covering these two big stories back to back was like.
paras.zh: 施密茨：不过，在你的手表上仅相隔几周发生两件历史性事件的情况很少见。嗯，这正是 NPR 南美记者 Carrie Kahn 所发生的事情。上个月，她报道了巴西历史性的选举，总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦后来居上，赢得了决选。随后，教皇利奥十四世以教皇身份首次访问拉丁美洲。因此，当我们坐下来拍摄《记者笔记本》时，我问她连续报道这两个重大故事是什么样的。

paras.en: CARRIE KAHN, BYLINE: It's been exhausting. But it's also incredibly amazing. You know, I just had this front seat to two very historic events on the continent. And to get to watch the mobilization just of millions in two very different public events, it was really - it was a career high point. Is that overstating it? But it really was. It was quite amazing. It was.
paras.zh: 嘉莉·卡恩连线：真让人筋疲力尽。但这也令人难以置信。你知道，我刚刚在非洲大陆发生了两件非常具有历史意义的事件。在两个截然不同的公共活动中观看数百万人的动员，这确实是职业生涯的最高点。这是否言过其实？但确实如此。真是太神奇了。是的。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: I mean, you've been covering Latin America for a long time.
paras.zh: 施密茨：我的意思是，您长期以来一直报道拉丁美洲。

paras.en: KAHN: Yes. I don't want to date myself, but yes.
paras.zh: 卡恩：是的。我不想和自己约会，但是是的。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: That is a long time. I mean, let's talk about the papal visit. Here you are reporting on ALL THINGS CONSIDERED on the day that Leo arrived in Peru, a country that he called home for 20 years.
paras.zh: 施密茨：那是很长一段时间了。我的意思是，让我们谈谈教皇的访问。在此，您将报道 Leo 抵达秘鲁这一他已称之为家 20 年的国家那天所考虑的所有事情。

paras.en: KAHN: It's a huge party. This country is so happy the Pope is here.
paras.zh: 卡恩：这是一个盛大的聚会。这个国家很高兴教皇在这里。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED GROUP: (Singing in non-English language).
paras.zh: 身份不明的团体：（用非英语语言唱歌）。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: That was obviously just a really celebratory mood there.
paras.zh: 施密茨：这显然只是一种真正的庆祝气氛。

paras.en: KAHN: It was. It was just amazing. There was a lot of bands and performers and local choral group all along Pope Leo's visit. There was a lot of waiting around, too, and so there were a lot of group celebrations breaking out. That was a group of young people that were singing in the streets. It was just wonderful. There was a lot of emotion in this visit.
paras.zh: 卡恩：是的。真是太棒了。教皇利奥访问期间，有很多乐队、表演者和当地合唱团。周围也有很多人等待，因此爆发了很多集体庆祝活动。那是一群在街上唱歌的年轻人。真是太棒了。这次访问，感触良多。

paras.en: And, you know, this trip came just weeks after he had a portion of his lung removed, you know, after being diagnosed with cancer. So the beginning was a little stiffer. You know, he was kind of standoffish, and you always wait for the pope to put out his hand before you touch the pope. But then they were hugging, and it was just - it was emotional all around. And, you know, it really - it was just surprising, all the emotions...
paras.zh: 而且，你知道，这次旅行是在他被诊断出患有癌症后切除了部分肺部的几周后进行的。所以刚开始的时候，气氛有点僵硬。你知道，他有点冷漠，你总是等教皇伸出手才去碰教皇。但后来他们拥抱在一起，整个人都充满了情感。而且，你知道，这真的 - 令人惊讶，所有的情绪......

paras.en: KAHN: ...And the tears. This was this very plain, simple man.
paras.zh: 卡恩：……还有眼泪。这是一个非常朴素、简单的人。

paras.en: KAHN: And he just touched a lot of hearts with his simplicity and his very simple message. It was that everybody needs to work for the common good, the bien comun, the good of everyone. You know, as his mentor Francis preached, too, you know, individualism, vanity and hypertechnology is not what humanity needs now. It needs community and civility. And I think that really touched a lot of people in these troubling times.
paras.zh: 卡恩：他的简单和非常简单的信息打动了很多人的心。每个人都需要为共同利益、bien comun、每个人的利益而工作。你知道，正如他的导师弗朗西斯所宣扬的那样，你知道，个人主义、虚荣心和超技术并不是人类现在所需要的。它需要社区和文明。我认为，在这个困难时期，这确实触动了很多人。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: You covered Pope Francis' trip to Mexico in 2016. How did this visit compare?
paras.zh: 施密茨：您报道了弗朗西斯教皇 2016 年的墨西哥之行。与这次访问相比如何？

paras.en: KAHN: It was just really different. It was a different time then.
paras.zh: 卡恩：这真的很不同。那时是一个不同的时代。

paras.en: KAHN: We hadn't seen so much polarization. And, you know, Francis was warmly welcomed to Mexico, but he's from a more liberal wing of the church, of Mexico's church. It was and still is very conservative. So it just felt different.
paras.zh: 卡恩：我们还没有看到如此多的两极分化。而且，你知道，方济各来到墨西哥受到热烈欢迎，但他来自墨西哥教会的更自由派。无论过去还是现在，它都是非常保守的。所以只是感觉不一样。
