articles.title: The North Atlantic Right Whale Population Has Shrunk, Raising Concerns About the Future of the Critically Endangered Species

paras.en: The North Atlantic right whale population shrank slightly in 2025, raising concerns about the future of the critically endangered species.

Scientists counted 382 individuals last year, according to new numbers released this week by the North Atlantic Right Whale Consortium. That’s a 1.8 percent decrease from the 2024 estimate of 389 whales.

Meanwhile, the number of reproductive females held steady at 73, according to the consortium, which is made up of scientists from the New England Aquarium’s Anderson Cabot Center for Ocean Life and the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA).

North Atlantic right whales are massive marine mammals that can weigh as much as 140,000 pounds. They spend their winters in the shallow waters off North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia and Florida, where they give birth and raise their calves. Then, they swim more than 1,000 miles north to spend the spring, summer and fall feeding in the food-rich waters off New England and Canada.

They’re one of three species of right whales, along with the North Pacific right whale and the Southern right whale. All three species are what’s known as filter feeders, meaning they use their baleen—flexible, comb-like plates that hang from their upper jaws—to tiny creatures called copepods from the water.

Commercial whalers hunted right whales to the brink of extinction by the late 19th and early 20th centuries, dubbing them the “right” whales to go after because they were relatively easy to kill and retrieve.

All three species have been protected under the U.S. Endangered Species Act since 1970. Still, the colossal creatures have been slow to recover—and their populations remain small today. Right whales can die or suffer life-threatening injuries after being struck by boats or becoming tangled in fishing gear.

“Imagine if you were wrapped in rope that moved as you moved … literally sawing into your body,” Philip Hamilton, a biologist with the New England Aquarium, tells CBC News’ Leila Beaudoin. “It is really painful. They don’t have arms. The pain is … kind of unimaginable.”

Climate change, noise pollution and oil and gas development also threaten the whales. Rising ocean temperatures are particularly dangerous for the massive animals. As the North Atlantic heats up, copepods are moving toward cooler waters, prompting the whales to follow them into areas where they’re not protected from ship strikes and entanglements.

“We know that this population can and will move around to find food, and if we aren’t protecting them throughout their range, we may see another situation where we have this tremendous decline again,” Heather Pettis, chair of the North Atlantic Right Whale Consortium and a biologist at the New England Aquarium, tells Patrick Whittle of the Associated Press.

Over the past decade, North Atlantic right whales have been experiencing high rates of deaths and serious injuries, a period NOAA has dubbed an “unusual mortality event.” The primary causes have been vessel strikes and entanglements, with 177 total individuals getting killed or injured between 2017 and 2026. The true number is likely higher, as NOAA notes that only about a third of right whale deaths are recorded.
The deaths are affecting the species’ ability to grow its numbers. The 2025 population estimate is 20 percent lower than the high of 483 in 2011, according to the consortium.
Southern right whales are also struggling. Hundreds of calves have washed up dead along Argentina's coast in recent months, likely due to a bacterium that can cause skin infections.

Scientists and conservationists are calling for stronger protections to prevent North Atlantic right whales from disappearing, including stricter vessel speed limits and measures to reduce entanglements in commercial fishing gear. “Right whales cannot afford to wait any longer,” Pettis says in the statement.
There was one bright spot in the data: The 2025-26 calving season was the best since 2009, with 24 babies born. Three females gave birth for the first time.

But Nora Ives, a marine scientist with the nonprofit conservation group Oceana, notes in a statement that “these whales can’t survive if the very safeguards and laws that protect them are constantly under attack. We must give them a fighting chance for a future.”

articles.title: Georgia O'Keeffe Is Famous for Painting Flowers and Deserts. Why Have We Forgotten Her Obsession With American Architecture?

paras.en: Georgia O’Keeffe started visiting New Mexico in 1929, immersing herself in the state’s austere desert landscapes for months at a time. She captured her surroundings in hundreds of paintings, which are now some of her best-known works.

But while she found the scenery striking, nature was only part of the American Southwest’s aesthetic appeal. In the 1930s, the artist stumbled across an abandoned house in Abiquiú, which she later purchased. O’Keeffe was particularly fascinated by a large wooden door leading to the central patio, a feature she painted at least 20 times.

“I bought the place because it had that door in the patio, the one I’ve painted so often,” she said in a 1962 interview. “I’m always trying to paint that door—I never quite get it. It’s a curse—the way I feel I must continually go on with that door.”

O’Keeffe is considered one of America’s greatest artists, and general audiences are familiar with her desert landscapes and large-scale flower portraits. But now, an exhibition at the Detroit Institute of Arts spotlights a lesser-known part of her oeuvre: her enduring fascination with the built environment.

“This is the first exhibit that takes a comprehensive view of architecture as a lifelong fascination for O’Keeffe,” Ben Colman, the exhibition’s curator, tells the New York Times’ Leslie Wayne. “Barns and fields and buildings are not the O’Keeffe that people think about. It’s a bit of a surprise.”
- The artist created more than 2,000 works during her lifetime, but only 10 percent of them—around 200 paintings—feature her famous flowers.

- In 2014, one of her flower paintings, Jimson Weed (1932), sold for $44.4 million, becoming the most expensive artwork by a woman ever auctioned. Frida Kahlo’s The Dream (The Bed) (1940) broke that record when it sold for $54.7 million last year.

“Georgia O’Keeffe: Architecture” features nearly 40 works created between the 1920s and 1960s. The artist’s paintings are grouped into three sections, each exploring a central setting from her life: rural barns and farmhouses, New York City skyscrapers, and New Mexico homes.

Stables, a painting of a white barn that the artist noticed during a 1932 road trip through Quebec, served as the inspiration for the exhibition. It’s the only O’Keeffe in the Detroit Institute of Arts’ collections. When Colman joined the institute in 2015, he was fascinated by its simple geometric shapes and large blocks of color. He found himself thinking about it often.

“I had such a strong pull to this picture and wanted to know more,” Colman says in an interview posted on the institute’s website. “In asking questions about Stables, I started to sketch out a broader story about O’Keeffe’s life and her engagement with architecture across her career. What began as a set of questions about the summer of 1932 turned into a larger story about the role architecture played as a recurring source of inspiration throughout the artist’s life.”

Stables is on display in the exhibition’s first section, which reflects O’Keeffe’s childhood on a Wisconsin dairy farm, as well as her sojourns to Lake George in Upstate New York with her husband, photographer Alfred Stieglitz.
Another highlight of this section is My Shanty, Lake George (1922). Colman describes it as “a challenge to her critics,” who struggled to evaluate O’Keeffe’s art without considering her gender.

“One day as I looked at the brown burned wood of the Shanty, I thought, ‘I can paint one of those dismal-colored paintings like the men. I think just for fun I will try—all low-toned and dreary,’” O’Keeffe wrote in her 1976 autobiography. When My Shanty, Lake George went on display, “the men seemed to approve of it,” she added. “They seemed to think that maybe I was beginning to paint.”

The second section showcases paintings of high-rises in New York City, where the artist lived for three decades. One of the pieces on view is Brooklyn Bridge (1949), the final city artwork that O’Keeffe created before moving away. She painted it from the perspective of someone passing through the bridge’s famous archways.

“It captures a view that you only see when you’re crossing the river, when you’re in the midst of making a change yourself,” Colman says. “The artist created this painting the year that she relocated her life and home to New Mexico permanently.”

The final section displays O’Keeffe’s paintings of New Mexico, where she lived until her death at age 98 in 1986. These paintings capture the region’s unique adobe architecture—including ten depictions of that inscrutable patio door.
“Georgia O’Keeffe: Architecture” is on view at the Detroit Institute of Arts through January 3, 2027.

articles.title: Teeth Discovered in Two Chinese Caves Are Rewriting the Story of Homo Erectus, an Ancient Human Ancestor That May Have Been More Capable Than We Thought

paras.en: Homo erectus was thought to have disappeared from mainland Asia roughly 400,000 years ago. But newly discovered fossils suggest that the species survived there for much longer, possibly living in southern China as recently as 184,000 years ago. The fossils also show for the first time that H. erectus was capable of living in a tropical rainforest environment.

The findings, described in two new papers published in the journal Nature, are based on recent analyses of H. erectus teeth. One paper finds that H. erectus persisted on mainland Asia for up to 216,000 years longer than previously thought, while the other indicates that the species was even more ecologically flexible than scientists assumed.

Scientists think H. erectus arose in Africa about 1.89 million years ago. It’s believed to be the first hominin species to have spread beyond the continent, with populations reaching what is now Georgia, on the border between Europe and Asia, by about 1.8 million years ago. The species continued spreading east into what is now China, eventually reaching the Indonesian island of Java.

Eugène Dubois, a Dutch anatomist and geologist, made the first discovery of an H. erectus fossil, in the early 1890s. He unearthed a skullcap and femur belonging to the so-called Java Man on the eponymous island.

H. erectus had a more modern, humanlike body than earlier hominins, with long legs and short arms suited to walking and running over long distances. The species made increasingly sophisticated stone tools, probably used fire, and hunted and butchered big game.

Scientists were excavating two limestone caves, located about nine miles apart in China’s Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, when they stumbled upon nine hominin teeth. They used computed tomography (CT) scanning and physical examinations to investigate the teeth, ultimately determining that eight belonged to H. erectus. The identity of the ninth tooth, however, remains unknown.

Researchers also recovered ancient protein from five of the teeth, including the mystery tooth. In the four H. erectus teeth, they found a version of a protein called ameloblastin that had only previously been seen in older Asian H. erectus fossils.

The mystery tooth also contained ameloblastin, however, it didn’t match any known hominin. For now, that tooth remains unidentified, but Frido Welker, a molecular anthropologist at the University of Copenhagen who co-authored one of the studies, tells Scientific American’s Jacek Krywko that he thinks Denisovans, hominins who lived across Asia from roughly 400,000 to about 30,000 years ago, “would be the first option to consider.” He suspects the two species overlapped in what is now southern China, but cautioned that scientists will need to conduct additional research to definitively identify the tooth.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The researchers used numerous methods to date the H. erectus teeth, deducing that they’re likely between 324,000 and 184,000 years old. At that time, the region seems to have been a tropical rainforest—a new and surprising ecosystem for H. erectus.

“Rainforests were thought to be a frontier that only modern humans could survive and cross,” Ben Marwick, an archaeologist at the University of Washington who was not involved with the new research, tells National Geographic’s Christina Larson. “But now it seems this idea of Homo sapiens exceptionalism may not be the true story.”

Additional analyses of the teeth revealed that these H. erectus individuals traveled long distances, possibly coming to southern China from as far away as what is now northern Vietnam, some 155 miles away. Making that kind of journey would have required “a sophisticated understanding of the surrounding terrain, including regional landscape features and river networks that change with the seasons,” Ben Utting, an archaeologist at the University of Connecticut who was not involved with the new studies, tells CNN’s Katie Hunt.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Together, the findings add to the growing picture of the species’ behavioral and ecological flexibility, Karen Baab, a paleoanthropologist at Midwestern University who was not involved with the new work, tells New Scientist’s Michael Marshall. “They seemed quite adaptable and flexible in general, because of the incredible range of niches they were occupying,” she adds.
That flexibility probably helped H. erectus persist for roughly 1.8 to 1.9 million years—six times longer than modern humans—making it the longest-surviving known species in the Homo genus.

However, scientists still don’t know why the species went extinct between 108,000 to 117,000 years ago. The leading theory is that H. erectus couldn’t adapt when rainforests started encroaching on their final home, the island of Java.

But the new findings turn that narrative “on its head,” Kira Westaway, a geochronologist at Macquarie University and the lead author of one of the studies, tells Reuters’ Will Dunham. “This opens up a new chapter on our understanding of H. erectus.”

articles.title: A Space Probe Returns to Asteroids Where NASA Tested Planetary Defense Systems
articles.author: Petr Kubala

paras.en: It’s mostly been the subject of Hollywood movies, but one day, an asteroid or comet could collide with Earth and cause serious damage. We don't have to look all that far back for an example. In 1908, in an incident now known as the “Tunguska Event,” a space rock, likely a few dozen meters wide, exploded over Siberia. Though scientists weren’t able to visit the site for another two decades, the landscape was still scarred from the explosion.
paras.zh: 这大多是好莱坞电影的主题，但有一天，小行星或彗星可能会与地球相撞，造成严重破坏。我们不必追溯太久就能找到一个例子。1908年，在一桩如今被称为“通古斯大爆炸”的事件中，一块可能宽达数十米的天外陨石在西伯利亚上空爆炸。虽然科学家们在二十年后才得以前往该地考察，但爆炸造成的创伤仍清晰可见。

paras.en: Astronomers predict that in mid-April 2029, the asteroid Apophis will fly by Earth. The 450-meter-wide body will miss us at a distance of only 19,000 miles. That’s about 12 times closer to us than the moon and much closer than many satellites. It will even be visible to the naked eye.
paras.zh: 天文学家预测，2029年4月中旬，小行星阿波菲斯将掠过地球。这颗宽450米的天体将与我们擦肩而过，距离仅19000英里。这比月球离我们近约12倍，也比许多卫星离我们近得多。它甚至可以用肉眼看到。

paras.en: In the past few decades, there’s been enormous progress in making these kinds of predictions. As space probes deepen our knowledge of small bodies in the solar system, astronomers have increasingly reliable and detailed data for finding potentially hazardous asteroids. Our ability to respond to such a threat, however, is another story. This is the missing and extremely important link—planetary defense technology that could allow us to deflect a dangerous object in time.
paras.zh: 在过去几十年里，此类预测的准确性取得了巨大进步。随着太空探测器加深我们对太阳系中小天体的了解，天文学家获得了越来越可靠和详细的数据，用于寻找可能具有危险性的小行星。然而，我们应对此类威胁的能力则是另一回事。这是缺失的、极其重要的环节——行星防御技术，它可以使我们及时偏转危险天体。

paras.en: In a sci-fi flick, such situations are often solved with a nuclear bomb. But in the real world, blowing up a big space rock into tiny bits is not ideal. Instead, it’s better to alter the asteroid's orbit. Everything in the vacuum of space is in motion. Our own planet travels about 20 miles every second. If the object hurtling towards us can be slowed down and thus reach the meeting point a little later, it will simply miss the Earth.
paras.zh: 在科幻电影中，此类情况通常通过核弹来解决。但在现实世界中，将一颗巨大的太空岩石炸成碎片并不是理想的解决办法。相反，最好是改变小行星的轨道。太空真空中的一切都在运动。我们自己的星球每秒钟大约移动20英里。如果能让朝我们疾驰而来的物体减速，从而稍晚一点到达相遇点，它就会与地球擦肩而过。

paras.en: Four years ago, this was essentially what NASA tested on a pair of celestial bodies known as Didymos and Dimorphos. Astronomers at the Kitt Peak Observatory discovered Didymos, an asteroid measuring 780 meters across, 30 years ago. A few years later, Czech astronomer Petr Pravec observed that this asteroid had a “moonlet” orbiting it about every 12 hours. This smaller body, measuring about 151 meters in diameter, was then named Dimorphos.
paras.zh: 四年前，这基本上就是NASA对名为迪迪莫斯和迪莫福斯的一对天体进行的测试。30年前，基特峰国家天文台的天文学家发现了直径780米的小行星迪迪莫斯。几年后，捷克天文学家彼得·普拉维茨（Petr Pravec）观察到，这颗小行星有一颗“小卫星”绕其轨道运行，大约每12小时绕行一圈。这颗较小的天体直径约151米，后来被命名为“迪莫福斯”。

paras.en: The paired objects were a perfect testing ground for the kind of deflection a planetary defense system would involve. Locked in on these targets, NASA launched the Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART) in late 2021. Nearly a year later, the DART probe crashed into Dimorphos.
paras.zh: 这对天体是测试行星防御系统所涉及的偏转的完美试验场。将目标锁定在这两个天体上，美国宇航局于2021年末启动了双小行星撞击偏转测试（DART）。将近一年后，DART 探测器撞上了迪莫福斯。

paras.en: Scientists had hoped that the impact of the probe—which was barreling toward the asteroids at over 13,000 miles per hour—could shorten the period of the mini-moon's orbit by a minute or more. In the end, it was slowed down by 33 minutes. This major deviation was caused by the ejection of debris, leading to a much greater recoil than what was produced by the impact itself. In addition, the orbital speed of both asteroids around the sun also slowed. And in a sense, Dimorphos briefly became a comet—the debris released by the impact creating a long tail behind it.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: But questions remain about the longer-term impacts of this test. In October 2024, the European Space Agency (ESA) sent off the space probe Hera to rendezvous with both asteroids. After a flyby of Mars, the probe began its arrival phase this past October. It took its first image about 800 miles away, and the first detailed image of Didymos was published in early November.
paras.zh: 但关于这次试验的长期影响，仍存在疑问。2024年10月，欧洲航天局（ESA）发射了“赫拉”号（Hera）太空探测器，与这两颗小行星进行交会。在飞掠火星之后，该探测器于去年10月进入了抵达阶段。它在距离约800英里处拍摄了第一张图像，而第一张狄迪莫斯的详细图像于11月初发布。

paras.en: Now in their vicinity, Hera will study both bodies in depth. Though there’s much we can learn about asteroids by observing them from our planet, nothing can replace close-up exploration, and this will be the first time a binary asteroid system will be explored in detail. One of the mission's goals is to find out how such asteroid pairs form. Didymos is also interesting for its rapid rotation, turning once every 2.3 hours—placing it on the very edge of stability.
paras.zh: 现在，“赫拉”号已抵达它们的附近，将对这两个天体进行深入研究。虽然我们可以通过从地球上观测小行星来了解很多信息，但任何东西都无法替代近距离探索，这将是首次对双小行星系统进行详细探索。该任务的目标之一是弄清此类小行星对是如何形成的。迪迪莫斯小行星的另一个有趣之处在于其快速自转，每2.3小时自转一圈，这使其处于稳定性的临界点。

paras.en: But of course, beyond this traditional astronomy research, which could also take place at another set of binary asteroids, Hera will investigate the consequences of the DART mission. This will include studying the impact site. Because there are so many knowns about the impact itself, scientists can also use this opportunity to understand craters more broadly, answering questions such as whether the strength of the material or gravity plays a more decisive role in crater formation.
paras.zh: 当然，除了这项传统的天文学研究（也可以在另一对双小行星上进行）之外，“赫拉”还将研究DART任务的结果。这将包括研究撞击点。由于关于撞击本身已知的信息非常多，科学家还可以借此机会更全面地了解撞击坑，回答诸如物质强度或重力在撞击坑形成过程中是否起着更关键作用等问题。

paras.en: Hera will also determine the exact mass of Dimorphos, an important detail in assessing the effectiveness of the DART mission as a test of planetary defense technology. The probe also contains a lidar instrument for mapping the asteroid's topography and instruments for investigating the chemical composition of the surface. Additionally, we can expect to see detailed images of the asteroids taken with a resolution of 1 meter per pixel.
paras.zh: “赫拉”号还将确定迪莫福斯小行星的确切质量，这是评估DART任务作为行星防御技术测试有效性的一个重要细节。该探测器还配备了一台激光雷达仪器，用于绘制小行星的地形，以及用于研究小行星表面化学成分的仪器。此外，我们有望看到以每像素1米的分辨率拍摄的小行星的详细图像。

paras.en: The probe is also carrying two miniature, cube-shaped satellites, called “CubeSats” for short, which it will deploy in January 2027. In Earth’s orbit, CubeSats are often used for simple experiments, including student projects, and they can even be stacked together to create larger satellites.
paras.zh: 该探测器还搭载了两颗微型立方体卫星，简称“立方体卫星”，将于2027年1月部署。在地球轨道上，立方体卫星通常用于简单的实验，包括学生项目，甚至可以将它们堆叠在一起，形成更大的卫星。

paras.en: Hera’s CubeSats, named Juventas and Milani, will attempt to land on the surface. Using radar capable of probing up to a depth of 100 meters, Juventas will focus on geophysical exploration of the asteroid Dimorphos. Additionally, a gravimeter on board will measure how the gravity on Dimorphos changes during its orbit due to the parent asteroid, Didymos. Meanwhile, Milani will carry out a detailed investigation of the asteroids’ surface composition and will search for traces of dust and the volatile substances contained within many space rocks.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: According to current plans, this main phase of the Hera probe's mission is expected to last until the summer of next year, and findings from this probe will likely only become more relevant, not just as Apophis approaches, but even after it slings back into space. In the year 2000, we knew of only 300 near-Earth asteroids—those that approach Earth or directly cross its orbit. Today, we know of over 43,000.
This story originally appeared on WIRED Czech Republic and Slovakia and has been translated from Czech.

articles.title: Best Power Banks (2026): My Picks After Testing Over 100
articles.author: Simon Hill

paras.en: I hate running out of power. Everybody does. While our gadgets have advanced in many ways, battery technology has been slow to improve. That’s why you’re looking to buy a power bank. A good portable charger is a handy backup that can keep your smartphone, tablet, and maybe even your laptop going for longer. I’ve been testing power banks for years. I’ve tested more than 100 portable chargers. But you only really need one or two.
paras.zh: 我讨厌没电。每个人都讨厌。虽然我们的电子设备在许多方面都有了进步，但电池技术的发展却很缓慢。这就是您想购买移动电源的原因。一款好的便携式充电宝是一款方便的备用电源，可以让您的智能手机、平板电脑，甚至笔记本电脑使用更长时间。我多年来一直在测试移动电源。我测试过 100 多款便携式充电宝。但您真正需要的其实只有一两个。

paras.en: Most folks should buy one of the first four power banks I recommend, but there are a few other unique use cases, so I’ve included a few extra options. Read the Best MagSafe/Qi2 Power Banks for more magnetic wireless chargers, and Best Laptop Power Banks or Best Portable Power Stations for more power.
paras.zh: 大多数人应该购买我推荐的前四个移动电源中的一个，但还有一些其他独特的用例，所以我又列出了几个额外的选项。请阅读《最佳 MagSafe/Qi2 移动电源》，了解更多磁吸式无线充电器；阅读《最佳笔记本电脑移动电源》或《最佳便携式储能电源》，了解更多大功率产品。

paras.en: Updated November 2026: I added power banks from Anker, Peak Design, Nitecore, and Iniu, removed some older devices, and updated links and prices.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月更新：我添加了来自 Anker、Peak Design、Nitecore 和 Iniu 的移动电源，移除了部分旧款设备，并更新了链接和价格。

paras.en: There are so many portable chargers out there. Here are a few more I like that just missed out on a place above for one reason or another. We also have separate guides for the Best Laptop Power Banks, Best MagSafe Power Banks, and Best Portable Power Stations.
paras.zh: 市面上的便携式充电宝琳琅满目。以下是我喜欢的另外几款产品，它们由于各种原因未能跻身上述榜单。我们还提供了最佳笔记本电脑充电宝、最佳MagSafe充电宝和最佳便携式储能电源的单独指南。

paras.en: These portable chargers I tested aren’t necessarily terrible, but you can do better.
paras.zh: 我测试的这些便携式充电宝并不一定很差，但您可以找到更好的。

paras.en: UGreen MagFlow Pro for $90: I actually quite like this magnetic, wireless charging power bank (Qi2 25W) with its Matrix-style screen that animates to show charging status. But considering the 10,000-mAh capacity, the price is absolutely bonkers. The marketing talks up its cooling properties, but it got very warm when I used it. The attached USB-C cable (45W) was annoyingly obtrusive when it was stuck to the back of my iPhone.
paras.zh: UGreen MagFlow Pro，售价 90 美元：我其实挺喜欢这款磁吸式无线充电宝（Qi2 25W），它配备了矩阵式屏幕，会以动画形式显示充电状态。但考虑到 10000 毫安时的容量，这个价格绝对是疯了。宣传中大肆吹捧它的散热性能，但当我使用时，它变得非常烫手。当随附的 USB-C 线缆（45W）贴在我的 iPhone 背面时，它非常碍事。

paras.en: OnePlus Slim Magnetic Power Bank for $70: Sleek in silver-gray aluminum with a chamfered edge, this power bank looks lovely, but the 5,000-mAh capacity is just over half that after inefficiency takes a bite.
paras.zh: OnePlus超薄磁吸式充电宝，售价70美元：这款充电宝采用银灰色铝制外壳，边缘经过倒角处理，外观时尚靓丽，但5000毫安时的容量在考虑到能量损耗后，实际可用容量仅为一半多一点。

paras.en: Iniu Portable Charger for $20: It’s very small for a 10,000-mAh capacity. You can charge at up to 45 watts from either of the USB-C ports or 18 watts from the USB-A (recharging was slow), it fell short of the stated capacity, and the display sometimes failed to update correctly.
paras.zh: Iniu 便携式充电宝，售价 20 美元：对于 10000 毫安时的容量来说，它非常小巧。您可以通过任意一个 USB-C 端口以最高 45 瓦的功率充电，也可以通过 USB-A 端口以 18 瓦的功率充电（充电速度较慢），但实际容量未达到标称容量，并且显示屏有时无法正确更新。

paras.en: FansDreams MChaos for $46: I love the idea of a wearable power bank, and this one comes in lime green with a carabiner that makes it easy to attach to a bag, but recharging is slow, and you’ll be lucky to get one full charge for your phone. It's also currently sold out.
paras.zh: FansDreams MChaos，售价 46 美元：我很喜欢可穿戴式充电宝的创意，这款充电宝是青柠绿色的，配有挂钩，方便挂在包上，但充电速度较慢，如果能为手机充满一次电，就算很幸运了。它目前也已售罄。

paras.en: iWalk Portable Charger for $22: The 4,800-mAh capacity won’t come close to fully refilling your device, but it's tiny enough to keep in a bag at all times.
paras.zh: iWalk便携式充电宝，售价22美元：4800毫安的容量不足以完全为您的设备充电，但它足够小巧，可以随时放在包里。

paras.en: What Features Should I Look for in Power Banks?
paras.zh: 我应该在移动电源中寻找哪些功能？

paras.en: There are a few things worth thinking about when you’re shopping for a portable charger.
paras.zh: 在选购便携式充电宝时，有几点值得考虑。

paras.en: The capacity of a power bank is measured in milliampere-hours (mAh), but this can be a little misleading because the amount of power you get depends on the cable you use, the device you’re charging, and the charging method. (Qi wireless charging is less efficient.) You will never get the maximum capacity from any power bank. You can generally expect to get between 60 and 80 percent after energy loss through heat and conversion. Some manufacturers list a “Rated Capacity” that’s lower than the overall capacity to give you an indication of what to expect in real-world use. We try to provide a minimum estimate of what you’ll get in terms of charges for devices.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The charging rate for devices like smartphones is measured in watts (W), but most power banks list the voltage (V) and the amperage (A). Thankfully, you can calculate the wattage yourself simply by multiplying the voltage and amperage. Unfortunately, getting that maximum rate also depends on your device, the standards it supports, and the charging cable you use. Many smartphones, including Apple’s iPhones, support the power delivery standard, meaning you can use higher-power power banks to recharge the device with no issues. A few phones, such as Samsung’s Galaxy S range, support a supplementary PD protocol called PPS (programmable power supply) that goes up to 45 watts. Many phones also support Qualcomm’s proprietary Quick Charge (QC) standard. There are also other proprietary fast-charging standards, but you won’t generally find power banks that support them unless they come from the smartphone manufacturer.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Your device will need pass-through support if you want to charge your power bank and use it to charge another device simultaneously. The Nimble, GoalZero, Biolite, Mophie, Zendure, and Sharge portable chargers listed support pass-through charging. Anker discontinued support for pass-through in some of its products because it found that differences between the output of the wall charger and the input of the device being charged can cause the power bank to cycle on and off rapidly and shorten its life. Monoprice does not support pass-through charging either. We would advise caution when using pass-through, as it can also cause portable chargers to heat up.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: It’s safe to fly with a power bank, but there are two main restrictions to keep in mind when you board a flight: You must have the portable charger in your carry-on luggage (it cannot be checked), and it must not exceed 100 watt-hours. If your power bank has a larger capacity than 27,000 mAh, you should check with the airline. Below that should not be a problem.
paras.zh: 携带移动电源乘机是安全的，但登机时需要注意两项主要限制：移动电源必须放在随身行李中（不能托运），且额定能量不得超过100瓦时。如果您的移动电源容量超过27,000毫安时，您应咨询航空公司。低于这个容量应该不会有问题。

paras.en: Some airlines introduced stricter rules in 2025, so always check with your chosen airline before you travel. For example, some airlines prefer you not to use or charge power banks during a flight, some require power banks to be in your hand luggage under the seat in front of you and not in the overheads, and some limit the number of power banks you can have on board.
paras.zh: 一些航空公司在2025年出台了更严格的规定，因此请务必在出行前咨询您所选的航空公司。例如，有些航空公司希望您在飞行期间不要使用或为充电宝充电，有些航空公司要求将充电宝放在您前方座位下的手提行李中，而不是放在头顶行李架上，还有些航空公司限制您在机上携带的充电宝数量。

paras.en: Many years ago, the Samsung Galaxy Note 7 gained notoriety when its batteries caught fire in a series of incidents. There’s been a steady stream of similar, though isolated, incidents ever since. Despite the high-profile coverage of batteries gone wrong, the vast majority of lithium-ion batteries are safe.
paras.zh: 多年前，三星Galaxy Note 7因电池在一系列事件中起火而臭名昭著。此后，类似的事件层出不穷，尽管都是孤立事件。尽管电池出问题的事件备受关注，但绝大多数锂离子电池都是安全的。

paras.en: The chemical reaction that occurs inside a lithium-ion cell is complex, but as in any battery, there’s a negative and a positive electrode. In lithium batteries, the negative is a lithium-carbon compound, and the positive is cobalt oxide (though many battery makers are moving away from cobalt). These two compounds cause a reaction that is safe when controlled and delivers energy to your devices. When the reaction gets out of control, though, you end up with earbuds melting in your ears. What changes a safe reaction to an uncontrolled reaction can be any number of things: excess heat, physical damage during use, physical damage during manufacture, or using the wrong charger.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The three basic rules that have kept me safe through testing dozens and dozens of batteries are these:
paras.zh: 在测试过数十种电池后，我总结出以下三条基本规则，它们让我始终保持安全：

paras.en: - Avoid cheap cords, chargers, and outlet adapters;
paras.zh: - 避免使用廉价的电源线、充电器和插座适配器；

paras.en: - Make sure batteries aren't exposed to excessive heat (above 110 degrees Fahrenheit);
paras.zh: - 确保电池不会暴露在过高温度（高于华氏 110 度）下；

paras.en: - Regularly inspect batteries for signs of damage.
paras.zh: - 定期检查电池是否有损坏迹象。

paras.en: Avoiding cheap wall-outlet adapters, cords, and chargers is the most important rule. These are your most likely sources of problems. Those chargers you see on Amazon for $20 cheaper than the competition? Not worth it. They probably got the price down by skimping on insulation, leaving out power-management tools, and ignoring the basics of electrical safety. Price alone is no guarantee of safety, either. Buy from reputable companies and brands.
paras.zh: 最重要的一条规则是避免使用廉价的墙壁插座适配器、电源线和充电器。这些是最可能导致问题的来源。您在亚马逊上看到的那些比竞争对手便宜20美元的充电器？不值得购买。他们很可能是通过削减绝缘材料、省略电源管理工具以及忽视电气安全的基本要求来降低价格的。单靠价格也不能保证安全。请从信誉良好的公司和品牌购买。

paras.en: Then there’s heat. Too much of it can cause all manner of problems, both in terms of discharge and safety. Avoid heat, and pay attention to your batteries when they’re charging. If your device gets overly hot when charging, this can be a sign of problems. Similarly, beware of any swollen, bulging, or otherwise misshapen batteries.
paras.zh: 接下来是热量。过多的热量会导致各种问题，包括放电和安全方面的问题。避免高温，并在电池充电时多加留意。如果您的设备在充电时过热，这可能预示着存在问题。同样，请留意任何肿胀、鼓包或形状异常的电池。

paras.en: I’ve explained charging rates and capacity above, but several factors can cause charging speed to be slower than expected. The rate is determined by the device being charged, so your phone will request a certain wattage, which changes depending on how full its battery is, on-device settings, and the battery temperature.
paras.zh: 我已经在上面解释了充电功率和容量，但有几个因素会导致充电速度比预期慢。充电速率由被充电的设备决定，因此您的手机将要求一定的功率，该功率会根据电池的电量、设备上的设置以及电池的温度而变化。

paras.en: All devices charge more slowly when they are completely empty, when the battery approaches full, and when they overheat. The cable you use will also have a maximum charging rate, and so will different ports on the power bank. Wireless charging is more convenient, but also slower than wired charging.
paras.zh: 所有设备在电量完全耗尽、电池即将充满以及过热时，充电速度都会变慢。您使用的线缆也有最大充电速率，移动电源上的不同端口也是如此。无线充电更方便，但速度也比有线充电慢。

paras.en: I’ve been testing power banks for close to two decades, and my home office has stacks of ’em at any given moment. I test every portable charger that comes in for at least two weeks. I always check how many times it can fully charge my test phone (currently an iPhone 16). I’ll also try charging my Pixel 10 Pro XL and Samsung Galaxy S24+ to test charging speeds, and whatever else I have in. For larger-capacity power banks, I test-charge an iPad Mini and a MacBook Air. I test how long it takes to recharge each empty power bank.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Aside from these standard tests, I try to use the power banks in my everyday life, just to see how they feel, and my wife and kids often help out and share their opinions. For some of our top picks, I continue to test over months to get a sense of their reliability and durability, though it’s not possible to do this for every device that lands on my desk. Beyond function, I take form and usability into account. I keep an eye on user reviews and consider the warranties and customer service of each manufacturer.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: How Does WIRED Select Power Banks to be Reviewed?
paras.zh: WIRED是如何挑选要评测的移动电源的？

paras.en: I often scan the latest releases to seek out worthy prospects, whether from an unknown new brand or an established favorite like Anker. I also get pitched many power banks every week. I sometimes reach out to those companies to ask for the product but never promise any kind of editorial coverage—that would go against WIRED’s editorial policies. While WIRED usually earns affiliate revenue if you purchase a power bank using our link, this is not factored into the decision on ranking.
paras.zh: 我经常浏览最新发布的产品，以寻找值得关注的产品，无论是来自名不见经传的新品牌，还是像安克这样备受青睐的知名品牌。我每周也会收到很多移动电源的推销。我有时会联系这些公司索要产品，但绝不承诺任何形式的编辑报道——那样做将有悖于《连线》的编辑政策。虽然如果您通过我们的链接购买移动电源，WIRED 通常会获得联盟营销收入，但这不会影响排名的决定。

paras.en: There are too many power banks for me to test everything, so I tend to stick to known, reputable brands, but there’s always room for something new if it has a compelling new feature or price, and I cover as many as I can. (Leave a comment or send me an email if you want me to test a power bank from a certain brand!) Once testing is complete, I typically donate power banks to a local charity. I try to hang on to some of our top picks for comparison purposes and to test their longevity.
paras.zh: 移动电源种类繁多，我无法一一测试，因此我倾向于选择知名度高、口碑好的品牌。不过，如果某款产品具备引人注目的新功能或价格优势，我也会考虑尝试。我会尽可能多地进行测评。（如果您希望我测试某个品牌的移动电源，请留言或给我发电子邮件！）测试完成后，我通常会将移动电源捐赠给当地的慈善机构。我尽量保留一些我们的首选产品，以便进行比较并测试它们的使用寿命。

articles.title: The Outages Are Just Getting Started
articles.author: Lily Hay Newman, Matt Burgess

paras.en: Over the last week, you have surely noticed the disruptive streak of technical outages that hit everything from Outlook to Apple, a half dozen US banks, United Airlines, and even the NSA’s classified network. While there’s no evidence that these were cyberattacks, speculation has run wild about the cause—including a pervasive feeling that AI is to blame.
paras.zh: 过去一周，您想必已经注意到了一系列具有破坏性的技术故障，从Outlook到苹果、六家美国银行、美国联合航空公司，甚至美国国家安全局的机密网络都受到了影响。虽然没有证据表明这些是网络攻击，但人们对原因的猜测却甚嚣尘上，其中一种普遍的看法是，人工智能是罪魁祸首。

paras.en: So let’s just be clear: The incidents were definitely not caused by some sort of coordinated AI hacking spree and, taken individually, they all seem to have routine explanations. But as AI impacts the dynamics of digital defense more and more, security researchers and analysts have increasingly concluded that AI pressures are starting to play a role in real-world tech failures.
paras.zh: 所以我们要明确一点：这些事件绝对不是由某种协调一致的人工智能黑客热潮引起的，而且单独来看，它们似乎都有常规的解释。但随着人工智能对数字防御动态的影响越来越大，安全研究人员和分析师越来越多地得出结论，人工智能压力开始在现实世界的技术失败中发挥作用。

paras.en: AI-assisted vulnerability discovery has unleashed a torrent of software bugs. Attackers are then using AI tools to exploit those vulnerabilities faster, which puts more pressure than ever on organizations to quickly patch their systems. This leaves often under-resourced IT teams scrambling to evaluate a massive number of patches and push the updates to systems on which countless people and organizations rely. Researchers and practitioners have told us again and again that AI’s biggest impact is that it speeds everything up.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Microsoft’s massive 365 outage last week was caused by a flawed update in its infrastructure exacerbated by other network failures. Officials said this week that the NSA outage to its internal communication system was due to botched patching following October’s critical PHP updates. Apple also said its snafus this week related to an internal update. AI vulnerability discovery and the resulting patching are “putting tremendous strain on systems that weren’t built to handle that pace of change,” US senator Mark Warner said in a statement on Tuesday. And more “instability” could be coming, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said this week, because a “patch needs to go instantly from being available to being patched in production because it’s being exploited in the wild.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: External pressures and bugs in patches are not new, and they’ve always caused tech failures. Researchers also point out that many organizations around the world have a significant amount of what’s often called “tech debt,” because they have cut corners and failed to invest in upgrading and maintaining their digital systems for years. This practice was always risky, but organizations that didn’t have the resources or didn’t want to devote them to digital security could gamble with out-of-date systems and missing safeguards and typically avoid the worst consequences.
paras.zh: 外部压力和补丁中的错误并不新鲜，而且它们总是会导致技术故障。研究人员还指出，世界各地的许多组织都背负着大量所谓的“技术债务”，因为他们多年来偷工减料，未能投资升级和维护数字系统。这种做法总是有风险的，但没有资源或不想将其投入数字安全的组织可以用过时的系统和缺失的保障措施进行赌博，通常可以避免最糟糕的后果。

paras.en: “Historically, even a couple of years ago, a vendor releases a patch for a nasty bug. You might have some time to do some validation and apply it,” says Joe Slowik, the director of threat research and cyber engineering at Dataminr. “Now, that may not even be an option, because we’re talking about turnaround times that completely defeat the ability to do patch verification.”
paras.zh: “从历史上看，即使是几年前，供应商也会发布针对严重错误的补丁。你可能有一些时间进行一些验证并应用它，”Dataminr 威胁研究和网络工程总监 Joe Slowik 说。 “现在，这甚至可能不是一个选择，因为我们正在谈论的周转时间完全破坏了补丁验证的能力。”

paras.en: IT administrators are leaning on AI more as well to accelerate their evaluation and prepare their systems for updates, but current AI tools still can’t replace human analysis and planning.
paras.zh: IT 管理员也越来越依赖人工智能来加速评估并为系统更新做好准备，但当前的人工智能工具仍然无法取代人工分析和规划。

paras.en: “AI can help, but people still need to understand what went wrong, check that the patch addresses the cause, and look for similar issues elsewhere,” says Lea Schönherr, a tenure-track faculty member at CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security, a German national research institution. “Rolling out patches across widely used systems also takes time.”
paras.zh: 德国国家研究机构 CISPA 亥姆霍兹信息安全中心的终身教授 Lea Schönherr 表示：“人工智能可以提供帮助，但人们仍然需要了解出了什么问题，检查补丁是否解决了原因，并在其他地方寻找类似的问题。” “在广泛使用的系统上推出补丁也需要时间。”

paras.en: Matthew Prince, CEO and cofounder of the web infrastructure giant Cloudflare, predicts that “it’s going to feel like the sky is falling for two years.” He suspects, though, that eventually AI acceleration will help defenders get on top of common vulnerabilities and better secure software in general. “These new threats and new security vulnerabilities won’t happen as often, and the background noise will actually tick down quite a bit,” he predicts.
paras.zh: 网络基础设施巨头Cloudflare的首席执行官兼联合创始人Matthew Prince预测，“在接下来的两年里，人们会感觉天要塌下来了。” 不过，他猜测，最终人工智能的加速发展将帮助防御者掌握常见的漏洞，并总体上更好地保护软件安全。他预测：“这些新的威胁和新的安全漏洞不会那么频繁地发生，背景噪音实际上会大大减少。”

paras.en: Still, the evidence that AI has fundamentally changed cybersecurity is mounting. This week the total number of vulnerabilities found in 2026 surpassed 100,000. To put that into perspective, in 2022, the final year before LLMs went mainstream, there were around 25,000 recorded vulnerabilities. And this year’s figure, with more than a month still to go, is double the combined totals of 2024 and 2025.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，越来越多的证据表明人工智能已经从根本上改变了网络安全。本周2026年发现的漏洞总数突破10万个。从这个角度来看，2022 年，即法学硕士成为主流之前的最后一年，记录了大约 25,000 个漏洞。距离今年还有一个多月时间，这一数字是 2024 年和 2025 年总和的两倍。

paras.en: In the last few days, researchers disclosed that they used AI to find critical vulnerabilities in PHP (for the second time), open source web server software NGINX, and programming language Java. Forbes also reported on 35 vulnerabilities across iPhones, Macs, iPads, Apple Watches, and other products from the company that had been discovered by researchers using AI.
paras.zh: 在过去几天里，研究人员披露，他们使用人工智能发现了PHP（第二次）、开源Web服务器软件NGINX和编程语言Java中的严重漏洞。《福布斯》还报道了研究人员使用人工智能发现的iPhone、Mac、iPad、Apple Watch以及该公司其他产品中存在的35个漏洞。

paras.en: There are important nuances to consider, though. Not all AI-discovered vulnerabilities are ultimately that impactful. “The number of vulnerabilities has certainly exploded, but the number of vulnerabilities that you need to care about has remained somewhat constant,” Slowik says. “The caveat is that the pace at which they’re being used or weaponized has increased dramatically.”
paras.zh: 不过，还有一些重要的细微差别需要考虑。并非所有人工智能发现的漏洞最终都会产生那么大的影响。 “漏洞的数量确实呈爆炸式增长，但您需要关注的漏洞数量却保持不变，”Slowik 说。 “需要注意的是，它们的使用或武器化速度急剧增加。”

paras.en: Only 300 vulnerabilities have been added to the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency’s catalog of exploited vulnerabilities this year—meaning the flaws that hackers successfully used to their advantage is far lower than the total number of discovered bugs. VulnCheck, which runs its own database, puts the number of known exploited vulnerabilities higher, at 1,500 so far in 2026, which is still just 1.5 percent of the total number of bugs discovered this year.
paras.zh: 今年，美国网络安全与基础设施安全局的被利用漏洞目录中仅新增了300个漏洞，这意味着黑客成功利用的漏洞数量远低于发现的漏洞总数。VulnCheck运营着自己的数据库，其统计的已知被利用漏洞数量更高，截至2026年目前已达1,500个，但这仍仅占今年发现的漏洞总数的1.5%。

paras.en: “What matters to me is that we avoid blaming AI when things go wrong,” says Schönherr, the German researcher. “Responsibility lies with the people and companies that choose to use AI and give it access to infrastructure, and there should be consequences and regulations that can be applied.”
paras.zh: “对我来说，重要的是，当出现问题时，我们要避免将责任归咎于人工智能。”德国研究员Schönherr表示。“责任在于选择使用人工智能并赋予其基础设施访问权限的个人和公司，应该有相应的后果和可适用的监管措施。”

paras.en: • Double take. After being impacted in the outages earlier this week, JPMorgan Chase confirmed that hackers have, in a separate incident, stolen some company data. The bank says “attackers accessed certain marketing data” that was held by third parties it works with. This “may” include customer information such as names and emails, JPMorgan Chase said in a statement reported by Reuters. The security incidents are not linked to any of the outages, though, the company said. Visa and Mastercard also had data impacted in attacks against their vendors.
paras.zh: • 双重考虑。在受到本周早些时候的中断影响后，摩根大通证实黑客在另一起事件中窃取了一些公司数据。该银行表示，“攻击者访问了与其合作的第三方持有的某些营销数据”。摩根大通在路透社报道的一份声明中表示，这“可能”包括姓名和电子邮件等客户信息。不过，该公司表示，安全事件与任何停电无关。 Visa 和 Mastercard 的数据也因针对其供应商的攻击而受到影响。

paras.en: • Police in the Netherlands revealed that they’ve thwarted several “attempts at violence” directed toward customers of the digital bank Revolut. In September the fintech company was reportedly compromised, with customer data being stolen. The National Police Corps published a statement saying they had made several arrests “which can be linked to the data theft.” It’s unclear who was being targeted, but over the last few years there has been an increase in physical attacks (sometimes known as “wrench attacks”) against wealthy cryptocurrency holders, who are forced to hand over money while being held hostage.
paras.zh: • 荷兰警方透露，他们挫败了数起针对数字银行 Revolut 客户的“暴力企图”。据报道，9 月份这家金融科技公司遭到入侵，客户数据被盗。国家警察总队发表声明称，他们逮捕了几名“可能与数据盗窃有关的人”。目前尚不清楚谁是攻击目标，但在过去几年中，针对富有的加密货币持有者的物理攻击（有时称为“扳手攻击”）有所增加，他们被迫在被扣为人质的情况下交出资金。

paras.en: • Confirm and deny. The UK government has been forced by a court ruling to admit that it ordered Apple to circumvent its own encryption and access customer iCloud data. British officials had maintained it would damage national security to confirm that it had issued Apple a “technical capability notice” last year—under British laws, the notices are supposed to be shrouded in secrecy and not talked about in public. However, as Computer Weekly reports, the existence of the order was widely known, with top Trump officials publicly criticizing it and even UK government officials allegedly briefing newspapers about the order.
paras.zh: • 确认和否认。法庭裁决迫使英国政府承认，它命令苹果公司规避其自身的加密技术并访问客户的 iCloud 数据。英国官员坚称，确认去年向苹果发出“技术能力通知”会损害国家安全——根据英国法律，这些通知应该保密，不得在公开场合谈论。然而，正如《计算机周刊》报道的那样，该命令的存在已广为人知，特朗普高级官员公开批评该命令，甚至据称英国政府官员也向报纸通报了该命令。

paras.en: Spotted something we should include next week? Let us know at [email protected]. And stay safe out there.
paras.zh: 您发现了我们下周应该纳入的内容吗？请通过 [email protected] 告知我们。祝您平安。

articles.title: Ariana Grande Recalls ‘Wildest Place’ She’s Heard Her Music Playing: ‘Getting a Bikini Wax’
articles.author: Ashley Iasimone

paras.en: Ariana Grande has a funny story about the time her song started playing mid-bikini wax.
paras.zh: 阿丽亚娜·格兰德 (Ariana Grande) 有一个有趣的故事，讲述她的歌曲开始在比基尼中蜡上播放的时间。

paras.en: She recalled the slightly awkward encounter in a new video segment with Focker-in-Law co-star Beanie Feldstein ahead of the comedy’s Nov. 25 opening in movie theaters. Grande (who plays Olivia Jones in the film) and Feldstein (Samantha Focker) sat down for a casual on-camera art session/Q&A with Harper’s Bazaar in which they painted pictures for each other.
paras.zh: 在这部喜剧片于11月25日在影院上映之前，她在一段与《福克尔一家》的合作演员比妮·费尔德斯坦（Beanie Feldstein）共同录制的新视频中，回忆了那次略显尴尬的邂逅。格兰德（在片中饰演奥利维亚·琼斯）和费尔德斯坦（萨曼莎·福克）坐下来，与《时尚芭莎》进行了一次轻松的镜头前艺术创作/问答环节，她们为对方画了画。

paras.en: “What’s the wildest place you’ve heard your own song playing?” Grande was asked mid-interview.
paras.zh: “您在哪里听到过自己的歌曲在最意想不到的地方播放？” 采访进行到一半时，格兰德被问到这个问题。

paras.en: “Yeah, I was one time getting a bikini wax,” she answered without hesitation, as seen in the video clip below.
paras.zh: “是的，有一次我在做比基尼脱毛蜡，”她毫不犹豫地回答，如下面的视频剪辑所示。

paras.en: “Yeah, I was, and this song came on,” continued Grande, who this week was nominated for four Grammys, including a song of the year nod for “hate that i made you love me.”
paras.zh: “是的，我是，这首歌出现了，”格兰德继续说道，他本周获得了四项格莱美奖提名，其中包括一首年度歌曲“hate that i made you love me”。

paras.en: “I didn’t think she knew who I was at all,” added Grande of the woman waxing her. “I never assume anyone does, and she was, you know, doing her work at her job and my song came on.”
paras.zh: “我认为她根本不知道我是谁，”格兰德在谈到给她打蜡的女人时补充道。 “我从不认为有人会这样做，你知道，她正在做她的工作，我的歌就开始了。”

paras.en: The pop star/actress reenacted the esthetician’s reaction to unexpectedly hearing an Ariana Grande song play while waxing Ariana Grande, and the intimate little moment they shared through facial expressions.
paras.zh: 这位流行明星/女演员重现了美容师在为阿丽亚娜·格兰德（Ariana Grande）脱毛时意外听到阿丽亚娜·格兰德歌曲的反应，以及她们通过面部表情分享的亲密小瞬间。

paras.en: “And she was like, ‘And my kids love your show, by the way,'” Grande recalled, sharing that her own response was, “Oh, perfect.”
paras.zh: “她说，‘顺便说一句，我的孩子们喜欢你的节目，’”格兰德回忆道，她自己的回答是，“哦，完美。”

paras.en: “You know, it was just very, it was wonderful. I love women and being a woman. It was very bonding,” she said.
paras.zh: “你知道，那真是太棒了。我爱女人，也爱身为女人。这非常有联系，”她说。

paras.en: Focker-in-Law, the latest installment of the Meet the Parents franchise and the family hijinks to come when the Focker and Byrnes families are involved, reprises Robert De Niro’s role as Jack Byrnes and Ben Stiller’s as Greg Focker opposite Grande, who’s introduced as the fiance of Greg’s now-grown son, Henry Focker (Skyler Gisondo). Feldstein joins the cast as Greg’s daughter.
paras.zh: 《福克姻缘》是《拜见父母》系列的最新一部，当福克和伯恩斯家族参与其中时，家庭狂欢即将到来，罗伯特·德尼罗（Robert De Niro）饰演杰克·伯恩斯（Jack Byrnes），本·斯蒂勒（Ben Stiller）饰演格雷格·福克（Greg Focker），与格兰德（Grande）演对手戏，格兰德被介绍为格雷格现已长大的儿子亨利·福克（斯凯勒·吉桑多饰）的未婚夫。费尔德斯坦加入演员阵容，饰演格雷格的女儿。

articles.title: BTS, ENHYPEN, BIGBANG & CORTIS Are Big Winners of 2026 MAMA Awards
articles.author: Paul Grein

paras.en: BTS, ENHYPEN, BIGBANG and CORTIS were the big winners of the 2026 MAMA Awards, which were held Friday and Saturday (Nov. 20-21) at the Kyocera Dome Osaka, in Japan. The awards streamed live worldwide on CJ ENM’s Mnet Plus platform.
paras.zh: BTS、ENHYPEN、BIGBANG 和 CORTIS 是 2026 年 MAMA Awards 的大赢家，该颁奖典礼于周五和周六（11 月 20 日至 21 日）在日本大阪京瓷巨蛋举行。该奖项通过 CJ ENM 的 Mnet Plus 平台在全球直播。

paras.en: BTS won artist of the year, best male group and album of the year for ARIRANG. They also ranked in the top 10 for fans’ choice male and song of the year for “SWIM.”
paras.zh: BTS 凭借《ARIRANG》荣获年度艺人奖、最佳男团奖和年度专辑奖。他们还凭借《SWIM》跻身粉丝选择的年度男歌手和年度歌曲前十名。

paras.en: ENHYPEN won fans’ choice of the year, favorite MCD Stage and also ranked in the top 10 for fans’ choice male.
paras.zh: ENHYPEN获得了年度粉丝选择奖、最喜爱的MCD舞台奖，并跻身粉丝选择男演员前十名。

paras.en: Both groups have topped the all-genre Billboard 200 album chart this year. BTS led for three weeks in April with ARIRANG. ENHYPEN was on top for one week in September with The Sin: Bliss.
paras.zh: 两个乐队都在今年的 Billboard 200 专辑排行榜上名列前茅。 BTS 在 4 月份凭借 ARIRANG 领先三周。 ENHYPEN 凭借《罪孽：极乐》在 9 月份连续一周位居榜首。

paras.en: BIGBANG won music visionary of the year and best music video, and also ranked in the top 10 for fans’ choice male. Taeyang of BIGBANG also won best dance performance male solo with “LIVE FAST DIE SLOW.”
paras.zh: BIGBANG获得了年度音乐梦想家和最佳音乐录影带，并且还进入了粉丝选择的男性前十名。 BIGBANG太阳还凭借《LIVE FAST DIE SLOW》获得最佳舞蹈男独唱奖。

paras.en: CORTIS won song of the year and best dance performance male group with “REDRED.” CORTIS also ranked in the top 10 for fans’ choice male.
paras.zh: CORTIS 凭借《REDRED》荣获年度歌曲奖和最佳舞蹈表演男团奖。 CORTIS 也跻身粉丝评选的男性前十名。

paras.en: Yeonjun of TOMORROW X TOGETHER won best male artist. The group also made the top 10 for fans’ choice male.
paras.zh: TOMORROW X TOGETHER的延俊荣获最佳男艺人奖。该组合还进入了粉丝选择的男团前十名。

paras.en: Soyeon of i-dle won best female artist. That group also made the top 10 for fans’ choice female.
paras.zh: i-dle的Soyeon荣获最佳女艺人奖。该组合还进入了粉丝选择的女性前十名。

paras.en: ALPHA DRIVE ONE and TUIDE were co-winners for best new artist.
paras.zh: ALPHA DRIVE ONE 和 TUIDE 共同获得最佳新人奖。

paras.en: Music released between Oct. 1, 2025, and Sept. 30, 2026 was eligible for this year’s awards.
paras.zh: 2025年10月1日至2026年9月30日期间发行的音乐有资格获得今年的奖项。

articles.title: Gorillaz Celebrate Mexico’s ‘Revolutionary Spirit’ at Corona Capital, Bring Out Johnny Marr and Trueno
articles.author: Isabela Raygoza

paras.en: Gorillaz returned to Mexico City on Friday (Nov. 20) for the first time in eight years, headlining the opening day of Corona Capital. During the long-awaited show, frontman Damon Albarn praised the country’s “revolutionary spirit.” Guitarist Johnny Marr and Argentine rapper Trueno joined the band as special guests — and Albarn also gave a shoutout to Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum.
paras.zh: Gorillaz 于周五（11 月 20 日）八年来首次回到墨西哥城，成为 Corona Capital 开业当天的头条新闻。在期待已久的演出中，主唱达蒙·阿尔本赞扬了这个国家的“革命精神”。吉他手约翰尼·马尔和阿根廷说唱歌手特鲁诺作为特邀嘉宾加入了乐队，阿尔巴恩还向墨西哥总统克劳迪娅·谢因鲍姆表示感谢。

paras.en: Last week, Sheinbaum traveled to Shenzhen, China, for the 2026 Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, flying economy alongside other passengers. The decision made waves on Chinese social media — and came up again Friday at the popular Mexican festival, where 72,000 people packed the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez, according to promoter Ocesa.
paras.zh: 上周，辛鲍姆与其他乘客一起乘坐经济舱前往中国深圳参加 2026 年亚太经合组织 (APEC) 峰会。这一决定在中国社交媒体上引起了轰动，据发起人 Ocesa 称，周五在受欢迎的墨西哥音乐节上，这一决定再次出现，当时有 72,000 人挤满了罗德里格斯赛车场。

paras.en: “I f— with Mexico because you have a revolutionary spirit here,” Albarn told the crowd. “This is an inspirational country, and I don’t know too much about your president, but the fact that she traveled economy class, for me, is a really important… It’s a statement, you know? So, I salute you all.”
paras.zh: “我喜欢墨西哥，因为这里有革命精神，”阿尔巴恩对人群说。 “这是一个鼓舞人心的国家，我对你们的总统了解不多，但对我来说，她乘坐经济舱这一事实非常重要……这是一个声明，你知道吗？所以，我向你们所有人致敬。”

paras.en: Albarn made the comment while wearing a red beret and military-style jacket, an image that fit the occasion: Mexico’s Revolution Day, observed every Nov. 20 to mark the start of the 1910 armed uprising against Porfirio Díaz, who had been in power for more than 30 years.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴恩戴着红色贝雷帽，穿着军装风格的夹克发表这番言论，这一形象与墨西哥革命日相契合。每年 11 月 20 日都是墨西哥革命日，纪念 1910 年针对掌权 30 多年的波菲里奥·迪亚斯 (Porfirio Díaz) 的武装起义的开始。

paras.en: Earlier in the set, Johnny Marr joined the band for “The Empty Dream Machine” and “Casablanca”; he played on the studio versions of both on Gorillaz’s The Mountain (2026). He also performed “The Plastic Guru” and “The Sweet Prince,” which also appear on the album.
paras.zh: 早些时候，约翰尼·马尔加入了乐队的“The Empty Dream Machine”和“Casablanca”；他在 Gorillaz 的 The Mountain (2026) 中演奏了这两首歌曲的录音室版本。他还表演了《The Plastic Guru》和《The Sweet Prince》，这些歌曲也出现在专辑中。

paras.en: Trueno, meanwhile, joined the collective — formed 28 years ago by Albarn, former frontman of Blur, and illustrator Jamie Hewlett — for “THE MANIFESTO,” their collaboration from The Mountain. He also freestyled during “Clint Eastwood,” the song that closed the set.
paras.zh: 与此同时，Trueno 也加入了这个由 Blur 前主唱 Albarn 和插画家 Jamie Hewlett 于 28 年前组建的集体，他们在 The Mountain 合作推出了《THE MANIFESTO》。他还在片尾曲《克林特·伊斯特伍德》中即兴表演。

paras.en: When Trueno shouted “¡Viva México, cabrones!” during “Clint Eastwood,” Albarn burst out laughing and kept singing offbeat as he tried to hold it together. Trueno also used the stage to hype up his favorite soccer team, Club Atlético Boca Juniors, proudly wearing the club’s blue-and-gold jersey.
paras.zh: 当特鲁诺高喊“墨西哥万岁，卡布罗内斯！”时在演唱《克林特·伊斯特伍德》时，阿尔本突然大笑起来，并继续唱着另类的歌曲，试图让自己平静下来。特鲁诺还利用舞台宣传他最喜欢的足球队博卡青年竞技俱乐部，他自豪地穿着俱乐部的蓝金色球衣。

paras.en: Mexican singer Luisa Almaguer was another special guest, joining Gorillaz for “Latin Simone (¿Qué Pasa Contigo?),” the 2001 song originally sung by the late Cuban star Ibrahim Ferrer for the band’s self-titled debut album. Her appearance made for an emotional moment with the crowd. Almaguer previously took part in Albarn’s Africa Express project and was chosen to open Gorillaz’s Latin American tour in November and December.
paras.zh: 墨西哥歌手 Luisa Almaguer 是另一位特邀嘉宾，与 Gorillaz 一起演唱了“Latin Simone (¿Qué Pasa Contigo?)”，这首歌曲最初由已故古巴明星易卜拉欣·费雷尔 (Ibrahim Ferrer) 在 2001 年为乐队的同名首张专辑演唱。她的出现给人群带来了激动人心的时刻。 Almaguer 此前曾参与 Albarn 的 Africa Express 项目，并被选为 Gorillaz 11 月和 12 月拉丁美洲巡演的开场嘉宾。

paras.en: The British collective also welcomed singer Kara Jackson for “Orange County,” U.S. rapper Bootie Brown for “Dirty Harry” and “Stylo,” and MC Black Thought for “The Sad God.”
paras.zh: 这个英国组合还邀请了歌手卡拉·杰克逊（Kara Jackson）出演《橙县》（Orange County），美国说唱歌手布蒂·布朗（Booty Brown）出演《肮脏的哈利》（Dirty Harry）和《Stylo》，以及MC Black Thought出演《悲伤的上帝》（The Sad God）。

paras.en: Alongside Gorillaz, other acts performing on the first day of Corona Capital included James Blake, Mumford & Sons, CHVRCHES, Yung Lean, The Kooks, Violet Grohl, Jamie xx, Durand Jones & The Indications, CMAT and Grace Ives.
paras.zh: 除了 Gorillaz 之外，在 Corona Capital 首日演出的其他艺人还包括 James Blake、Mumford & Sons、CHVRCHES、Yung Lean、The Kooks、Violet Grohl、Jamie xx、Durand Jones & The Inspirations、CMAT 和 Grace Ives。

paras.en: The festival’s second day, Saturday (Nov. 21), is set to feature Twenty One Pilots, The Offspring, Pierce the Veil, Underworld, Sébastien Tellier and Peaches, among others.
paras.zh: 音乐节的第二天，周六（11 月 21 日），将有二十一名飞行员、The Offspring、Pierce the Veil、Underworld、Sébastien Tellier 和 Peaches 等乐队参加。

articles.title: ‘Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’ Feasting With $120M+ in Franchise’s Box Office Comeback
articles.author: Ryan Gajewski

paras.en: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping has begun to ignite the box office.
paras.zh: 《饥饿游戏：收割日出》已经开始点燃票房。

paras.en: Lionsgate released the sixth film in the dystopian franchise in 4,018 North American theaters, and it grossed $56 million on Friday, including Thursday previews, as it heads for more than $120 million for the weekend. This would give it the fourth-best opening Friday in franchise history, besting 2015’s Mockingjay — Part 2 ($45.6 million) and 2023’s The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes ($19 million) but behind 2013’s Catching Fire ($70.9 million), 2012’s The Hunger Games ($67.2 million) and 2014’s Mockingjay — Part 1 ($55.1 million). Sunrise earned an A- CinemaScore from audiences, putting it below the A grades of the Jennifer Lawrence-led initial 2012 movie that kicked off the series and 2013’s Catching Fire but matching the A- grades of the two Mockingjay films.
paras.zh: 狮门影业在 4,018 家北美影院上映了反乌托邦系列电影的第六部电影，包括周四的预映在内，周五的票房收入为 5,600 万美元，周末票房收入将超过 1.2 亿美元。这将使其成为系列历史上第四好的周五首映票房，超过 2015 年的《嘲笑鸟 — 第 2 部分》（4,560 万美元）和 2023 年的《鸟与蛇之歌》（1,900 万美元），但落后于 2013 年的《星火燎原》（7,090 万美元）、2012 年的《饥饿游戏》（6,720 万美元）和 2014 年的《饥饿游戏》。 Mockingjay — 第 1 部分（5510 万美元）。 《日出》获得了观众的 A- 级 CinemaScore 评分，低于 2012 年詹妮弗·劳伦斯主演的系列首部影片和 2013 年的《星火燎原》的 A 级，但与两部《嘲笑鸟》电影的 A 级相当。

paras.en: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping will notch the fifth-biggest opening in Lionsgate history, as it also stands at No. 5 among 2026 domestic openings for all studios. It represents the highest-grossing launch for the careers of stars Glenn Close, Jesse Plemons, Kieran Culkin and Elle Fanning. This weekend’s haul also brings the Hunger Games franchise’s box office total to roughly $3.437 billion to make it the studio’s highest-grossing franchise ever, besting The Twilight Saga.
paras.zh: 《饥饿游戏：收割日出》将成为狮门影业历史上第五大首映影片，同时在所有电影公司 2026 年国内首映影片中排名第五。它是格伦·克洛斯、杰西·普莱蒙、基兰·卡尔金和艾丽·范宁等明星职业生涯中票房收入最高的电影。本周末的票房成绩也使《饥饿游戏》系列的票房总额达到约 34.37 亿美元，超越《暮光之城》，成为该工作室有史以来票房最高的系列电影。

paras.en: Lionsgate had projected The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping to gross north of $80 million, but other sources expected that it would collect between $100 million and $130 million, which now looks to be the case. Adapting author Suzanne Collins’ prequel novel that was published last year, director Francis Lawrence‘s movie carries a production budget of roughly $150 million as it revitalizes the franchise in telling a story set 24 years before the events of Collins’ original 2008 book.
paras.zh: 狮门影业曾预计《饥饿游戏：收割日出》的票房收入将超过 8000 万美元，但其他消息来源预计该片的票房收入将在 1 亿至 1.3 亿美元之间，现在看来确实如此。这部电影改编自作家苏珊·柯林斯去年出版的前传小说，导演弗朗西斯·劳伦斯的制作预算约为 1.5 亿美元，讲述了柯林斯 2008 年原著中发生的事件 24 年前的故事，为该系列注入了新的活力。

paras.en: This opening represents a major comeback for the series after registering its lowest-performing entry with 2023 prequel The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes, given that Sunrise on the Reaping is looking to open with more than double its launch. Starring Tom Blyth, Rachel Zegler and Hunter Schafer, Songbirds & Snakes — telling the backstory for the villainous President Snow, played by Ralph Fiennes in the new movie — disappointed, opening to $44 million domestically for the weekend before ending its run with $166.4 million domestically and a global sum of $361.8 million. It earned a B+ CinemaScore, the lowest for the franchise.
paras.zh: 鉴于《收割日出》预计开播量将是其发行量的两倍以上，此次开映代表着该系列在 2023 年前传《饥饿游戏：鸟蛇之歌》创下表现最低的作品后的一次重大卷土重来。由汤姆·布莱斯、雷切尔·齐格勒和亨特·谢弗主演的《鸣禽与蛇》讲述了拉尔夫·费因斯在新电影中扮演的反派斯诺总统的背景故事，但令人失望的是，周末首映票房为 4,400 万美元，最终以 1.664 亿美元的国内票房和 3.618 亿美元的全球票房收官。它获得了 B+ CinemaScore 评分，这是该系列电影中最低的评分。

paras.en: Sunrise on the Reaping holds a 67 percent critical score on Rotten Tomatoes, lagging behind the franchise’s first four movies but besting the 64 percent approval for Songbirds & Snakes. The new film has a franchise-best 95 audience score on Rotten Tomatoes. In his review for The Hollywood Reporter, chief film critic David Rooney wrote that it “delivers on emotion and brutal spectacle.”
paras.zh: 《收割日出》在烂番茄上获得了 67% 的好评率，落后于该系列的前四部电影，但超过了《鸟与蛇》64% 的好评率。这部新片在烂番茄上获得了 95 分的最高观众评分。首席影评人大卫·鲁尼在《好莱坞报道》的评论中写道，它“传递了情感和残酷的场面”。

paras.en: The movie opened the day after the launch of the hotly anticipated video game Grand Theft Auto 6, which does not appear to be preventing the film from thriving. Joseph Zada stars as Haymitch Abernathy, providing the backstory for the character whom Woody Harrelson brought to life in the first four movies. The cast for Sunrise on the Reaping also includes Mckenna Grace, Whitney Peak and Maya Hawke.
paras.zh: 这部电影在备受期待的电子游戏《侠盗猎车手 6》发布后的第二天上映，但这似乎并没有阻止这部电影的蓬勃发展。约瑟夫·扎达 (Joseph Zada) 饰演黑密斯·阿伯内西 (Haymitch Abernathy)，为伍迪·哈里森 (Woody Harrelson) 在前四部电影中饰演的角色提供了背景故事。 《收割日出》的演员阵容还包括麦肯娜·格蕾斯、惠特尼·皮克和玛雅·霍克。

paras.en: Among other weekend titles, Amazon MGM Studios expanded I Play Rocky to 2,477 North American locations after two frames in limited release. Peter Farrelly’s Rocky origin story earned $3.8 million on Friday, including Thursday previews, as it heads for an estimated $9.3 million. Starring Anthony Ippolito as a young Sylvester Stallone, I Play Rocky landed a rare A+ CinemaScore, becoming only the second release this year to do so (after April’s A Great Awakening).
paras.zh: 在其他周末游戏中，亚马逊米高梅工作室在限量发行两帧后，将《I Play Rocky》扩展到北美 2,477 个地点。彼得·法拉利的《洛奇》起源故事周五获得了 380 万美元的票房（包括周四的预览），预估票房将达到 930 万美元。 Starring Anthony Ippolito as a young Sylvester Stallone, I Play Rocky landed a rare A+ CinemaScore, becoming only the second release this year to do so (after April’s A Great Awakening).

paras.en: I Play Rocky holds an 89 percent approval rating from critics on Rotten Tomatoes and a 98 percent audience score. Rooney’s review described it as a “big-hearted movie about moviemaking, if not an artful one.”
paras.zh: 《我玩洛奇》在烂番茄上获得了 89% 的评论家支持率和 98% 的观众评分。鲁尼的评论将其描述为“一部关于电影制作的慷慨电影，即使不是一部巧妙的电影”。

paras.en: In its sophomore frame, Paramount’s horror-tinged holiday offering Ebenezer is likely to claim third place with roughly $8.2 million for a decline of around 57 percent, bringing its domestic cume to $33 million. Johnny Depp marks his studio comeback vehicle with director Ti West’s reimagining of Charles Dickens’ A Christmas Carol, which opened atop last weekend’s box office.
paras.zh: 在其第二部影片中，派拉蒙的恐怖片《Ebenezer》很可能以约 820 万美元的票房收入位居第三，但下降幅度约为 57%，使其国内收入达到 3,300 万美元。约翰尼·德普 (Johnny Depp) 凭借导演蒂·韦斯特 (Ti West) 重新演绎查尔斯·狄更斯 (Charles Dickens) 的《圣诞颂歌》(A Christmas Carol) 标志着他的工作室复出，该片于上周末首映票房冠军。

paras.en: Continuing to draw families in its third weekend is Warner Bros.’ The Cat in the Hat, as the animated adaptation of Dr. Seuss’ classic children’s book is expected to gross around $7 million for a domestic total of $47.2 million. This marks a respectable decline of roughly 38 percent for directors Erica Rivinoja and Alessandro Carloni’s movie that features the voice of Bill Hader in the lead role. It is set to face fresh competition in the animated space from Disney’s Hexed over the forthcoming Thanksgiving frame.
paras.zh: 华纳兄弟出品的《戴帽子的猫》在上映第三周继续吸引家庭观众，这部根据苏斯博士经典儿童读物改编的动画电影预计票房收入约为 700 万美元，国内总票房为 4,720 万美元。这标志着埃丽卡·里维诺贾 (Erica Rivinoja) 和亚历山德罗·卡洛尼 (Alessandro Carloni) 导演的由比尔·哈德尔 (Bill Hader) 主演的电影的票房收入大幅下降了约 38%。在即将到来的感恩节框架中，它将在动画领域面临来自迪士尼 Hexed 的新竞争。

paras.en: Gkids and Toho’s Godzilla Minus Zero is likely to close out the top five with $2.9 million in its third weekend to reach a domestic cume of around $54.7 million.
paras.zh: Gkids 和 Toho 的《哥斯拉负零》很可能在第三周末以 290 万美元的票房挤进前五名，国内票房收入约为 5,470 万美元。

paras.en: Focus Features opened Elsinore in six theaters in New York and Los Angeles, with director Simon Stone’s Oscar hopeful likely to collect approximately $240,000 to average $40,000 per screen. Andrew Scott stars in the biographical film about Scottish actor Ian Charleson, who navigates personal challenges while preparing for a pivotal performance of Hamlet. After earning acclaim at Telluride and TIFF, Elsinore holds an 87 percent rating from critics on Rotten Tomatoes, with Rooney deeming it “a hymn to the theater, powered by a towering lead turn.”
paras.zh: 焦点影业在纽约和洛杉矶的六家影院开设了《埃尔西诺》，导演西蒙·斯通的奥斯卡有望获得每场约 24 万美元到平均 4 万美元的收入。安德鲁·斯科特主演了一部关于苏格兰演员伊恩·查尔斯森的传记电影，他在准备哈姆雷特的关键表演时应对个人挑战。在特柳赖德和 TIFF 上获得好评后，《埃尔西诺》在烂番茄上获得了 87% 的评价，鲁尼认为它是“一首由高耸的主角转向推动的剧院赞歌”。

paras.en: Toward the bottom of the top 10 is Ramayana: Rise of a Legend, with Sony Pictures distributing the Prime Focus Studios religious epic that is expected to gross $2 million for its third weekend to bring its domestic take to $28.3 million through Sunday. Director Nitesh Tiwari’s project becomes the highest-grossing Indian film ever at the North American box office.
paras.zh: 排在前十名最后的是《罗摩衍那：传奇崛起》，索尼影业发行了 Prime Focus Studios 的这部宗教史诗片，预计第三周末票房收入为 200 万美元，到周日国内票房收入将达到 2,830 万美元。导演尼泰什·蒂瓦里 (Nitesh Tiwari) 的项目成为北美票房史上票房最高的印度电影。

paras.en: With Thanksgiving arriving next weekend, the holiday frame brings an array of new options, including Disney’s Hexed, Universal’s Meet the Parents sequel Focker-in-Law, Netflix’s The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth and Angel’s biographical Hershey.
paras.zh: 随着下周末感恩节的到来，节日框架带来了一系列新的选择，包括迪士尼的《Hexed》、环球影业的《拜见父母》续集《Focker-in-Law》、Netflix 的《克里夫·布斯的进一步错误冒险》和安吉尔的传记《好时》。

articles.title: How Raising Cane’s Became an A-List Magnet
articles.author: Lexy Perez

paras.en: There’s a new billionaire in town — and this one’s ready to party.
paras.zh: 镇上出现了一位新的亿万富翁，而这位亿万富翁已经准备好参加派对了。

paras.en: Todd Graves, founder and CEO of chicken fingers chain Raising Cane’s, has quickly gained a reputation for hosting Hollywood’s hottest events, splashing out for A-list gatherings around major sporting events and awards shows.
paras.zh: 鸡指连锁店 Raising Cane’s 的创始人兼首席执行官托德·格雷夫斯 (Todd Graves) 很快就因主办好莱坞最热门的活动而闻名，在重大体育赛事和颁奖典礼周围挥金如土地参加一线明星聚会。

paras.en: During last summer’s World Cup, the 54-year-old Louisiana native rented out stadium suites nationwide, throwing parties with guests including Woody Harrelson, Sacha Baron Cohen, Mick Jagger, Halle Berry, Jamie Foxx, Ashton Kutcher, Adam Brody, Florence Pugh, Alix Earle, Tate McRae and Matt Damon (during opening weekend of The Odyssey, no less). He also enlisted Tiffany Haddish to serve chicken fingers and host Raising Cane’s-branded interviews backstage at the Emmys, persuaded Adrien Brody to paint a custom mural for his Times Square store and is getting the biggest winners across sports and awards season to come by his restaurants immediately after their victories, establishing a tradition to rival the post-awards In-N-Out run.
paras.zh: 去年夏天的世界杯期间，这位 54 岁的路易斯安那人在全国范围内出租了体育场套房，与伍迪·哈里森、萨莎·拜伦·科恩、米克·贾格尔、哈莉·贝瑞、杰米·福克斯、阿什顿·库彻、亚当·布罗迪、弗洛伦斯·皮尤、阿利克斯·厄尔、泰特·麦克雷和马特·达蒙等嘉宾举办派对（在《奥德赛》首映周末期间也不例外）。他还邀请蒂芙尼·哈迪什 (Tiffany Haddish) 为他提供鸡柳，并在艾美奖后台主持 Raising Cane 品牌采访，说服阿德里安·布罗迪 (Adrien Brody) 为他的时代广场商店绘制定制壁画，并邀请体育界和颁奖季的最大赢家在获胜后立即来到他的餐厅，建立了与颁奖后 In-N-Out 竞争的传统。

paras.en: How exactly did a brand serving $15 chicken finger meals — whose nearest competitor is Chick-fil-A — become such a popular collab magnet for the rich and famous? Graves says the secret sauce is his own up-by-the-bootstraps backstory, which he sees as the ultimate icebreaker: Having worked as a boilermaker in California oil refineries and as a salmon fisherman as a young man, he went on to launch his fast food empire — which 30 years later, according to Forbes, has landed him a net worth of $20 billion.
paras.zh: 一个提供 15 美元鸡条餐的品牌（其最接近的竞争对手是 Chick-fil-A）到底是如何成为富人和名人如此受欢迎的合作磁石的？格雷夫斯说，秘诀在于他自己的白手起家的背景故事，他认为这是最终的破冰之道：他曾在加州炼油厂担任锅炉工，年轻时曾担任鲑鱼渔民，后来创办了自己的快餐帝国——据《福布斯》报道，30年后，他的净资产已达到200亿美元。

paras.en: Graves says he does not pay celebrities to attend his events but instead provides a high-end, all-inclusive outing. “I want it to be like, ‘I want to go hang out with Todd and go to this event.’ It’s first-class, great hotels, transportation, security,” Graves says of his pitch. “No one in there wants anything from them but friendship, hanging out.”
paras.zh: 格雷夫斯表示，他不会花钱请名人参加他的活动，而是提供高端、包罗万象的郊游活动。 “我希望它就像，‘我想和托德一起出去玩，参加这个活动。’这是一流的、很棒的酒店、交通和安全，”格雷夫斯在谈到他的推销时说道。 “那里没有人想要从他们那里得到任何东西，除了友谊和闲逛。”

paras.en: He adds that on top of the fact that “the dinners are great, the parties are fun, there’s DJs and performers that they like,” it’s important to him to take out the corporate element, with no business partners in his rooms “hitting people up or asking for selfies.”
paras.zh: 他补充说，除了“晚餐很棒，聚会很有趣，有他们喜欢的 DJ 和表演者”之外，对他来说，去掉公司元素也很重要，他的房间里没有商业伙伴“打人或要求自拍”。

paras.en: There is a catch: Graves does ask his guests to post on their social media channels, telling them up front that ” ‘It helps me get a return on this and we can keep doing great events,’ and they’re all cool about doing that.” Haddish and Snoop Dogg have been particularly enthusiastic posters for the brand, while on the Raising Cane’s channel, Tom Brady declared its Fanatics Fest event (which featured a dunk tank of Cane’s sauce) “my favorite part of the entire week.”
paras.zh: 有一个问题：格雷夫斯确实要求他的客人在他们的社交媒体频道上发帖，预先告诉他们“这有助于我获得回报，我们可以继续举办伟大的活动，”而且他们都乐于这样做。 Haddish 和 Snoop Dogg 一直是该品牌特别热情的海报，而在 Raising Cane 的频道上，Tom Brady 宣称其 Fanatics Fest 活动（以一罐 Cane 酱为特色）是“我整周最喜欢的部分”。

paras.en: Graves confirms that the company measures impressions after every event, and “it’s amazing for sales,” he adds. “You see long-term loyalty because [customers] are like, ‘The person that I really love and respect loves Cane’s and actually wants to hang out with the founder.’ “
paras.zh: 格雷夫斯证实，该公司在每次活动后都会衡量印象，“这对销售来说是惊人的，”他补充道。 “你会看到长期的忠诚度，因为[客户]会说，‘我真正爱和尊重的人喜欢 Cane’s，而且实际上想和创始人一起出去玩。’”

paras.en: The CEO, who this year bought a home in the Hollywood Hills for a reported $23 million, says he doesn’t do cold calls to invite people he doesn’t know. “It looks like a branded thing,” he says, which, to be fair, it very much is, judging by the ubiquity of the chain’s logo in celebrities’ posts. Instead, he fills his events with stars with whom he is friendly. That helps him expand the Hollywood circle in a more organic way, through word-of-mouth. Damon, for instance, came to the Raising Cane’s World Cup celebrations because Casey Affleck, a friend of Graves’, vouched that the events were good.
paras.zh: 据报道，这位首席执行官今年以 2300 万美元的价格在好莱坞山买了一套房子，他表示，他不会主动打电话邀请不认识的人。 “它看起来像是一个品牌的东西，”他说，公平地说，从名人帖子中无处不在的连锁店标志来看，它确实是一个品牌。相反，他的活动中充满了与他友好的明星。这有助于他通过口碑以更有机的方式扩大好莱坞圈子。例如，达蒙参加了“举起手杖”的世界杯庆祝活动，因为格雷夫斯的朋友卡西·阿弗莱克保证这些活动很棒。

paras.en: Graves’ friend group also includes Adrien Brody — who showed off his artwork while Graves was hanging out at the actor’s home, leading to the idea to paint a custom piece for the New York store — and Teyana Taylor, who dropped by a Cane’s for a photo op after winning at the Golden Globes earlier this year. “We want to be part of culture when it happens,” he says, having organized the plan with Taylor before the awards show, getting her to come by before her night of parties. (These photo moments are executed as more traditional brand deals.)
paras.zh: 格雷夫斯的朋友圈中还包括阿德里安·布罗迪（Adrien Brody）——当格雷夫斯在演员家里闲逛时，他展示了自己的艺术作品，从而产生了为纽约商店绘制一件定制作品的想法——以及泰亚娜·泰勒（Teyana Taylor），后者在今年早些时候赢得金球奖后顺便去 Cane’s 拍照留念。 “当它发生时，我们希望成为文化的一部分，”他说，他在颁奖典礼前与泰勒一起制定了计划，并让她在派对之夜前过来。 （这些照片时刻是作为更传统的品牌交易执行的。）

paras.en: The Raising Cane’s founder says he was on the road 260 days in 2025, and he doesn’t seem to be slowing down as the brand expands into Europe and begins to plan international events. (Baron Cohen is helping connect him to contacts in London, Graves says.) He also notes that despite his connections and financial status, he doesn’t have any aspirations to produce projects or be actively involved in Hollywood — though he does think another friend, Leonardo DiCaprio, should play him in the story of his life.
paras.zh: Raising Cane 的创始人表示，到 2025 年，他已经在路上 260 天了，随着该品牌向欧洲扩张并开始筹划国际活动，他似乎并没有放慢脚步。 （格雷夫斯说，拜伦·科恩正在帮助他联系伦敦的联系人。）他还指出，尽管他有联系和经济状况，但他并没有任何制作项目或积极参与好莱坞的愿望——尽管他确实认为另一位朋友莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥应该在他的人生故事中扮演他。

paras.en: But L.A. remains as much of a home base as Louisiana. “The town has so accepted me. [It’s] so diverse, so rich culturally. I love it,” Graves says. “So for me, [the goal] is just to keep meeting these great people. L.A. is so full of all these amazing people that I get inspired by.”
paras.zh: 但洛杉矶仍然像路易斯安那州一样是一个大本营。 “这个小镇非常接受我。[它]如此多元化，文化如此丰富。我喜欢它，”格雷夫斯说。 “所以对我来说，[目标]就是不断结识这些伟大的人。洛杉矶到处都是这些了不起的人，我受到了启发。”

articles.title: Hollywood’s Biggest Watch Nerds Are Obsessing Over These Indie Brands
articles.author: Lexy Perez

paras.en: Watchmaker Denis Flageollet founded De Bethune in 2002 with art collector David Zanetta. The DB25 Digitale reimagines digital time, with the hour individually displayed above minutes on a rotating disc, while a spherical moon-phase function is positioned in the center of a dial crafted in blued titanium, all set in a 42mm titanium case. At The 1916 Company, Manhattan Beach.
paras.zh: 制表师 Denis Flageollet 于 2002 年与艺术收藏家 David Zanetta 共同创立了 De Bethune。 DB25 Digitale 重新诠释了数字时间，在旋转圆盘上将小时单独显示在分钟上方，而球形月相功能则位于蓝钛合金表盘中央，全部镶嵌在 42 毫米钛金属表壳中。曼哈顿海滩 The 1916 Company。

paras.en: Watchmaker Felix Baumgartner and chief designer Martin Frei co-founded Urwerk in 1997, naming the brand for the Mesopotamian city of Ur, where Sumerians pioneered timekeeping. The UR-300 Time Quantum employs a sculptural approach to time via a T-shape metal frame, on which numbers rotate and rearrange to display hours and minutes. At Urwerk USA, Beverly Hills.
paras.zh: 制表师 Felix Baumgartner 和首席设计师 Martin Frei 于 1997 年共同创立了 Urwerk，以美索不达米亚城市乌尔 (Ur) 命名该品牌，这里是苏美尔人开创计时技术的地方。 UR-300 Time Quantum 通过 T 形金属框架采用雕塑般的时间方法，数字在框架上旋转和重新排列以显示小时和分钟。位于美国比佛利山庄的 Urwerk。

paras.en: A legend in watch circles, Jean-Claude Biver launched his eponymous brand in 2023 — his latest, the 38mm Biver AB, blends brushed and polished steel, while the dial is crafted of solid 18-karat gold beneath a dark gray treatment. Exclusively at Material Good, New York City.
paras.zh: Jean-Claude Biver 是钟表界的传奇人物，于 2023 年推出了他的同名品牌——他的最新款 38 毫米 Biver AB 融合了拉丝和抛光钢，而表盘则采用深灰色处理的 18 克拉实心金制成。纽约市 Material Good 独家发售。

paras.en: Named after watchmaker François Czapek, who founded his firm in 1845, the Geneva-based brand was revived in 2015 to honor his legacy. The latest model, the 40.5mm Antarctique Tourbillon Victory Green, got its start as a bespoke order and now is available in a limited series of 10 numbered pieces, each one produced on demand. At Cellini Jewelers, New York.
paras.zh: 这个总部位于日内瓦的品牌以制表师 François Czapek 的名字命名，他于 1845 年创立了自己的公司，并于 2015 年复兴，以纪念他的遗产。最新型号 40.5 毫米南极陀飞轮胜利绿腕表一开始是定制订单，现在限量 10 枚，每枚均按需生产。在纽约切利尼珠宝商 (Cellini Jewelers)。

paras.en: Master watch restorer Michel Parmigiani founded his firm in Fleurier, Switzerland, in 1996. This month, he won the Chronograph Prize at the 2026 Grand Prix d’Horlogerie de Genève, the Oscars of watchmaking, for the Tonda PF Chronographe Mystérieux — its styling is similar to this Toric Petite Seconde Platinum Morning Blue, which debuted in October. At Feldmar Watch Company, Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 钟表修复大师米歇尔·帕玛强尼 (Michel Parmigiani) 于 1996 年在瑞士弗勒里耶 (Fleurier) 创立了自己的公司。本月，他凭借 Tond PF Chronographe Mystérieux 腕表荣获被誉为制表业奥斯卡奖的 2026 年日内瓦钟表大奖赛计时码表奖，其造型与 10 月份推出的这款 Toric Petite Seconde Platinum Morning Blue 腕表类似。位于洛杉矶 Feldmar 手表公司。

paras.en: Geneva’s MB&F debuted in 2005 as a concept house, in which founder Maximilian Büsser would partner with independent watchmakers and artisans. Limited to 33 pieces, the LM1 EVO offers two separate time displays and an oversized flying balance wheel suspended above the movement. At MB&F Lab at Westime, Beverly Hills.
paras.zh: 日内瓦的 MB&F 于 2005 年作为概念公司首次亮相，创始人 Maximilian Büsser 将与独立制表师和工匠合作。 LM1 EVO 限量 33 枚，提供两个独立的时间显示和悬挂在机芯上方的超大飞行摆轮。位于比佛利山庄 Westtime 的 MB&F 实验室。

paras.en: Industrial designer Benoît Mintiens founded Ressence in 2010 in Antwerp, Belgium, crafting pieces that tell time using a system of orbiting, rotating discs. Weighing just 82 grams, the Type 10 DN is seamlessly crafted of two independent sections, allowing the movement to function while the display above is filled with oil. At Feldmar Watch Company, Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 工业设计师 Benoît Mintiens 于 2010 年在比利时安特卫普创立了 Ressence，利用轨道旋转圆盘系统制作能够报时的作品。 Type 10 DN 重量仅为 82 克，由两个独立部分无缝打造而成，允许机芯在上方显示屏充满油的情况下正常运行。位于洛杉矶 Feldmar 手表公司。

paras.en: Heinrich Moser founded his namesake brand in 1828; 174 years later, his great-grandson relaunched it in northern Switzerland. This Heritage Centre Seconds Espresso Fumé honors the early 20th century moment when wristwatches became the preferred timekeeping device over pocket watches. At Westime, Rodeo Drive.
paras.zh: Heinrich Moser 于 1828 年创立了同名品牌； 174 年后，他的曾孙在瑞士北部重新推出了它。这款 Heritage Centre Seconds Espresso Fumé 腕表旨在纪念 20 世纪初期，腕表成为取代怀表的首选计时设备。位于罗迪欧大道西时区。

articles.title: Anthropic’s record IPO collides with tech’s worst week on Wall Street since 2020

paras.en: Startup investor Ben Narasin is so jazzed about Anthropic's blockbuster IPO that he's planning a party later this month at his Silicon Valley home. Sake, vodka and Krug Champagne will be served. Each attendee will be given two jars of caviar.
paras.zh: 初创公司投资者本·纳拉辛 (Ben Narasin) 对 Anthropic 的重磅 IPO 非常感兴趣，他计划本月晚些时候在他位于硅谷的家中举办一场派对。供应清酒、伏特加和库克香槟。每位参加者将获得两罐鱼子酱。

paras.en: "This is a celebration of the most material, significant, and mind-blowingly awesome event that has ever happened in venture capital," Narasin, founding partner of Tenacity Venture Capital, told CNBC in an interview, adding that he didn't even invest in the company.
paras.zh: Tenacity Venture Capital 的创始合伙人 Narasin 在接受 CNBC 采访时表示：“这是对风险投资领域有史以来最重要、最重要、最令人惊叹的事件的庆祝。”他补充说，他甚至没有投资该公司。

paras.en: Anthropic raised a record $93.5 billion in its IPO and an additional $26 billion from tech giants that bought at the offer price. The stock gained 17% in its debut on Thursday, lifting Anthropic's market cap to $1.8 trillion and providing a much-needed windfall for Silicon Valley's startup ecosystem.
paras.zh: Anthropic 在 IPO 中筹集了创纪录的 935 亿美元资金，并从按发行价收购的科技巨头那里额外筹集了 260 亿美元资金。该股在周四首次亮相时上涨了 17%，将 Anthropic 的市值提升至 1.8 万亿美元，并为硅谷的初创生态系统提供了急需的意外之财。

paras.en: It was quite the split-screen moment on Wall Street, which spent the week in an AI-driven tailspin. Led by Nvidia's 23% plunge, which marked the stock's sharpest weekly pullback in 18 years, the Nasdaq slid 10% over the past five trading days in its worst week since the early days of Covid in 2020.
paras.zh: 这是华尔街的分屏时刻，整个星期都处于人工智能驱动的混乱之中。在英伟达股价暴跌 23%（标志着该股 18 年来最大幅度的每周回调）的带动下，纳斯达克指数在过去五个交易日内下跌了 10%，这是自 2020 年新冠疫情初期以来最糟糕的一周。
